2048: 2048 is a number puzzle where you slide tiles across a small board. When two matching tiles collide, they merge into one tile with a higher value, and your goal is to build up to the 2048 tile. The basic rules are simple to learn, but planning ahead matters a great deal.

Every slide places another tile on the grid, so the open space gradually shrinks. You need to think a few moves in advance and keep clear paths available so you don't get stuck. It's a game of patience and careful planning, and it suits anyone who enjoys working through numbers.
kobadoo-flags: Kobadoo Flags is a trivia game where you check how well you know your national flags. Your job is to remember flags, and the challenges get harder as you go. It is a fun way to train your memory and sharpen your thinking, and it suits anyone who loves flags or wants a bit of mental exercise while they play.

The game keeps things light but still gives your brain a workout. Because it asks you to hold flag designs in mind and recall them, you learn something new while you pass the time. If you enjoy geography, design, or simply a good quiz, this one is worth a look.
the-egg-stealing-master: Step into the role of a sneaky thief in this 3D stealth and collection game. Your task is to slip past watchful guards, grab rare eggs, and carry them back to your pen, where they hatch into pets you can look after. Once your animals are grown, sell them for coins and spend those coins on upgrades to your speed and on fancy trails. The faster you get, the closer you come to being the quickest thief around.
Movement works with WASD or a joystick. Get near an egg and press the action button or the E key to take it, then bring it home to hatch. Keep an eye on the guards as you go and steer clear of them.
bubble-wrap: Bubble Wrap is an idle clicker built around a 3D globe covered in hexagonal bubbles. You can spin the sphere and pop the bubbles yourself, or let your weapons take over while you watch. Coins build up as you go, and you can spend them on any of 38 weapons, from simple pins to absurd planet-wreckers.

Sweep the left mouse button across the globe to pop bubbles, and keep popping without pausing to build a combo. Drag with the right button to rotate the globe. On mobile, tap or hold to pop and drag with two fingers to rotate. Buy and upgrade weapons with your coins, fill the Rage ring to trigger Rage Mode for a burst of chaos, then crack the core of each world to reach the next one. Your progress keeps growing even when you step away.
bee-swarm: You play as a honeybee flying through a 3D simulation with idle arcade elements. The world is built from blocky voxel meadows, and your job is to collect bright pollen from blooming flowers, then return to the hive to turn it into golden honey.

Upgrade your bee's flight speed and how much cargo it can carry. Recruit hard-working helper bees that gather pollen automatically, so your swarm keeps growing and collecting even while you're away. On desktop, steer with WASD or the arrow keys and hold the left mouse button to fly. On mobile, a virtual joystick handles movement.
knock-your-mind: Knock Your Mind is a quirky puzzle title that throws tricky tasks and surprise turns at you. Your logic, creativity and sharp eye all get a workout while you tackle a range of brain teasers. Hidden clues often sit in plain sight, so look past the obvious and experiment with odd approaches. The answer might turn out simpler, or weirder, than you expected.
Each level presents a fresh challenge that asks you to think differently and see things anew.
screw-sort-3d: Screw Sort 3D is a puzzle game for people who enjoy taking mechanisms apart. Your job is to loosen the fasteners holding intricate contraptions together, including screws, bolts, and nuts. Study how each structure fits together, remove the fasteners, separate the pieces, and drop every part into the matching box. Careful observation and clear reasoning are needed throughout.

Every stage pushes your sense of space and your ability to work out a plan. Before you click anything, check the colors of the boxes on screen, then select only the fasteners that share those colors. Work through the parts in the right sequence, because a wrong move can cost you the run.
5-nights-at-tung-tung-hotel-horror-3d: This three-dimensional survival horror puts you on night shifts inside an eerie hotel. Your job is to keep watch on the cameras while you gather notes and objects around the building. Piece together what you find, and you will slowly uncover the secrets the hotel is hiding.

Walk with WASD or a joystick, and look around with the mouse or by swiping. Check the cameras, close doors, and manage your power while you use the items you come across. You need to make it through all five nights, and each night you must survive until morning. Finding the notes unlocks the endings, so you can work toward reaching one of them.
trick-your-brain-puzzle: Trick Your Brain Puzzle is a drag-and-drop adventure in which each decision counts. You work through awkward predicaments, dig up amusing secrets, and guide characters out of sticky spots by using objects in the right sequence, all while a countdown clock keeps ticking.

Controls are simple: tap, drag, and release items to act on the scene. Search for hints, clear away barriers, and work out the correct answer to finish every stage. Be careful, because a single misstep can trigger a laughable mishap. Reach your goals before the timer hits zero to win.
petdoku-cozy-puzzle-games: Petdoku combines two classic brain teasers into one new challenge. Part of the puzzle calls for the careful planning found in Minesweeper, and part draws on the number-matching fun of Sudoku. As you progress, a hidden map gradually comes into view, revealing the territory your pup likes to explore.

The controls are simple. A single tap marks a cell with an X, while a double tap places a dog in it. Dragging lets you mark several cells quickly, and swiping moves across cells to mark them as you go. If you make a mistake, undo reverses your last move, and hint offers help with the next step.
jelly-sandbox-playground: Jelly Sandbox is a 2D ragdoll playground where you build your own scenes and test out characters, guns, props, and vehicles. The physics feel true to life, so you can set up all kinds of interactions and see how they unfold. Knock characters into things, hurl items across the level, set off destruction, and observe the results as they happen. Nothing is scripted, and no missions or targets stand in your way.

Shape the level into a calm lab for quiet experiments, or turn it into a crowded battleground full of messy fights. Every item responds to hits, drops, and crashes, so no two setups play out quite the same. Pick what you want from the interface and drop it onto the scene, then drag things around and let the ragdolls react in real time. On a computer you steer everything with the mouse, and on a phone or tablet you use touch.
find-out-hidden-object: This free picture puzzle is a scavenger hunt where you study the list of items shown below, then tap each one you spot in the scene. Every picture you explore hides things to find, and you can try to finish each scene as fast as you can. The game features several lively maps, and you can unlock new ones for free by stepping into mystery locations and tracking down everything hidden there.

Hints are available whenever you get stuck, helping you pinpoint the target so you can tap it. You can zoom in and out and swipe across every corner of a map to look closely. Hundreds of hidden objects are waiting to be collected, and a scene is complete once you have gathered all of them. Fans of hidden object, spot-it, and point-and-click brain teasers should find plenty to enjoy here.
insect-clicker: Insect Clicker is a clicker game where each press multiplies your tarantula coins. You spend those coins on upgrades that raise what your insect produces, and you can buy new skins to aim for the title of the best insect in the world.

Controls are simple. On desktop, use the left mouse button to work with the in-game interface. On mobile, use your finger to interact with the same on-screen menus. The game is tagged as Clicker, Mouse, Easy and Idle.
tnt-sandbox: Think of TNT Sandbox as a block-based playground built in an obstacle-course style, where the aim is to wreck as much as you can with dynamite. You collect rewards for both setting off blasts and constructing things, and you can spend them on stronger TNT to make bigger messes. Fire spreads as well, so a single spark can catch both explosives and trees and carry across the map.

The world is generated at random and includes caves and stretches of water to explore before you start blowing it apart. On a computer, use WASD to move and the Space bar to jump. On a phone or tablet, drag the joystick to walk, tap the button in the lower right corner to jump, and swipe across the screen to turn the camera.
the-specimen-zero: Specimen Zero is a 3D horror game in which you find yourself in a strange place with no idea how you got there. Your last memory is of being abducted, and fear is weighing on you from the start. Something unusual and possibly hazardous has happened in this peculiar location, and you must work out how to leave the facility.
Sickly creatures move through the rooms, determined to kill you until you find a way out. You need to track down the keys that unlock doors, arm yourself with ammo and weapons, and
cod-duty-call-fps: Dive into COD Duty Call FPS, a first-person shooter set amid war-torn battlefields and centered on modern combat. The action unfolds in a near future, where you play as an elite special forces soldier sent into unstable regions, city war zones, and hidden enemy bases. Explosive action runs throughout, and the story is built to keep you hooked.

Here, quick reactions, smart tactics, and accurate shots decide whether you make it through. The single-player campaign follows a high-pressure mission to stop a worldwide disaster. Controls are simple: use W, A, S, and D to move, Space to jump, and Shift to run, while the mouse handles aiming and firing.
hide-and-seek-horror-escape: Hide And Seek Horror Escape is an asymmetric horror escape game, so the two sides do not play the same way. You explore settings like abandoned schools and haunted hospitals, where many hidden secrets and treasures are waiting to be found. At the start, you pick one of two identities: will you hide, or will you seek?

The game is controlled with a simple mouse click or tap. Whichever role you choose, you can dive into its creepy locations and uncover what they conceal. It is a good pick for players who enjoy tense, spooky puzzles and a bit of mystery.
mahjong-puzzle-tile-match: Mahjong Puzzle: Tile Match offers a calm experience that still makes you think. Your aim is to empty the board by pairing identical tiles that sit in the same line, whether across or down. Before you act, study each arrangement, notice repeating designs, and map out several moves ahead. As difficulty climbs, the challenge tests your focus, while the relaxed pace lets your mind unwind and strengthens your puzzle-solving skills.
To play, click two neighboring tiles, either side by side horizontally or stacked vertically, to make a match. Tiles can also be paired across empty space when
hero-city: In Hero City, your job is to defend a large city from waves of invading aliens and demons. Combat is fast and action-packed, built around shooting and quick, nimble movement. The game's settings are detailed and visually pleasing, giving each battle a striking backdrop.

As each new wave grows harder, you will need to plan ahead and keep your aim sharp. Success depends on both careful thinking and steady accuracy. Players who rise to the challenge can aim to become the city's top defender.
clutter-master: Clutter Master is a handmade, easygoing puzzle game about tidying up. Your job is to sort out a cluttered room by putting every object in its proper spot. A hidden surprise waits for you at the very end of the game.

You only need your mouse to play. Select an object with one click, drag it over to the spot it matches, and click again to let it go. Once a room is fully in order, the game automatically takes you to the next one, a fresh room waiting to be cleaned up.
emergency-dispatcher-911: Emergency Dispatcher 911 puts you in the seat of someone who coordinates emergency response. You move through tense, fast-moving calls, choose the right actions while under pressure, and send help out without delay. The scenarios feel true to life and will test how well you plan ahead. As cases grow more complicated, you can improve your equipment to handle them. The game is built around the satisfaction of making a difference when lives are on the line.
age-of-apes: Age of Apes drops you into a jungle where monkeys wage a war built on adventure, evolution, and passion. It is a multiplayer battle game, so you face other players in a primitive wilderness, all fighting for supremacy. Tension builds as each side pushes for the upper hand.

At the heart of the game are evolution and collection. You take on the role of a smart, brave monkey and keep gathering bananas, which you use for upgrades. Controls are simple: click with your mouse or tap the screen to play.
drive-quest: Drive Quest lets you roam a wide-open world at your own pace. You can cruise between cities, search out hidden corners of the map, and take on challenges like drifting runs, stunts, and speed tests. The map is filled with ports, highways, and secret zones to discover, and you can pick from 35 vehicles that you are free to customize to match your personal style.

Controls are simple. Steer with WASD or the arrow keys, use the spacebar as the handbrake, and press C to change the camera position. Whether you are chasing a clean drift or just wandering the highways, the game offers plenty of driving fun with a strong focus on style.
match-4: Match 4 is a puzzle game that rewards careful thinking several moves ahead. Your job is to merge colorful hexagon tiles that carry numbers, building up your score as you go. The grid changes as you play, so you need to stay flexible and adjust your plan when the layout shifts. Soothing visuals keep the experience easy on the eyes while you work through each board.

A key part of the challenge is setting up chain reactions, where one well-timed merge can set off more. Strategy lovers will find plenty to think about as they aim for higher scores. The game centers on continuous puzzle solving, so each round is a chance to see how far your planning can take you.
scoop-empire: Manage a 3D ice cream parlour and expand it step by step. Grab scoops from the machines, place them on the counter, then hand them to customers at the register to collect your money. Spend those earnings on price tiles to open new machines, tables, rooms and staff, or to research fresh flavours. Keep tables clean and toss trash or spare items into the bin.

Drive-thru cars, a sidewalk café, and floating power-ups such as Speed Shoes, Cash Magnet and Turbo Machines add variety, while the Trader and Supplier offer surprise deals. Five worlds, from Sunny Town to Fun Park, each have their own menu, and the global leaderboard shows how far you climb. Move with WASD or the arrow keys, drag on mobile, and zoom with the mouse wheel or a pinch. The trophy button opens the rankings.
go-find-the-cake: In this puzzle adventure, you guide a kind-hearted sister as she gathers tasty cakes and brings them to the kids waiting for them. Along the way, you'll need to get past tricky barriers and work out clever puzzles. Mapping out the best path is key, since the goal is making sure every child receives a treat.

Each stage tests your logic, timing, and problem-solving abilities. Moving is done with W, A, and D or the arrow keys, F picks things up, and you can also throw cakes. The controls are simple, and the puzzle play is engaging enough to keep you coming back, making this an entertaining brain-training experience.
draw-to-goal-soccer-game: In this puzzle title, you never kick the ball yourself. Instead, you sketch lines that act as a route, steering the ball toward the net. Every stroke counts, so planning angles and avoiding hazards is key. Each stage tests your reasoning, your sense of timing, and your imagination as you hunt for a route that scores.

The game is simple to pick up, yet it takes real practice to excel, so it suits both casual visitors and lovers of brain teasers. You will face hundreds of hand-built stages packed with traps, moving elements, and awkward goal placements. Difficulty climbs steadily, encouraging you to think differently and draw cleverer paths. Control uses the mouse: hold
fish-love-game: In Fish Love Game, your mission is to rescue fish from threats like bombs, lava, and a crab, while showing them some affection. The two fish rely on each other and cannot survive apart. Each stage brings a fresh puzzle, and the pleasant tunes, sound effects, and bright, colorful artwork accompany you the whole way.

Play with your mouse or by tapping the screen, and work through every puzzle while keeping both fish out of harm. It suits younger players who enjoy brain teasers and avoid-the-danger challenges, and it offers plenty of fun along the way.
trimino: Trimino turns triangular dominoes into a board game where you face bots alone. Lay each tile so matching numbers touch along shared edges. Close off hexes, build bridges, and chain bonuses as you go. The first player to reach 400 match points wins. If you cannot move, you can draw from the boneyard for a 5-point penalty or pass for 10.

Each round scores the tile's numbers plus bonuses for opening, bridges, hexes, and emptying your hand. A round ends when someone plays their last tile or the game gets blocked. The menu offers a tutorial, a shop for cosmetic skins, quests, daily rewards, and a coin wallet. Ads are optional and appear between rounds, and coin packs are sold for those who want them.
weight-balance-journey: In this arcade runner, you sprint along a course while trying to make your body weight match a set target exactly. On the way, you can pick healthy fruits to shed pounds or high-calorie fast food to add them quickly. Every stage calls for a precise result on the scales.

Obstacles appear along the route, so you need to avoid them while choosing your items at the right moments. To steer, hold down the mouse button and drag left or right. Land exactly on the scales and you will clear each level.
stickman-kombat-2d: Step into a fast-moving 2D brawl where stickman fighters face off one-on-one in arena matches. Pick the warrior you want, then string together punches, kicks and special moves into chains that can floor a rival. Progress through several stages and game types, where the foes grow tougher as you move along, and slip past incoming attacks to stay in the fight.

Everything runs on simple mouse clicks or taps, so you can jump in quickly. Still, precise timing and careful planning are needed to win each bout. Try out a wide range of stick characters and different arenas, and aim to rise to the top as the champion.
my-perfect-hotel-html5: Ever pictured yourself running a hotel of your own? This fast-paced time-management title lets you start right from the foundations and grow your business step by step. The main aim is to build a large network of lodgings that reflects how much you care about looking after guests. As the hotel manager, you get to show off your skills, decide where to spend money on your team and on upgrades to your property, and work hard to rise to the very top of the hospitality business.
Controls are simple: click the mouse or tap the screen to play.
extreme-balancer: Extreme Balancer asks you to keep a ball balanced as it travels along narrow wooden bridges toward the end of each level. If the ball tips off, the level begins again from the start. The 3D visuals and lifelike physics make it feel as though you are truly balancing the ball.

Roll the ball forward carefully along the bridges and narrow tracks. Dangerous paths, spinning blocks, and moving platforms are the main obstacles. When something is moving or rotating, stop and watch its pattern before you go. Time your movement so you can cross quickly while staying in control. Each fall restarts the level, giving you another chance to improve your timing.
infinite-bike-trials: Infinite Bike Trials presents a scenic setting and 200 demanding levels. Your goal is to complete each one, and along the way you can buy a new bike or change your rider's color. It is an action game about bikes and motorcycles that runs in the browser.

Steer your machine with the W, A, S, and D keys. The levels are hard, so patience goes a long way as you work through the whole collection. Whether you are customizing your rider or tackling a tough course, the game keeps the focus on riding and having fun.
relic-runway: Relic Runway is a 3D endless runner where the goal is to get as far as you can. Along the way, you grab coins, which you can spend to strengthen helpful bonuses. Collecting pieces of relics lets you uncover ancient artifacts, while smashing idols opens up new characters to play as. If you enjoy a little friendly rivalry, you can challenge your friends and see who ends up as the top relic runner.
Steering is handled with the arrow keys or by swiping in the direction you want to go.
the-superhero-league: Become a superhero in The Superhero League, a puzzle game built around an adventure. Your hero takes on a series of missions centered on killing, solves puzzles along the way, and works to save the world. You guide your hero through challenging levels with one goal in mind: becoming the strongest hero of all. The game blends superhero themes with rich strategy gameplay, and its endless puzzle fun keeps going.

This creative puzzle title is controlled entirely with mouse clicks or taps. Whether you prefer a computer or a touchscreen, the controls stay the same, so you can focus on the missions and the puzzles ahead.
monster-truck-racing-game-truck-race: Take the wheel of powerful four-wheel-drive monster trucks and tear across punishing tracks. You can attempt stunts that seem nearly impossible while crossing dangerous off-road landscapes. Fans of off-road racing, truck stunt titles, or realistic driving simulators should feel right at home. Steering is simple to pick up, the physics behave believably, and the vehicle responds quickly to your inputs.

Controls are straightforward. Press W or the Up Arrow to drive forward, and S or the Down Arrow to reverse. Use A or the Left Arrow to steer left, and D or the Right Arrow to steer right. Any on-screen button can be selected with a mouse click.
super-wings: Super Wings puts you in charge of Jett, a cheerful jet plane who carries parcels across the globe in a game that has no fixed finish. Your task is to keep Jett delivering packages to the world's children as the run goes on. Jett stars in an animated show where he brings deliveries to kids in many countries. He also joins the Super Wings, a team of planes that can switch into robot form, to face new problems and work through them together.
You control the action with your mouse, or simply by clicking. The game sits in the Arcade category and carries tags including Adventure, Aircraft, Cars and HTML5.
stack-colors: Stack Colors! challenges you to transport as many bricks as you can. Each level presents a new scene and a person wearing a different color. Your task is to carry bricks that match that color while avoiding bricks of other colors.
Bricks join your stack on their own as soon as you touch them, so you only need to reach them. To move, just slide. Keep your stack in the right color and enjoy the colorful stacking.
stack-up: Stack Em Up! is a laid-back puzzle game you play on your own. Tap a stack to select it, then connect it with other stacks of the same colour to combine them into a longer chain. Your aim is to build stacks ten or more units long. Bigger stacks earn more score and help you reach level goals.

The look is stylised, and the controls are simple to pick up. Each level limits your moves, so you need to reach its objective before they run out. There are many levels, and they grow steadily more challenging as you move through them.
twisted-rope-3d: Twisted Rope 3D is a free puzzle game for Android where you work through ropes tangled into intricate arrangements. Your goal is to untangle them, and the key is to move each rope without creating any new knots. Simple touch controls let you select a rope and shift it into place.

Levels grow more complex as you progress, so each one offers a fresh challenge that calls for sharp thinking and quick problem-solving. Success depends on careful planning and precise rope placement. Bright visuals and a user-friendly interface make the 3D experience approachable, and the game blends fun with mental exercise for anyone who loves a clever challenge.
traffic-jam-hop-on: Traffic Jam: Hop On is a puzzle game that tests both your planning and your reaction speed. You find yourself in a bright, colorful parking lot where many different kinds of vehicles are stuck bumper to bumper. Your job is to untangle the crowd so each vehicle can roll out of the jam and move along without trouble.

Playing is simple: just use your mouse or tap the screen to select and move the vehicles. Think a few steps ahead, choose the right order, and clear the path one car at a time. It is a relaxing yet clever way to spend a few minutes, and the cheerful look of the lot keeps things light from start to finish.
black-hole-swallow-master: In this casual arcade title, you steer a mighty black hole that pulls in whatever lies along its route. You roam the playing area, gathering objects and growing larger with each one you take in. The clock is always ticking, so your goal is to absorb as much as you can before time runs out.

Your black hole begins small, so move it carefully across the level and take in smaller items first to grow. As it expands, it can swallow bigger objects and clear more of the surroundings. Think ahead, pick the most rewarding targets, and work toward mastering the art of swallowing. Every button in the game is operated with your mouse.
escape-ancient-egypt: Escape Ancient Egypt is a 3D adventure puzzle game set in the mysterious ruins of ancient Egypt, following in the footsteps of Cleopatra and the pharaohs. You must try to break free from a pharaoh's curse by solving puzzles that unlock each next room. Your brain is the main tool here, because you will need it to open every door on the way out.

The game looks striking, with visuals that capture the mystery of ancient Egyptian temples. Along the way, you can take a closer look at the history of Cleopatra and the pharaohs. There are many rooms to explore and many doors to unlock, since the pyramids keep their mysteries hidden. Everything is controlled with a mouse or touch input.
pathfinder: PathFinder is a two-dimensional puzzle title where you carve out tunnels so that coloured balls roll into pipes hidden under the ground. Every stage throws up its own hurdles, such as metal blocks and thorns, so you need to think ahead about the route you choose. There are 30 stages in total, and later ones grow trickier and ask for careful forward planning and clever solutions.

It suits people who enjoy relaxed games as well as those who love a good brain teaser. The title runs on phones, tablets, and desktop computers, and controls stay simple: a tap or mouse click is all it takes to dig a path. Expect it to keep you occupied for quite a while.
body-drop-3d: Body Drop 3D puts you in charge of a tough crash test dummy whose body flops around with ragdoll physics after every knock. Your job is to line up your shots carefully, since you only get a set number of balls to launch. Each throw is a chance to cause as much bone-jarring damage as possible, so timing and aim matter.
Beyond that, you can try out different angles to see what works best, and new scenarios open up as you
deadly-descent: Your goal in Deadly Descent is to steer a car down a mountain road and bring it across the finish line still in one piece. The track is packed with obstacles, and hitting any of them will wreck your vehicle, so every turn calls for careful driving. This simulator suits players who enjoy watching cars get destroyed, since the vehicles can be smashed up. You can play it on a phone or a computer, and it costs nothing.
fps-shooting-game-multiplayer: This pixel-style 3D shooter mixes survival with blocky, Minecraft-like worlds. You push through towns, farms, terminals, and train stations crowded with zombies, shooting your way forward while gathering the supplies you need to keep going. The animation looks sharp for a game built on pixels, and the guns match the blocky style of everything around them.

The game also supports multiplayer. You can meet other players on the road, and some may end up as friends, but others will try to take what you have collected, so you need to defend yourself. If you get tired of fighting zombies, you can switch to online player-versus-player battles in the same pixel world. The controls are simple: use WASD to move your character and the mouse to shoot.
noob-in-mine-sandbox-and-craft: Step into a vast three-dimensional sandbox built from blocks, where you decide what gets made. Stack blocks to raise houses, castles, or whole cities, or head out to explore caves, forests, and villages. Creative Mode gives you unlimited blocks so you can construct anything you imagine. Dozens of block and item types are available, and dynamite is there when you want to blow things apart.

Prefer a challenge? Survival Mode releases zombies and monsters at night, so you will need to defend yourself. Gather resources, craft tools, and fight off the enemies you meet. The graphics are cheerful and the controls are easy enough for kids. Pick your blocks, shape your own world, and play it your way.
arrow-cube-3d: Arrow Cube 3D asks you to clear a six-sided cube of every arrow by working out the right sequence. This calm three-dimensional logic puzzle tests your focus, your ability to plan ahead, and your sense of space. Each level is short, so you can dip in and out whenever you like.

To play, tap an arrow to take it off the cube. An arrow can leave only when nothing blocks its path, so you need to decide which one to remove first. Rotate and inspect the cube from every angle before choosing your order. Once all the arrows are gone, the level is complete.
cut-cut-game: Dorote is a rabbit who runs an orchard, and she is getting ready for an event in her village. While checking her oranges, she notices that some of them hide explosive surprises left behind by someone. She is in a hurry and cannot deal with them right now, since the juice for the event still needs to be made. Your job is to slice the fruit carefully and steer clear of anything that could blow up.

This is a single-player, 2D arcade game available on Android, and it can also be played with a mouse. To cut, tap and slide your finger across the screen, or drag with your mouse. Take your time and avoid cutting the wrong things.
the-queen-s-jewels: The Queen's Jewels is a casual puzzle game about matching gems, and physics plays a key part in how everything moves. Its levels bring different mechanics, so each new challenge asks you to think in a fresh way. This mix keeps the experience varied from start to finish.

Gameplay is simple: click the jewels and make identical ones match. When a board becomes difficult, you can use three items that help with matching. Together, these tools give you a few different ways to work through each puzzle.
mahjong-connect-classic: Mahjong Connect Classic is a tile puzzle built around the old-fashioned mahjong style. Your job is to find matching tiles and link them together. A path between two identical tiles may bend at most twice, and each bend must be a right angle. Work through a series of boards that start off easy and grow steadily harder.
To play, just click with your mouse on one tile, then on its match. If the line between them fits the rule, both tiles disappear from the board. Clear the whole layout to move on to the next one.
gas-station-simulator: Gas Station Simulator puts you in charge of a run-down fuel stop that you grow into a thriving petrol business. Pump fuel into cars as fast as you can to collect money, then reinvest it in extra pumps and workers so you can handle a steady flow of customers. Improvements range from quicker service to perks for high-end vehicles, and each upgrade keeps the cycle of expansion and earnings moving forward.
Controls depend on your device. On a computer, use the W, A, S and D keys or your mouse. On a phone, use your finger on the screen.
fire-truck-driving-simulator-2024: Fire Truck Driving Simulator 2024 puts you in the seat of a brave firefighter behind the wheel of a powerful fire engine. Your route might lead through crowded city avenues, quiet country lanes, or dangerous mountain roads. Your job is to get to each emergency fast and in one piece, weaving past obstacles and other cars while looking after your crew. Handling the truck well matters, and so does using the siren at the right moments to open up the road. Keeping a cool head when things get tense is part of the job.
draw-the-perfect-shape: Draw the Perfect Shape! is a calm but demanding arcade puzzle that rewards a steady hand. Your job is to sketch the shape you're given, which can be a circle, a square, or a triangle, as closely as you can. The game's clever scoring system tracks your line while you draw and gives you an accuracy rating between 0% and 100%. It's easy to pick up, yet getting a perfect score takes real practice.

To play, hold down your mouse button and drag on a computer, or place your finger on the screen and swipe on a phone or tablet. The whole shape must be finished in one unbroken stroke, so you can't lift your pointer or finger partway through. When you let go, the game works out how precise your drawing was and shows the result. Aim for 100% and see how close you can get.
home-design-decorate-house: Home Design: Decorate House combines a calm match 3 puzzle game with renovation and interior decorating. Move into a huge mansion that includes plenty of rooms, gardens, swimming pools, and playgrounds, then give each space the look you have in mind. Nearly anything you would expect to find in a well-furnished house is available here, so the decorating options feel wide and varied.

Puzzle play and house decorating work together, so each session mixes both parts. As you finish levels, you collect brushes, and those brushes are what you use to repair and decorate your home. Unlock new rooms as you progress, including the library, kitchen, garden, tennis court, and swimming pool, with more areas still to come. Your job is to help her restore this dream house into the finest manor in town.
goods-sort-3d: Goods Sort 3D is a free puzzle game that is easy to pick up but gets tougher as you progress. Each level gives you plenty of time, and the varied items and simple controls make it a relaxing choice for anyone who enjoys tidying up. You tap similar 3D items to group them together, then clear any three identical pieces. Snacks, beverages and fruit all appear alongside closet and general stuff sorting, so the challenge stays fresh.

Cleaning and organising shelves raises your score. As you complete levels, you discover and unlock favourite products with cuter designs and better colours. Matching pairs and triple matches mix together, so there is always a new combination to find. If you enjoy match-3 puzzles, this game offers a sorting challenge worth trying.
stickman-warriors: Stickman Warriors is a fighting RPG that puts you in charge of a stickman hero. As you win battles against strong opponents called Saints, you climb through the ranks. Planning matters here, since daily rewards and a range of stickman attributes give you different ways to build your fighter.
Your goal is to reach the top S rank and earn the title of the strongest stickman warrior. Each victory moves you closer to that final ranking, so every fight counts toward your progress.
monster-match-mania: Monster Match Mania is a Halloween-themed puzzle game that sends you on a journey through a world full of monsters. Your goal is to line up three monsters of the same color so they disappear. Each completed match helps you move through a series of challenging levels, and the game leans on logic as much as quick thinking.

The controls are simple: touch a column to drop a monster into it. Look ahead for your next group of three, and plan a few moves in advance. Choosing the right column at the right moment is what keeps you progressing from one level to the next.
crazy-difficult-game: Crazy Difficult Game is a puzzle title that tests how quickly you can react, with more than 50 stages to work through. It presents itself as one of the most demanding games around, so every new level will push your timing. Once you reach level 10, you need to slow down and move with far more care. Your aim is to clear every level and see how much of this tough challenge you can conquer.
Movement uses the WASD keys or the arrow keys. If you would rather use a controller-style setup, you can switch on joystick control in the settings menu. The game is built for one player.
tile-match-puzzle: Tile Match Puzzle is made for fans of match 3 and calm combination games. Fresh puzzles arrive every day. You match three tiles to uncover more tiles hidden underneath, then keep finding groups until the board is clear. Be careful, though. If you select too many tiles without at least three matching, you must start your journey over from the beginning.

Each level brings a new puzzle, and you travel through fresh landscapes on a relaxing getaway. With tiles in over 20 styles, the number of combinations you can make has no limit. Tap to place tiles into the box, and match three or more identical tiles to remove them. Clear the whole board to win a level, and beat each one as well as you can to collect coins. Test and improve your memory and pattern recognition along the way. Hundreds of colorful puzzles await.
tb-world: TB World invites you to let your creativity run wild. Your main goal is to bring your daydreams to life and shape them into original tales. You can design distinctive outfits for your characters and furnish cozy rooms to suit your taste.

The controls are easy to pick up, so players of every age can jump right in. The clean layout lets you slide characters, objects, and decor across the screen with a swipe. To dress a character, tap a piece of clothing or an accessory; to decorate a room, drag items into place. Nothing is scripted and there are no firm rules, so you write your own adventures using a broad mix of settings, figures, and objects. Your imagination is the only boundary here.
pop-it-now: Pop It Now is a relaxing online puzzle game built around the well-known Pop It fidget toys. Your goal is to press each popit until it pops, which unlocks a colorful toy. Pay close attention, because every bubble needs to be popped and nothing should be left behind. It is filed under the Girls, Casual, Kids, and Puzzle categories.

All of the action is controlled with the left mouse button, so a single click is all it takes to interact. The experience is meant to feel calming, which makes it a suitable choice for a quiet break. Keep working through the bubbles, since popping them is how the colorful toys are unlocked.
1942-pacific-front: Set during the Second World War, this strategy title puts you in charge of military campaigns across the Pacific. You can take the side of the United States or Japan, and your job is to direct troops on the ground, warships at sea, and aircraft overhead. The terrain you fight over is dynamic, so you must keep adjusting your plans as the landscape changes.

Play unfolds in turns, giving you time to weigh each decision before you commit. Managing your resources is a key part of the challenge, and you will need to outmaneuver your opponents to get ahead. Sharp tactical thinking and a willingness to adapt will carry you toward victory on a battlefield that never stays the same.
last-night: You step into the shoes of a content creator working hard toward the gold award for his channel. One night, his computer starts behaving strangely, and a survey appears asking whether he wants to take part. This scary, horror-themed story-driven adventure offers three different endings and a plot that unfolds step by step, with a
obby-1-digging-power-per-click: Obby: +1 Digging Power per Click is a clicker game where each press raises your digging power by one. Building up your strength lets you tunnel deeper underground. Along the way, you gather loot and sell it for money. Spend your earnings on a stronger pickaxe to speed things up. Once you're ready, rebirth and keep pushing until you reach the bottom.
Movement uses the WASD keys, E picks things up, and Space makes you jump. On mobile devices, the controls are shown right on the screen.
jigsaw-solitaire-puzzle: Snaptaire: Jigsaw Solitaire blends card play with puzzle solving in a set of fantasy jigsaw brainteasers that challenge your mind and test your skills. As you work through colorful cards, you uncover HD jigsaw artwork built for mobile. It plays as a smooth slide puzzle, and its Christmas games add a festive touch.

Moving cards is simple. Press and drag any card to wherever you want it. When cards with matching patterns touch, they lock together automatically, and you can then move the whole connected group as one piece. Be careful with tricky placements, because a poor move can break your groups apart. The fast-paced Christmas countdown mode makes these choices even more important.
save-the-girl: Save The Girl drops a young girl into many kinds of danger, and it is up to you to help her get away and survive. She needs the right props or objects to finish her escape. Each time, the game offers several items, and you choose one. Pick poorly and the bad guys will catch her.

Everything is played with a mouse click or a tap on the screen. Because it is a puzzle game, you should weigh each option before you decide, since a single wrong pick is enough to let the bad guys catch her. Stay focused as the dangers keep coming and see how far she can get.
electron-dash: Electron Dash is a fast magnetic arcade game built around physics and maze navigation. Instead of just running, you glide, slam, and swing by shifting your charge with a slider at the bottom of the screen. Sliding left gives you a negative blue charge, while sliding right gives you a positive red one. Letting go returns you to neutral, where only your momentum carries you.

Unlike charges draw you together, while matching ones push apart. You can bounce off walls to shoot across the map, or pull toward magnetic pillars to swing around tight bends. Your job is to grab every coin, dodge traps, and reach the finish zone safely before the clock runs out. Momentum matters here, whether you crash into walls or zoom through open areas, and it all works smoothly on mobile.
jewel-gem-puzzle: Step into a bright world of shining gems where sorting and pixel art building blend together. This casual title is made for light, soothing play, mixing color matching with the creation of pixel pictures. The controls feel smooth and easy to pick up, and each stage becomes a little more involved as you move forward, all while keeping your thinking sharp.

Your job is to tap jewels and move them into groups of matching color. Keep your shelf tidy and plan a few moves ahead so each puzzle clears efficiently. As you place every gem, a hidden pixel image slowly appears, and each level unveils a fresh picture to admire. Nothing pushes you to hurry, so every session feels like a calm creative pause.
help-me-tricky-story: Help Me: Tricky Story is a brain test game filled with light-hearted fun. It brings together puzzles across 17 levels, and each one asks you to finish a set of actions that match the prompt shown. Scenes are drawn from everyday life, so you might be pulling a tooth, eating fries, or enjoying some cheese. The variety of challenges keeps each stage feeling different from the last.

Playing takes only a mouse click or a tap, so you can move through the levels with either input. Read each prompt carefully, since it tells you which action to take. The game sits in the Puzzles category and carries the tags Boys and Brain
hula-hoops-rush: In this 3D arcade game, you gather hoops that match the correct color as you move along a path. Steer clear of the lava pool ahead, and try to catch as many hoops as you can on the road, which leaves you feeling like a true hula queen. Sliding your finger or pointer is how you grab each hoop.
The game is quick to learn and leaves you feeling at ease. It's a hypercasual HTML5 title tagged with collecting and avoid mechanics, so it runs right
try-again: Roll a ball through a tricky physics platformer made up of 70 levels. Some floors vanish under you, certain traps wait for just the right moment, and a level can play out differently each time you attempt it. Every failure offers a lesson: learn where the hazards hide, work out when it is safe to move, and make your way to the portal.

A new zone and a boss level arrive every 10 levels, and new ball colors unlock as you progress. The controls are simple. Use the arrow keys or A and D to roll, Up, W, or Space to jump, and Esc or P to pause. On touch screens, hold the left button to roll and tap the right button to jump.
my-town-home-family-playhouse: Step into My Town Home: Family Playhouse, a lively online dollhouse where your imagination leads the way. The game offers six distinct rooms spread across a roomy two-story house. Choose a family, then build stories with them, cook in the kitchen, or care for plants in the garden. You can play for free on a phone or a computer.

Mini-games let you earn a little extra, which you can spend on something new, such as washing a teddy bear or popping balloons. Outdoors, the backyard offers a sandbox, a trampoline, and picnics. Nothing limits your creativity, so write your own plots and invent unique stories. On a computer, use the mouse; on a phone, tap with your finger to press buttons and move items and characters.
build-an-island: Build An Island is an educational building game for young children, especially kindergarten and preschool learners who are just beginning to understand how things fit together. Players construct a house and an island while picking up the basics of ships and seaport mechanics. Boys and girls, including toddlers as young as two, can take part, and the free game aims to build motor skills and imagination.

Little builders work out how to put together both an island and a boat. Large ships and platforms give them plenty to construct and a chance to explore the ocean. The game shows the technical details needed for building, and players can create a lovely oasis with their own home in the middle of the sea. Controls work with taps or clicks.
leaf-clean-up: You start with nothing but your hands, gathering fallen leaves and hauling them to the sell zone to turn them into cash. Glowing upgrade pads let you increase how many leaves you can carry, how far your suction reaches, and how quickly you move. As you progress through several themed worlds, you can unlock stronger gear, including a Leaf Blower for quick sweeping and a heavy-duty Lawnmower that mulches leaves instantly.
On a computer, move with W, A, S, D or the arrow keys, switch tools with keys 1, 2, or 3 or the mouse scroll wheel, and left-click to
tap-tap-reloaded: Tap Tap Reloaded is a fast-paced rhythm game where you tap along to your favorite songs. It is built around what the community asks for and run by a team of veteran Tap Tap players, so it truly belongs to its players. Missing a track? Request it and vote on what gets added next. Stuck on a tough part? Jump straight to any section. You can also change the note speed, lane angle, note size and color, background color, and highway design to suit how you play.

Upcoming features include daily, weekly, and career challenges with achievements, such as scoring as many points as possible in a day, playing ten multiplayer games, or clearing a song without a single Perfect tap. Friends can form a clan, battle for Tap Tap dominance in online multiplayer, and compete in leaderboard races. Each week a tournament with cash prizes rotates between skill-based, grind-based, and clan-based formats. Controls use the mouse.
the-windows-game: The Windows Game turns the familiar Windows 10 desktop into a space filled with small games and room for creative work. You move through system features you already know, and they lead you to a range of mini-games. Expect shooting simulations, painting, and tasks that test how well you can juggle several things at once, along with plenty of other activities.

Hidden extras are tucked away across the interface for you to discover, and the sounds are modeled on the real operating system. The game leans on nostalgia for its charm, while its gameplay is designed to keep you coming back for another round.
schoolboy-escape-runaway: This stealth adventure casts you as a determined kid who wants to slip out of a house where strict parents keep him locked in. Move through gloomy hallways, stay hidden, and use clever tricks to get away. He has made a promise to his friends outside, and it is up to you to keep it.

Expect a creepy mood, where every creak and rustle could give you away in the dark corridors of an old house. Explore each corner like a detective, and listen closely to footsteps to work out where the parents are heading. On desktop, WASD moves, the mouse turns the camera, left click interacts, R gives a hint, and P pauses. On mobile, a joystick moves you, swipes rotate the view, and on-screen buttons handle interaction, pausing, and prompts.
dice-merge: Dice Merge is a quick puzzle game where you roll dice and combine them before the clock runs out. Every roll gives you two new dice and restarts the countdown, which begins at 10 seconds and drops to 5 seconds once two minutes have passed. Your final score is multiplied by the time you have left, so acting fast matters. You can roll by pressing Space or clicking the Roll button.
magic-coloring-book-for-little-artists: This calm, imaginative game for children blends outline drawing with classic coloring. Rather than being handed a finished image, young players build their picture one step at a time. A magical marker draws the outline automatically for as long as you keep holding the screen.

Once the outline is complete, you can fill it in with cheerful, vivid colors. Along the way, the game supports fine motor skills, focus, patience, and color perception in a fun and relaxed way. To play, simply click the mouse or tap the screen.
bbq-sort: BBQ Sort is a food-themed puzzle game where you stand at the grill and test your matching skills. Early on the music is calm jazz and the orders are few, but the game steadily brings in larger orders that come with a timer. Some special requests call for close attention and cooking techniques that only those orders need.

To play, tap skewers and move them so that three identical ones end up on the same grill, which completes an order and frees the grill for the next match. Each level has its own sorting puzzle, along with limited time and space, so think a few moves ahead and place each skewer with care. When a layout gets stuck, you can use power-ups that clear obstacles and turn up the heat.
tricky-prank-annoying-quest: Tricky Prank: Annoying Quest is a funny puzzle game built around sneaky jokes, awkward predicaments, and sudden turns of events. Each stage opens on a fresh scene packed with comical storylines, clues tucked out of sight, and interactions that catch you off guard. The whole game rewards looking at problems from an unusual angle.

Some stages work like a short mental workout that asks for a quick flash of insight. Others invite you to experiment with the objects around you and work out the right sequence of actions. The controls rely on clicking and dragging.
bubbles-clicker: Bubbles Clicker is a bright, busy action game where fast reflexes and smart tapping matter most. Your job is to pop colorful bubbles before they float away. Along the way, you may come across power-ups that show up unexpectedly and can push your score higher. As the game goes on, things speed up and the challenge grows, keeping the pressure on from start to finish.

It suits players who enjoy quick, fast-moving action and want something that can hold their attention for a long stretch. The game asks you to stay alert and tap with purpose. If you like games that reward sharp timing and keep getting faster, this one is built for you.
army-run-3d: Army Run 3D sends you charging into combat as your soldier sprints down desert roads. Along the way you take out foes, break apart barrels, and pick which gates are worth driving through. Your character fires on its own, so your focus stays on steering and lining up targets.

Steering works by dragging left or right, whether you use a mouse or your finger. Between battles, the money you collect can go toward stronger shots, faster firing, and extra health, which help you endure harder fights and travel further down the road. The game begins from its Play button.
boom-cell: Boom Cell starts you as one lone cell, and your goal is to expand into a strong cell brigade. You will face rival cell armies in fights, yet you need to keep watch, since bigger groups of cells can easily overwhelm smaller ones. Moving through this tiny world takes careful planning and quick thinking as you work toward becoming the leading cell force.
Controls are simple: press the left mouse button or use the WASD keys to play. Keep your eyes on the microscopic map, since each decision you make shapes how your army grows.
cats-go: Cats Go! is an obstacle course game where you guide a cat across a map toward a fish waiting at the far end. It is built as a demanding platformer, so expect a tough challenge from the first jump, and find out whether you can make it through. Your feline hero only ever moves forward, so there is no turning back once you set off.

Your goal is simple: reach the fish. Whether you play on a phone or a computer, you jump by pressing the button shown on screen. Keep your timing sharp, because each leap has to be right if you want to keep moving along the route.
momo-horror-story: Momo Horror Story draws on the history of the "momo" chat messages. You play a young man who reached out to Momo by message, and now that same monster is hunting him. Before help arrives, you must finish several jobs, such as starting a generator, locating keys, and closing windows.

Your goal is to survive until the countdown reaches 00:00, when the police arrive and you can escape. The game offers two modes, Classic and Gun. Controls are simple: W, A, S, and D move you, the mouse looks around, and left click attacks. Right click switches your flashlight and aims, the mouse wheel changes weapons, G throws grenades, R reloads, F interacts, Left Shift runs, and Left CTRL has its own function.
annoying-boss-game: Blow off some steam in this silly office-themed action game, where your target is a boss who never stops getting on your nerves. Slap, punch, and kick him as the scene falls apart around you. It is built purely for light-hearted fun, so it works well as a quick break. Dull meetings, extra hours, and long lectures all become reasons to let loose.

Left click to throw a punch, and click rapidly to chain combo attacks. Drag the mouse to aim special attacks like flying chappals, smashed eggs, and water balloons. Use the arrow keys to move, press the spacebar for a powerful punch, and press E to trigger a special move. Expect funny animations and plenty of office mayhem.
optical-illusion: Optical Illusion is a puzzle game designed to give your brain a jumpstart. It presents eight perplexing optical illusions for you to work through, and each one asks you to look closer and think differently. Because the game is interactive, you engage with the illusions directly instead of just watching them.

Playing is straightforward, since you only need your mouse or a tap to interact. The game runs in the browser and is also tagged for Android. It sits in the Puzzles category, but it has an arcade feel and a light, funny tone that makes it a playful break for anyone who enjoys a little mental challenge.
koenigsegg-jesko-absolut-puzzle: Put together six jigsaw pictures, each one featuring the Koenigsegg Jesko Absolut. Every puzzle in this HTML5 browser game shows the same car, so the whole set stays focused on one vehicle. Solving all six is the goal, and the challenge is a good way to keep your brain sharp.

Each picture comes in four modes, with 16, 36, 64, or 100 pieces to arrange. The game is played with your mouse, so you can start with a smaller count and work your way up to the largest. Whichever mode you pick, the car stays the same, and the puzzle is ready to try as soon as it loads.
solitaire-picture-puzzles: Here, the cards show pictures instead of jigsaw pieces, and you pair them by swapping. The rules take only seconds to learn, yet the game can hold your attention for hours. Boards start at 3x3 and grow tougher as your skills improve. Reach level 9 and, if things feel too easy, extra demanding challenges unlock.

Each board hides an image that is revealed through matching. Every photo was taken by a professional photographer, and no AI-generated images appear anywhere. Subjects range from nature and food to architecture, offering a visual tour of the world. Press a card with your cursor or finger and drag it onto another to swap them, since adjacent cards may match when they fit. Matched cards stay grouped while you drag. More moves improve your chances of correct matches, and the picture gradually appears as your skill grows.
mini-asmr-relaxing-game-relax: This is a calm little toy box you can open in your browser. Each mini-game aims to ease stress and anxiety and settle a busy mind, with soft ASMR sounds and gentle visuals that pull you in. You can pop bubbles, press fidget toys, stir swirling liquids, and try dozens of other calming activities, such as popping, pouring, and tapping, all set against soothing background audio.

To begin, pick any game from the menu, such as Pop It, bubbles, or fidget. Tap the screen to pop, press, pour, or spin, and watch the smooth effects respond. Nothing ticks down and nothing pushes you forward, so you can take a quick reset, a mental break, or simply drift for a while, whenever and wherever you happen to be.
age-evolution-run: Race through human history in this nonstop runner, where your hero sprints from the earliest days of humanity to a futuristic age. Keep moving as you dodge obstacles, grab power-ups, and collect points along the way. Each era unlocks new abilities, so the race itself shows how speed, strength, and survival change over time.

Your character levels up as you progress and can unlock more powerful forms. You will need to avoid traps, break through barriers, and defeat rivals who stand in your way. Upgrades bring new looks, weapons, and abilities. Move with the left mouse button, WASD, or the arrow keys.
rescue-the-princess: Rescue The Princess is a single-player puzzle game with tower defense elements. You shove crates around the battlefield to build turrets and take control of the area. When matching turrets touch, they merge into a stronger version with more firepower. Your goal is to knock back the evil Dragon and keep the Princess safe.
Plan each push carefully and chain merges together to unleash heavy damage once your setup is right. The Dragon never stops hunting, so you cannot afford to rest. Play with a mouse click or a tap.
roshambo: Roshambo, also known as Rock Paper Scissors, brings this classic hand game to your screen with bright, colorful graphics. You can play with touch controls, or on keyboard devices with the A, S, and D keys and the J, K, and L keys. Your task is to anticipate the next move, whether it comes from a friend or from the computer.

The goal is simple: the first player to reach 3 points wins the game. Since every round depends on reading your opponent, you will need to think ahead as well as react. It is a light, funny choice for two players or for a quick match against the computer.
sudoku-block-puzzle: Sudoku Block Puzzle blends the grid logic of sudoku with the feel of wooden block puzzles. It is free to play in your browser. Pieces come in many different shapes, and you drag each one onto a 9x9 board without letting it overlap another piece. When you fill an entire row, column, or 3x3 square, those blocks disappear, so your aim is to keep the board tidy and push your score past your best run.

Clearing several tiles with one placement earns combo bonuses, and chaining successful moves in a row builds a streak that adds more points. Daily challenges reward you with unique trophies. The game ends once none of your remaining blocks can fit anywhere on the board.
obby-steal-an-egg-the-great-escape: Obby: Steal an Egg - The Great Escape is a race to build the finest pet collection. Snatch eggs from computer-controlled creatures and rival players, then hatch them at home to get pets that earn coins automatically. Spend those coins on your treadmill and base, since a better treadmill trains you faster and boosts your speed. Speed lets quick thieves grab eggs unnoticed and outrun slow bosses. Look for mutated or oddly sized eggs, which hatch the most valuable pets.
safety-sheriff-labrador: Help Sheriff Labrador work through a range of made-up safety situations by dragging and dropping items into place. The controls are simple to pick up. Scenarios include things like crossing the road and riding a bike safely. Along the way, children pick up useful safety habits while enjoying the playful storyline. The game mixes learning with fun, helping young players make wise decisions and feel more sure of themselves in everyday situations.
merge-for-renovation: Merge For Renovation lets you reshape a house into the place you have always pictured. Joining identical items creates new essentials that you can use on the many renovation jobs that keep coming up. It is a puzzle game with a match 3 twist, so smart choices about which items to combine really matter.

Stars are your reward for progress. Spend them to upgrade rooms and personalize the home until it matches your own vision. Strategic planning plays a big part, since deciding which merges to make first shapes how far you get. Each step forward feels rewarding, and the journey keeps your imagination busy from start to finish
color-dots-challenge: Color Dots Challenge is a straightforward puzzle where the goal is to slot every dot into the spot that matches its color. Precision matters, so you'll want to take your time and line things up carefully. The game is easy to pick up, yet it keeps you engaged, which makes it a good fit for a short break or a longer stretch of play.

Tap a colored dot and it moves to its correct place. Your goal is to get each dot into its own slot while avoiding contact with the other dots. It is a simple, fun puzzle that is easy to learn and enjoyable to play.
stage-show-designer: Stage Show Designer is a 3D puzzle game with a girl as the central figure. Your task is to gather outfits and decorations that match the performance shown to you, while steering clear of the wrong ones. To pass a level, at least 75% of the items you collect must be the correct ones. Controls are simple: drag your finger or mouse to move and play.

Think of it as dressing a stage show one piece at a time, where every choice counts toward finishing the round. Keep an eye on what the act calls for and sort the good picks from the bad. It's a relaxed way to spend some time, so enjoy the process.
brain-puzzle-tricky-choices: Brain Puzzle: Tricky Choices is a puzzle game that asks you to think creatively. Each level presents a tricky brain teaser, and you need to work out the correct storyline before you can move on to the next stage. Progress may seem straightforward, since the only task is picking the right options, but the choices are harder to get right than they look.

Play is simple. Use your imagination to crack every puzzle, and click or tap to make your selections. Tap through the scenes, weigh each option carefully, and let your creativity guide you toward the answers that unlock the next level.
underwater-survival-deep-dive: Stranded on an alien ocean planet, you must find a way to escape its dangerous depths. Suit up in scuba gear, sharpen your fishing skills, and gather the vital resources you need. Keep an eye on your oxygen levels, since threats lurk in the darkness. If you enjoy Subnautica, you will like this game too.

Every encounter calls for careful planning and quick adaptation as you work through this unforgiving world and aim to emerge victorious. Navigate the underwater labyrinth, collect resources, and outmaneuver the monsters to secure your chance of escape. WASD moves you, the spacebar dives and surfaces, and shift accelerates. Press F to switch the flashlight on or off and Q to use a stun gun. Use the left mouse button to rotate the camera.
penguin-splash: Penguin Splash takes you on a frosty journey filled with colorful penguins that need pairing up. Your goal is to link penguins of the same color to rack up points. To do this, drag your pointer across matching flippers so they connect, which can set off big chain reactions. Along the way, power-ups can help you clear the stage in each level.

The gameplay is hard to put down, so it's easy to keep going for one more round. Its cheerful artwork and playful look add to the fun. If you enjoy puzzles with a silly, wintry twist, this one offers a lighthearted challenge.
block-craft-3d-school: Step into Block Craft 3D School, where imagination and excitement blend together. This pixel-style title lets you explore a limitless world much like Minecraft. Your job is to construct a school out of blocks in many different shapes and keep it safe. Don't expect a simple building experience, though: foes lurk in every corner, ready to strike. Along the way you gather blocks and set them down wherever you need them.
Controls are simple. Click the mouse or tap the screen to play.
brick-slide: Brick Slide is a puzzle game built around falling blocks and spatial thinking. You nudge colored brick pieces sideways to plug empty spots and wipe out complete horizontal lines. Keeping the board clear matters, since fresh rows keep rising from the bottom. Planning chain reactions can produce large combos and help you reach a new high score.

Controls are simple: swipe, or click and drag, any brick left or right. Bricks drop on their own whenever there is open space beneath them. A full row clears right away, earns points, and lowers the board, and clearing several rows in one move earns bonus points. Be careful, though. Every move that clears no line pushes another row up from below, and if the stack reaches the top row, the game ends.
dice-puzzle: This game asks you to place numbered cubes on a grid and join three neighboring cubes that show the same number. When cubes combine, their value rises. Choose carefully, since cubes carry different points, and think about where each one will meet matching partners. Cubes appear singly or in pairs, so plan around both.

Three or more matching cubes merge when they touch horizontally, vertically, or diagonally. To rotate a cube before placing it, tap it in your tray, which helps most with pairs. Drag a cube from the tray onto a fitting spot on the board. Spare storage lets you hold cubes for later use.
bubble-gum: Bubble Gum is a mobile arcade game where you float upward by inflating a balloon. Each tap pumps air into it, and the same taps control how large it gets. Your goal is to climb as far as you can while avoiding spikes. Staying light is key, and the bigger your balloon grows, the more coins you collect along the way.

Locks also stand in your path. To open one, you must match the number on the lock with your balloons. Keep an eye out for spikes while you work toward it, since they are the main hazard you need to dodge.
subway-clash-3d: Step into a 3D shooter set in an underground part of the Moscow metro, where furious KGB soldiers are determined to take you down. Your job is to survive the firefight by picking up a range of weapons and using them to defend yourself. The game also includes multiplayer, so you can go up against other players.
Movement runs on WASD, C lets you crouch, and SPACE makes you jump. Fight well enough and you can climb to the top of the rank table.
don-t-whack-your-boss: Don't Whack Your Boss is a Flash game built around letting off steam at the office. It works like a revenge simulator where the humor is cranked well past realistic, so every prank feels like a cartoon. You get to try many different inventive and wild methods of showing how much you dislike your imaginary manager.

Everything happens inside a safe, make-believe setting, and the boss is entirely fictional. The whole thing is meant as light fun, with none of the outlandish antics reflecting real life. It is a way to vent while staying in a playful, harmless space.
rally-race-pro-3-0-car-racing: Take the wheel in this lifelike rally simulator, where rough hill roads, tight bends, and demanding terrain test you at every turn. Mastering drifts, braking, and precise handling is essential. Tune your suspension, chase faster lap times, and climb the leaderboard in offline rally races.

Dynamic weather and true-to-life physics shape every run, and the cars are finely detailed. The game is built for fans of rally racing and car simulation titles. Press W or the Up Arrow to accelerate and S or the Down Arrow to brake or reverse. Steer with A and D or the Left and Right Arrows, tap Spacebar to handbrake into a drift, and use C to change your car.
survival-race: Survival Race drops you into a fast fight to stay alive on a six-sided arena. Every tile crumbles as you drive over it, so success depends on careful thinking as much as quick reflexes. To keep your car on the platform, you need tight turns, timed jumps, and well-planned moves. Push rivals off the edge and they tumble into dangerous terrain such as water, lava, or acid.

Each rival you eliminate earns you a golden crown. Collect coins along the way and pull off stunts to unlock new cars. As your rank climbs, the competition grows tougher, so only the sharpest drivers keep control of the arena. Steer around gaps, outmaneuver your opponents, and smash them to claim victory. Complete challenges to open better vehicles.
going-up-rooftop: Going Up Rooftop sends you across the rooftops of a sprawling city in a 3D parkour challenge. You scale walls, hop between ledges, wriggle through tight gaps, slide, tumble and zip along ziplines, always working your way higher above the streets. Ladders, poles and scaffolding all become part of the route, and the only rule is to keep climbing.

Pick from three modes: the Story, pure Parkour runs, or Climb and Jump. Watch your stamina, hit checkpoints and grab coins to unlock new outfits for your character. As you rise, rain, snow and wind make the higher floors trickier. Move with WASD or the arrow keys, press Space to jump and grab the next ledge, hold Shift to sprint, and use Ctrl to crouch and crawl. Hold the climb key to move faster on ladders and poles, and move the mouse to look around.
tank-war-battle-game: Tank War Battle Game puts you in the driver's seat of a strong battle tank and sends you into fierce war zones packed with hostile enemies, tough missions, and blasts of gunfire. Your job is to steer, line up shots, fire, and take out enemy tanks to prove what you can do on the front lines. Move through several battle arenas, think ahead before each strike, and keep your weapons in check. Enemy tanks are always ready to attack, so stay sharp and beat your rivals before they get the upper hand.
Controls are simple. Use W or the Up Arrow to move forward, S or the Down Arrow to reverse, and A or D (or the Left and Right Arrows) to turn. Use the mouse to click any on-screen button.
block-combo-blast: Block Combo Blast is a free puzzle game that blends classic block puzzling with bursts of jewels. It offers over 1,800 levels, and its sounds are calming to listen to. You can also compete with players from around the world. The game runs on both phones and computers, so you can aim for puzzle mastery wherever you prefer to play.

To play, pick one of the three tiles offered, then drag and drop it onto the grid. Each time you fill a complete row or column, you score. If none of your three tiles can be placed anywhere on the grid, the game is over. Think ahead, since every placement changes which tiles will fit next.
counter-terror-battle-simulator: Counter Terror Battle Simulator puts you in the middle of counter-terrorism fighting across desert terrain. Its controls are easy to pick up, and the strategy side asks you to think before you act. Each battle uses realistic weapons, so every choice in the field feels meaningful.

Your job is to complete dangerous missions by choosing where your units stand and working closely with your team. Enemies keep coming and do not give up easily, so you need to stay one step ahead of them. Succeed, and you will lock down the key objectives that matter most.
say-cheese: You are the family photographer, and your relatives refuse to stay still. This 3D puzzle is a race against the clock: drag each person onto a glowing spot, tap anyone who wanders off, blinks, or looks away, then press Space or the cheese button in the final seconds so everyone smiles. Your shoots cover weddings, a summer barbecue, picture day, Thanksgiving, Christmas, prom, and graduation.

Meet each client's request, keep the couple centered, and you can earn three-star prints for the album. Tall relatives belong at the back, the couple stands on the gold stars, and kids go in front. Everyone must be in frame with eyes open, facing the camera, for full marks. Between shoots, rename your family, gather films and frames in the photo studio, and meet a new Daily family every day.
match-challenge: Match Challenge is a straightforward puzzle that asks you to spot links between everyday things. A row of mixed objects sits along the lower part of the screen, and your job is to find four that fit together under one heading. The groups could be fruit, tools, animals, or household objects. Speed matters, but so does careful judgment.

To play, study the assortment first, then tap the four pieces you think form a set. Once your selection is made, send it in to see whether you got it right. Later levels add a race against the clock, so you will need to make your choices while the timer keeps running.
save-woman: In Save Woman, you take on the role of a hero whose mission is to rescue a young woman from a range of perilous circumstances. The game is split into numerous levels, and each one presents its own particular challenge. Every scenario gives you two possible moves, yet only one of them brings the rescue to a happy end. The other choice leads to failure.

Before acting, study the picture of her situation and weigh what could follow from each option. You can select a level from the menu or begin with the opening scenario. Once you have settled on an option, click its button to carry it out. Take your time, because a single wrong decision can cost you the round.
wild-horse-simulator-racing-games: Step into the hooves of a wild horse in a large open world full of adventure, survival, and challenges. You can build your own horse family, run a farm, take part in races, or wander through forests and valleys at your own pace. Four modes are on offer: Family, Farm, Racing, and Free Roam. Customize your horse, work through dozens of missions, and discover that each run plays out differently.

Move with WASD, jump with Space, and sprint with Q. Press E to attack and F to perform actions, though the mouse can also be used for actions. Press P to pause, Ctrl to open settings, and i to view information.
fat-2-fit-online: Fat 2 Fit Online is a 3D arcade game with a casual, running-focused feel. Your aim is to get fit enough to win the race. Along the course, you will meet tempting burgers, but they are unhealthy choices, so steer clear of them. Cucumbers are the better pick, so collect those while clearing the obstacles in your way. Use the fitness you gain to race toward victory.
The game is tagged as 3D, Casual and run, and its controls are explained in the game tutorial, so follow that to get started. Everything you need to know about how to play is covered there.
city-car-driver-mega-real-sim: City Car Driver Mega Real Sim is a racing and driving simulator that runs in your web browser using WebGL. It is made for short bursts of fun and rewarding challenges. You can explore detailed city settings, pick up the controls as you go, and work through objectives while sharpening your driving. Movement stays smooth throughout, so the drive runs without interruption.
To get moving, use WASD or the Arrow keys to steer and drive, and press Space to engage the handbrake. Keep an eye on the on-screen objectives to know what to do next. The game men
offroad-truck-driving-simulator: Drive through deep mud in this off-road truck game, which doubles as a lifelike car racing simulator. The visuals are sharp, the driving follows true-to-life physics, and you can choose from a large range of 4x4 trucks, each with its own handling. Tune and customize your rigs as much as you like, then tackle tough obstacles, dozens of off-road races, timed runs, and dirt tracks. Authentic truck sounds, a simple in-game map, and open-road adventures add to the experience. Fans of Snow Runner, Mud Runner, 4x4 Mania, and Offroad Outlaws should feel at home with this diesel truck simulator.
Use W, A, S, D or the arrow keys to move your truck. Press H to sound the horn and R to reverse.
idle-cinema-tycoon: Run your own movie house in this relaxed business sim, then gradually grow it into a whole chain of cinemas. You can buy new screening rooms, set up showtimes, and improve the interiors so your earnings climb. Build up a collection of films spanning many genres, keep in touch with guests in VIP rooms, and squeeze as much money as you can from ticket sales and other income.

Expansion is a big part of the fun. Add locations to your theater and finish missions to unlock valuable rewards. Everything is controlled with the left mouse button, which lets you handle daily operations, buy upgrades, and make strategic choices easily.
nitro-ball: Nitro Ball is a car soccer game that runs entirely in your browser. Drive a boost-powered car, bounce off the walls, and slam a giant ball into the opposing goal. Leap and flip through the air to make saves or scores from anywhere on the pitch.

Pick from quick matches against AI rivals in 1v1, 2v2 or 3v3, a knockout tournament, or Hockey, where a heavy puck slides across ice instead.
