Challenge Maps are timed obstacle courses that test aerial control, and your best time is saved for each one. Customise cars, wheels, decals, boost trails, toppers and over 250 antenna flags, or practise solo in Free Play. Controls: WASD to drive, Space to jump, Shift to boost, V to powerslide, C to change camera, G for scoreboard, and O or Esc to pause. Gamepads are supported, with rebindable controls in Settings.
drawing-games-for-girls: This drawing game is a worksheet for children, filled with animated pictures aimed at little princesses. Young artists can look forward to cute animals, dolls, mermaids, and other fairy tale characters. The mix of cartoon scenes and coloring makes it a fun, educational pick for creative kids.

Playing is simple: use a mouse or tap the screen, depending on your device. The pictures leave room for colors and bring the characters to life, so it works well for quiet, imaginative time. Whether you enjoy sketching or simply like bright, playful art, there is plenty here to keep you busy.
slidey-sliding-cat-puzzle: Slidey is a sliding block puzzle built around kittens. You nudge rows of cat blocks to the left or right, and whenever a line gets filled completely, those cats vanish from the grid. Every slide also pushes a fresh row up from the bottom, so you need to plan ahead. If cat blocks climb all the way to the top, the game ends, so keep an eye on the stack.

There are no timers and nothing rushing you, which makes it a relaxed way to unwind. It is free to play and quick to learn, yet it gives your brain a good workout and can hold your attention for minutes or hours. The challenge never really runs out, and there is always another arrangement to discover.
skateboard-city: Skateboard City is an acrobatic skateboarding game aimed at kids. Your goal is to ride around and grab every star in a level to finish it. Be careful on high ledges, since a bad drop sends you tumbling. Each level gives you just one life, so a fall means starting that level again. A freestyle mode is coming later.

Press the right arrow key to get your skater rolling, then use the arrow keys to steer. Z and X perform tricks, and the space bar makes you jump. On mobile, on-screen controls show up once you rotate your device.
snow-plowing-simulator: Step into the boots of a snow plow operator, starting with nothing more than a shovel. Your first job is clearing paths around a small house. As your work grows, you climb into a tractor to tackle the whole yard or even the street, and eventually you handle highways and airports with a powerful snow plow truck. The simulator is built to pull you deeply into this kind of work, and it stays both entertaining and demanding.

New levels unlock only after you finish the ones before them. You win a level by completing its task in full. Use WASD to move your character or steer the car, press the left mouse button for manual snow removal, and hit Esc to pause.
american-18-wheeler-truck-sim: Fans of truck games should give American 18 Wheeler Truck Sim a look, especially the 2021 edition. It offers a sensible and energetic driving experience built around hauling cargo. As you drive the payload truck, you will face uneven weather and put your mountain driving skills to the test. Driving on slopes, mountains and steep roads makes for a real challenge across rough terrain.

Your main goal is to move freight efficiently and grow into a successful delivery truck carrier. You control the rig with the WASD keys. Each load calls for careful driving, especially when the routes get difficult.
get-a-screw-puzzle: Get a screw: puzzle! is a puzzle game built to give your brain a workout. Inside its three-dimensional world, you solve challenges, twist screws, and gather mechanisms. Each level is its own task, where you must pick the right parts both accurately and quickly. The controls are simple, but the trials become more interesting as you progress.

It suits both kids and adults, since it mixes fun with mental training. Each step makes you more skilled with screws, and new levels are waiting. On desktop, left-click the colour you want, move closer to the wheel, and drag sideways to rotate the model. On a smartphone, touch a screw to grab it, then slide your finger sideways to turn the model.
airplane-factory-tycoon: Run your own aircraft company in Airplane Factory - Tycoon, a clicker where you begin by turning out small, light planes. Over time your operation grows into building huge passenger jets and high-performance fighters. You handle the production lines, improve the factory buildings, train your manager to work better, and open up new aircraft models that bring in more money. Careful planning of your expansion is the key to rising to the top of the plane-making world.

On a computer, move your character across the map with the W, A, S and D keys, or by clicking the left mouse button. On a phone or tablet, just swipe anywhere on the screen to send your character in the direction you want.
tile-jumper-3d: Tile Jumper 3D is a music game where you hop across bright three-dimensional tiles in step with the rhythm. Sharp timing and focus keep the tune flowing, so each jump needs to match the beat. The vivid tiles make the stage feel lively as you move through it.

Every session tests how quick and steady you can stay. Push your own skills to go further, and compare your scores with other players on the leaderboard to see where you rank. It's a fun choice for anyone who enjoys rhythm challenges and wants to show off their precision.
dot-and-dot: Dot and Dot is a single-player 2D puzzle built around pairs of vividly colored dots scattered across a grid. Your task is to draw a route linking every pair of matching dots, making sure no route crosses another. Hints are available when you get stuck, and a double-click will finish the final remaining path for you with a smooth animation. A right-click removes a line so you can redraw it.
Across 300 levels, the puzzles steadily grow harder, giving your logical thinking and spatial reasoning a real workout. Controls are simple: click or tap to play.
queens: Queens is a 2D puzzle game where your goal is to guide royal queens to their proper thrones. Each intricate board asks you to place every queen so that no two can see each other along a line. The puzzles come in bright, color-coded sections, and clearing them is the main challenge.

A ticking clock adds pressure, so you need to plan your moves carefully instead of rushing. Working through these boards gradually sharpens your spatial awareness, which is the skill the game is built around.
find-the-key: Find The Key is a maze puzzler where you wander through winding routes and collect stars along the way. Once you have gathered enough of them, you can grab the key and head for the exit it unlocks. Some stars are tucked away out of sight, so you need to map out each move ahead of time and avoid walking into a dead end.

The mazes grow more intricate as you advance, which rewards careful, deliberate play. It will take logic, patience, and problem-solving to get through them. Movement is controlled entirely with the arrow buttons.
deadshift-halloween-night: Deadshift Halloween Night is a racing game set in a 3D world where the undead rule after dark. Across 20 missions in a quarantined arena, you smash through crowds of zombies, grab supplies, rescue survivors, and race to the extraction point. Powerful collisions send the zombies tumbling into ragdolls, with green splatter flying and limbs coming off on impact.

Choose your vehicle, then customize its paint and upgrade its engine, armor, and nitro. Daily rewards are waiting for you too. To clear a mission, follow the orange markers, complete the objectives shown on screen, and stop inside the green extraction ring before time runs out. Collect green supply crates to repair your car, refill nitro, and earn scrap. Drive with WASD or the arrow keys.
office-escape-to-date: Your evening plans are set, but first you have to slip out of the office. Finish your tasks and get dressed up for a date before the clock runs out. The catch is that your boss could walk in at any moment. When that happens, close whatever you are doing right away and return to your work so you don't get caught. Everything is controlled with the mouse alone.

This casual click game in the hypercasual style mixes dress-up fun with a race against time and the constant worry of being noticed. The challenge is to leave the office and be ready in time for your date.
meow-pair-pop: Meow Pair Pop is a soothing puzzle where you link matching pairs of food tiles. Each board gets trickier as you move along, so the challenge slowly builds. You can travel across the Travel map, take on Daily Challenges, and unlock bright color themes to customize your experience.

To play, tap two identical tiles so they connect and disappear. The path between them must stay open and be made of no more than three straight segments. Every tile has to be cleared before the timer runs out. If you get stuck, reach for Hint, Shuffle, Flip, or Bomb to get moving again.
wall-rush-3d: Wall Rush 3D is a racing game where you sprint as quickly as the wind and compete against some of the finest runners around. Along the way, you can leap off buildings and hurdle over walls. Only the racer who crosses the line first takes the crown of victory.

Steer your runner by swiping left and right. Watch out for obstacles and dangerous gaps, and stay on the course. You can hop up onto rooftops and dash along the edges of walls, but you must keep your footing or you will tumble. Grab coins as you go, and beat your rivals by sprinting to the finish.
fire-truck-driving-simulator: Step into the cab of this fire truck driving simulator, where you handle a fire engine across four distinct modes. Level Mode asks you to reach a blaze and extinguish it before time runs out, spread over ten stages. City Mode lets you wander the streets and choose which emergency calls to take on. Free Mode has no restrictions, so you can practice your firefighting know-how at your own pace, while Parking Mode sets the rescue work aside and focuses on sharpening your parking abilities.
To play, use a mouse click or a tap. Whether you want a timed challenge or an open-ended drive around town, each mode offers a different way to spend time as a firefighter.
gt-racing: GT Racing takes its inspiration from the arcade racers of the 1980s. Its driving feels lively and easy to pick up, thanks to a car control setup that is simple to understand. You race across 21 circuits, and each one holds hidden surprises waiting to be found. The visuals are bright and full of detail, and the cars handle smoothly as you chase top speed. Listen for the engine's roar as you build pace, and save your turbo boost for the moments that matter most.
Fans of rally-style arcade racing will find plenty to enjoy here. Getting started is simple: a mouse click or a tap is all you need.
halloween-fighters: Step into a Halloween-themed arcade fight and pick from 11 monsters. You work your way through 12 haunted arenas to reach three giant bosses: Iron Revenant, Hexwrap, and Witchpump. Your moves include ten punches and kicks that change with the direction you hold, along with chained combos, guard-breaking hits, and glowing super attacks.

The artwork uses hand-drawn comic animation, with bouncy reactions, character voices, and a soundtrack that fits the spooky theme. Knockouts play out in dramatic slow motion. You can choose from three difficulty levels, and an arcade ladder that grows harder as you climb. Move with the arrow keys or WASD. Press Z or J to punch and X or K to kick. Hold forward for a strong attack, back for a medium attack, down for a low attack or sweep, and up for an uppercut or high kick. With no direction held, you throw a light attack.
wood-chopping-game: Wood Chopping Game is a hypercasual title with a brisk pace, so you'll need fast reflexes and good timing to succeed. You take on the role of a resolute lumberjack who cuts through colorful woodland scenes while steering clear of awkward branches that could get in the way.

The game is a treat to look at, with cheerful visuals and captivating sounds. It stays engaging without end and can be quite addictive, making it easy to keep coming back for another round of chopping.
pool-blast-merge-balls: Pool Blast: Merge Balls is a 3D billiards puzzle with a relaxed but lively pace. Your goal is to fuse pool balls together, setting off long chains of merges that can empty the table. Bank shots off the cushions help you pull off clever angles, and two helpers, the Bomb and the Magnet, can save a difficult turn. Push for the highest score you can reach.

Playing is simple. Click or tap and drag to adjust the aiming line, then let go to send the cue ball rolling across the table. When two balls sharing the same number or tier touch, they combine into the next larger ball. Keep merging successfully before your moves run out, and see how
makeup-studio-halloween: Makeup Studio - Halloween invites you to get creative with a seasonal twist. You can give your avatars a fresh look by trying out a range of bewitching makeup styles. The game leans into the eerie side of the holiday, so every fashion choice has a spooky edge.
You can experiment with creepy yet stylish designs while a professional artist guides you through each step. Their advice helps make sure every costume turns out as a haunting creation.
war-robots-battles: Step onto a battlefield set in the future, where you command a squad of robots in fierce fights. Each clash brings a dose of intense robot action, and you can strike back with strong armaments while planning your moves carefully to come out on top.

Pick the machine you want, arm it with the weapon of your choice, and assemble a team that can hold its own. Options include the Wind Sword and the Imperial Bow, among others. You play by clicking the mouse or tapping the screen.
hand-over-hand: Hand Over Hand is a physics-driven climbing game for one player, where you work your way up through a series of demanding levels. Each stage throws moving hazards at you, so you'll need to plan every grip. Your goal is to reach the top first and snatch the red flag, all while watching for slick patches and uneven ground that can throw you off balance. Ragdoll physics make every fall and tumble hard to predict.

To control your climber, press and drag with the left mouse button to pull the character upward, then let go to make it grab hold of whatever it's touching. Dragging left and right builds a swing that carries you to higher ledges. Collect stars along the way to unlock customization options that let you personalize your character.
lets-kill-evil-nun: Lets Kill Evil Nun is a shooting game where you explore a deserted asylum after reports of odd events there. Local rumors point to a sinister nun as the cause, so your job is to hunt down 8 crosses, gather proof that she is real, and make your way out alive. Along the way you will meet zombies and find a range of weapons to help you survive.

Move with W, A, S and D, and steer your view with the mouse. Left click fires, while right click aims down the sights. Scroll the mouse wheel to switch weapons, press G to throw grenades, and use R to reload. Press F to pick up items, hold Left Shift to run, tap Left Ctrl to crouch, and press X to go prone.
save-the-girl-epic: In this puzzle title, your job is to free a girl and guide her past many kinds of hazards. Every stage presents its own obstacles and threats, and you must work out a route to the exit. Keeping her safe is up to you, so think carefully before each move. Some levels may take several tries, so stay patient and keep pushing forward when things go wrong.
Along the way you can visit shops that sell items for decorating rooms and outfits for the girl, which add some style to her escape. Controls are simple: tap the screen to start playing.
buggy-racing: Buggy Racing is an off-road driving game built around speed, fun, and plenty of variety. You can pick from three buggies and three characters, each with a distinct style. Three modes are available: Racing Mode pits you against opponents, Time Lap Mode challenges you to beat the clock, and Endless Mode asks how long you can survive. Drive through tricky tracks, avoid obstacles, and put your skills to the test.
Controls feel smooth and easy to learn on both mobile and keyboard, so you keep full command of your buggy in any situation. On mobile, the on-screen buttons let you steer left and right, manage
robots-battle-mech-arena: Step into a mech arena where giant robots face off in a fierce clash. You take command of huge machines and fight through combat filled with action. Link several strikes together in a row to keep your opponents off balance, and knock out every rival standing between you and the win.

Between bouts, you can strengthen your hero by increasing its damage or raising its health. Play with a simple mouse click or a tap on the screen. Keep improving your fighter as you go, and aim to come out on top of every round.
bottle-avenger-royale: Bottle Avenger Royale is an arcade shooter where you play as a brave bottle hero. Your job is to battle zombies and other enemies and keep yourself alive. Along the way, you can buy new guns, and when two guns of the same level are merged, they become a stronger weapon. You can also spend skill points to boost your character's attributes.

Controls are simple: click the mouse or tap the screen to play. Each upgrade you choose matters, so think about how you merge your guns and where you put your skill points. Fighting off zombies and other enemies is the core of the game, and surviving longer is the goal.
super-willie-world: Super Willie World is a platformer where you guide a mouse named Willie on a playful journey back to his steamboat. The stages move at a relaxed pace, but they are full of hazards, so every step counts. Along the way, you collect coins and defeat foes by landing on top of them, choosing your moments carefully.

Each level gives you only one life, so you need to move with intention and time your jumps precisely. Patience is the key to getting through. Willie's trip is about rediscovering his joy on the river, and you help him get there by taking things slowly, one careful step after another.
brain-dots: Brain Dots is a physics puzzle game where you sketch your way to a solution. Two colorful balls start out on opposite sides of platforms, gaps, and tricky obstacles, and your job is to get them together. You can draw lines or shapes anywhere on the screen, then watch as your drawings push and steer the balls. Gravity and momentum both play a part, so every stroke changes how the balls move.

Each level presents a new puzzle, so take a moment to study the layout before you start drawing. Try to avoid obstacles and keep the balls from tumbling off into the void. The aim is to use as few lines as possible while making both balls touch. Once they meet, the level is complete. Can you find the cleverest route for each pair?
rodha: Rodha is a minimalist platformer that rewards quick reflexes. You guide a round, ball-shaped hero through 60 levels filled with dangerous obstacles. Each stage asks you to steer a range of distinctive characters past hazards that can end your run in a moment.

Coins scattered through the stages can be spent on upgrades, so gathering them along the way pays off. Hitting your timing just right also opens up a seemingly endless set of customization options. The game is built around skill, offering a simple look paired with a challenge that stays engaging.
golden-boot-2022: Golden Boot 2022 is a soccer game where you aim to finish as the top scorer and collect other trophies along the way. You can go for a hat trick, but every shot has to get past both the defenders and the goalkeeper before the golden boot trophy is yours.

Controls are simple. Move your mouse or finger to line up your shot, then click or lift your finger to kick. You never need to swipe, so you can focus on reading the defense and finding a gap in the keeper's reach.
pickaxe-crusher-idle: Pickaxe Crusher Idle sends you into underground mines, where a miner swings a pickaxe that keeps bouncing down through the rock. You steer by clicking the left or right arrow to dash the pickaxe sideways, pushing further into the caves with each move. Along the way you gather resources and unlock other tools, including axes, arrows, and swords.

Spend what you collect on upgrades for your tools, talents, and skills through the on-screen interface to speed up your progress. Achievements give you goals to chase, and you can advance through the prestige system. Every descent into the depths brings fresh opportunities, challenges, and valuable treasures to find.
hatch-surprise-pets: Step into a gentle, dreamy world full of Surprise Pets, soft and fluffy little animals that are very easy to adore. Your job is to look after these pets and collect them all. Fluvsies is a virtual pet care game made for girls and boys who enjoy nurturing animals.

You control everything with your mouse or by tapping the screen. The game sits in the Girls category and carries tags for animals, grooming, puzzles, fun, and kids. It is built with HTML5 and works on mobile devices too.
raccoon-bubble-shooter: Raccoon Bubble Shooter is a laid-back puzzle game where you guide a clever, adorable raccoon through a bright, colorful world of bubble-popping tasks. You aim your shots, line up matching bubbles, and pop them to finish each stage and collect rewards. Planning ahead lets you chain together strong combos and get past awkward obstacles. Each new stage brings tougher puzzles, so there is plenty to keep you busy for a long time.

Everything is controlled with the mouse, so just click any button to move through the game. The gameplay is simple to pick up, yet it leaves room for thoughtful strategy as you progress. Whether you want a short break or a longer session, the mix of relaxing pace and steadily rising challenge makes it easy to settle in.
sponge-challenge: Sponge Challenge is a 2D puzzle platformer starring a springy yellow sponge. You guide it as it gathers purple diamonds, all while avoiding obstacles and sneaky traps placed throughout each level. Every stage works like a small riddle: you use the sponge's sticky grip to climb walls and hop from one surface to the next until you find the route to the magic portal that opens the way forward. As you advance, the levels grow more intricate, so careful timing and fast decisions become essential.

Controls are simple but engaging. A tap makes the sponge jump, and by bouncing off walls and platforms you can change its direction mid-air. This lets you slip past hazards and work through each stage's challenges.
stealth-silent-squid: A squid is locked in a cage at the top of a heavily watched tower. You steer its tentacle through rooms filled with guards, gathering the lost pieces scattered along the way so the limb can stretch farther. Almost anything in a room can be turned into a weapon, so you'll need to think creatively.

Seize enemies, hurl pieces of furniture, smash through barriers, and solve puzzles to clear a path to the cage. Every clash runs on physics, and the bright 3D levels contain dangerous obstacles to avoid. On a computer, use W, A, S, and D to move, or click the left mouse button to send the tentacle toward the pointer. On a phone or tablet, swipe across the screen to guide it.
blade-merge: Blade Merge mixes merge-based strategy with fast, close-quarters blade fights. You join blades together to create stronger weapons, then use them to beat enemy bots in quick matches. The spinning, sharp blades are how you cut through opponents, wear down their health, and keep your own safe as you move through the stages.

Control is simple: press and use the left mouse button to play. The game is a 2D casual title that works with a mouse and on mobile devices, and it falls under the action category with a battle focus.
shooting-range: Shooting Range is an arcade-style first-person shooter in which accuracy matters most. Your job is to hit targets that keep moving, and as you progress you can unlock additional guns. The game also includes distinct areas where familiar faces show up to make things harder.
Each zone brings its own mix of tests, so you will need to keep your aim sharp while the pressure builds. It is a good pick if you enjoy fast rounds that reward careful shooting and steady nerves.
live-eating-simulator: Picture yourself hosting a live broadcast where eating takes center stage. In this simulator, you decide how every bite goes and tackle huge meal challenges one after another. Snatch up plates as you go, and keep your hunger in check so you can keep chewing.

Along the way, your streamer persona levels up in real time. Your virtual viewers need to stay entertained, since their attention is what grows your subscriber count. Move quickly, stream with plenty of energy, and watch your channel expand. Just use a mouse click or tap to play.
mad-max-zombie-arena: Mad Max Zombie Arena is a 3D racing game where you steer a customized car through a landscape crawling with the undead. It is enjoyable and hard to put down, and it showed up just in time for the apocalypse. To stay alive, you pick the vehicle you like best and weave around the zombies as you go. Keep moving, race your war vehicle across the arena, and take the undead down.

Controls are simple. Use W, A, S and D to drive, hold space for the handbrake, and press N for nitro. On mobile, on-screen controls handle everything. The game is free to play and suits anyone who enjoys drifting through zombie-filled chaos.
stretch-guy: The matchmaker is trying to make his way back home, but the trip turns out to be harder than it sounds. He has to stretch his body outward and shift himself back a little at a time. His limbs can only press against the wall, so it is up to you to guide each one into place.

Go easy on the pressure, because shoving too hard will make him spread apart. Everything is controlled by dragging, so use your pointer to move him along. Every small movement matters when you are helping him inch closer to home.
cat-boba-tea-food-asmr-master: Step into the paws of a small feline cook in this kitchen simulator. Your days blend preparing food yourself, going live to chat with viewers, browsing the shop, and dressing up your cat as you wish. The heart of it is cooking tasty dishes, serving them to your audience, and living the life of an ASMR eating livestream host.
Mix and match different styles to build a stream setup that feels entirely your own. It's a relaxed, easygoing game, and everything is handled with a mouse click or a tap.
cooking-korean-lesson: Cooking Korean Lesson invites you into the lively world of Korean food. In this interactive game, you learn how to prepare real dishes such as Kimchi and Bibimbap. You work through cooking tasks one step at a time, and you collect rewards as your skills with different flavors grow. It is a bright, colorful kitchen experience built around learning to cook.
destruction-simulator: Destruction Simulator is a sandbox where you can wreck buildings with a lot of control. Time can be slowed, sped up, or stopped completely. Gravity can be set low or high, or switched off for a weightless, space-like feel. Explosion visuals can be hidden, reduced to smoke only, or shown with lights and flashes. A debris limit makes extra pieces fade away smoothly, and a destructibility level lets you add more debris when a scene feels sparse.

Choose from about 13 explosives, including missiles, dynamites and bombs, along with earthquakes, tornadoes and singularities. Cannonballs come in different sizes, and a custom gun editor lets you craft your own weapon. There are over 30 prebuilt maps to demolish, plus a map editor for building new ones. On a computer, drag with the left mouse button to rotate the camera, move with WASD, and use QE to raise the camera shutter. On mobile, use your fingers and the in-game interface.
draw-couple: Draw Couple is a no-cost sketching brainteaser for boys, with bright, vivid HD visuals and easy-to-follow play. Each puzzle shows a picture with an unfinished section, and your task is to complete it using a single continuous stroke. Hundreds of different scenarios move the story along, so every new scene adds to the adventure.

The game can be played on mobile phones, tablets, and desktop computers. You control it with a mouse click or a tap, so getting started takes almost no time. No matter which device you use, the same pu
find-match-3d: Find Match 3D is a puzzle game where you hunt for groups of three matching objects in a crowded, colorful collection. The visuals are lovely, and the calm pace suits players of any age. Every level is a race against the clock, so you aim to clear the board while chasing high scores.

To play, spot three identical items and tap each one to select it. Once you've chosen a matching set, those items vanish. Your goal is to clear the whole board before time runs out. When a stage gets especially tricky, you can use boosters to help. Finishing levels with high scores unlocks new challenges to try.
mini-shooters: Mini Shooters is a 2D shooting game built around deathmatch fights. You can equip multiple weapons, so you are not limited to a single gun while you battle other players. It is a fun way to jump into a match and see which weapons you can collect next.

Move with WASD or the arrow keys, and aim with your mouse. A left click fires your weapon, and pressing Space picks up a weapon so you can equip it. These simple controls cover everything you need to get started.
angry-bird-friends: Step into the Star Cup and face rival players one on one. You can also test yourself against friends, climb the leaderboards, and aim to become the best Angry Birds player in the world. Tournaments kick off every Monday, Thursday, and Saturday, and each week brings 24 fresh levels. Beat your opponents to move up into higher leagues, or claim the top spot for rewards. Every other week, a special themed tournament arrives.

Each level gives you free power ups, level effects, and special slingshots to use. Gather feathers to level up your birds and boost their scoring power. Stringing several wins together in a row increases the rewards you collect. The game is controlled with the mouse.
hero-time: In Hero Time, you play as Ben 10, who transforms into one of his ten alien forms to stop Bily Billions and his plot. Each alien you become has its own special power, and you will need to use these abilities to get past a variety of obstacles and save the day.

Ben tries to spoil the villain's scheme by harnessing the power of the Omnitrix, and you take control of him as he works through each challenge. Steer the ball with your finger, or use your computer mouse.
jump-ball-2021: In this hypercasual title, a bouncing ball hops along a road made of tiles, and your job is to guide it from one tile to the next. Each tile shows a number, and you must tap it that many times before moving on. You cannot jump ahead until the taps on the current tile are finished. The game is set in 3D with an arena feel and an endless style of play.
Your goal is to complete the target missions and reach the winning point. Stay focused, because every tile has to be cleared in full. To control the ball, click anywhere on the screen.
monster-go: Monster Go is a brain game where you link cute, cube-shaped monsters across a colorful grid. Each stage asks you to plan your moves carefully, and the puzzles grow harder as you move forward. Every level you clear rewards you with stars, so there is a clear sense of progress along the way.

The game blends thoughtful strategy with a playful, lighthearted look. Working through its bright stages feels like a quirky journey through a puzzle world. If you enjoy problems that reward patience and clever thinking, this one offers plenty to chew on.
click-that-button: You start with one large red button, and every press adds to your growing empire. Cash from each tap goes toward upgrades that raise what the next press earns. Later, hired helpers tap on their own and keep earning even when you step away. Build a quick tapping rhythm to fill the combo meter for critical hits, and remember that the spacebar works too.

Eleven collectable buttons, six tiers of hands to merge, and guardian bosses that block the way to each new button are all waiting ahead. Use the arrows beneath the button to switch between the buttons you have unlocked, and combine three matching hands from the roster into a stronger tier. Tap fast to defeat each guardian, and catch golden buttons drifting across the screen for a burst of cash. It is easy to begin with a single tap, and it keeps opening up for about an hour.
merge-items-build-city: Here you run a growing town and try to make life simpler and happier for its residents. Your job is to lay out simple homes and roads so the citizens feel content. Play with a mouse on a computer or with a finger on a phone. Tap a building to begin its construction, then pick a job by clicking or touching it.

Merging is the core mechanic: drag two identical items together to combine them. Joining stones gives bricks, and joining trees gives boards. Add a hospital and a kindergarten, open shops and banks, and collect income from every building to grow richer. Finish tasks and quests to boost your earnings. All of a building's tasks must be completed before it goes up, and you'll create stairs, windows, and walls along the way.
help-me-tricky-story-of-puzzles: Help Me: Tricky Story of Puzzles is a relaxed logic game that pairs clean two-dimensional visuals with controls that are easy to pick up. Your job is to guide a character through awkward predicaments by selecting the tools that will free them, all while steering clear of the hazards along the way. Each choice sets off a chain of events, and the results often turn out far more comical than you would expect.
To play, click the character and drag the hand that appears. Hold and drag across obstacles to reach items, then pick the one that
relaxing-games: Take a laid-back trip through Relaxing Games, a collection of light, enjoyable mini-games made for unwinding whenever you have some spare time. The lineup covers several styles, and each one is simple to pick up while still being really entertaining. Playing feels effortless, so you can slip into the game world without much effort.

Among the options you'll find simple elimination, simulation challenges, easy hooting games, and puzzles. Moving between them is quick and free, so you can change direction whenever you feel like it. Everything is controlled with a mouse click or a tap, making it easy to start on a computer or a phone.
doodle-halloween-momo-cat-academy: Momo is a brave young cat with strong magic, and she attends a school for spellcasting. One Halloween night, a band of silly ghosts sneaks inside and steals the magic spellbook, so Momo has to set things right. You play with a mouse on a computer or with your finger on a touchscreen, drawing the symbols that appear above each ghost's head. Every correct shape casts a spell that sends the ghost packing.

The journey takes you through the classroom, the cafeteria, and up to the rooftop. As you progress, the ghosts move faster and become sneakier, so quick hands and sharp eyes will help. Each stage ends with a boss ghost, which may ask you to draw a long chain of symbols. Cute characters, colorful animations, and simple touch controls make this a safe, friendly game for players of all ages.
slide-block-jam: Slide Block Jam is a block puzzle game where you test your thinking by sliding colorful blocks toward doors of the same color, opening a path as you go. Each stage brings fresh hurdles, so you need to study the board and map out your moves before acting. Solving a level means clearing the way completely.

Expect puzzles that push both your logic and your strategy. As you advance, the layouts grow more complicated and inventive, and you'll face tough barriers as well as spots where you must slide pieces aside to make room. Every completed level unlocks harder obstacles, so the challenge keeps building and your attention stays on the board for a long time.
color-cube-puzzle: Color Cube Puzzle is a calm logic game where careful planning matters more than speed. You slide colored shapes across the board and park them beside the cube conveyors. When a cube's hue lines up with a shape's hue, that shape begins to pick up cubes. Once it is packed full, it vanishes from the stage. Clear every shape to finish the level.
Nothing ticks away: no timers, no bombs, no rush, so take your time. Wrong moves can block your route, so look ahead before you act. A mistake never ends your run, and
glam-doll-salon-makeup-and-dressup-game: Glam Doll Salon is a playful design and dress-up game aimed at girls. You'll find plenty of outfits and cosmetics to choose from. Your job is to create the newest looks by styling makeup and hair, then dressing the model until she appears just right. Controls are simple: tap or click to make your selections.
Anyone who enjoys pretty characters and creative styling should find this a relaxing pick. Start whenever you feel like experimenting with fresh combinations and seeing how the model turns out.
brick-breaker-ball: Brick Breaker Ball is a classic arcade favorite built around fast-paced brick smashing. Keep the ball in motion and clear rows of bricks while the action moves quickly. Along the way, grab power-ups and extra lives before they fall out of reach. It is a good chance to set a new high score.
To play, just click the mouse or tap the screen. Mouse and touch controls work the same way, so you can start right away on either a computer or a touch device.
superstar-family-dress-up-game: Step into a bright fashion world where you dress up a superstar family of four. Pick outfits, apply makeup, and add pets or fireworks to the scene. There are endless choices, so you can mix and match until each look feels one of a kind.

Once your styles are ready, snap a picture of your finished creation against one of the dynamic backgrounds. Your scenes can be shared with friends with very little effort, so you can show off your work right away. The game is filed under Girls and Dress Up.
niko-adventure: Niko Adventure is a platform game that blends careful planning with quick reflexes. You move through colorful scenery, dodging obstacles and grabbing coins along the way. Outwitting the Dinos is how you earn keys, so thinking ahead matters just as much as speed.

Each stage gets tougher than the last, pushing your skills further as you go. Keep an eye out for hidden rewards tucked away in the levels. The game is built around a bright, busy world that keeps you engaged from start to finish.
witch-s-shop-potion-brewing: Take on the role of a witch who runs her own enchanted potion shop in this cozy simulation game. Your days revolve around gathering rare ingredients, mixing powerful brews, and handling unusual requests from the people who walk through your door. No two visitors bring the same trouble, so you must figure out which potion will actually solve each one. As you progress, you can upgrade your shop and expand it, with the goal of turning your small store into the most famous magical shop around.
On a computer, press W, A, S, and D to move your character. On a phone or tablet, touch the screen and use the virtual joystick to get around.
last-chair: Picture a musical chairs contest with 100 competitors sprinting through a messy course of hazards while the tune keeps playing. The moment the melody cuts out, everyone scrambles for a free seat, and anyone left standing without one drops out. Your character runs forward on its own during the music, so your job is mostly steering and timing jumps to dodge trouble and stay in a good spot around the arena.

On desktop, move the mouse to steer and left-click to jump. On mobile, drag your finger to steer and tap the JUMP button to leap. When the music stops, head straight for an open chair. Nine rounds stand between you and victory, and whoever takes the final chair wins.
robotex: Robotex invites you to build one-of-a-kind robots in an adventure that doubles as a learning experience. You put pieces together by dragging and dropping parts into place, gradually shaping detailed machines. Each new challenge encourages you to think creatively and work through problems along the way.

The game looks bright and colorful as it moves through steadily harder builds. Along the way you pick up the fundamentals of robot design while you play. It suits anyone curious about how machines come together and who enjoys hands-on puzzles.
nextbot-can-you-escape: You find yourself trapped in a world full of nextbots, and your goal is to last until a set amount of time passes so you can get away. These creatures chase you relentlessly, moving at a rapid pace. If one gets close enough, it knocks you aside and you are eliminated on the spot. There is no recharge between attacks, so a single pursuer can take out several people in one go.
Move with W, A, S and D, and turn your view by moving the mouse. Press F to interact or to hide, then press T to step back out of your hiding place. Hit Escape whenever you need to pause the action.
formula-car-stunt: Pilot a formula racer along lofty courses that stretch high above the clouds. The game offers five modes to try, including Stunt Mode, Police Chase, and Zigzag Mode, and each one brings its own challenges and fast driving. Your jobs include taking tight corners, speeding through bold routes, slipping away from police pursuers, and handling roads that seem almost impossible to cross.
Control your car with W, A, S, and D, or use the arrow keys instead. Press to accelerate, brake when needed, and ste
alien-quarantine: Twenty missions await aboard a research facility that has been taken over by alien life. This top-down sci-fi shooter has you clear three waves of growing intensity while dodging enemy fire. Every level ends with a larger, one-of-a-kind boss to defeat. Alien designs and attack styles shift as you move from one sector to the next.

Your goals include restoring power to consoles, rescuing crew members, collecting samples, keeping evacuation routes secure, and pushing deeper into the station. Aim with the mouse, left-click to fire, and right-click to throw a grenade. Move with WASD or the arrow keys, press E to use consoles, grab items, and activate exits, and press Esc to pause. On touchscreen devices, on-screen controls handle movement, firing, grenades, and interaction.
screw-color-puzzle: Screw Color Puzzle is an online brain teaser where you sort screws by color. Each screw must be matched with the screw case that shares its shade, and you clear every screw from the board to move through the levels. The setting around the puzzle is designed to keep your attention while you work.

The game is free and runs on both computers and phones, so you can switch between devices whenever you like. It is a good workout for your logic, matching, and color recognition, and it is built to be brain-stimulating for hours of entertainment. If you enjoy testing your thinking, it also challenges your IQ.
protect-my-dog: Protect My Dog is a light, playful puzzle game where your job is to keep an adorable dog safe from a swarm of bees. On each level you sketch a defensive line with your mouse to block the attackers. The dog also faces other dangers such as lava, thorns, and assorted hazards from the surroundings that you need to keep away from it.

The game spans 50 levels of bee-fending, and the challenge builds a little with every stage. Tags for the game include casual, drawing, fun, funny, and hypercasual, which suit its quick, easy-to-pick-up style.
rise-of-the-dead: Rise of the Dead puts you in a shooting horror setting where zombies press in from all directions while you work through objectives. The city has descended into disorder, and your job is to find out what triggered the collapse and keep yourself alive. Along the way you can strengthen your firearms, purchase fresh weapons, and sharpen your abilities to give yourself a better shot at surviving.

The game offers several styles of play, including sniper missions, survival challenges, and resource hunting. On a computer, move with the arrow keys or WASD, open the menu with Tab, and fire with a left click. R reloads, E punches, Q swaps weapons, G and F trigger your two props, and the scroll wheel zooms. On mobile, steer with the virtual joystick and tap the on-screen buttons to act.
barrel-roller-stack-and-run-3d: Barrel Roller is a 3D endless runner set on a colorful track. Drag left or right to steer, and gather barrels to make your stack grow taller. Watch out for obstacles and traps along the way, and keep your balance while you run.

Your goal is to build the tallest stack you can and reach the finish line to win rewards. The controls are simple enough for players of all ages, so it works well for short play sessions. The game runs right in your browser, is free to play, and receives new levels and features regularly. Its smooth, bright 3D visuals keep the action moving.
satispuzzle-perfect-tidy: SatisPuzzle Perfect Tidy blends brain teasers with a set of light, bite-sized mini-games spread across several themes. Expect jobs like sorting items and making deliveries, along with cooking tasks, puzzles that need some thought, and creepy hunts for hidden objects. Each stage presents a new small test, so there is always something different to try.

If you enjoy putting things in order, the tidy-up side of the game offers ASMR-style cleaning play. You tap and drag items, sort them, and arrange them, slowly turning cluttered scenes into clean, calm spaces. Cooking fans will also find plenty to keep them busy. To play, tap and drag.
knock-down: Knock Down, also known as Bottle Hit, challenges you to clear a set of bottles using a slingshot and a ball. Your goal is to rely on logic and careful aiming so that every bottle comes down. The game includes many different levels, each with its own unique and interesting layout to work through.

To fire, touch the ball and the slingshot, move to aim, then release. You only get a limited number of balls, so each throw matters. Knock down all the bottles to win the level. If you use up your balls while any bottle is still standing, the level is failed and it's game over.
cubetopia-parkour: Cubetopia Parkour is a jumping game set high in the air, where good timing and smooth movement matter most. Your route crosses platforms that hang in the sky, and the game borrows the physics of Minecraft. Every leap needs careful judgment, because the course is built to test how agile you really are.
The challenge goes beyond simply reaching the top. You will need to overcome your nerves, keep stretching your limits, and climb toward impressive heights without tumbling off the edge.
sort-the-beads: Sort The Beads is a color-sorting puzzle where you tap the beads on screen and guide each shade toward its matching container. Gathering every color into the right place is the aim, so you will want to think ahead before each move. Clearing the whole board finishes a level, and the stages grow tougher as you go. The controls are simple, and the relaxing visuals keep things calm even as layouts get tricky.

Every stage asks for sharp timing, close observation, and a clear plan, since one careless move can block a route you still need. Later levels bring more colors, obstacles, and demanding arrangements to work through. Keep an eye on which paths stay open and which beads are in the way.
find-a-pair-3d: Find a Pair 3D asks you to spot two matching objects within a heap of items and combine them. Each successful match earns you one star, so your aim is to join as many pairs as you can and build up a large star count. As you move through the levels, new objects keep appearing and they become more varied, which makes each round trickier than the last. Higher levels bring harder combinations to sort out.

Your scores can be compared with other players on the leaderboard, where you can see how you stack up and try to reach the top spot. To play, drag an object onto one of the round platforms near the bottom of the screen. A level is finished once you have found every pair in it.
survival-island: Survival Island drops you onto a tropical island where staying alive is up to you. You wander the land, chop wood, mine stone, and collect other materials you find along the way. With those supplies you can put up shelters, craft handy items, and improve both your tools and your character. New areas open up as you go, letting you push outward and grow your base until the wild island starts to feel like home.

Resources are scarce, so you have to keep a close eye on what you hold and keep improving to make it through. Controls are simple: move around the island and get to work. The game is built around a survival adventure mood, with plenty of gathering, building, and crafting to keep you busy. Can you endure the island and turn it into your own paradise?
battle-simulator-sandbox: Build your own force and lead it to triumph in Battle Simulator - Sandbox. Try out a wide range of troop types to get the better of opponents across many different scenarios, or switch to sandbox mode and let your imagination run wild. The controls are simple to pick up, and you can refine your plans as you go. Every puzzling challenge you overcome brings a satisfying sense of winning through clever tactics.
roof-rails-color-stack-3d: Roof Rails - Color Stack 3D is an arcade game where a round runner slides along rails across the roof. Tricky tracks include shortcuts you can take, and along the way you collect cubes that build a tall, colorful stack under your character. Hurdles block the path, and hitting them eats away at the rails you have gathered, so the stack gets smaller when you lose pieces. Performing stunts and avoiding obstacles will carry you to the end point. The game is simple enough that you won't need a guide or hints.

Diamonds and coins are scattered across the track, and you can spend them on new skins or use them to unlock levels. The game is aimed at both boys and girls, and the runners start moving on their own. You control it with the keyboard.
owl-hunter: Set in the magical forest, this sling shooter follows King Alden, who sets out on a night hunt in the land of Willowvale with his trusted sling. His target is owls, which tuck themselves away inside blocks and barriers. Your job is to fire balls from the sling and smash through every barrier until the owls are caught. Shots are scarce, so every launch counts.

Fans of adventure, action, RPG, sling shooting, or quest-driven games should find plenty to enjoy here. The game offers high-quality graphics, a very small game size, very easy controls, and interesting quests to work through. On Android, use the on-screen touch controls with taps and holds. On PC, use a left mouse click and hold.
taxi-rush: Taxi Rush is a driving simulation where you race through busy city streets to deliver clients quickly and safely. Dense traffic and roadblocks keep every trip tense, and each passenger arrives with unique demands that you must manage to earn rewards.

Between runs, you can upgrade and customize your taxi, then plan your routes carefully as you climb the leaderboard. Use the left mouse button and the W, A and D keys to control the car through this urban adventure.
last-archer: Last Archer is a bright, cheerful archery game built around tower defense. Your job is to guard your tower from playful but troublesome monsters. Take careful aim and shoot at the enemies, and also at explosive barrels that can blow up a whole group at once. The attacks come quickly and keep things lively, so you have to stay sharp to keep your fortress intact.

To play, aim and launch your arrows with the mouse or with touch controls. Every monster must be stopped before it gets close to your tower. When a crowd of enemies gathers, hit an explosive barrel for a strong blast that can clear them out.
nextboot-horror-online: NextBoot Horror Online sends you on an unsettling trip through a trap set in a nightmare-like setting. You play the main character, and your job is to think your way past the boots that keep showing up around every corner, then get away from them. Tense moments keep your nerves on edge, while detailed visuals and sound work build a mood of fear and unease.
The game suits people who enjoy both casual and action titles, since it mixes traits of each. Move with the arrow keys or WASD, hold Shift to run, and use the mouse to look around.
race-rocket-arena-car-extreme: RACE: Rocket Arena Car Extreme drops you into a 3D survival racer set in a post-apocalyptic world. You can upgrade your combat cars, fire weapons, raise protective shields, and boost forward with nitro. Each arena is packed with traps and destruction, so you have to race and fight at the same time. Win battles to unlock new vehicles and aim to be crowned the top champion.

Controls: press the Up arrow or W for nitro, Down or S to brake, and Left or A and Right or D to move. Space fires rockets, Q activates your superpower, and E raises your shield. Use the mouse for navigation.
lovely-virtual-cat-at-school: Step into a school where you have the final say. Your virtual pets are waiting for you to get to know them and help them perform well. Plenty of costumes are available, so you can dress each pet in something unique and start with the theme you love most.

Head to the art room, where a set of colored pencils lets you paint your creations. You can decorate your artwork with stickers, or try a coloring game to stretch your imagination. Fruits and vegetables can also be used to make some wild decorations. Play with your mouse or by tapping the screen.
stickman-punishment-2: In this arcade adventure, Stickman has framed a player, who nearly died as a result. Now the tables turn, and it's your job to make the troublemaker answer for every prank he pulled. A special power gives you plenty of room to get creative with his comeuppance. Pick whichever punishment suits your mood from the options on offer.

Controls are simple. A computer mouse does the job, and mobile device users can tap with a stylus or a finger. Begin by sitting through the story animation, then decide how Stickman will be punished. To browse every punishment he can receive, press the buttons and explore the full list.
hugi-wugi: Hugi Wugi is a 3D adventure where you keep moving and never stop. A creature called Hugi Wugi is always behind you, so you must hurry. Your task is to find the lucky block before the clock runs out, because the creature could catch you if you are too slow. Reach the lucky block to move on to the next level.

Play with the WASD keys to move your character. Use the mouse cursor to turn the view a full 360 degrees and look around. If you need a break, press the P key to pause the game. This is a one-player title with an alien theme, and it fits the arcade and action side of the site's collection.
boat-merge: Boat Merge is a calm idle puzzle where you join matching boats to build faster, more valuable ones. As you grow your fleet, you can unlock dozens of different boats, widen your waterways, and collect coins without any extra effort. Upgrades and boosters help you move ahead at a quicker pace.

To merge, drag two identical boats together so they become a stronger, higher-level vessel. Put your boats on open routes and they will start earning coins on their own. Spend those coins on new boats and upgrades, then keep combining, adding to your fleet, finishing tasks, and opening up more powerful boats. Your main aim is to find the top-level boats and earn as much as you can. On desktop, click and drag with the mouse; on mobile, tap and drag with one finger. No keyboard is needed.
jiffy: Jiffy is a fast-moving platform game with an old-school look. Your reflexes are tested from the start, since you must hop past hazards and foes while working your way to the end of each level. Smashing through breakable blocks opens new paths, and tapping jump twice in quick succession fires a powerful shot that takes down enemies. The game features more than 25 levels, tough boss battles, and both endless and battle modes.

On a computer, move with WASD or the arrow keys, jump with the spacebar, and press the spacebar more than once to shoot. On a phone or tablet, use the on-screen buttons to move and jump, and tap the jump button more than once to fire. Time your jumps carefully, break through obstacles, and defeat enemies with precision.
soccer-random: Soccer Random takes football in a silly, unpredictable direction. Each match gives you just one key to work with, and every round tends to play differently from the last. The pitch might be covered in ice one moment and sand the next. Your aim is to reach five goals first, though the balls, the players, and even the goal posts can switch up along the way. You can face the computer or challenge a friend in two-player mode. On phones and tablets, touch controls let you join in.

Player 1 uses the W key, while Player 2 uses the up arrow key. Both sides share the same keyboard, so you can sit beside a friend and take turns trying to outscore each other. Expect the physics to keep things lively and the matches to surprise you.
good-guys-and-bad-boys-zombie-survival-g: Good Guys & Bad Boys Zombie Survival GUI is a fast shooter where you fight through waves of zombies. Built with Unity, it offers plenty of action from start to finish. Steer your character with W, A, S, and D, and use the mouse to aim and shoot. Switch weapons through the gun menu, which you open with the Tab key, and press the spacebar to jump. Enemies keep closing in, so you need to stay alert.
Each intense round tests your reflexes and how well you manage your weapons. Your task is to fight and stay alive on the battlefield. You can jump into the fight online in your browser.
join-the-gang-and-fight: Gather your crew in this online multiplayer party game built on physics. Stickman fighters face off in player-versus-player arenas where everything wobbles and flops. Team up with friends to form a gang, then trade punches, kicks, and floppy ragdoll moves in slapstick brawls. Each match plays out differently because the physics are carefully accurate, so you never quite know how a fight will end.

Pick from several events, including Brawl, Kick the King, Steal the Chicken, Racing, and Football. Learn how your stickman moves, knock your rivals off their feet, and enjoy the messy chaos of playing with others. Controls are simple: just click the mouse or tap the screen.
magic-castle-invasion-idle-rpg: Step into the role of a wizard whose job is to protect a castle filled with magic from frightening monsters. The realm is home to strange creatures, perilous dungeons, and treasure waiting to be found, and survival belongs only to the toughest. Build up your power, call on a group of magical allies to fight beside you, and push through the struggle to stay alive.

The game offers wizard battles, hunting and defeating monsters, and magical upgrades that help your character grow. You can explore the land, take on quests, and construct and guard your castle. Boss fights and special challenges test your skill along the way. Movement uses the WASD keys or the on-screen joystick, and your wizard attacks foes that come near on its own.
boing-bang: Boing Bang drops you into fast, hectic play where you steer a odd little creature carrying a blaster. You move through a space full of bouncing chaos, blasting huge balls until they break into smaller pieces. Platforms are there to help you, so you need to use them with care and timing.

The bouncing follows patterns that are hard to predict, and you have to learn them to get ahead. Your survival is on the line, so each shot you fire matters. It's a lively retro arcade adventure that rewards quick thinking.
tile-pair-jam-mahjong-master: In this mahjong-style brain teaser, your job is to push tiles sideways or up and down so that identical pieces line up. Think ahead before every slide, since each choice affects what you can clear next. Your aim is to remove all of the tiles from the board, and the layouts grow tougher as you move along.

Controls are simple: swipe up, down, left, or right to shift tiles along a row or column. Tiles never travel on a diagonal. When two matching tiles sit in the same row or column with nothing blocking the path between them, they vanish. Keep shifting and pairing until the board is empty.
half-life-2-platformer: Take on the role of Gordon Freeman as you work through five chapters of this illustrated action platformer based on Half-Life 2. Your tools are a crowbar, an SMG, and the gravity gun, and you will need each of them as you push back against the Combine.

Every stage is drawn in an illustrated style, so the familiar world of Half-Life 2 looks quite different here. Getting started is simple: one mouse click or tap is all it takes to begin, and you move through the chapters as you progress.
pull-him-out-online: A hunter sets off in search of treasure, but along the way he gets caught in a series of puzzles that leave him stuck. Your job is to work out how to draw the sticks in the correct sequence. Get the order right, and the hunter can grab the hidden treasure and leave without harm.

This is a puzzle game that relies on logic and careful thinking, and it suits both boys and girls. Everything is controlled with the mouse, so you simply click and draw to move through each challenge. It also carries an adventure theme, giving the whole experience a treasure-hunting feel.
residence-of-evil-quarantine: You play as a survivor during a zombie apocalypse. Your path leads through a city overrun by the infected, and as you push forward, you uncover the truth behind the deadly virus that started the outbreak. The game is presented in 3D, and you'll find plenty of weapons to help you face more than ten types of monsters.
Controls are simple. The left mouse button fires, and the right mouse button aims, while W, A, S and D move you around. Hold Left Shift to sprint, press Left Ctrl to crouch, and tap X to go pr
cuphead-rush: Cuphead Rush is a 2D action adventure for one player, where you sprint alongside the familiar Cuphead cast. Your route passes through hazardous surroundings, so you must avoid spikes while grabbing stars and power-ups along the way. Boosters can also be earned for keeping your run going.

Obstacles appear constantly, so you will need to jump over some, slide under others, roll out of the way, or dodge incoming rockets. The stars you collect can be spent to unlock new characters. The game is endless, so your aim is to beat the best scores. Control everything with a mouse or by touch.
go-octopus-find-pearl: Go Octopus Find Pearl is a puzzle game set beneath the waves. You guide a charming octopus through the deep ocean in search of valuable gems. Each level asks you to get past obstacles and steer clear of hazardous sea creatures, while picking the correct route so that every gem gets collected.

The rules are easy to pick up, yet the game is hard to stop playing once you start. Its bright, lively visuals and plenty of tricky challenges make it a good fit for players of any age. Move your octopus with the W, A, S, and D keys or with the arrow keys.
hoop-world: Hoop World puts you in the air for a 3D basketball game built around acrobatic dunks. You use precise mouse clicks to send yourself through the sky, then pull off flipping slam dunks while looking sharp doing it. The controls are easy to pick up, yet they allow for dramatic moves that make every clean dunk feel like a real accomplishment.
Your aim is to soar, perform flipping dunks, and stand out with
holemart: Steer a hole through a crowded market in HoleMart, an arcade casual game with a shopping theme. Drag your finger across the screen to move the hole wherever you want it to go. You start small, so your first targets are tiny goods, along with shelves and carts. Every object you swallow adds to your size, and the more you consume, the bigger and stronger your hole becomes.

As the hole expands, it can take in larger shelves, carts, and other objects, which helps you clear the market faster. The controls are simple and the gameplay runs smoothly, making it well suited to quick play sessions. Keep swallowing until the market is completely cleared. The game is also tagged as an io title.
xtreme-motorbikes-rider: Xtreme Motorbikes Rider lets you tear through busy city streets on a smooth, streamlined bike. You can join fierce racing battles, perform eye-catching stunt moves, and customize your machine to match your style. The whole adventure takes place in a wide open world that invites you to explore.

The physics feel lifelike, and the controls are easy to pick up, so every ride stays lively from start to finish. Each race brings a pounding pulse and endless options to try. It offers a real rush for anyone chasing adrenaline.
truck-coloring: Truck Coloring invites you to spend some relaxed time decorating a selection of trucks, each one looking a little different from the rest. Using a set of virtual paints, you add color to every vehicle until it looks bright and pleasant to see. The game sits in the arcade category and is built with HTML5, so it runs in a web browser.

Playing is simple: use your mouse or tap the screen on a touch device, so it suits both desktop and mobile players. The game is tagged as fun and kid-friendly, which makes it a light pick for young players who enjoy drawing and colors.
quizmasters: Step into a bright, colorful quiz show where trivia is the main event. Each time you pick the right answer from four choices, you climb the prize ladder and move closer to the top reward. Questions grow tougher as you advance, so you need to stay sharp and decide quickly. Along the way, you collect cash, crystals, and reward stickers.

Spend what you earn to open new collections and keep building your progress. If you want a bigger test, take on other players in head-to-head trivia battles and see who really knows more. Every stage ramps up in difficulty, so each round stays fast and rewarding from start to finish.
flip-trickster-parkour-simulator: Flip Trickster is a parkour game where you pull off flips and stunts that seem to shrug off gravity. You move through city environments with controls that are easy to pick up, and the physics feel believable, which makes each run feel immersive. Timing is the key skill: nail it and your landings come out clean. As you advance, the levels grow harder, giving you a chance to show off your parkour style along the way.
slendrina-must-die-the-asylum: Slendrina is back in this horror adventure set in an abandoned asylum. This time she is far angrier than before, and she is guarding something you will need to uncover. Watch out for her mother too, an old evil witch. Your goal is to find eight old medical books inside the asylum.

You can arm yourself with three weapons: a gun, an MP5, and a shotgun. Move with W, A, S and D, and look around with the mouse. Left click fires, right click aims, and the scroll wheel switches weapons. G throws grenades, R reloads, and F picks up items. Hold Left Shift to run, Left Ctrl to crouch, X to go prone, and V for melee attacks.
skating-hero: Step onto the rink in Skating Hero, where you take on three separate events and show off figure-skating moves across the ice. Good timing is the key to success, so you'll want to land each move at the right moment. Along the way, you can build up your skater's abilities to help you chase higher scores.

Sharp reflexes matter just as much, since precise responses decide how well each run goes. The game is all about combining speed and skill as you glide across the ice. It's open for free play, so you can start skating right away whenever you like.
super-bike-racing: Super Bike Racing is a motorcycle game where you ride a bike along road tracks. Johnny and his friends love it, and you can join them by steering with the arrow keys. Tap to play, then work through the challenges to win. The visuals look impressive, and the action moves quickly as you zoom down each course at high speed.

Races take place against players from all over the world in this quick arcade style game. You will need to handle sharp bends, steep climbs, and wide open plains. Pick from a variety of bike designs and customize each one to match your taste, so you can build the machine you want to ride.
tic-tac-toe-multiplayer-x-o: Tic Tac Toe Multiplayer X O brings the old pencil-and-paper game onto a digital 3x3 board, with up-to-date visuals. You take on a friend in head-to-head matches, and each turn calls for a careful choice to get one step ahead of your opponent.
It works well for short rounds as well as longer grudge matches with someone you know. Every game is a fresh chance to test your planning and read the other player's moves.
marble-maze: Marble Maze is a 3D puzzle where you go one-on-one against a rival. Swipe up, down, left, or right to send your marble across a labyrinth. It keeps rolling until it hits a wall. Dark tiles start unpainted, and every one your marble crosses takes on its color. Each maze uses just one color, and there is no finish line to reach. A maze is complete once every open tile on the board has been painted.

If you get stuck, you can tap the lightbulb for a hint that costs 50 coins. It shows your next roll and updates after each move. Hints are optional. The real contest is the 90-second timer, so finish more mazes than your opponent before time runs out.
mr-bullet-3d-online: Mr Bullet 3D online is a shooting game set in a three-dimensional world, where you guide the hero Mr Bullet as he takes aim and fires in the right direction. Each stage asks you to work out angles and how your shots will rebound, while you make your ammunition last long enough to take out every agent. Normal mode offers more than fifteen levels to clear.

Once you finish normal mode, you can test yourself in Hostage mode, which is far more demanding. Along the way you can gather in-game currency to unlock rewards and aim to become one of the best online players. The whole game is completely free to enjoy. Use the mouse to aim and shoot, or touch the screen to point and shoot.
gun-festival-shoot: Gun Festival Shoot is a quick arcade action game with easy controls that keep the pace high. You chase robbers through colorful three-dimensional stages, using math to build up your arsenal. Some barriers multiply your firepower while others reduce it, so you need to plan which path to take before you pass through.

Expect obstacles to dodge and bosses to defeat along the way. Keep your shots coming without pause, because your aim is to stop the heist before the robbers escape. Every stage rewards careful choices and steady fire.
shadow-fights: Two shadowy fighters step onto the arena, and only one of them can walk away the winner. Speed matters here, so throw your punches and slip past incoming attacks. You can play alone or invite a friend to join in for a two-player match. The battle is made up of three rounds, so get ready before you begin.

The blue fighter moves with W, A, S and D, punches with F and kicks with G. The orange fighter uses the arrow keys to move, K to punch and L to kick. Each player has their own set of keys, so both of you can share one keyboard.
perfect-wax-3d: In Perfect Wax 3D, you play a barber whose job takes a funny turn. Your task calls for careful timing and accuracy as you gather strands of hair. Keep moving, dodge the obstacles in your path, and then carry everything you have gathered over to a head with no hair at all.

Engaging gameplay and simple controls make it easy to pick up, and the game promises hours of fun through this quirky challenge. It tests your precision from start to finish, so staying focused is key.
music-tools: Music Tools lets you play piano, guitar, and drums in an immersive setting. You can try out different sounds and rhythms and build your own compositions. Online leaderboards let you compare your results with other players. The game suits both beginners and experienced musicians who want to sharpen their abilities and keep having fun with music.

Everything here is about making music and improving over time. There is no fixed endpoint, so you can keep experimenting with new combinations whenever you like. Whether you are just starting out or already have some experience, the game gives you room to practise and explore at your own pace.
dead-paradise: Dead Paradise: Race Shooter is a car game set in an apocalyptic world. Instead of only racing to the finish, you fire at enemies while you drive, so you can clear the road as you go. Your real aim is to survive the race, since foes chase you in all sorts of vehicles.

Finishing a level earns coins, which you spend on upgrades in the garage. You can unlock missile, armor, engine, and fuel upgrades that boost your damage, health, and speed. There are also other striking vehicles you can buy. Press the up arrow to accelerate, the down arrow to slow down, X to launch missiles, Z to adjust your firing direction, and the spacebar for nitro.
idle-airport-tycoon: Idle Airport Tycoon is a relaxed simulation game where you design and run your own busy airport. You begin with a small airstrip and gradually expand it into a top-tier travel hub, with the goal of becoming the busiest airport in the world. Along the way, you improve everything from aircraft to terminals, open up fresh income sources, and watch your profits grow.
Controls are simple. Click the left mouse button to work with the in-game interface, and press the plus or minus keys to change the size of the camera.
train-puzzle: Get ready for a puzzle that tests your thinking. In this browser game, your aim is to grow into a skilled railway engineer. Slide and turn track pieces so they link into one continuous route, guiding your train safely across the grid. Charming 3D graphics give the board a cheerful look, and the controls are easy to pick up. Logic is the key, since you need to spot dead ends before they trap you and steer every wagon toward the finish line.
transport-tycoon-deluxe-open-ttd: Transport Tycoon Deluxe - Open TTD asks you to plan and run a network of transport routes. You set up roads, sea lanes, and flight paths, then choose which vehicles travel along them. Your aim is to grow your transport business while raising its efficiency and rating. Each route you design can link land, water, and air travel together, so every decision affects how your company develops.

The game is a strategy title filed under Puzzles, and it rewards careful thinking about how each part of your network fits together. Expanding into new areas gives you more ways to grow, so you will need to keep an eye on how your empire is performing as it gets bigger.
evade: You play as a driver carrying packages through a city while the police chase you at high speed. Your aim is to lose the pursuit, complete each delivery, and then move on to the next job. Every run becomes a race to stay one step ahead of the law.

Steer with the arrow keys or WASD. Press Space to use the handbrake and hold Shift to boost. Each job requires you to reach the drop point, but you cannot finish the delivery while the cops are still on your tail, so you must shake them first.
hospital-surgeon-doctor-game: Step into the shoes of a heart surgeon facing tough medical emergencies. You begin by examining patients to work out what is wrong, then pick up realistic surgical instruments to carry out heart operations and stabilize serious conditions. Your job doesn't end there, since you also oversee several hospital departments, take on missions, and choose the right course of action when the pressure is on.

Cases reach well beyond the heart. You will handle emergency care, dental work, eye procedures, ENT treatments, and orthopedic cases, with each one presenting its own problem to solve. Tap and drag the tools into place, follow the on-screen prompts, and finish every surgery to keep patients alive and on the road to recovery. Earn rewards along the way as you grow into a professional doctor.
life-of-a-tree: Life of a Tree blends education with entertainment in a game built to teach as much as it entertains. It suits people who love nature, students hitting the books, and anyone curious about the natural world. Along the way, you pick up useful knowledge and come away with a deeper respect for trees.

Through play, you learn how trees grow, how they survive, and how they contribute to the world around us. The experience treats learning as an adventure, and every tree has its own story to share. Play is simple: just use a mouse click or a tap.
ultimate-flying-car: Race along winding city roads, or lift off and glide through the open sky in a realistic flying car simulator. Pick from stylish flying cars to explore the air freely, or earn access to new models by taking part in races. Every mode can be played alone or with a friend in two-player mode.

Player one steers with W, A, S and D, uses Shift for nitro, looks behind with T, resets the car with R, and pulls the handbrake with Space. Player two drives with the arrow keys, uses M for nitro, looks back with L, resets the car with U, and hits the handbrake with K.
flows: Flows is a relaxed logic puzzle about separating colored liquids across a set of flasks. Select one flask, then pick a second to pour the color on its top into it. A flask can only take liquid if it is empty or its top shade matches the color you are adding. You win by leaving every flask holding a single color or nothing at all.

The game includes 40 carefully crafted levels that grow in difficulty gradually. Each level has its own time leaderboard, so you can compare your fastest solves with others. An optional hint is available if you get stuck. The visuals are clean and minimal, with a calm palette, and the game is offered in English, Russian, Spanish, and Portuguese. There are no accounts and no timers counting you down, so it suits both short breaks and longer sessions. Use a mouse click on desktop or a tap on mobile.
fps-gun-shooting-game-3d: In this first-person shooter, your goal is to take out enemy shooters and keep your team safe. You can play offline or join online multiplayer matches, and the game is free to play. The story follows a commando unit as terrorists and commandos fight for survival, with new maps, upgraded guns, and different game modes to try. Each day brings fresh missions, and as your player level rises, you can unlock powerful modern weapons.

Movement uses the arrow keys, and holding Shift with them lets you sprint. Right-click fires your weapon, while left-click zooms in to aim. Press G to throw a bomb and the spacebar to jump. Good tactics matter as much as quick reflexes, so plan each engagement carefully.
coloring-book-color-by-number: Pixel Art Book is a color-by-number game where you fill pixel pictures by matching numbered squares to their colors. Tap or drag across matching pixels, choosing 1x, 3x, or 5x brushes to paint your way. Browse animals, food, transport, scenery, characters, and more, from quick pictures to detailed challenges.
