Power-ups like the Finder, Paint Bucket, Magic Wand, Bomb, and Rainbow Brush help you spot tricky pixels faster.

Turn any favorite photo into your own pixel creation. Your progress saves automatically, finished pictures appear in My Work, and artwork can be saved to Photos. A premium upgrade unlocks all artwork and categories and gives unlimited power-ups. With the mouse, left click to pick colors and fill squares, hold and drag to paint continuously, hold on blank space to move the picture, and use the scroll wheel to zoom, which follows your pointer.
portal: Portal is a hyper casual game that rewards quick reflexes and precise control. Your job is to guide a ball to safety while a relentless black hole chases it, so every decision matters. Physics-based puzzles ask you to combine skillful maneuvers with fast thinking to find a way through. Each level brings a fresh challenge, keeping the experience varied as you move forward.

The otherworldly cosmic setting pulls you in, and the pressure rarely lets up. Your timing and precision decide whether the ball stays ahead of the danger. The goal is to break free from the black hole's grip, and it takes every bit of skill you have.
connect-puzzle-image: Think back to rainy afternoons spent piecing together a large jigsaw? This game brings that same feeling to your smartphone or tablet, no matter where you are. You join virtual pieces together in real time, and each level presents a new picture that is more complex than the last. The scenes vary widely, so you might build a quirky character, a tasty dish, or a cool object. As you move through the stages, your thinking skills get a steady workout.

Playing is simple. Tap a piece, drag it into position, and align it correctly. Once the pieces are placed properly, the full image comes together on screen. When you finish a level, you can carry on to the next one or pause and resume whenever you like. That flexibility makes it easy to fit in short bursts of play.
zombie-raft: Zombie Raft is a survival game set in a world where the undead have taken over. As a zombie apocalypse closes in, you find yourself on a raft and must stay alive. You shield yourself and fellow survivors from the approaching zombie tsunami and push the undead back. Surviving on the raft is your responsibility.

Along the way, you squeeze vehicles forward and shove them when needed. Keep moving to escape the tsunami and claim the barren land beyond it. If you come across stranded survivors, you need to rescue them. The controls are simple: mouse click or tap to play.
drifty-road-rush: Drifty Road Rush sends you down winding roads where each bend calls for a clean drift. Weave your car through moving traffic, pick up rewards along the way, and do your best to stay out of crashes so your run keeps going. The difficulty rises as you progress, so you will need to get a feel for the timing of every turn. Unlocking new vehicles gives you more to try, and the game is built around chasing big scores in a quick-paced arcade driving experience.
Controls are simple. Use the Arrow Keys or the A and D keys to steer and drift. Menus can be navigated with the mouse, and touch controls are available for playing on mobile devices.
dora-candy-land: Dora Candy Land is a puzzle game built around match-three play. Its theme pairs Dora with a sweet, candy-themed world. To make a move, you switch the spots of two candies, and if that lines up three or more matching candies in a row, you score the match.

The game is free to play and works with a mouse or by tapping the screen. Its tags highlight collecting, matching, and fun, and it is listed for kids and girls, so it suits players who enjoy those themes.
detective-max-mystery-the-disappearance-: Step into the shoes of detective Max in this story-driven adventure. A curious postcard arrives from his neighbour, Benedict Winters, who writes that he moved away in a hurry and has no plans to return. He also asks Max to track down a small mystery box he lost. Your job is to uncover where Winters went by searching his apartment for clues.

The game blends an escape room with a classic detective story. Use forensic science and sharp thinking to examine the crime scene, collect evidence, and work out who the suspects are, what their motives were, and where they were at the time. Click on areas you want to investigate, drag objects to solve puzzles, and use the items you pick up from your inventory. Solve riddles to escape the room, and if you get stuck, a hint is available to point you in the right direction.
neon-maze: Neon Maze is a glowing logic puzzle in which every decision matters. Your task is to free the grid by taking out all of the arrows in a proper sequence, and the maze gets more tangled the further you go.

An arrow can only be tapped when the space directly ahead of it is empty. Once you make a valid tap, that arrow disappears and the grid gains room to maneuver. Every level caps the number of moves you may use, so working out the order before you act is essential. If you get stuck, hints are available, and looking a few steps ahead helps you unravel the whole tangle.
stickman-io: Stickman.io drops you into a roomy arena where your little stick figure grows by gobbling up food and smaller rivals. Bigger opponents are a danger, so you need to slip past them, steering with your mouse. Speed boosts give you a burst of quickness when you need to move fast, and deciding when to use them is part of the challenge.

It is a live, real-time contest, so every move matters. You have to think ahead, outsmart your rivals, and keep your wits about you. The goal is to rise above everyone else and earn the title of top stickman in the arena.
click-click-clicker: Click Click Clicker is a true clicker game: you press a button in order to press yet another button. Each click earns cash, which you can spend on upgrades that raise your passive income, boost how much you make per click, or add more cursors. Along the way you collect new buttons as rewards for your effort. You begin with a single modest click and build from there.

The game is all about gathering flashy new things with little effort. Backgrounds, music, cursors, and buttons can all be personalized, but you need to earn each one before it unlocks. You can keep clicking nonstop or let your idle earnings pile up while you wait to reach your next goal. It is free and works on both mobile devices and computers.
worms-zone: Worms Zone takes the familiar Snake formula and adds bright, lively changes. Your worm eats its way toward enormous size, so every bite counts. You move through colorful zones, and you can make your worm grow faster or change how it looks to suit your style.

Balancing speed with strategy is the key. You must steer clear of rival worms while collecting power-ups along the way. The goal is to finish as the longest worm, outlasting every opponent who hopes to take the top spot.
mini-car-racing: Build your own tiny vehicle, then take it out on a series of racing circuits. Each course is full of obstacles to steer around, giving you a chance to show off your driving skills. Collect bonuses along the way to improve your ride and keep your car performing at its best.

Designing your car is a fun, creative part of the game, and it pairs well with the fast pace of each race. The goal is to grow into a skilled mini car racer by mastering the circuits. Pick up speed, dodge trouble, and see how far your creation can take you.
madness-online: Madness Online is a multiplayer survival shooter seen from above in a 2D view. Set in a harsh, collapsed world, its map is generated as you explore and never runs out, so you can keep moving into new ground. Relentless waves of zombies and other enemies come at you, and you fight them off with fast, intense gunplay.

Survival is just as important as combat. You gather resources, craft the gear you need, and build fortified bases to defend. Dodge moves help you avoid hits, and a large inventory keeps your supplies organized. Team up with friends to build and survive together, or face the unforgiving world alone. Controls: WASD to move, the mouse to aim and shoot, Spacebar to dodge, E to interact, B to open inventory, R to reload, Q to switch weapons, and Enter to chat.
bumbly-bee: You play as a bee bumbling through a whimsical collecting game, where the local wildlife keeps getting in your way. Every stage asks you to dodge their harassment while you gather honey. You can race the clock to earn gold medals, or slow down and simply relax while collecting all the honey.
The game offers 40 unique levels to explore. On PC, you steer with the mouse, and the spacebar is an optional extra control. On mobile, you control the bee with touch.
geometry-vibes-x-arrow: Geometry Vibes X Arrow is the newest entry in the Geometry Vibes series, aimed at players who want a sharper, more competitive, and highly adjustable arrow game. You steer your arrow through risky geometric routes, get through patterns that grow tougher over time, and reach the portal at the end of each path without touching any hazard. Every tap shifts your height, obstacles demand careful timing, and each mode tests your skill in a different way.

Controls are simple. Press the left mouse button or the Space bar to climb, then let go to sink back down. In multiplayer, extra players use H, L, and the Up Arrow. Touch controls work on phones and tablets.
nuts-puzzle-sort-by-color: Nuts Puzzle: Sort by Color asks you to group mixed nuts onto screws so each one holds a single color. Levels grow harder, so you'll need to plan your moves and think a few steps ahead. Every completed sort brings a satisfying sense of achievement. Vibrant visuals set the mood, and as you advance, you repair the flowers in your garden.

Tap a nut, then tap the screw where you want to move it. A nut can only go onto an empty screw or on top of a matching color. New levels bring more nuts and colors, while hard mode hides each nut's color until the piece above it is moved. Coins buy power-ups such as an extra bolt, and Nuts pay for garden repairs. A piggy bank gathers Coins while you're away, and chests opened at certain levels can drop bonuses and currency. Sound isn't required.
flippin-coins: Flippin' Coins is an idle merge game built around coin flips. Tap a coin to flip it. Each flip has a 75% chance to win cash, and on the other 25% of tries you miss and can simply go again. Higher-tier coins pay more for every successful flip. Drag one coin onto a matching coin of the same tier to combine them into a higher tier.

Spend your earnings on new coins to speed up your progress. Each new tier brings bigger rewards and fresh visuals, climbing from pennies to millions and including rare legendary coins worth thousands. Enjoy lively merge animations, satisfying coin sounds, and achiev
bandits-bane: Set in the Wild West, this 2D action shooter drops you into a town whose city bank has just been robbed. Across five levels, your job is to protect the city from a gang of outlaws. Pick your targets carefully, since you only fire on the most dangerous bandits, and rescue the hostages along the way. Clear the bandits from each level to move on before the game ends, and you will earn a name for yourself across the frontier.

Controls rely only on the mouse. A click launches your attack, and moving the cursor sets the direction of your aim. Filed under adventure and arcade, the game mixes shooting with rescue missions from start to finish.
untangle-threads: In Untangle Threads, you move glowing spheres called nodes by dragging them with a finger or a mouse until no thread runs across another. A thread turns red when it crosses another one and green once the whole tangle is clear. Fewer moves earn you more stars, up to three.

The game has six worlds, and each adds its own twist. Neon offers classic puzzles to warm up with, while Nature adds new threads as you solve. In Space, some nodes stay locked in place, and in Ocean, they drift along with the current. Crystals limits how many moves you can make, and Steampunk links certain nodes so they move as mirror images.
the-man-from-the-window: You take on the role of Mama Rabbit in this suspenseful mystery. Danger lurks nearby, and your job is to protect your family from it. As the dark story slowly unfolds, the choices you make shape what happens next, so think carefully before you act.

Expect a steady build of tension, along with puzzles to solve and an eerie mood that rarely lets up. Small details can matter a great deal, so keep your eyes open. Every move you make is part of the search for a way to keep everyone safe.
mini-golf-3d: Mini Golf 3D is a fluid, arcade-style round of golf with more than 40 levels that grow harder as you go. You line up each putt, build up power for your swing, and take a precise shot. Sand traps will bog your ball down, and water hazards add a penalty stroke when you land in them. Along the way, you collect gems to unlock differently colored balls, and you face courses that become more intricate over time.
The physics feel responsive, so each hit responds clearly and the gameplay stays satisfying. Controls are simple: click with a mouse or tap the screen to play.
cooking-city: Cooking City is a cooking and restaurant simulator where you play a charming waitress. Your goal is to prepare and serve guests as quickly as you can while keeping an eye on the clock and making sure no dish gets burned. The game is easy to start but takes skill to master. You can cook in different kitchens, cafes, and restaurants, upgrade your kitchen, and unlock new establishments.

Hundreds of meals are on the menu, including burgers, sausages, hot dogs, soups, and french fries, and you can learn new recipes along the way. Customers range from caring moms to impatient kids. Coins and diamonds both cover upgrades and enhancements, and players can also buy diamonds or booster packs. Donations speed up progress, and the music is pleasant but optional. Memorizing recipes doubles as brain training.
stack-the-blocks: Stack the Blocks is an online puzzle game that asks you to plan ahead. The board is a grid of 10 by 10 squares, and you place the offered blocks onto it. Your goal is to form solid rows or columns, running straight across or straight up and down. When you complete one, that line vanishes and frees up space for new pieces, and you earn points along the way.
The game is easy to pick up but offers plenty of depth for anyone who enjoys strategy and logic. It works on both mobile devices and desktop computers, so you can play whichever way suits you.
rolling-balls-sea-race: Rolling Balls Sea Race is a fast obstacle racer played on narrow, elevated tracks above deep water, where one misstep sends your ball into the sea. Built on Unity physics, it challenges you to roll to the finish line while grabbing every coin along the way. You can race solo or take on a friend on the same keyboard in split-screen head-to-head play, with dozens of levels to work through.

In single-player, steer with W, A, S, D or the arrow keys, whichever you prefer. In two-player mode, Player 1 uses W, A, S, D and Player 2 uses the arrow keys. Coins collected during runs unlock new ball skins, tail tracks, and sky packages, all earned through play. The game has a clean low-poly 3D look set against realistic nature backdrops, and it runs smoothly in both desktop and mobile browsers.
tangram-puzzle-2: Tangram Puzzle 2 is a logic game built on the classic tangram idea. You receive a fixed set of colorful geometric pieces, called tans, and must recreate a target shape with them. Every piece has to fill the outline completely, with no gaps or overlaps, and neighboring colors must match. Instead of plain black silhouettes, both the pieces and the targets are bright and multi-colored.

Each level can earn up to three stars, and fewer moves bring a higher rating. Move counters and hints add a layer of strategy, and hundreds of designs unlock as you progress. On PC, left-click and drag to move a piece, use the mouse wheel or R key to rotate it, and right-click to flip it when that option is available. On mobile, tap and drag. The experience is relaxing yet mentally demanding.
ping-pong-table-tennis: Step into the world of table tennis with this browser game. Every match puts you across the table from a rival you need to beat, and the whole experience is built around enjoying the sport in a relaxed way. It suits anyone who loves ping pong and wants a light, casual session.

Playing is straightforward. You move the racket to meet the ball, aim your shots with care, and respond fast when the ball comes your way. Each rally rewards careful thinking as well as quick reflexes, so you will need to plan your moves and make every point count. Opponents grow stronger as you progress, which means you should change your approach and watch for the spots where they struggle. Control is handled entirely with mouse clicks or taps.
knockback: Knockback is a free party board game that runs right in your web browser, so there is nothing to install. You race your pegs toward home while arenas erupt, black holes swallow pieces, and Power-Ups flip the board around you. Your moves can knock rival pegs back to the start.

Quick matches pair you with players from around the world, and you can also take on the weekly arena and seasonal events. The game works on both desktop and mobile. To roll, hit the dome, then choose which peg to move. Landing on an opponent sends that piece back to the beginning, while grabbing Power-Ups changes the board. The first player to bring all their pegs home wins. A short how-to video is available when you start.
4wallpong: 4Wall Pong is a solo take on the classic Pong formula, with a twist: the ball may head toward any of the four walls, so you must manage four paddles at once to keep the rally alive. Every hit nudges the ball speed up by 1%, so the longer you last, the tougher things get. Your scores can climb the global Top 10 leaderboard, and the game runs free in your
kart-chaos: Kart Chaos is a free, three-dimensional kart racing game that you can enjoy in your web browser, whether you use a computer or a phone. You can compete in the Chamo Cup Grand Prix against computer-controlled drivers. In Time Trial, you try to beat ghost racers, and the Daily Challenge is also available. You can even create an online room to race against your friends.

Speed comes from drifting through bends, which builds up boosts, and from landing jumps off ramps to perform tricks that give you extra pace. Steer and accelerate with the arrow keys or WASD. Gamepad and touch controls are also supported, so you can pick whichever input suits you best.
stonkrider: StonkRider is a free bike game that builds motocross courses from real price charts. Pick a stock or crypto symbol, such as TSLA, GME, or BTC-USD, and choose a timeframe. Each candle on the chart becomes part of the course, with hills, ramps, and cliffs taking shape from the price movement.

Accelerate and lean to keep your bike moving across the terrain. Flip off the peaks to chain tricks together, and grab the green-candle orbs to fill your nitro. Land back on your wheels to keep going, and try not to crash on the next dip. Since every chart rides differently, each track feels new. The game is just for fun, not financial advice, and you don't need an account to start.
louvers: Louvers is a calm logic puzzle that runs in your web browser. The board is a stack of horizontal slats, each holding a few coloured tiles. You shift the slats sideways until every column has exactly the tiles it needs, and then the column lights up and a hidden image appears.

The collection includes 33 handcrafted levels. A short tutorial introduces the basics, and then the difficulty rises step by step, so the game is simple to pick up yet tough to put down. You can play with a mouse, the arrow keys, or a touchscreen. To move a slat, drag it left or right, or select it and use the arrow keys. Light every column to reveal the picture and finish the level, then choose the next one from the Levels menu.
guessnow: guessNow is built on real historical photographs that start out blurry. As the seconds tick by, the image comes into focus, and each extra moment lowers your score while revealing another hint, like a uniform, a car, or a shop sign. Drag the slider to the year you think the picture was taken, then confirm. Being off by only two
snake-trail: Snake Trail gives the familiar snake formula a tidy, minimal look. You guide the snake with the arrow keys or by swiping, collecting luminous orbs to lengthen it while steering clear of your own body. Each orb you grab stretches the snake and squeezes the play area, so success depends on planning your path rather than relying only on fast fingers. Keep an open lane ready as the snake grows.

The game offers two modes. In Walls, touching the edge ends your run. In Wrap, the snake slips through one side and comes out the other. Your best score is kept for future attempts, and a typical round lasts a minute or two. It works on desktop and on a phone.
merge-numbers-2048: This browser version of the classic number puzzle is free to play. Swipe or press an arrow key and every tile slides in that direction. Two tiles with the same number merge into one twice as large, so two becomes four and four becomes eight. A new tile appears after each move, and the board slowly fills up.

The main goal is reaching 2048, but many players care more about beating their own best score, which the board remembers between sessions. Rounds are short, there is no setup required, and it works the same with a mouse or a thumb on a phone. Keep your largest tile in a corner and build the other rows around it to make the board last much longer. The game ends when no move is left.
zombie-survival-blackout: Zombie Survival: Blackout puts you in a gloomy, rain-soaked city as a lone survivor in an action game seen from an angled, isometric view. Your weapon does the shooting for you, so your job is mostly positioning: keep on the move, avoid getting boxed in by the undead crowd, and gather XP to climb levels. Each stage counts down toward a boss, and the coins and experience you collect help your run continue.

The opening stage, Residential Blocks, works as a tutorial for newcomers. If you need to stop mid-battle, the game keeps your unfinished fight so you can resume later. Move with W, A, S, D or the arrow keys, and your weapon will fire at zombies within range. Keep moving, pick up experience, and last until the boss shows up. A pause button lets you halt the action whenever you need to.
meowdoku: Meowdoku is a logic puzzle played on a grid split into colored regions. Your goal is to place exactly one cat in each row, each column, and each color region. Cats may never touch, not even diagonally. The game has 300 levels spread across Easy, Hard, and Expert, where the grids start at 7x7 and the deductions get steadily tougher.

A new daily puzzle appears every day. When you are stuck, you can use free hints or the built-in solver. To play, tap a square to place a cat there. Pick Easy, Hard, or Expert at the top of the screen, or try the daily puzzle. It runs right in your web browser.
water-sort-color-tubes: Water Sort: Color Tubes is a puzzle where you untangle colored liquid by sorting it. Every tube holds layers stacked on top of one another. The top layer can move into another tube only when that tube has room and its top shade matches, or when the tube is completely empty. A level is solved once every tube holds just one color.

The early stages are simple and can be cleared in a handful of steps. As new colors appear, though, the free tubes become valuable, so it pays to plan a few pours ahead. If a move turns out badly, the undo button takes it back, and any level can be restarted from the beginning. You play with a mouse click or a tap, which makes it easy to fit in a short break.
vibestead: Vibestead is a relaxed game about growing a village, with richly detailed pixel graphics. You begin with a modest timber business: recruit loggers, keep the sawmill and construction workshop humming, and deliver goods to buyers. Profits pay for new structures like a brick kiln, a paint workshop and a village inn. Managers, incoming orders and chapter objectives give you a steady list of targets, and your workforce keeps going even when you step away.

Follow the quest panel on the left for guidance. Hire loggers, open the Sawmill and Construction workshop from the bottom bar, complete orders, and spend your cash on fresh buildings. The Machines, Orders, Managers and Woodland tabs help you expand. There is also an optional coding-rewards feature for programmers, but the village game works fully without it.
piece-of-cake-merge-and-bake: Piece of Cake: Merge & Bake blends puzzle solving with running a café. You inherit your grandfather's countryside café, which has been empty for a long time, and your job is to bring it back to life and make it better than it was. The game is free to play on a phone or a computer. You navigate by clicking with the mouse or by tapping the screen, then drag items around with your finger or cursor.

Cooking happens on a table where you combine ingredients and find matching pairs. As you merge items, your workspace grows, letting you prepare more dishes at once. Start with simple recipes and work up to richer meals by combining ingredients into new creations. The money you earn pays for restoring the café and its other areas, and the facade outside needs work too. Watching the building improve at every step keeps things satisfying from start to finish.
history-gacha: History Gacha turns real moments from the past into cards you can collect. Each pack holds five cards drawn from a pool of more than 77,000 events, with sources taken from Wikipedia. Rarity is set by a fixed metric, so a famous disaster or discovery may appear as a top-tier card.

Open one pack at a time, or switch to 5X to draw several at once. Check your Collection, assemble a team for Battles, and send cards out on a long Expedition. Finish Quests to earn trophies, and use the daily Check-in for extra packs. It runs right in your browser.
zigzag-snow-mountain: This freeskiing simulation gives you plenty of room to tweak, style, and combine realistic tricks. Slopestyle, halfpipe, big-air, jibbing on rails and boxes, and backcountry challenges cover a wide range of the sport. Steering is powerful yet easy to pick up, with helpful in-game tutorials. Beginners get simple buttons, advanced players can use double taps and swipes, and pros have grab trick packages as enhancements.

Your main goal is to beat the world's best scores and master each challenge to build your overall skiing skills. The game is set at a real resort in LAAX, Switzerland, and includes 5 levels spread across 38 spots. Pick from four customizable male and female characters
torque-trail: Climb behind the wheel of a powerful monster truck in Torque Trail, a driving game built around physics. Across 20 separate courses, you will balance over bridges, scale steep ramps and get past tricky obstacles, all while staying upright until you reach the finish. Forward and reverse inputs are simple to learn, so getting started is easy, yet every course tests your timing, balance and throttle control.

The tracks are colorful and built in 3D, and the trucks roll on oversized wheels with engine sounds and customizable vehicle effects. On a computer, hold the right arrow or D to drive forward, and the left arrow or A to reverse and balance. On a phone or tablet, hold the right half of the screen to drive or the left half to reverse. If your truck flips, tap Restart to try again, and use the settings to adjust audio and effects.
melon-craft-ragdoll: Melon Craft Ragdoll is a creative ragdoll sandbox where you build your own experimental scenes. Place ragdoll characters, position interactive objects, and then watch physics make everything respond. The pixel-style visuals pair with flexible sandbox tools, which makes it a physics simulation for anyone who likes to tinker.

Start by placing blocks on the grid, then arrange your characters and objects however you like. Adjust the setup as often as you need before you start your experiment. Controls are simple: tap and drag to play.
prism-match-3d: Prism Match 3D is a puzzle game set inside a three-dimensional world built from cubes, where colorful prisms put your reasoning and sense of timing to the test. You spin the scene around and study carefully constructed levels, all while keeping your mind calm. Each stage asks you to plan ahead and act at just the right moment.

As you improve, you move through an open-ended run of inventive stages. Sharpening your skills is the heart of the experience, which feels fresh from start to finish. It is a match-three title that mixes unwinding with a good workout for the brain.
defend-the-castle: Defend the Castle is a strategy puzzle about strengthening your kingdom. You use gold and wood to construct defenses, then upgrade them as the game goes on. Enemies arrive in nonstop waves, so your setup has to hold up against attack after attack. Cannons and archers give you two different ways to deal with incoming foes.

Your main task is to keep the King safe while your stronghold stands firm. Each wave tests what you have built, so the choices you make about where to place and improve your defenses shape how long your castle can endure.
jumping-panda: Jumping Panda is a one-button game that runs right in your web browser. You press and hold to build power, then let go to launch the panda toward the next platform. Land short or overshoot and you fall, so every jump depends on judging the distance well. A quick tap gives a small hop, while a long hold delivers a big leap.

The levels are numbered and you can pick any of them from a menu. Coins you collect along the way can be spent in the shop. Rounds are quick, and everything is controlled with a single mouse button or your finger. Choose Play to carry on from your current level, or Levels to select a different one.
obby-cut-the-grass-for-egg: In this 3D clicker, every cut you make through the grass raises your Strength. Your goal is to track down eggs hidden across the meadow, then carry them home while getting past the boss. Creatures you hatch live on your farm, and the gold you collect lets you buy sharper blades and auras. When you're ready, you can rebirth for permanent boosts.

Movement uses WASD, and the mouse lets you look around. Clicking or tapping cuts grass, and arrows point you toward the eggs. Press E to use shops and your farm, and B to head back to base. On phones, a joystick and on-screen buttons handle the same controls. New worlds are open to explore, and you can play online with other cutters.
garden-master: You take on the role of a hardworking gnome in Garden Master, a farming game about keeping a garden thriving. Nurture your plants with care, drive off the mischievous gophers that threaten them, and gather golden seeds to unlock new upgrades. Bit by bit, you shape your patch of land into a lush paradise.

The adventure is both pleasant and demanding, so every gardening decision counts. It puts your green thumb to the test from start to finish. By the end, you will have a real chance to prove your gardening prowess.
hero-rescue-puzzle: Hero Rescue Puzzle is a rescue game where you help a hero save a princess and collect treasure along the way. You shoot sticks to free the princess, and you shoot them again to defeat goblins and grab the treasure. As the adventure goes on, the hero becomes rich in this township rescue title.

The game is played entirely with the mouse. It is tagged as action, logic, and puzzle, and it is made for both boys and girls. If you enjoy rescue stories with a bit of thinking involved, this one may suit you.
slime-jump-crown-quest: Climb toward the crown with a cheerful slime in this colorful game packed with 150 platform levels. Each stage asks you to press and hold to aim, then let go to launch your slime onto the next ledge. Every landing gives you a chance to plan where the following bounce should go. Stages are kept short, so you can jump back in quickly after a miss.

Controls are simple, and you can use either a mouse or your finger on a touchscreen. Even so, the jumps demand careful timing, and precise leaps are rewarded with skill-based bonuses. To finish a level, land on the platforms and reach the crown at the top.
good-sort-master-triple-match: Good Sort Master: Triple Match is a puzzle game built around tidying up shelves. You move objects around so that three matching items end up together on the same shelf, and they clear away once they line up. The goal is to empty every shelf to finish a level. Each completed level reveals more items to enjoy. It is a calm, easygoing experience that suits anyone who likes a bit of order.

Your task is to drag each item into place and keep the shelves sorted. Cleaning up in this game is surprisingly entertaining, and the gentle pace makes it easy to pick up and enjoy. Anyone can follow the simple rules, whether you are new to puzzles or a long-time fan of matching games.
tideroll-block-puzzle: Roll a wooden block across floating platforms over the ocean, and steer it so it lands upright in the goal hole. The game offers 150 puzzles set in sunny, rainy, and snowy scenery, with switches, bridges, and fragile orange tiles to work around.

Use the WASD or arrow keys to roll the block, or tap the on-screen direction buttons on a phone. You can cross orange tiles safely by lying the block flat, since an upright block breaks them. Plan each move carefully, undo any mistakes, and solve each puzzle to unlock the next one.
save-the-pets: A nervous shiba pup sits beside a hive of furious bees that are about to spill out. Draw one line to form a wall, a roof, or another clever shape that shields the puppy. Once you lift your finger, the swarm bursts out, and your drawing must hold for 10 seconds. Ink is limited, so plan each stroke. On a mouse, click and drag, then release. On touch, drag and lift.

Across 72 handmade levels, new twists keep arriving, including water, spikes, bombs, ice, rocks, spiders, fans and balloons. Replay any unlocked level from the map to beat your score. Use less ink for up to three stars, collect coins, and unlock dog skins in the
football-world-27: Take charge of your club in a full eleven-a-side match, filmed from a broadcast-style camera and played under real match rules. You can jump into a Quick Match, go after the FW Cup, or work your way up the World League.

Build a dream squad by opening packs, or run a club by managing transfers and the budget. You can also follow a single player's career, beginning at the academy and aiming for the first team. Move with WASD or the arrow keys, pass with J, shoot with K, play a through ball with L, lob with I, and sprint with Shift. Every key can be remapped in Settings, and Esc pauses the match. On phones, a joystick and on-screen buttons handle the controls.
mahjong-classic: Mahjong Classic brings the classic tile-matching solitaire to your browser. Every layout is created by a special level generator, so any random arrangement of tiles is guaranteed to be solvable. Because no two games look the same, you can replay your favourite boards as many times as you like. Choose from well-known layouts such as Turtle, Fort, Crab, Spider, Cat and Dragon, plus many more.

Your aim is to empty the board by picking pairs of matching tiles. A tile can only be chosen when no other tile is blocking it. Flower tiles count as a pair with each other, and season tiles pair up in the same way. If you run out of available pairs before the board is clear, the round is lost. Three helpers are available: Undo takes back your last pair, Hint reveals a playable pair, and Spotlight makes it easier to spot tiles you can select.
splash-rivals: Splash Rivals is an online team paint battle. Two squads of four compete to coat the whole arena in their own colour. You can spray the floor, soak your rivals, and dive into your squad's paint to refill your tank and recover health. Seven weapons are available, and you can customise your character and powers to match your style.

Team up with friends or create private matches for up to eight players. Move with WASD or ZQSD, jump with Space, and aim with the mouse. Left click fires, right click uses your secondary ability, and F activates your special once it's charged. Hold Left Shift to swim through your team's paint, and hold Tab to view the scoreboard.
hedgies: In Hedgies, a single hedgehog takes a run-down household and the land around it and works them into a busy, prosperous farm. Few people realize that hedgehogs are skilled cooks, fishers, and craftsmen, and that they are also wonderfully generous hosts. Along the way, your little character helps make the valley a more beautiful place.

The game is a farming sim in which your hardworking hedgehog grows crops, crafts goods, and builds mastery in cooking and fishing. Thanks to its warm and welcoming nature, the valley gradually grows into a lively community. It is a charming, cozy world that comes to life as you guide it.
zombie-bears-night-shooting: A scientist dropped a virus vial in a secret lab, and within hours the outbreak had escaped past the military lockdown. Now the living dead roam the land, hunting people for food. You are one of the few survivors, an elite marksman sniper trained in military strategy and shooting range practice. With this possibly your last day on Earth, leaving your shelter to become a zombie hunter is your only hope.

This 2D FPS survival game has you choose a sniper rifle, load bullets, and pull the trigger to clear the zombies in your way. Protect helpless victims by shooting the undead before they transform. Upgrade your arsenal from sniper rifles to crossbows, bazookas, shotguns, assault rifles, revolvers, or machine guns. Hunt weak crawling undead and strong super zombies from hidden spots, testing your observation, dexterity, and marksmanship. The game is played with a mouse.
goal-arena-game: Head into the arena and put your football ability to the test. Line up each kick, pick your angle, and send the ball toward the net, trying to score as many goals as you can. Varied targets and obstacles challenge you along the way, and your timing and accuracy improve the more you play. Your aim is to land the perfect strike, beat the goalkeeper, and earn the title of Goal Arena champion.
Controls are simple: a single mouse click or a tap on a touchscreen is all you need to get going. Every shot counts, so take your time and make each kick count.
vegan-quest: Vegan Quest sends your plant-based hero through a cascade of food. Your goal is to gather delicious vegan treats, which raise your score, while avoiding non-vegan pitfalls along the way. The controls are straightforward, so you can focus on the action right from the start.

The challenges keep climbing as you play. Obstacles grow more intense, so you will need precision and quick decisions to stay on track. This arcade adventure is designed to deliver endless entertainment.
numicolor: Numicolor offers a calm way to unwind. Painting by numbers keeps your mind on the task and helps you leave everyday stress behind, and many players find it restores a sense of balance. The library spans nature scenes, anime styling, fashion, and cute animals, with new pictures added on a regular basis. Filters for theme and difficulty make it simple to find a page that suits your mood.

Beyond the classic style, you can try the Reveal and Mystery modes, which bring a bit of suspense to coloring. The game suits grown-ups who want to relax as well as children who are building focus and creativity. To play, select a shade from the palette, then tap the highlighted areas marked with that matching number. If you get stuck, use a hint to find a detail that still needs color.
memory-cards: Memory Cards puts your recall and thinking skills to the test. Each stage asks you to spot cards and pick them in the right order, and the levels get harder as you move forward. It works well as a quick brain workout, and the game keeps throwing in unexpected turns while you climb through its detailed stages.

Along the way you can expect a few surprises and a steady sense of sharpening your mind. Every new stage builds on the last, so you need to stay focused to keep your sequence correct. If you enjoy memory challenges that grow step by step, this one offers plenty to work through.
buggy-blast: Race across twelve World Circuit stages in this dusty off-road game. You begin with a single track, and finishing first unlocks the next challenge. Each event runs four laps through forests, mountain nights, snow, storms, desert, and coastal routes. Once those are mastered, six reverse routes await.

Steer with A and D or the arrow keys, and release to stop turning. Hold Space for nitro and let go to recharge it. Press S or Down to brake, and combine braking with steering to drift through corners. Launch off ramps, beat three rivals, and collect coins to unlock four buggies and upgrade your favorite. Press P or Escape to pause, and R to put your buggy back on the track. Each race ends with a live classification, while your buggy keeps going on autopilot.
aod-art-of-defense: In this tower defense title set in a ruined future, you take command of the A.O.D squad. Your job is to push back the merciless fighters of Mr. Evil, who are hunting for the missing Project Inola. Strategy and RPG ideas blend into the action, keeping every battle lively. The striking isometric visuals bring your tech kingdoms to life as you work to frustrate your rival's plans.

Real-time fights unfold across more than 500 sectors, from small villages to sprawling metropolises. Three new defense modes, escape, fog, and survival, add variety to the challenge. You can choose from over 1000 upgrades for your towers, including tanks, miniguns, and anti-aircraft guns, while six heroes can be explored and leveled up. Nuclear bombs are also part of your arsenal, so plan carefully before you act.
flag-memory-match: Flag Memory Match puts your recall to the test with a collection of flags from 98 countries. You flip cards to uncover matching pairs, earn points for your successes, and work through six levels that grow steadily harder.

This title is built to sharpen your focus and precision, and it doubles as a lesson in world flags. Its entertaining style keeps the learning light and enjoyable. Keep a close eye on where each flag appears so you can pair them up as you go.
jumper-jam: Jumper Jam takes its inspiration from Doodle Jump, so fans of that game should feel at home. It is an arcade title that runs right in your web browser, and its controls are kept deliberately simple. Your job is to guide a charming little character while gathering gleaming coins. Every run is a chance to beat your previous score and set a fresh record.

The game has a bright, colorful look that keeps the mood cheerful from start to finish. To play, you only need to click the mouse or tap the screen. Whether you are on a computer or a touch device, the same simple input works, so the game is easy to pick up and start playing.
bike-race-rush: Players of any kind can choose from a lineup of quirky characters, whether they are a boy or a girl. Ride a range of cool bikes that you unlock by collecting coins. Along the way, you can finish quests and climb through the ranks. The game has been refreshed with its newest features and extra content, so there is plenty to see.

Speed through town while your reflexes get tested, and pull off flips, tricks and stunts on the slopes. This is not a typical running game. It moves faster and feels smoother, and it is all about bike impact. Play using your mouse or by clicking.
kobadoo-emojis: In this memory game, your job is to recall a run of funny emoji symbols and put them back in the correct order. Each stage makes the task a bit harder, so the challenge grows as you move forward. Along the way you give your thinking skills a workout, and the controls are easy to pick up.

Success depends on careful attention, so watch closely and keep your focus sharp. Expect plenty of giggles, since the whole experience is full of laughs. Your observation skills and memory are put to the test from start to finish.
age-of-heroes: Raise an army of heroes and send them through history's great periods. You act as the commander, choosing the strategy that decides each clash. Summon warriors, build fortresses, and destroy enemy towers as you advance from the earliest villages toward the age of machines. Role-playing elements and tower defense battles, including castle sieges, run throughout.

Form a squad of heroes and pets, blending knights, mages and fighters from different eras. Strike first, defend your towers, and enjoy varied game modes, fortress attacks and PvP clashes between top teams. Heroes from every era compete for territory. Each period, from the Stone Age to the Space Era, brings new wars and new forms of evolution. Once Earth's eras are complete, new worlds and planets open for your army and heroes to keep growing.
prado-parking-master-3d: Take the wheel of a powerful luxury Prado SUV in this 3D parking game. You weave through demanding parking courses, squeeze into narrow gaps, dodge obstacles, and aim to park neatly every time. Across five levels, you sharpen your driving and test how precise your control really is.

Handling feels realistic, with responsive steering and smooth physics that make each move feel natural. The 3D parking area is built to pull you in. Use W or the Up Arrow to accelerate, S or the Down Arrow to brake and reverse, and A or the Left Arrow and D or the Right Arrow to steer. The gameplay is fun and addictive.
math-fight-club: Step into the ring in Math Fight Club, where your math skills are your main weapon. Start by designing your own fighter, then take on a lineup of legendary opponents. Each bout asks you to crack challenging equations, and the quicker your calculations, the better you can outwit your rival.
Defeat an opponent and you can add their mask to your collection. Keep winning and you climb toward the top spot, aiming to be crow
merge-royal: Merge Royal blends the planning of Solitaire with the number-combining thrill of 2048. You join cards that share the same value, working toward higher numbers as you go. Along the way, you unlock bright, striking visuals.

Combining cards feels effortless, yet the game keeps you thinking. It is relaxing enough to enjoy at an easy pace, but it also tests your logic and your speed. It is a card puzzle adventure built for players who like a calm challenge.
kobadoo-numbers: Kobadoo Numbers is a memory game you play in your web browser. It asks you to remember sequences of two-digit numbers, and the sequences grow harder as you progress. Your goal is to keep recalling them accurately as the challenge rises.
The game is built to exercise your working memory, and along the way it aims to sharpen your focus, attention, and mental agility. Playing it is a fun way to give your mind a workout.
rabbit-punch-rabbit: Rabbit Punch Rabbit is a clicker game built around quick reflexes. You can take on a car in a solo match, or invite a friend to share the same screen and compete head to head. Either way, every tap brings a jolt of energy and a good deal of fun.

A hare pops up at unexpected moments and vanishes almost as soon as it shows. Your task is to strike it before it goes away, because whoever hits the hare first earns points. Reflexes are the main tool here, so speed decides who comes out ahead. To play, just click with your mouse or tap the screen.
kobadoo-shapes: Kobadoo Shapes is a memory game where you watch a series of colorful shapes and then rebuild that same sequence from memory. Each round asks you to remember a little more, so it works as a solid brain workout. The bright visuals and simple, hooked-you-fast style make it easy to pick up and keep playing.
The challenge grows as you move through several levels, and the game is open to players of every age. It gives you a calm space to concentrate and sharpen your recall one step at a time.
bubble-blast: Bubble Blast is a classic matching puzzle built around popping bubbles, with plenty of levels and bonus features that keep each session feeling fresh. Your goal is to clear the whole board, which is trickier than it sounds. As you move further along, harder stages call for sharper skills and careful, tactical thinking.

It's the kind of casual shooter people often pick up on a morning commute. Work through the levels to earn coins and refine your technique. Boosters can help you earn all three stars on a stage, and daily rewards are waiting whenever you come back. Fire at bubbles that match the color loaded in your launcher. If that color isn't helping, you can swap it for one of another color.
epic-empire-tower-defense: In this tower defense title, you hold back waves of goblins and ogres heading for your realm. You command three heroes at once, place defensive towers along the route, and boost your fighters with runes and pets. Bosses hit far harder than ordinary monsters, so careful planning matters. Battles can grow large, and the map shifts from frozen kingdoms to dark underground tunnels.

Progress comes from replaying stages, which raises the difficulty and the rewards while unlocking new skills. Gold is earned during sessions, and rubies go toward upgrading your heroes. There are at least 30 levels, including daily challenge stages that bring rewards, plus tournaments and several modes. Music is optional but adds to the mood. Use the left mouse button or tap the screen to interact.
my-first-100-words: "My First 100 Words" is a language game for young learners, set up as a journey through several languages. Kids take part in lively, playful activities where they spot emojis while hearing each word pronounced correctly. As the challenges grow harder, they pick up new vocabulary and also learn about different cultures.

The whole experience is framed as a multilingual quest, so learning feels more like an adventure than a lesson. Each step builds on the one before, helping young players strengthen their skills over time. It offers a fun way for a child to explore the world of language.
super-runcraft: Super RunCraft drops you into a 3D world with a blocky, Minecraft-inspired landscape that stretches on for a long way. You keep moving forward, so your job is to steer along the lane, grab rows of gold coins, and pick up special items like the hoverboard scattered along the track. Every obstacle in your path must be avoided.

It is an endless runner in the classic style, so the challenge is to keep going while staying alert. Controls are simple: use the arrow keys on a keyboard, or tap the screen on a touch device. Whether you are chasing a high distance or just enjoying the blocky scenery, this game offers plenty of Minecraft-style fun.
push-the-crazy-crowd-stickman-clash-3d: This hypercasual title challenges you to knock a crowd of stickmen off a platform with nothing more than a swipe of your finger. Your goal is to push through the rush of rivals and reach the finishing line while staying an unbeaten master of the crowd. Every opponent you send off the bridge tumbles away like a ragdoll, and you play as the crowd pusher who keeps the whole mob moving.

Controls rely on your mouse. Press the left button to shove the enemies in your path. It is a running game at heart, so you keep advancing while battling through the crowd. Whether you enjoy quick reflex play or just want something light to pick up, this running title keeps its rules simple and its action steady.
fall-bros: Fall Bros brings the feel of Fall Guys to your browser. Its featured stage is Hex-A-Gone, a well-known level, and you can jump into it whenever you like without paying anything. The aim is simple: last as long as you can without tumbling off the platforms. You can also knock rival players off their footing to clear the way. Thinking ahead and trying clever strategies will help you improve your play over time.
Controls are simple: press W, A, S, and D to move, and tap SPACE to jump. Ongoing work aims to make the experience better, and new releases are planned.
bubble-shooter-tap-and-pop: Bubble Shooter: Tap & Pop is a bubble-shooting puzzle game built around a series of levels. You aim and fire bubbles, linking them so that whole groups drop away in a chain reaction. Each stage asks you to test your reflexes and plan your shots, since the layouts change from one to the next.

Along the way, you can collect upgrades and bonuses that help with tougher stages, and you can unlock new bubble types to mix up your options. The controls are simple enough for players of any age, and you can play wherever you are, whenever you like. Bright visuals and lively animations give the game its cheerful look, while varied tasks and goals keep each session fresh.
kobadoo-arithmetic: Kobadoo Arithmetic is a browser game that puts your brain to work with a series of number puzzles. You will need to remember sequences of numbers and work out sums in your head as you go. Each new level grows harder, so your math skills and memory get a workout.
The game was designed with science in mind to help build thinking abilities. Its gameplay is simple, yet it stays stimulating while keeping players engaged and entertained.
skate-hooligans: Skate Hooligans is a 3D arcade game set in an endless city. You choose a rowdy hero and set out to cause some mayhem on the streets. As you skate, grab coins, unlock upgrades that boost your bonuses, and spend what you collect on new skateboards. Obstacles appear along the way, so you need to avoid them while you chase the highest score you can reach.

Move your skater with the arrow keys or by swiping. Keep an eye on the high score as you go, and see how far your run can take you. Because the city never seems to end, there is always more road to explore. Every run gives you another chance to beat your previous result.
fruit-merge-juicy-drop-game: Fruit Merge: Juicy Drop Game is a puzzle where matching fruits join together. When two identical fruits touch, they combine into a bigger one, and you get to watch each transformation unfold. Your aim is to keep building larger fruits, starting with two small ones and working toward a gigantic final piece. Only about 1% of players have reached that point, so it is a real accomplishment.

Every move matters, because you must stop the fruits from spilling out of the container. Plan each placement carefully, and you will unlock new fruit varieties as you advance. As the fruits grow, they take up more room, so using the limited space well becomes the main challenge. The game is built for hours of matching fun, so you may find yourself losing track of time.
gun-trigger: Gun Trigger casts you as a stylish agent in a single-player shooter with a stickman look. Each level feels dynamic yet unfolds in slow motion, so you can study the scene before you act. Your goal is to take out enemies, and success depends on landing every shot at precisely the right moment.

Controls are simple: tap or click the screen to fire your weapon. Timing decides everything, so hold back until your aim lines up with an enemy, then pull the trigger. Eliminate every foe to clear the level safely. It is a casual, hypercasual title with action and adventure elements.
hoops-and-fruits: Hoops & Fruits is a playful game where you toss rings at a set of bright, fruit-shaped targets. You control your throws by dragging and dropping, which makes each attempt feel hands-on and easy to pick up. The visuals are cheerful and colorful, and the music adds to the lighthearted mood as you move through the stages.

Each level pushes you to get better at your aim and timing. You can rack up higher scores by landing a single hoop over several fruits at the same time. The game is built to be quick to start and tough to put down, especially when you are chasing a better result on a level you have already cleared.
bike-stunt-master-mini-rush: Bike Stunt Master Mini Rush puts you on a motorcycle and sends you down racing courses full of obstacles to dodge. Along the way you can pull off stunts, crush fruit and boxes, and go head to head with rival riders. Pick from a broad selection of motorbikes, upgrade them, and collect power-ups that help you on the track. Several racing modes are available, so you can change the challenge whenever you like.

The tracks take you across beaches, jungles, deserts, and night courses. Finish levels to earn rewards and unlock new bikes to try. You control everything with on-screen buttons for steering, accelerating, braking, and performing stunts. Expect fast gameplay and plenty of bikes to customize as you race.
cerkio: Cerkio offers a stripped-back world where careful aim and a calm pace go hand in hand. Your job is to judge the right moment and launch a ball toward a target. The game spans 30 stages, and each one grows a little more complex than the last, so your timing gets tested steadily. A soothing soundtrack plays throughout, which keeps the mood relaxed even when a level pushes you.

Every action uses a single touch, so the controls stay intuitive from start to finish. The challenge is real, yet the overall feel remains calming. As you refine your skills, you can work toward mastering the game with one hand.
barry-prison-parkour-escape: Barry Prison: Parkour Escape! is an obby-style parkour platformer about breaking out of jail. Along the way, you need to trick the warden, get through a series of tests, and collect every coin before you can finally make your way out. It also works on mobile.

On a computer, rotate the camera with the mouse and move with WASD. Space makes you jump, Enter uses items, and Shift activates your jetpack. Press Tab to open the menu. On mobile, use the interface buttons on the screen to control your character.
parmesan-partisan: You play as a cheese guardian in Parmesan Partisan, an arcade game where rats keep invading your territory. Your main weapon is a shotgun, and its blasts help you hold back the swarm. Success depends on balancing careful strategy with quick movement, since you need to keep your cheesy realm safe while staying on the move. Along the way you can use powerful upgrades to strengthen your defenses.

It is a defense adventure built around constant pressure. You have to plan ahead and act fast at the same time, and upgrades give you extra firepower when the rats press harder. Your goal is to stop the invaders and protect your cheesy kingdom, proving yourself as its guardian.
three-cups-game: Three Cups Game is a memory test that asks you to keep your focus sharp. You follow a slippery cup that conceals surprises, and each new level makes the pace quicker than the last. Precision and planning both matter, so you will need to think ahead while keeping your eyes on the right spot.

Uncover hidden secrets as you progress, and take a moment to enjoy each victory along the way. The game looks simple at first, but it pulls you back for one more round. It is a light mental adventure that makes you wonder how good your attention really is.
arrow-exit-puzzle: Arrow Away is a minimalist logic puzzle that tests how well you read space and direction. Your task is to work out the correct order for removing every arrow from the grid. The boards grow complicated, so you need to plan which arrows can leave first. Whether you see it as a brain teaser or a logic game, the aim stays the same: clear the board by tapping arrows in the right sequence.

Each tap sends an arrow moving in the direction it points. If an arrow runs into an obstacle, it is blocked and you lose one of your three health points. Lose all three and the game ends. Think before you tap, because every blocked arrow costs you a life.
backgammon: Backgammon is a classic board game where planning and skill make a real difference. Each player works to move their pieces around the board and take them off before the rival does. You can enjoy this long-loved game online for free on your device.

Every turn, you roll the dice and move your pieces according to the numbers you get. The winner is the first player to remove all of their chips from the board. Luck does play a part, but it is not the whole story, and over the long run strategy matters more. Keep your wits sharp and see how far your skills can take you toward becoming a Backgammon champion.
bus-driver-simulator-3d: Bus Driver Simulator 3D lets you take the wheel and drive through well-known cities across a range of different terrain. Your job is to get better at handling a bus, and the game gives you two ways to play. You can go for fast-paced racing, or you can take it easy in free mode. The streets feel realistic thanks to busy traffic and changing weather that shape each drive.

The game is filed under Arcade and tagged as a simulation. It is built around the everyday challenge of driving a large vehicle through crowded urban roads, with the realistic scenery and conditions adding to the experience.
12-minibattles: Challenge a friend across a mix of physics-driven mini games in 12 MiniBattles. Each round is picked at random, so one moment you might be playing a soccer match and the next you could be taking part in sniper warfare. Every game uses a single button, which keeps the controls simple to pick up. The gameplay is engaging enough that two players can lose track of time for hours.
Play through the full range of games and work to get the upper hand over your friend, aiming to win every match. Player 1 uses the A key and Player 2 uses the L key. Three
summer-rider-3d: Summer Rider 3D sends you across the water on a bright, sunny surf run that draws on fast endless runner games. You can glide over the waves on a surfboard or a jet-ski while collecting shimmering starfish. The speed keeps climbing, so your reflexes get tested the whole way.

The game has a colorful summer look and upbeat tropical soundtracks. You can play alone or compete against another player. On a computer, use the arrow keys or WASD to move left and right and to jump over waves and obstacles. On mobile, tap the left or right side of the screen to steer, and tap both sides together to jump.
gelatino: Gelatino puts you in charge of a brave little popsicle trying to keep its cool. Your route is full of hazards you must avoid by swinging around them, while ice cubes along the way can be collected to help the trip go on longer. Watch out for clusters of scorching heat, which can quickly ruin the run.

Staying alive takes careful, exact handling and quick thinking as the situation changes. You weave back and forth across bright, sunny terrain, adjusting your plan on the fly so the frozen hero stays in one piece. Each attempt tests whether the popsicle can survive the heat or whether it will melt away.
motocross-rush: Moto Cross Rush is an arcade motocross race with twelve dirt courses and four bikes to choose from. Launch off jumps, drift through the corners, and grab missiles, bombs or oil to pass your rivals.

You can play the World Circuit, the Cups, or Time Trial, where you race against your own ghost. There is also the Eliminator. Coins earned along the way let you unlock new bikes and tune them. Sometimes it rains, and the track turns to mud, so the ride gets rougher.
Arrow keys or A and D steer, Space uses nitro, and Down drifts. Up or E uses your item, R puts you back on track, and P pauses the game. Mobile players can use the touch buttons.
turbo-crash-test: Turbo Dismounting is a physics-based game about causing big, messy wrecks. You launch your stickman through a course full of chaotic obstacles, and the physics decide how the crash unfolds. Along the way, you earn rewards that unlock new vehicles and more challenging levels.

Each crash can be replayed in unique ways, so you can relive the chaos and study what went wrong. The game tests your skills with fast, high-energy action that rewards careful planning and quick reactions. It is a good pick for anyone who enjoys watching a stickman come apart in creative ways.
car-destruction-king: Take the wheel of a variety of vehicles and see how well they hold up against spinning hammers, crushing presses, catapults, and other hazards. You can join races and try to beat your best times. Hitting the slow-motion button stretches out a crash so you can watch the damage in more detail. Pick from several maps and multiple game modes to change up the challenge.

Driving uses WASD, with the spacebar for the handbrake and Shift for nitro. Press C to swap camera views, R to reset your car, K to restore it, and N to switch to another car. B activates slow motion, while TAB or Escape opens the pause menu. Mobile players can use the on-screen interface instead.
jewel-coloring-crystal-sorting: In this calm puzzle, colorful crystals slowly turn into sparkling pictures as you work. Pick up a crystal, work out its shade, and carry it to the cell that matches. Each correct placement makes the image glow brighter and look more complete. The controls are simple, and the soothing atmosphere keeps every level easy to pick up and enjoy.

When the right cell is temporarily blocked, set the gem aside in the storage area instead. Plan your move order so the storage slots don't fill up and clutter the board. Hints and boosters are available for a quick way forward whenever you need one. Place every gem in its correct spot, and the finished picture will shine in full beauty.
merge-mine-idle-clicker: Dig into Merge Mine - Idle Clicker as a miner working a vein packed with diamonds. You tap the rock to gather gems, then improve your tools and combine them to boost how much you mine. Each upgrade is a choice you make on purpose, so planning ahead pays off. Over time you set up an automated mining operation that keeps growing, and diamonds keep piling up even when you step away from the screen.

It is a relaxed game for anyone who enjoys steady progress and seeing a stash grow little by little. Early taps feel slow, but each merge brings a noticeable jump in output, which keeps the work satisfying. Whether you play in short bursts or let things run in the background, your mine keeps working for you.
penalty-kick-wiz: Penalty Kick Wiz puts you in a head-to-head duel from the spot. You can take the shot or try to stop one, and every attempt depends on quick timing and reading your rival. Choices have to be made in an instant, so staying alert matters just as much as planning ahead.

Your aim is to outwit your opponent and win through clever, strategic plays. Each moment calls for sharp thinking and fast reactions, so the game tests your mind as well as your reflexes. Expect split-second decisions from start to finish.
flamit: Flamit is a quick, reaction-based adventure where you race to keep a shrinking flame alive. Your job is to move through 30 tough levels set in icy surroundings, lighting torches along the way before the clock runs out and your chances fade. Each stage asks you to plan your route around snowy barriers while dodging frost-covered foes.

The game offers two distinct modes to play through. Expect a tense, demanding experience that rewards sharp timing and careful thinking. If you enjoy adventure games that test your reflexes against the clock, this icy journey gives you plenty to work through.
funny-shooter-2: Funny Shooter 2 is a shooting game full of silly mayhem, where every fight turns into a source of laughs. You take on odd foes with unusual designs and build up your weapons using a large range of customization choices. The game takes place in a playful setting filled with character, so there is always something to look at as you move through it.
Action runs through the whole adventure, and the humor gives the experience a one-of-a-kind feel.
minni-family-home-play-house: Minni Family Home is a gentle pretend-play game for young kids who love dressing up. You build the Minni family, choose their looks, and then take them to places like the house, supermarket, dentist, tree house, hair salon, café, school, park and a friend's house. Nothing is graded here, so there are no rules, scores or timers. Every object works like a toy that you can grab, drag and play with, which makes it easy to invent your own stories.

Inside Minni Town, you can cook a snack, brush teeth at the dentist, fill a shopping basket, try a fresh haircut or feed the birds in the tree house. You can also change hairstyles, outfits, hats, eyes and expressions. Open the map and tap a building to visit it. Four places are ready from the start, and one short optional video opens the other five. Each day you collect free tickets to spend at the Prize Pop machine, which gives you a random new outfit. On desktop, play with the left mouse button.
hidden-object-my-hotel: Help a heroine bring a worn-out building back to life in this hidden-object adventure. She has just bought an old hotel and wants it to become the place she has always imagined, so you will tidy up rooms filled with clutter. Search each messy scene for well-concealed objects and restore the charm the building once had.

When you get stuck, hints can point you toward those tricky items. Scenes are packed with detail and bright colors, making every visit feel lively. Move left or right and zoom in to inspect every corner. The game runs on both PC and mobile, so you can pick it up whenever you have a spare moment. It suits casual players who enjoy renovation projects and puzzles.
morphit: In Morphit, you change your shape on the fly so you can get past obstacles that come rushing toward you. The game is an arcade challenge, and each moment asks you to react quickly and place your moves with care. Your reflexes and precision get tested as the fast-paced action keeps building.

Timing matters most here. Since the world keeps testing how well you adapt, you need to stay alert, change shape when it counts, and survive every rush. Keep watching, keep adapting, and see how long you can last.
2-minute-football-qb-legend: Get ready for a quick football game built around the parts that matter most: planning plays, spotting open receivers, and getting the ball into the end zone. Passing is simple, since a single tap starts a throw, so there are no complicated controls to learn. You run live offense against computer-controlled opponents as you work your way toward the World Championship.
apex-combat: Apex Combat is a quick-moving 2.5D arcade beat 'em up. You push through crowds of cybernetic foes set against futuristic cyberpunk backdrops. String together punishing combos, call on special abilities, and join friends in cooperative fights that keep the feel of classic arcade games alive.

Move with the W, A, S and D keys and launch attacks with Z, X, C and V. Use these keys together to chain hits, and keep moving as hordes of enemies press in around you. Stay on your feet and keep your rhythm steady.
stickman-street-fighting-3d: Stickman Street Fighting 3D is an action brawler set on city streets, where you take control of a stick figure ready to face any rival who crosses your path. Your task is to bring down foes with well-planned blows, so quick reflexes and good timing matter as much as landing hits. Breaking objects can reveal unexpected power-ups, and picking up weapons gives your attacks extra punch.
Your goal is to show everyone that you are the toughest stickman around. Stay alert, react fast, and make each fight count, because only the sharpest fighter will stay on their feet.
monsters-wheels-2: Monsters Wheels 2 is a monster truck game where each event poses a different challenge. You might race a crowded field to the finish, crush a row of parked cars, pull off the biggest backflip you can manage, or try to beat the clock. There are 24 levels in all, set in jungles, on a beach, in an amusement park and across the Arizona desert. You can choose from three trucks and upgrade their engine, suspension, tyres and nitro. Prize money from every event goes straight into your garage.

On PC, use Up or W to accelerate, Down or S to brake and reverse, and Left or Right to lean back and forward in the air. Space or X activates nitro. On mobile, acceleration is automatic, a Nitro button gives you a boost, and the tilt buttons rotate your truck left or right.
sokoballs: Sokoballs is a puzzle game built around a series of levels, each one a fresh test of your strategy. Your job is to move the balls so they land on the switches, and the controls are simple enough to pick up in moments. The look leans into retro pixel graphics that give the whole experience a nostalgic feel.

As you advance, the puzzles grow tougher, and you will need to think several moves ahead to get through them. Every stage rewards careful planning over rushing, so the game becomes a thoughtful journey through problem-solving. If you enjoy working out a clever solution step by step, this one has plenty to chew on.
robot-band-find-the-differences: Robot Band - Find the Differences takes you into a playful setting filled with musical robots. Your job is to compare pictures and spot the small differences hidden between them. As you move through the levels, sharp eyes and a bit of patience will help you catch every change. It is a cheerful puzzle where each find feels rewarding.
The game sits in the Puzzles category and is tagged as a puzzle title. No instructions are provided, so you can explore the scenes and work out your own approach to spotting the mismatches.
going-right: "Going Right" sends you soaring through the sky as you help a little bird find its way home to its nest. Dynamic obstacles appear along the route, so you need to stay sharp and keep your flyer on track. The controls are intuitive, and every move comes from a single touch, so the game is easy to pick up.

The game includes multiple modes, letting you tackle the challenge in different ways. Coins you collect along the way can be used to customize your bird. Planning your taps ahead is how you master this arcade adventure.
geometry-black-wave: In this musical platformer, you steer a small arrow through a black and white world full of spikes, blocks, and other hazards on the way to the finish line. Each level has its own soundtrack, and the music is synchronized with the gameplay. The levels vary in difficulty, and the emoji on each level button hints at how tough it will be.

To rise, tap and hold the screen. The longer you hold, the higher the wave climbs, though it stops when it hits a wall. Release the screen to send it down until it reaches the ground. Touching any obstacle ends your run, so you need quick reactions and accurate movement. Reach the finish line to clear the level and earn a high score. The game suits all ages and skill levels, so it's an easy way to pass the time. Don't be afraid to experiment with your timing.
shooting-blocky-combat-swat-gungame-surv: Shooting Blocky Combat Swat GunGame Survival is a multiplayer shooter set on a blocky arena map. It includes five game modes, and you can team up with friends from around the world. If you prefer to play alone, you can go offline and tackle up to 40 levels. The game offers 18 guns, which you can customize with camo and attachments.

Here is how the controls work. W, A, S and D move your character, and Shift makes you run. Space makes you jump. The mouse handles aiming, looking around, and changing guns. Press Q to change camo, E to change attachments, and Tab to open the menu.
car-wash-idle: Car Wash Idle is a 3D idle arcade management game about running your own car wash. You scrub dirty vehicles, pick up the cash they earn, and open new washing stations as you go. Equipment can be upgraded to speed up cleaning and handle more cars at once, and new areas let you widen the business. Hired helpers can take over some of the work so the money keeps coming in.

Move your character with WASD or the arrow keys, and drag the mouse to swing the camera around. Left-click to press buttons and pick upgrades in the interface. Keep improving your setup, serving more customers, and growing your small washing spot into a much larger cleaning operation.
slope-racing-3d: Roll a determined ball at high speed down a colorful slope that keeps shifting beneath it. Your route is packed with moving obstacles, so you need to dodge them while picking up gems and driving over boost pads for extra momentum. Power-ups are there to help as well, and using them at the right moment makes a real difference. The ramps never seem to end, and the difficulty steadily climbs the longer you keep going.
Slope Racing 3D is a quick, fast-moving ride that puts your reflexes and accuracy to the test. Every run asks you to stay sharp and keep your ball steady as the track speeds up around you.
playground-man-ragdoll-show: Playground Man! Ragdoll Show! is a free, relaxing 3D casual game built around ragdoll physics. You help a wooden stickman, or other objects found on each level, by solving puzzles that call for inventive thinking. Smashing and tumbling things around the playground is part of the fun, and the physics keep every crash looking silly. Solve a puzzle to unlock new levels and keep moving through the game.

The game suits anyone who enjoys physics puzzles and ragdoll simulators, and fans of Ragdoll Break: Let's destroy! and Kick Master should feel at home. Global leaderboards let you post your best results and try to beat other players. You can play online from a phone or a PC whenever you like. On a phone, move your finger across the screen; on a PC, hold the left mouse button and move the mouse.
animal-hair-salon: Animal Hair Salon lets you step into the role of a stylist working on cute animal clients. Pick the animal you'd like to style, then use the tools along the bottom of the screen to cut, shape, and dye its hair. Once you have a hairstyle you love, you can finish the look by adding fun accessories. The game is free to play in your browser.

Each look starts with the animal you choose. Click a tool at the bottom, then click the hair to work on it. Build your dream hairstyle first, then move on to picking accessories to complete the makeover.
canjump: Canjump puts you in control of a monster that must hop across dangerous ground in this arcade-style adventure. Timing is everything, since each leap has to land at just the right moment. You only need a single button, but the challenge grows as you face tougher hazards and foes along the way. Your reflexes will be tested the whole time.

There is no set finish line, so the main goal is to chase a higher score every time you play. It stays entertaining over a long stretch, making it a good pick for anyone who enjoys simple controls and steadily rising difficulty.
superbike-hero: Superbike Hero puts you on a high-powered motorbike in the Superbike Series, with races held across Europe and the Middle East. You can boost past rivals to gain ground and lean deep into sharp bends to keep your speed up. Along the way, grab coins and spend them on upgrades that prepare your bike for the next event.
Steering works with touch on phones and tablets, while desktop players use the arrow keys or WASD. It is a 3D arcade racer with a simple, classic feel, built for quick sessions of pure bike racing.
