hero-rescue: Hero Rescue is a 3D action game that runs in your browser using HTML5. Your goal is to free a brave man from danger and help him escape alongside the woman he loves. Each stage is a logic challenge built around pulling pins, so you need to think before you act. Along the way, you gather treasure while the hero fights off enemies and the hazards that stand in his way.

The game rewards careful planning and sharp strategy more than quick reflexes. Solving each puzzle lets you move forward and collect more loot. Everything is controlled with your mouse, so you only need that single device to make your moves. It suits players who enjoy brain teasers and rescue stories, and it is tagged for both boys and girls.
binbloom-city-cleanup: BinBloom: City Cleanup is a 3D game about driving a waste collection truck. You steer powerful vehicles along bright urban roads, lift bins with a mechanical arm, and sort the refuse into plastic, paper, glass, and organic piles. Each mission is challenging, and every one leaves the streets a little cleaner.

The game includes 60 levels set in attractive city environments. You can unlock and upgrade 12 different vehicles, and you earn coins and gems along the way, plus a daily reward. Controls are simple: W accelerates, S brakes or reverses, A and D steer left and right, and Space pulls the handbrake to drift.
moto-x3m-spooky-land: Moto X3M: Spooky Land is a racing game with a haunted twist. Every curve on its ghostly courses pushes you to face something unnatural. You pull off daring jumps and flips that seem to defy gravity, while steering across eerie tracks lined with obstacles that threaten to rattle you off your bike. Speed matters most here.
Riding fast unlocks creepy new gear to show off. Whether you can keep pace with the haunting action and make it through the ghoulish adventure is up to you.
elastic-man: Elastic Man lets you grab a man whose face can be pinched and pulled. Like a balloon, his features stretch as you tug on them, which makes for silly results. There is no objective, so you can simply spend time pulling and dragging his stretchy face however you like.

For the best look, choose the medium quality setting. At this level the wrinkles on his face stay hidden, so he doesn't come across as unsettling, and the game runs smoothly. Everything is controlled with your mouse.
val-d-agri-race: Speed through the busy streets of Viggiano in this car racer, weaving past regular traffic while patrols give chase. Your aim is to shake them off and keep moving through each high-speed pursuit. Every run calls for quick reactions and steady nerves behind the wheel.

Coins gathered along the way let you unlock new cars and customize the flashy models you collect. You can also tap into temporary powers to help you stay ahead. Causing destruction across the streets is another way to reach exclusive rides.
royal-couple-halloween-party: Welcome to a dreamy setting where your job is to design spooky-sweet Halloween looks for royal couples. The graphics are bright and colorful, and you play by pointing and clicking. Pick pieces from different wardrobes, combine them, and build one-of-a-kind costumes that fit the holiday theme. Let your imagination run wild and make the festive evening feel like a enchanted work of art.

Every outfit you create adds to the fun of the party. Experiment with different looks until each couple is ready for the celebration. The game rewards a playful eye and a love of dressing up, so take your time and enjoy shaping a night that feels truly magical.
hidden-objects-island: Hidden Objects: Island takes you into a world of secrets and surprises, where every place has a story to tell. You travel between calm beaches, peaceful Japanese gardens, magical flying houses, and rustic fishing villages. As you explore each spot, you uncover the mysteries behind the scene, searching for concealed items, working through puzzles, and gathering rare treasures along the way.
To play, simply click or tap the objects hidden within each picture. If an item is especially hard to spot, you can use a hint to reveal it more quickly.
offroad-monster-truck-game: Step into a rough-terrain driving adventure built around monster trucks. You take the wheel of these machines and tackle offroad courses that wind through wild, uneven landscapes. Routes lead through muddy paths, rocky roads, and steep hills, and each stretch of difficult ground asks you to keep your truck under control.

Every track is designed to test your driving ability, including your balance, your speed, and how well you handle tough offroad conditions. All buttons in the game are selected with a mouse click. Whether you are sliding through soft mud or climbing a rocky incline, the goal is to stay steady from start to finish.
santabalt: Get into the holiday mood with Santabalt, an endless runner that puts Santa in charge. Your job is to make him jump from one rooftop to the next while steering clear of obstacles along the way. The pace picks up quickly, and a single tap or click is all you need to control every leap.
Good timing and quick reactions are the keys to going further, since each careful run stretches Santa's trip a little longer. It's a lively seasonal game that keeps you coming back for another round.
the-tall-man: Wandering through a pitch-black woodland at night, you search for nine mysterious pages scattered among trees, abandoned buildings, and rusted vehicles. A flashlight with a draining battery is your only light, and a Slender-inspired figure called the Tallman is approaching before a countdown runs out.

The visuals are gritty and realistic 3D, dominated by deep blacks, navy, and cold grays that are broken only by the harsh yellow glow of your light. Fog drifts between spindly pines, and your character appears only as a hand in a pink sleeve gripping the flashlight. A HUD shows the timer, page count, battery level, and mini-map, while the sounds grow more intense as you collect more pages. Move with WASD, look with the mouse, and hold Shift to run.
injection-invasion: Injection Invasion is an arcade platformer where you dodge and weave to avoid trouble. Quick reflexes and a bit of strategy are essential if you want to get through. You guide a boy across a risky world where injections keep flying toward him. Precise movement and good timing are what keep him alive, so watch closely how each one approaches.
Mastering evasive maneuvers is the heart of the game. Your main aim is to see how long you can last before the injections finally catch him.
age-of-tanks-warriors-td-war: Age of Tanks Warriors: TD War is a strategy game about leading tank armies through history. You start in the Stone Age and move forward to a science fiction future. Along the way you can upgrade your battle tanks, join large clashes, and use tower defense tactics. Some battles pit 100 units against 100 in survival fights.

Matches are played with simple clicks, so the challenge lies in planning. Your stone cave faces your opponent's cave, and you send soldiers out by clicking a small icon in the lower right corner. You may not have enough soldiers ready in time to match the enemy. Each level requires you to defeat the opposing army and destroy its shelter. As levels advance, fortresses become harder, and upgrading your army and weapons helps you keep up.
snake-2048: You begin as a tiny cube and grow by swallowing smaller snakes while steering clear of bigger, stronger ones. Your mass decides what you can eat: you may consume cubes smaller than you, but crashing into a heavier cube ends your run. Growth has no ceiling, so you can keep expanding for as long as you survive.

Controls are straightforward and quick to respond. On desktop, your snake follows the cursor, while on mobile a joystick handles the turning. Opponents hit hard, and you can battle rivals in a race for first place. Two difficulty levels let you pick your challenge, and plenty of entertainment waits along the way.
diner-in-the-storm: Caught off guard by a storm that arrives without warning, you duck into a diner to wait it out. You are protected for the moment, but it does not take long to notice that something dangerous waits just beyond its fragile walls. Getting out is the easy part. Persuading everyone else inside to join you is where the trouble begins. This single-player, 2D horror escape puzzle has an apocalyptic mood.

Controls are simple. A left mouse click interacts with things in the scene. You can move left and right with the arrow keys or with A and D, which are optional, and press Space to move through dialogue.
spooky-halloween-makeover: Step into a Halloween world where creativity, style, and a touch of the supernatural meet. You transform a beauty into a Halloween icon, then design a room that feels haunted yet stylish. There are 15 distinct Halloween makeover styles to explore, along with endless ways to customize the room.

Start by dragging makeup tools onto your client's face. Next, open the cupboard and choose an outfit for her. Match her wishes to earn three stars. To play, click and drag with the left mouse button, or tap and drag on a mobile screen.
car-crash-test: Car Crash Test is an arcade game about smashing vehicles in dramatic ways. Its physics respond in real time, and the scenes are drawn in 3D, so every collision looks and behaves convincingly. You collect coins by wrecking cars with careful planning, and those coins let you unlock new vehicles. Several tracks offer tough courses to work through along the way.

Mastering time dilation is a central skill, letting you control the pace of the action while wrecks burst apart in explosive fashion. The game is built to keep you coming back, and fans of sudden, spectacular crashes will likely find it compelling.
run-and-jump-jumbo-runner: Run & Jump Jumbo Runner is an arcade game where you race across terrain that keeps changing beneath you. Precise moves and good timing are key, since you must fly over and weave past obstacles as you go. Every quick tap sends you faster and brings harder challenges, so the pace steadily picks up.
The game centers on runs and flights that seem to defy gravity. Each stretch of ground asks you to learn its pattern, so you can time your jumps and keep moving forward through its arcade action.
mahjong-3: Step into a storytelling puzzle world where tile matching meets classic mahjong. The game blends the strongest ideas from match-3 and mahjong into one experience. Each level presents a board packed with tiles, and your job is to remove every single one. Boosters are available to help you finish stages, and they reward you with coins along the way.

To play, find two identical tiles on the board and match them to make them disappear. Keep going until nothing is left, and the level is complete. Finishing levels earns you stars, so you can track how well you have done.
steel-directive-city-zero: You step into the role of an armored enforcer determined to reclaim City Zero in this 2D action shooter. Across 20 different missions, you battle rival human gangs, face robots that grow more threatening as you advance, and bring down formidable bosses. Your objectives include rescuing civilians, gathering evidence, shutting off security systems, and making it to the extraction point, using cover, a variety of guns, grenades, and shields.

Move with A and D or the Left and Right arrows, jump with Space, and kneel with S or C. Shoot using a mouse click or J, while E interacts with objects and picks up weapons. Press V to scan, Q to swap weapons, R to reload, Shift to dodge, G for grenades, and F for your shield. Pause with P, and on mobile, use the on-screen buttons.
harvestoria-tractor-farming: Build a farm of your own and watch it grow through the seasons. You start on foot as a farmer, then climb into your tractor to handle 40 levels of working the land. Your jobs include ploughing, sowing seeds, spraying crops, hauling cargo with a trolley, and delivering water with a tanker. Each level brings a new mission and a fresh machine to learn, such as ploughs, cultivators, seeders, sprayers, disc cutters, grass machines, and more.

To use a machine, reverse up to it, hitch it to your tractor, and work the field one row at a time. The soil changes colour behind you as you move. Glowing orange arrows on the ground point to each objective, and Farmer Joe is ready with a tip when you need one. Steer with A and D, accelerate with W, brake or reverse with S, use Space for the handbrake, and press F to attach or detach machines.
endless-car-chase: Endless Car Chase puts you behind the wheel while the police hunt you through the streets, and your job is to stay out of their reach. City roads are crowded and chaotic, so you'll need to weave between traffic and cut sharp turns to keep your lead. The chase never really ends, so every
strike-galaxy-attack: Strike Galaxy Attack puts you at the controls of a single, strong spaceship. Your job is to weave out of the way of nonstop waves of bright space birds while firing off steady bursts of gunfire. Pick up upgrades along the way to make your ship stronger and to slip past enemies more easily. The goal is to take control of the galaxy in this 2D arcade shooter.

It sits in the Arcade category, and the game has no written instructions, so you can jump in and learn the controls as you play. Expect fast, colorful action where quick movement and good timing matter most.
bmg-ragdoll-car-race: Think of this game as a crash test simulator on wheels, packed with obstacles and debris that can wreck your car in seconds. Physics drives most of the fun, so the ragdoll racers tumble around in unpredictable ways. A realistic damage system shows every impact, turning each collision into a sight worth watching.

You can explore a large open world with varied areas and hidden routes to discover. Each level brings its own conditions, from grueling tracks to tricky stunt zones, and the challenges test your speed as well as your driving skills. On PC, use WASD or the arrow keys to drive, Shift for nitro, Space for the handbrake, and R to restart. Smartphone players can use the on-screen keys.
tentrix: TenTrix asks you to think ahead while keeping things simple. Blocks drop from above, and you place each one on a 10 by 10 board, aiming to complete lines so they vanish and your score climbs. The pieces cannot be turned, so every placement needs planning, yet the game still leaves plenty of room for creative choices.

Think of it as a fresh spin on the classic Tetris formula. Since the shapes stay in their original orientation, the puzzle depends on where you set each piece, and the possibilities seem to keep unfolding. It works on both PC and mobile, so you can play on whichever device suits you.
wild-love: Wild Love takes you to a puzzling island where danger lurks around almost every corner for the heroine. Your choices shape what happens next, and you have to work out which people you meet are allies and which are threats. Solving the island's secret is the goal, and you'll be guided by your own instincts. You can also customize how your heroine looks before setting off on the adventure.

Playing is simple. You read through the story page by page, getting caught up in the events and feeling what the heroine feels. When the game presents options, tap the buttons to decide what she says and does. Each decision moves the tale forward in its own direction.
war-of-tanks-3d: War of Tanks 3D puts you in control of a tank during fierce fights where planning and accuracy matter most. You move across shifting landscapes, carefully line up your cannon shots, and work out clever ways to get around your opponents. The action moves quickly as you try to take control of the battlefield, learning to make the most of your tank's firepower and using the terrain to your advantage in the push for a win.

Because no separate instructions are provided, you will pick up the controls as you play. Expect a mix of tactical thinking and rapid reactions, with every move you make shaping how the battle unfolds. Whether you prefer slow, deliberate aiming or fast, aggressive pushes, the game gives you room to try different approaches on the field.
super-candy-jewels: Super Candy Jewels is a match-three puzzle game built around colorful sweets. Your journey takes you through a candy-filled world, and your goal is to clear every level. Swap candies to line up three of the same color, and they vanish from the board. Lining up three or more in a row creates candy bombs and earns you extra points. Each win also brings tasty candy combos as a reward.

When a stage feels tough, you can use the boosters you have collected to get past it. Keep an eye on your progress, because each level asks you to gather a set number of candies. You must reach that target before your moves or the clock run out. Every swap counts, so plan ahead and think about where your next candy bomb could go.
boat-war-mayhem: Steer an inflatable raft down wild jungle rivers in this shooter. Explosive traps and enemy fire are waiting, so you must keep dodging while you move. Aim your weapon to blast the obstacles coming your way, and grab the cash scattered across the water. The goal is to outlast the rival combatants around you.

Success depends on precise targeting, quick reactions, and relentless action throughout each high-stakes river showdown. Movement is flexible: guide the boat with your mouse, or use the WASD or arrow keys if you prefer the keyboard.
dotto-botto: Dotto Botto is a retro platformer starring a small pixel hero. As you move through a range of different levels, you'll need to leap and sidestep spikes and dangerous foes, with timing that has to be spot on. Along the way you can gather power-ups and tackle tricky challenges before facing a huge final boss.
evil-invader: Set in a bleak future war zone, Evil Invader drops you onto a battlefield crawling with monstrous foes. Fast shooting keeps the pace high, and you must keep firing at enemies that seem to never let up. A wide range of weapons gives you plenty of ways to answer the attack.

Power-ups let you plan your next move, and watching how each enemy behaves helps you predict their attacks. As you gain levels, you unlock much stronger firepower. This is a survival challenge, so every choice you make counts.
jigsaw-pusha-pusha: Set in a forest, this single-player puzzle is all about pushing. Use the arrow keys, or W, A, S and D, to walk around and shove the crates where they belong. Your objective is to place every crate onto an altar, an act meant to please the almighty God. The game is filed under puzzles and tagged with jigsaw and puzzleblock.

Movement is simple: walk, push, and keep at it until each crate sits on its altar. Because the challenge is built like a jigsaw, every shove is a small piece of a bigger arrangement. Take your time, plan your pushes, and pay attention to where each crate ends up.
spinning-oia-oia-cat-bricker: Step into a brick-smashing journey led by a spirited Oia Oia cat. Bright, colorful scenes and cheerful meows keep the action moving from the very start. Your job is to line up your shots and take out bricks accurately.

As you go, each stage grows more demanding, so you will need to keep sharpening your aim. The cheering atmosphere and upbeat rhythm make every round feel bouncy and full of energy. It is a game that can keep you coming back for a long, enjoyable session.
bouncing-egg: Bouncing Egg puts you in charge of a delicate egg moving through a colorful world built from pixel art. Your egg hops from one spinning circle to the next, and along the way it can crush the grumpy faces scattered across the path. Controls are kept simple: you only tap to make the egg act, so the game is easy to pick up but hard to put down.

Success depends on careful timing, steady nerves, and a willingness to keep trying. As the difficulty ramps up, each jump takes more precision, and the egg has to stay in one piece the whole way. Stay patient, watch the rotation, and see how far your egg can go without cracking.
golf-battle: Golf Battle is a mini golf game built around a golf battle match, where your aim is to become the king. It is made for casual players, so it is easy to pick up. You can play it online on a mobile device or a PC, and the controls rely on your mouse.

The title sits in the Sports category and is presented in 3D, with tags covering golf, action, and sport. It is listed for both boys and girls. Simply use your mouse to play and see if you can win the match and become king.
city-bus-simulator-driving-games: Take the controls of a powerful city bus and live the day of a professional bus driver. Your job is to pick up passengers from different locations, then carry them through crowded city streets to their destinations. Parking your bus carefully is part of the challenge, and each drive comes with driving missions to complete.

On desktop, move with the A, W, S, and D keys, brake with Space, pause with P, open settings with Ctrl, switch the camera angle with C, and skip a level with N. On mobile, tap the left and right buttons to steer, then use the race and brake buttons to speed up or stop.
yummy-toast: Yummy Toast puts you behind the counter of a busy, cheerful kitchen where you make toast for hungry customers. Your job is to build tasty creations from a range of ingredients and get each order out the door. Working fast and staying accurate both matter, because they help you move forward as you open up tougher stages. Your aim is to master the art of toast making.

The game rewards quick hands and careful choices, so every order is a small test of your skill. As the stages get harder, you will need to keep up the pace while still getting each topping right. Watching customers' requests and assembling them in time keeps the kitchen running smoothly and your skills sharpening.
bus-escape-clear-jam: In Bus Escape: Clear Jam, your job is to take a bus apart and get its riders back home. This cheerful parking puzzle blends a bit of adventure with a good workout for your brain. The rules are easy to pick up, but the challenge grows as you move along, so it should appeal to people who enjoy tactical puzzles and driving sims alike.

Your task is to sort the vehicles, work out the right answers, and clear space in the lot. Every bus and car can only hold a set number of spaces, so think ahead before each move to untangle the snarled traffic. Move buses and cars around, group them by color, and open up the parking area. Puzzles come in many difficulty levels, designed for players of any age or skill. The bright, colorful stages are also meant to help you unwind while you play.
perimeter-legate-edition: In Perimeter - Legate Edition, you take charge of the Exodus civilization in a real-time strategy game where reshaping the land is a key tactic. By terraforming the terrain on purpose, you change how each battle unfolds. Raise defensive perimeters to protect your position, then push outward to claim new territory as the setting shifts around you.

The map never stays still, so you need to keep adjusting your plans as conditions change. Your job is to keep your people alive and guide them toward victory, with the future of Earth resting on the choices you make. Tagged as strategy, it suits players who enjoy planning ahead.
bubble-pop-legend: Bubble Pop Legend is an arcade bubble shooter where you aim and fire to clear a board full of colorful bubbles. Each bubble you pop earns coins. Groups of three or more bubbles of the same color burst together, and a level is won once every bubble is gone. It is a handy way to pass time, and you can easily spend hours on it while keeping your mind active.

Controls are simple. Swipe to aim the shooter, then tap anywhere to fire. Use fewer shots to earn a higher score and three stars on each level. Boosters can help with tougher stages, so plan ahead and use them at the right moment to blast through every level.
idle-craft-3d: Idle Craft 3D is a clicker set in a three-dimensional world, where you rebuild your home. Recruit workers to help with the job, and summon elders when fatigue builds up. The world is colorful to look at, and your progress keeps going even when you step away from the screen.

Think ahead about how you grow your workforce, and keep an eye on the balance of your resources so nothing runs short. Each change you make shows up as a visible transformation around you, so the rebuild becomes more satisfying the longer you play. The game rewards careful planning as you work toward your goals.
robo-butcher: In Robo-Butcher, you control a humanoid robot in two-dimensional platform arenas, where the aim is to reach supremacy by defeating everything in your path. Waves of robotic opponents come at you one after another, and you must outmaneuver them with agile, tactical movement while wiping them out. You can upgrade your arsenal, and grabbing power-ups from crates gives you extra help during a fight.
Winning means studying each enemy and striking at its weak points. The game tests both endurance and skill, so you need to stay sharp for as long as the battles last.
call-of-tanks: Call of Tanks is an action title where you send tanks onto the battlefield to beat your rival. Picking the right mix of units is what decides who wins the fight. You can improve your defenses and your tanks to hit harder, and you can unlock stronger bases to hold your ground.
To play on desktop, click the cards to place units on the battlefield with your mouse. On mobile, simply tap the cards to deploy your units.
kiki-world-kawaii-doll-decor: Kiki World invites you to redesign messy rooms and turn them into comfortable, fashionable homes. Start by tidying up, getting rid of worn-out pieces, and then placing stylish furniture where it fits best. Empty corners soon feel lived-in once your own taste shows through. This game suits anyone who loves interior design, since it tests your imagination as you decorate, give rooms a fres
commando-force-2: Commando Force 2 is a first person shooter where you take part in fast, intense fights. You can join team battles or face other players one on one in free-for-all matches. As you play, you earn rewards through the Battle Pass, and you can learn a variety of maps and weapons. The controls feel smooth, the visuals look impressive, and the strategy adds depth, so it is simple to pick up but takes practice to get good at.
dune-surfer-3d: You are a poor stickman lost among colorful yet lethal dunes, and your shape keeps changing. In the air you turn into a ball, and when you surf you become a stickman again. Your goal is to draw, surf and slide your way to safety while avoiding rolling stones, darts, sharks, alligators and more.

Touching a white obstacle ends your run instantly, and the other colored obstacles can kill you too, so every hit is a risk. Dune speed bumps will shield you a little, but only up to a point. To keep from sinking into the endless depths of the dunes, you need to draw precise lines. Controls work with the keyboard, the mouse, or touch.
dead-land-survival: Dead Land: Survival is a multiplayer survival simulation set in a post-apocalyptic world where ordinary life has fallen apart. Cities lie in ruins, and thousands of zombies wander their streets. Your hero needs to grow stronger, your shelter needs rebuilding, and every trip beyond the safe zone is a search for gear, food, and materials for crafting. Forge new equipment and weapons, then team up with other players in clans.
Friends can play together here. You can take on elite bosses as a group, tackle clan challenges, and fight off the undead while slowly restoring your survivors' settlement.
demolition-derby-life: Demolition Derby Life puts you behind the wheel of a derby simulator built around crashing into rivals. Your goal is to smash your way to victory through careful, strategic play. You can upgrade your car as you go, which helps you last longer than the competition. Victory goes to whoever is still driving once the rest have been wrecked.

Each impact is meant to feel forceful and up close, so every hit carries weight. This is a single-player experience, so the whole arena is yours to tackle alone. It asks you to balance aggression with patience as you work toward the win. Expect a tense, immersive run where every choice on the track counts.
ember-boy-and-ripple-girl: Ember Boy and Ripple Girl is a puzzle platformer built around teamwork, where two elemental characters must cooperate to get out of each stage. Each hero can do things the other cannot, so you will often switch between them to flip switches, avoid hazards, move platforms, and work through the puzzles built into the surroundings. Good timing and careful exploration matter as much as quick thinking.

Pay attention to where fire and water can travel safely, because a wrong route can cost you the run. Many exits can only be reached by using both heroes' abilities together at the right moment. The controls use the WASD keys and the arrow keys, and the game is tagged for two players, with action, fire, and water themes.
sorter-ragdoll-playground-shooter: Sorter: Ragdoll Playground Shooter is a fast action game built around stress relief. You aim at ragdoll foes using a wide range of firearms, from handguns and rifles to shotguns, submachine guns, and launchers. Every target moves like a real doll with full ragdoll animation, so shots and blasts send them flailing in lively, expressive ways. The physics and detailed damage system make each hit feel satisfying.

The scenes feature familiar faces and recognizable places, and the gameplay stays simple. To play, move your weapon anywhere on the stage, aim at a ragdoll, and tap to attack. Earn money as you go and spend it on new guns, then use them to clear levels and open fresh challenges. It suits anyone who enjoys physics-based chaos and a calm way to unwind. Prove your precision, reaction, and skill as you work toward becoming the top mercenary.
mini-switcher: Mini Switcher asks you to flip the direction of gravity so a small blob can reach the goal. The adventure stretches across around 30 levels, and you will face a mix of colorful enemies and obstacles, each behaving in its own way. If you want a harder test, the speed run mode lets you see how fast you can finish.
The game has a retro look and was built to be a short, relaxing experience. On a computer, press X or Space, or left-click, to switch gravity. On a touch device, tap the screen to do the same.
robot-car-transform-race: Hop into a bright, colorful kart race against playful rivals on lively tracks. Each lap brings sharp corners and obstacles to dodge, and every race is a fight for the top spot. Pick the smartest line through each bend and keep your competitors behind you as you zoom along in a quick, arcade-flavored way.

Use the controls to steer and accelerate, then push for the finish line in first place. Learn every course, sharpen your skills, and grow more confident with each attempt until you can claim the crown as the top racer.
heist-idle: Build a growing crime operation in this 3D idle heist game. You can rob jewelry stores, break into banks, and sneak through museums while dodging security cameras and lasers. Every job means digging through secure areas, smashing displays, and carrying stolen treasures out before you escape with the loot.

As you progress, you unlock new locations, upgrade your character, and recruit crew members for bigger heists. Each new area brings tougher security, better rewards, and fresh ways to steal. Move with WASD or the arrow keys, and use your mouse to interact with buttons and upgrades. Collect cash, improve your operation, and work your way up to master thief.
build-an-aquapark: Step into a water park where the slide is entirely up to you. You purchase pieces of slide, connect them in whatever arrangement you choose, and then ride them at top speed. The goal is to construct the longest, quickest, and most outrageous routes you can manage.

Start by buying slide components and assembling your structure. When it is ready, jump onto the water ring and glide down the track. Keep improving your design with better parts, then show off your finished slide for others to admire.
spider-evolution-runner-game: You play as a spider in this 3D runner, racing forward while you hunt. Feed on bugs and smaller spiders to grow along the way. The path ahead is full of rough terrain and threats, so you need to keep moving and dodge whatever could end your run. Colorful landscapes stretch out around you, and every decision you make helps you last a little longer.

Your goal is to grow into the biggest spider in the realm. Plan each move carefully, since every meal and every dodge affects how far you can get. It is a short, bite-sized adventure, so you can jump into a quick round whenever you have a few spare minutes.
octopus-run: Octopus Run puts you in control of a strong octopus that swims through the deep parts of the ocean in a runner-style game. Your targets are divers and fish, which you chase down and hunt as you move. Obstacles drift through the water, so you must steer around them to keep going. Money is scattered along the way, and collecting it lets you improve your abilities and attacks.

Movement is simple: use the WASD keys or steer with your mouse. Either way, you glide through the sea, dodging hazards and gathering money while working toward becoming the top predator below the waves. Each run blends hunting, dodging, and collecting into one underwater challenge.
battlebox: BattleBox is a puzzle adventure where you dig up buried treasure while dodging dangerous monsters. Success depends on both memory and wit, as you plan your moves and try to recall the hidden grid layout, all while aiming for riches and steering clear of peril.

Staying alive means keeping your health topped up, and handy strawberries help you do exactly that. Each round brings a fresh discovery as you uncover what lies beneath the board. It is listed under Puzzles and carries the Board tag.
clutchcraft-drive-car-driving: Step behind the wheel in this realistic 3D driving simulator. You can roam an open-world city, cruise through detailed streets, and take on challenging roads. Parking missions help you sharpen your skills, while traffic lights and road signs teach real-world rules as you go. Several cars are available to unlock along the way.

The driving physics and vehicle controls are designed to feel smooth and true to life, and you can switch between different camera views. Press W to accelerate and S to brake or reverse, use A and D to steer, and tap Space for the handbrake. C changes the camera, H sounds the horn, and L toggles the headlights. Q and E operate the left and right indicators, R resets your car, and Esc pauses the game. Free Drive mode lets you explore at your own pace.
ball-sort-puzzle: Balls have been jumbled across the flasks, and your job is to restore order. Each flask needs to end up holding balls of just one color. The game offers many levels that climb from gentle starters to tougher challenges.
To move a ball, click the flask you want to take it from, then click the flask you want to drop it into. Simple logic and a bit of patience are all it takes to get everything sorted again.
warfare-area: Enemy forces have taken over your base, and you are the only soldier left from your troop who can fight them back. Armed with a rifle, you must face the battle alone. This HTML5 shooter can be played on both desktop and mobile devices.

On a computer, use the arrow keys or W, A, S, and D to move your character, while the mouse turns, aims, and shoots. On a mobile device, drag the on-screen joystick to move, press the fire button to shoot, and tap and drag the right side of the screen to aim and turn.
super-billy-boy: Super Billy Boy takes you across a world built from chunky pixels, where traps are scattered about and alien enemies lurk. Your mission is to free a close friend, and reaching them means overcoming platforming challenges that reward precision and clever planning. Each obstacle asks you to think carefully before you leap.

The adventure has a nostalgic charm that fans of older games will recognize. As you progress, every level brings fresh challenges and surprising turns, so you never know quite what waits around the next corner. Expect the unexpected at every step.
match-mystery: Match Mystery is a match-3 puzzle adventure where you line up matching pieces while a story unfolds around you. Each strategic move reveals new plot developments, and the game is packed with eye-catching visuals. There is an endless supply of challenges to keep you busy.

Levels never run out, and they grow more difficult as you go, so your puzzle-solving skills get a real workout. The game suits players of all ages who enjoy brain-teasing fun. If you like puzzles with a mystery running through them, this one gives you plenty to think about.
perfect-tongue: Perfect Tongue is a 3D hypercasual title designed to help you unwind. Your goal is to stretch your long tongue and gobble up as much food as you can. Be careful, though, because some harmful objects are mixed in with the snacks, and you need to keep your tongue away from them.

Staying clear of those hazards is the key to finishing your meal quickly. The game offers several different routes, so you can choose the path that suits you best. To begin, simply tap the screen and the action starts. It's a light, low-stress way to pass a few minutes.
the-room: The Room is a 2D shooter where you guard the heart of your own domain. Enemies arrive in waves that never seem to stop, so you must hold your ground and keep them away from the core. Success depends on accurate aim, careful planning, and quick reactions.

Controls are easy to pick up, so you can focus on the action instead of memorizing complicated inputs. The pixel art gives the game a warm, throwback feel, and each new challenge is tougher than the last. Expect addictive gameplay that keeps pulling you back for one more round.
golf-king-3d: Golf King 3D is a hypercasual golf title where you face rivals from around the world in real-time one-on-one matches on lifelike 3D courses. You aim by holding the mouse and dragging, then letting go to send the ball, a motion much like a cue shot in pool. Wins earn trophies that open higher tours, and you can gather and upgrade clubs to sharpen your game. Daily and weekly leaderboards offer prizes too, and you can challenge friends directly.

Your golfer is fully customizable, with mixes of characters, hats, glasses, tops, pants and shoes, plus emotes for celebrating a win. Collecting better clubhouses and caddies brings extra benefits. The goal is to build your career and sharpen your skills until you become the Golf King.
puzzle-drive: Puzzle Drive is a puzzle game where you work through detailed challenges to keep your car moving. Each solution sends your vehicle further ahead. Along the way, you can collect coins, and those coins help you unlock new worlds.
The levels are dynamic, and the engaging challenges keep every session fresh and rewarding. Each stage brings a different test, so your progress always feels worthwhile.
screw-match: Screw Match is a puzzle game built around nuts and bolts. You take screws in different colors from a see-through nut and send each one to the box at the top of the screen that shares its color. Matching is the core of the challenge, so keep an eye on which colors you still need to place.
When every hole in a box is full, that box is replaced by a new one. The game falls under Puzzles and carries the tags puzzle, matching, and color.
magikmon: Magikmon is a monster-collecting adventure in which you catch and raise offbeat creatures to assemble your own team. Battles are fast-paced and fun, and you travel through a magical world full of discoveries and unexpected moments. It's a charming role-playing game that rewards careful planning as much as curiosity about what lies ahead.

Your goal is to grow a strong roster of monsters while wandering through the game's enchanted landscape. Every new area offers something to find, and each fight calls for a bit of thought about which creatures to bring along. If you enjoy strategy mixed with exploration, this game has plenty to keep you occupied.
tricky-story-friendly-help: Tricky Story: Friendly Help is a brain test built around scenes from everyday life. Each round presents a riddle or logic puzzle that asks you to view a situation from a fresh angle. Along the way, you pick up several brain tricks and are encouraged to think more freely and use your imagination. If you get stuck, hints are available to nudge you forward. Changing your approach and aiming wider often turns a dead end into a solution.

The game is simple to pick up and hard to put down. Your job is to work through each puzzle, find the solution, and clear every level in these mind games. Its daily-life setups and logic challenges make for a solid workout for your brain.
obby-cart-rush: Obby Cart Rush is a colorful 3D cart-coaster obby. You hop into a wooden minecart and race down wild roller-coaster tracks spread across five themed worlds: Mountain, House, Forest, City, and Zoo. Holding the accelerate control builds your speed, while braking before the speed signs slows you down when needed. Along the way, you must survive loops and steep drops and reach the flag as quickly as you can to earn Bronze, Silver, or Gold medals.

The controls are kept simple. On a computer, press W or the Up arrow to go, S or the Down arrow to brake, and R to restart. On mobile in landscape mode, use the on-screen gas and brake pedals, with a joystick also available. Your goal is to finish every track as fast as you can.
haunted-house-idle: Step into this 3D arcade management idle game, where you design a haunted attraction and keep growing it over time. Greet guests as they arrive, lead them through frightening scenes, and collect the cash they bring in. As your earnings climb, new haunted zones open up for you to explore and add.

Your attraction can include creepy shadows, clowns that give chase, a spinning bridge, deadly lasers, slime monsters, photo spots, and mask stalls. Make your character stronger, boost movement speed and how many visitors you can handle, and bring on helpers. You can also automate attractions and finish tasks to keep your income rising. Move with WASD or the arrow keys, and use the mouse to press buttons and navigate upgrades and menus.
arrows-out: This puzzle game asks you to escape tricky arrow mazes by studying each path and choosing which arrow to tap first. A sound opening move can clear the way, but one slip triggers a chain reaction that costs a heart. Later levels bring twisting paths, loops, and denser layouts, and some stages act as sealed arenas where every direction is either a threat or a chance.

You begin with three hearts, and three mistakes end the attempt immediately. Each board must be cleared before time runs out, which tests focus and reaction speed. The controls rely on taps and swipes. On PC, use the mouse wheel to zoom and left-click an arrow to move it away. On mobile, pinch to zoom and tap an arrow to move it away.
hidden-objects-home-sweet-home: Slip into a cozy hidden object game set in charming home interiors and peaceful outdoor corners. You can take your time exploring your house, its courtyards, and natural landscapes, and each location has its own mood and design. Spotting concealed items sharpens your focus and observation, all while calm, pleasant music plays in the background. It's a relaxed pastime that kids, grown-ups, girls, boys, women, and men can all enjoy.

To play, look at the strip along the bottom of the screen, which lists the objects you need to find. When you spot one in the scene, click it to collect it. If the bottom panel gets in the way, simply click on it to hide it. Your goal is to find every hidden object in each scene.
plant-squad: The world has been overrun by zombies, and you are one of the few left who can push them back. In Plant Squad, a classic defense adventure, you lead a team of plants into battle. Merge plants together to create tougher, stronger fighters, and plan where each one should stand to build your defenses. Your objective is to clear every zombie off the field.

The undead are not waiting around, either. They are preparing for their own fight, so each decision you make matters. You control the game with your mouse or with touch input. Careful strategy and steady planning will carry you through the mission.
obby-swim-for-egg: Head up the highway into a flooded aquarium and start swimming. Every biome has a boss guarding a nest of eggs. Your goal is to snatch one egg, carry it home past the guardian, and hatch it on your farm. Creatures earn money along the way, which you can spend on upgrades and treadmills. Swimming deeper brings you into rarer biomes, and you can fill your Codex as you go or play online with other people.

Controls are simple. Use WASD to move and the mouse to look around. Space swims up, while Shift swims down. Press E to steal an egg, use shops, and place eggs on your farm, and press Esc to open the menu. On a phone, the left thumb moves, the right thumb looks, and the ACTION button does the rest. A video is also available.
splatcha: Splatcha! is a quick territorial paint battle where two blobby rivals share a single arena. You have 90 seconds, and whoever covers the most floor with paint wins. Hold the paint control and color lays down automatically while you roam the arena.

Play head-to-head with a friend on the same device, take on the computer at one of three difficulty levels, or climb the arcade tower. Five unique arenas, power-ups to grab, and golden chests to crack open await while you try to survive. Confetti is guaranteed. Player 1 uses WASD to move and SPACE to dash, while Player 2 uses the arrow keys and 0
snail-clicker: Snail Clicker is a clicking game where you tap to build up your pile of snail coins. Each coin you gather helps you climb the ranks, and along the way you can unlock new upgrades and snail skins. Every click adds to your growing snail empire, so there's always a reason to keep going.

The game is built around a simple loop of clicking and collecting, with steady progress that rewards each tap. Its charming, addictive pace suits anyone who likes watching their numbers grow. Everything comes back to expanding your snail kingdom one click at a time.
rooftop-run: Race across city rooftops in this parkour runner. You jump, roll, and slide your way forward while dodging obstacles, smashing through barriers, and escaping enemies. Each level brings quick challenges that test your reflexes and help you sharpen your moves. The controls are simple to learn, so you can focus on running.

On a computer, the arrow keys move your runner up, down, left, and right, the spacebar fires your weapon, and Shift activates a boost. On mobile, drag the on-screen joystick to move, tap the fire button to shoot, and tap the boost button to go faster. Your aim is to become the best parkour runner you can be.
dta-6: DTA 6 is a messy, free-form sandbox that runs right in your browser. The only real boundaries are your own creativity and how well you handle your character's limbs. You wander through a strange, dreamlike world populated by ragdolls who spout internet memes. Along the way you can pick up a collection of weapons and cause as much mayhem as you like.

The game throws you into a city that feels completely open to you. Nothing stops you from experimenting, so you can test wild ideas and see what happens. Whether you want to explore quietly or make the whole place a chaotic playground, the choice is yours.
bouncing-bug: Guide a quirky little bug as it bounces around an enclosed room packed with hidden creatures. Your task is to change its course at the right moments so it slips past each threat, while also grabbing glittering valuables and tasty snacks that keep it going. Since the bug moves in a floaty, gravity-defying way, quick reactions are essential.
As you play, you can unlock a range of companions to join your insect. Every attempt tests your reflexes and asks you to plan each bounce carefully, so the challenge stays fresh from start to finish.
save-the-kitten: Furious cat Tom has lured a group of kittens up into his tower, and your job is to rescue as many of them as you can. Run around, beat Tom's attacks back with a trampoline, and carry each kitten down to the basket where mommy kitty waits. The little ones are hoping for your help to get out.

Control the trampoline cat with the arrow keys and help the kittens bounce their way to their mother's basket. Along the way, you can buy new trampolines and sneakers. This single-player arcade game has a retro feel and a cartoon look, mixing casual action and adventure, and it is aimed at kids.
fractal-combat-x: Take the controls of cutting-edge fighter planes in Fractal Combat X, a shooter where quick reflexes and careful planning decide how your air missions unfold above alien worlds. Improve your jet as you go, get good at dodging incoming fire, and jump into intense dogfights that open up new aircraft and abilities. Everything is presented in an immersive three-dimensional environment.
Your goal is to rule the sky through accuracy and firepower. Each mission rewards smart choices, so think ahead about which upgrades and tactics will keep you flying longest.
police-department-3d: You play as a sheriff who turns a jail into a profitable business. Add new blocks, bring on staff, maintain order, and watch your income grow. Every decision affects both security and budget as you aim to become the top name in prison management. You also look after inmates and recruit guards, while earning money through production work and
steal-an-egg-3d: Creep past the guards, snatch eggs, and haul them home to your base. Hatch 141 different pets, grow your collection, raise your speed, and unlock new areas. Play solo or against rival bots, customize your character, and earn optional rewarded bonuses. Your progress saves automatically.

On a computer, walk with WASD or the arrow keys, drag to look around, and jump with Space. Follow the prompts to steal eggs and carry them to safety. On mobile, steer with the virtual stick, slide your finger to look, and tap the action buttons. Hatch eggs at base, collect income, train your speed, and explore farther. Optional reward videos and purchases, such as eggs, speed, coins, and permanent boosts, are found in the shop on supported platforms.
basketball-stars: Basketball Stars is a fast and silly take on the sport, where you take on well-known NBA players. You can go head to head in one-on-one games or team up for two-on-two matches. Want a rival in the same room? Pass the keyboard back and forth with a friend for close-quarters local matches, or face computer-controlled opponents instead. Shooting, stealing the ball, and throwing down slam dunks are all handled from the keyboard, and every move you make helps you claim the win.
speakerman-revenge: Speakerman Revenge is an action clicker where you take on foes from the seat of a toilet. Every tap follows a beat, and that rhythm lets you send out devastating sound waves. Your speakers can be upgraded along the way, making each blast stronger.

Expect a nonstop run of tough obstacles that push your skills. The setting is wonderfully odd, which gives the whole adventure a playful, bizarre feel. Keeping a consistent tempo is the path to victory, so practice your timing and see how far the sound takes you.
in-space: You play as an elite soldier fighting to survive among the stars, where swarms of alien creatures keep coming. Your arsenal includes futuristic weapons, and you battle enemies from a 2D top-down view. Planning your moves matters, and upgrades help you grow stronger over time.

The real challenge is outlasting threats that keep evolving. You must make your way through a starscape full of dangers that seem endless. Keep upgrading, stay determined, and hold out for as long as you can.
battle-simluator-counter-stickman: Counter Stickman drops you into a strategy war where you lead stick-figure soldiers through 3D battlefields. You move across shifting landscapes, make smart tactical moves, and aim carefully with your shots. As you advance, every stage brings a new setting and higher pressure, all set to driving techno music. Your planning is what decides whether you win and bring back peace.
tentrix-blast: TenTrix Blast is a fresh take on the well-known puzzle formula, and it looks great doing it. Your job is to move blocks around by dragging them so they cover the grid, and the more you fit in, the higher your score climbs. Be careful, though: if you run out of room on the board, the round is over.

The HD visuals pull you into the action, and the gameplay is easy to get hooked on. It offers a challenge for players of every age, whether you want a quick session or a longer run of trying to beat your best.
drift-city-car-driving-games: This fast 3D car game is all about sliding your ride around corners. You can drift across race tracks, snowy mountain highways, and city streets. The longer and wider your slide, the more points and coins you collect. Points depend on drift angle and speed, and chaining slides together builds a combo that can reach x5.

The game has 40 levels split into four chapters, named Rookie, Street, Pro, and Kings. Every tenth level is a BOSS lap. You can spend coins on nine cars in the garage, and upgrade Engine, Grip, and Drift up to level 5 each. Other cars share the road with you as live traffic. Use W to gas forward, S to brake or reverse, and A to steer left.
car-eats-car-3d: Car Eats Car 3D is a fast racing title built around demolition fights between cars. You battle alien invaders, work through missions, and take on tough bosses along the way. As you progress, you can unlock new cars, improve their stats, and arm them with strong weapons. Enemies can be smashed, bitten, shot, or wrecked, and you can enjoy the game either online or offline.

Controls are simple. Press the Up arrow or W to accelerate and the Down arrow or S to brake. Use the Left and Right arrows, or A and D, to steer. Space drops bombs, while Left Shift or M activates turbo. Your goal is to prove yourself as the top car battle champion.
chrome-dino-game-original: Chrome Dino Game is an endless side-scrolling runner where you guide a dinosaur through an ever-continuing run. Jump over cacti and duck under pterodactyls as they approach, and keep pushing for a higher score each time you play. The game stays true to the feel of the Chrome T-Rex experience, right in your browser.

Tap Space, the Up Arrow, or the screen to jump, and press Arrow Down to duck under flying pterodactyls. The speed keeps rising the longer you survive. After a crash, you can watch a rewarded video to earn one extra life, then press Space or tap to run again.
commando-gun-shooting: Commando Gun Shooting puts you in a first-person view as a commando on the front line. Every stage is a high-stakes operation full of blasts and close-quarters clashes, and only the most daring soldiers make it through. You can choose from four different battle gun modes, each with its own style of play.

Your objectives change from mission to mission. You might need to eliminate terrorists, defuse a bomb, plant explosives, or rescue hostages. Each task tests your aim, planning, and nerve. All controls work with the mouse, so every button is reached by clicking.
tiles-hop-edm-rush: Tiles Hop: EDM Rush! is a hypercasual HTML5 game where you keep hopping and jumping through an endless run. Music sits at the heart of the experience, and you can upload your own favorite tracks to play along to songs you already love. Everything is controlled with the mouse.
Along the way, you can enjoy the beat as you move, and the game offers special gifts along with music meant for everyone. It suits quick sessions whenever you want some rhythm and motion in your day.
bff-christmas-cookie-challenge: In this holiday game, you take on the role of a princess who competes in merry cookie decorating battles. Your job is to create festive treats, choosing bright colors and unique decorations to make each one stand out. Whether you face a pal or the computer, the winner is decided by how imaginative your designs are and how well you present them.

The mood stays upbeat and cheerful throughout, with a seasonal feel that suits the holidays. Think of it as a sweet contest where your imagination does most of the work. Every cookie is a chance to show off your style and beat your rivals with a treat that looks just right.
3d-acrylic-nail-nail-art-game: Step into a nail studio where you create sleek acrylic nails in vibrant colors. Every visitor arrives with a request of their own, so you need to match their taste. Pick from a wide range of colors, patterns, and nail styles, then add charming accessories to finish each set. Earn money by pleasing your clients, and spend it to help your salon grow into the best nail stylist in town.

Professional tools let you produce detailed nail art, and each customer brings a unique style request to meet. As your business does well, you can refresh the shop with trendy decor, new tools, and extra accessories. Run the salon, keep clients happy, and watch your workspace improve over time.
naughty-baby-prankster: Naughty Baby Prankster sends you on a messy, laugh-filled journey as a little rascal who enjoys wandering through every nook of the home. Ordinary moments can become silly surprises in your hands. Each room is packed with toys, tools, and chances to cause mischief, so there is always something new to find. The game blends comedy, imagination, and a bit of planning, which makes it an entertaining pick for people who like simulation titles with a playful spin.
Controls are simple. On PC, use WASD to move, hold Shift to run, press G to crawl, and hit F to open doors or move forward. On mobile, tap the on-screen button to operate.
my-sugar-factory: In this browser game, you grow a sugar business from nothing. You begin with a single tap and gradually add factories and laboratories to your operation. Research lets you develop fresh sugarcane types, and the goal is to bring in as much money as possible.

Play moves forward in turns, so planning ahead matters. Your income keeps coming in even when you step away from the screen. The whole thing is drawn in charming pixel graphics, and each choice you make shapes how your sweet venture develops.
saguaro: Saguaro puts you in control of a cheerful cactus that zips across a bright Mexican setting. Your job is to keep moving while steering clear of playful balloons that could harm the fashionable accessories you are carrying. Along the way you can grab shining maracas, which bring back items you have misplaced and push your score higher.

Planning your route matters here, since every move counts. The controls are simple to pick up, so the challenge comes from timing and choosing where to go next. It is a fast, cheerful arcade game with plenty of color to take in as you improve.
drink-drive-survive: Drive Survive puts you behind the wheel while impaired, and your job is to weave through a steady stream of disorder. Hazards keep arriving without pause, so your quick reactions get tested constantly. The world on screen has been deliberately warped, which makes every turn feel off-balance. Each new level asks for sharper focus than the last.
Your aim is to stay alive and get past the dangers, but the simulated drunkenness might win out first. Your score depends on how long you can last, so endurance is what counts most.
hoops-the-game: Accuracy and good timing will carry you far in HOOPS. You steer your basketball skillfully through the air, lobbing it from one rim to the next. Shots that go straight in reward you with extra points, so clean throws pay off. Along the way, you can gather coins, which let you unlock eye-catching looks for your ball.

The game is also a challenge for anyone chasing a top score. Each throw gives you a fresh chance to push your total higher, so staying steady and maneuvering with care matters as much as the shot itself.
jewel-magic: Jewel Magic is a match 3 puzzle game where enchanted gems are waiting to be lined up. Your job is to swap neighboring jewels so that three of the same color connect and disappear. Aim for as many points as you can while moving through different levels, and enjoy a calm, relaxing experience along the way.

Matching three or more in a row creates special bombs and earns extra points. If you need a boost, the power-ups you have collected can lend a hand. Keep an eye on your moves and time, because you must reach the point goal before either one runs out.
mr-santa-run-2: Mr Santa Run 2 is a holiday-themed arcade game that sends Santa through a festive world full of obstacles. Your job is to guide him along the way while gathering stars, which add to your score. Sharp reflexes and well-timed movements help you avoid danger and master jumps as you go.
Playing this title calls for careful timing and quick responses throughout. Its seasonal setting gives the whole experience a cheerful holiday feel, making it a lively arcade challenge to try.
rolling-football: Rolling Football is a physics puzzle game where you steer a soccer ball toward the goal net. You arrange ramps, platforms, fans, and other objects to build a route that ends with a goal. As you progress, each stage brings new obstacles that test your reasoning, sense of timing, and problem-solving skills.

The controls are simple, and the physics feel realistic, so every shot looks believable. The levels are both fun and challenging, which should appeal to anyone who enjoys puzzles. The whole game is played with the mouse.
strike-a-pose: Strike a Pose challenges you to bend, stretch, and flex your way past one tricky obstacle after another. Timing is everything: you need to squeeze through tight gaps, avoid pieces of furniture, and collect shiny gems along colorful indoor tracks. Pulling off extreme poses earns you extra points, and the game puts your lightning-fast reflexes to the test.
Steering is simple. On a computer, hold the mouse button and drag left or right. On mobile, swipe left or right instead.
wear-the-helmet: Wear the Helmet is a 2D endless runner where you guide a scooter along dangerous streets. The road never ends, so you must steer around barricades, roadblocks, and open sewer holes as they appear. Everything runs on simple keyboard controls, so the challenge comes from timing and quick reactions.

Before you set off, you choose whether to wear a helmet, which gives your scooter extra bounce, or to ride without one and rely purely on your own skill. Each choice affects how you approach the course. The goal is to see how far you can ride.
babel-tower: Babel Tower puts you in charge of gathering raw materials and turning them into bricks. Your goal is to race ahead and raise the mythical Tower of Babel. Along the way, you refine your setup, choosing which upgrades to pursue and arranging your work so production keeps flowing.

Automation plays a big role in the challenge. By planning carefully and strengthening your operation, you climb higher and aim to reach the heavens faster. The game blends resource management with incremental growth, so each small improvement builds on the one before it.
stickman3d-shooter: Step into the shoes of a stickman equipped with a pistol in this puzzle-driven shooting game. Precision and clever thinking matter most here. Your job is to figure out the right angle, line up each shot carefully, and remove enemies using creative approaches. Every stage raises the difficulty, so your accuracy and problem-solving abilities get pushed further as you progress.
You can play with a mouse or with touch input, whichever suits your device best. Thinking ahead before
football-free-kick: This 3D arcade soccer game is built around free kicks. Swipe up from the ball to shoot: a faster swipe lifts it higher, and a curved swipe bends it around the wall. Your target is the top corner, where a goalkeeper dives to stop you. Seven stadiums, from a park to the moon, bring wind, jumping walls and sharper keepers at every stage.

Scoring fills each stage, and a run of goals builds a streak that earns bonus points. Between stages, pick perks, finish missions and open reward chests to unlock new balls and trails. Try not to run out of balls. Keyboard players aim with the arrow keys, add curve with A and D, and shoot with Space or Enter. Mouse players drag from the ball and release to fire.
worm-hunt-snake-game-io-zone: Worm Hunt brings back the classic snake formula with a fresh, contemporary spin. You guide your worm across vast arenas while trying to get the better of rival players. Grow longer by eating food, and pick up strategic power-ups that help your worm evolve as the match goes on.

Live battles happen in real time, so every move counts when you are up against others. Your performance feeds into the leaderboard, where you can work your way up the rankings and aim for victory. It is a modern take on the retro snake game.
word-search-hidden-words: Word Search: Hidden Words is a puzzle game where you hunt for words hidden among rows of letters. Each level offers endless themed categories that mix fun topics with educational ones, so you can keep searching for hours. Some secret hidden words add more excitement to the search. The game stays simple and classic, and it's easy to enjoy with friends. Fans of trivia, crossword puzzles, or word games like Scrabble, Wordscapes, and Word Cookies may find it hard to put down.

To play, swipe across the grid in any direction, whether up, down, left, right, or diagonally, to find the words you're given. Words you've already swiped can offer clues that help you uncover the hidden ones. Collect six of these secret words to earn bonus coins.
samurai-brawling: Samurai Brawling lets you step into a three-dimensional action adventure as Arashin, a tough Yakuza fighter. Your battles call for careful planning as you face strong opponents who are not easy to beat. As the plot unfolds, you dig up secrets that were buried and follow a story that keeps you guessing.

Along the way you can learn powerful signature techniques and watch your skills grow stronger. The setting is crowded with samurai, ninja, and plenty of scheming, so every corner you turn could bring a new threat. Keep your wits sharp and your blade ready, because victory depends on both.
sonik-run: Sonic the Hedgehog and his friends are back in this new runner game. It is a brand-new release, so fans of the blue hero get a fresh adventure to explore. The game works on both mobile and desktop devices, so you can enjoy it on whichever screen you prefer.

Controls work with either a mouse or touch input. You can play with a computer mouse on a desktop or with your fingers on a phone or tablet, which makes it easy to switch between devices depending on where you are. Sonic and his companions are ready for you to join the run.
robby-climb-and-jump-tower: Your goal is to reach the top of the tallest tower. Powerful wings help you speed up as you climb, and the higher you travel, the more coins you pick up. You can also buy silly pets that gather extra coins for you.

The wings are built for quick ascents, and the cute pets are charming companions. Each tower is steep, and the bright visuals give the whole game a cheerful mood. On a computer, WASD moves your character, the mouse changes the camera view, the spacebar jumps, and Tab or Escape pauses the game. On a phone, use the on-screen interface, tap any spot to move there, and adjust the camera view by touch.
cozy-garden: Cozy Garden invites you to bring worn-down outdoor areas back to life and turn them into warm, inviting spots. Your work starts with clearing rubbish, gathering fallen leaves, tidying up walkways, and fully restoring each zone. Once the ground is clean, you can plant flowers, put together bouquets and arrangements, and pick decorations that suit your taste. Finish jobs to open fresh levels and watch each place change little by little. Between the main tasks, short mini-games challenge your memory, focus, and reaction speed.

To play, pick a level that is open on the map and follow the hints shown on screen. Drag litter into the bin and choose the right tool for each cleaning job. To grow plants, select a seed and carry out the actions displayed. It suits anyone who enjoys creative projects, a calm pace
red-boy-and-blue-girl-forest-adventure: Red Boy and Blue Girl Forest Adventure is a fresh spin on the Fireboy and Watergirl formula, set in a woodland world with cool graphics. This 2D adventure has an arcade feel and is built with HTML5, so it runs right in your browser. Its playful tone makes it a good fit for kids and anyone who enjoys a light, funny challenge.

The game supports two players. The first player moves the red character with the W, A, S and D keys, while the second player guides the blue character with the arrow keys. Team up with a friend and explore the forest together.
strykon: Strykon is a first person shooter made for mobile devices, mixing tactical planning with fast combat. You lead your own forces through firefights that take place across a variety of game modes. Each battle asks you to plan your moves as well as react quickly.

Along the way, you can tweak and improve a large selection of weapons to suit your style. The visuals and audio are designed to look and sound impressive, and the controls are simple to pick up. New challenges keep arriving, so there is always something to tackle next.
ragdoll-mega-dunk: Ragdoll Mega Dunk lets you get creative as you steer wobbly, odd-looking characters through inventive obstacle courses, all aiming for that flawless slam. Your job is to get a feel for the physics and nail your timing so your ragdoll launches high into the air. Along the way, you will need to keep your balance on trampolines and steer clear of barriers standing in your path.

This is a 3D basketball game with a playful twist, and the outcomes are often unpredictable and funny. The mix of silly physics and the goal of a dramatic dunk keeps every attempt feeling different, so each course brings a fresh way to watch your ragdoll fly.
park-the-cars: Park the Cars is a driving game that tests how steady and accurate your steering really is. Each stage is harder than the last, so you'll need to squeeze through narrow gaps, avoid obstacles in your path, and bring your vehicle into its spot with precision. The controls are easy to pick up, so you can focus on lining up your moves instead of wrestling with the keys.

The game looks bright and colorful, and the driving feels grounded, as if you were really behind the wheel. Success comes down to staying calm, taking your time, and practicing until your parking becomes smooth and confident.
vehicle-masters: This minimalist arcade parking game asks you to steer your car through more than 40 levels of rising difficulty. New stages bring narrow lanes, moving barriers, sharp bends, and crowded lots. Avoid walls and obstacles, then stop inside the green zone. Clearing a level unlocks the next one.

Controls stay simple, while the physics feel realistic. On desktop, steer with the arrow keys or WASD, press R for reverse, D for drive, and the spacebar to brake. On mobile, you only steer by tapping the left or right side, and the gears shift automatically for smooth play. Clean visuals and a steady climb in challenge test your precision and patience, making it well suited to quick sessions.
car-eats-car-dungeon-adventure: Race rivals along a busy highway in this 2D driving game, where overtaking enemies is the goal. Design your own vehicle in the incubator, then rise as a car tycoon by upgrading your machines. Your friends have been locked up, so your mission is to free the imprisoned evil cars. Good driving and a tur
wood-blocks-jam: Wood Blocks Jam is a calm brain teaser built around colorful wooden pieces. Each block must be moved into the gate that matches its color, and the aim is to clear the whole board. No clock is ticking, so you can take your time and plan each move. The game includes thousands of handcrafted stages that grow harder as you advance, with new mechanics, obstacles, and challenges appearing along the way.

When you get stuck, three boosters can help. The Saw cuts through troublesome blocks, the Hammer smashes any single block, and Magic removes three random blocks. On a phone, drag blocks with your finger and drop them into the matching gates. On a computer, click and hold the left mouse button to grab a block, then drag it to the correct gate. Suitable for players of all ages, the game blends strategy, color matching, and pleasing visuals into one comfortable package.
ww2-call-of-sniper: You play as a sharp-eyed sniper working alone behind enemy lines in this WW2 title, where every mission is a demanding task you must carry out by yourself. Success depends on pairing careful aim with clever planning as you move through tense, dangerous surroundings. Before each run, you pick the gear you want to bring along.

Your goal is to finish each assignment while staying hidden, so outwitting enemy soldiers matters just as much as your shots. Keep out of sight and stay one step ahead of the opposition. The aim is to complete your orders quietly and avoid being spotted by anyone nearby.
correct-math: Correct Math is a brain-teasing puzzle that puts your addition and subtraction skills to the test. Each question comes with three possible answers, and your job is to tap the one that is right. You only have a brief moment to work out each result, so you need to respond quickly while still being careful. The more correct answers you rack up, the more points you collect.
To begin, just tap the screen. Stay quick and accurate as each new question appears, and keep an eye on your score as you go.
push-noob: Push Noob is a physics-driven adventure where you throw snowballs at sturdy characters and knock them off high perches. Bouncing your shots is the key to earning the most diamonds. The game uses floppy ragdoll movement, so every tumble looks silly and lively.

Expect plenty of laughs as the characters flop around on this pushy journey. The whole experience values dramatic falls far more than keeping anyone in one piece. It's a playful pick for anyone who enjoys watching physics do the work.
delete-part-in-lovestory: This sequel offers a glimpse into the lives and destinies of its characters. Reflect on what is missing from each scene, then add those missing pieces with a single line. When your guess meets their expectations, their unhappiness fades and a smile spreads across your face, while the characters light up with delight.

Begin by studying each image closely to grasp the situation. Every puzzle is a small story or challenge. Work out what is missing or needs uncovering, then rub a section away with your finger. The erased area reveals the hidden answer or fixes the problem. Complete each level to move on to the next. Puzzles grow more creative and tricky as you advance, and each one carries a humorous or surprising twist, so feel free to test different approaches.
friday-night-funkin-vs-garcello: This modded take on Friday Night Funkin sends you into a rhythm showdown with Garcello in a back alley. Three original tracks, Headache, Nerves, and Release, give you plenty of new beats to hit. For the toughest version of the fight, try hard mode. The game also makes it clear that smoking is a bad habit, and you'll pick up that lesson before long.

The game runs smoothly on Chromebooks and works on phones and tablets as well. A recent update made Garcello harder to beat by switching off ghost tapping, so every wrong press counts. You control the action with the arrow keys.
geometry-vibes: Geometry Vibes is a quick-reflex arcade game where obstacles, traps and spikes roll toward you in waves. Your job is to keep your arrow on its route and push the distance as far as you can. Every run calls for fast reactions, and the game is built as a challenge for anyone who enjoys testing their tim
stickman-prison-counter-assault: Stickman Prison Counter Assault puts you in the middle of a messy fight where you pick a team. You can play as a SWAT officer or as one of the prisoners, and the battles take place in 3D with plenty of speed. Controls are kept simple, so your attention can stay on lining up shots, pulling the trigger, and getting around your opponents. Weapons get upgraded automatically as you go, so there is no need to manage that yourself.
Respawns happen quickly, which keeps the action flowing from one moment to the next. If you enjoy shooters where the pace never really lets up, this one keeps things lively from start to finish.
the-aesthetic-world-of-obby: Step into this aesthetic adventure, which draws its inspiration from popular Roblox parkour games. Your aim is to leap across colored platforms and work through parkour maps in a pleasing, stylish setting. The open world contains 10 parkour locations, and the graphics are lovely to look at. There is no traditional leveling system. Instead, each course simply asks for skill and agility.

You can customize your obby avatar with 72 skin options, and the in-game money lets you buy them. The controls are convenient: WASD moves your character, the mouse rotates the camera, Space jumps, and Shift accelerates. Press E to interact and Tab to open customization. The music suits the mood well, though you can progress without sound.
sliding-slide: Sliding Slide is a puzzle game where you rebuild colorful pictures by moving tiles into their correct spots. Boards come in several difficulty levels, so you can start with easier puzzles and move on to harder ones. Each round runs on a timer, so you need to keep your moves quick while still planning where every tile belongs.

Controls are simple: you tap or click tiles to slide them into place. The main challenge is balancing speed with strategy, since a hasty move can cost you time later. Try to beat your previous high scores as you practice. It's a classic-feeling puzzle that stays entertaining from one session to the next.
zumba-mania: Zumba Mania is a puzzle game built around shooting marbles. Your goal is to sharpen your aim and clear every level while earning three stars on each one. The rules are simple to pick up, yet the challenge keeps pulling you back for another round.

Tap to fire your marble at the chain. Line up three or more marbles of the same colour and they vanish from the track. You must destroy every marble in the chain before it reaches the end. Tapping the frog swaps your current marble with the next one, giving you a bit more control over each shot. When the board gets crowded, power-ups can help you clear it faster.
hero-vs-traps: Lead a courageous hero through a run of perilous stages, where a single misstep can send them right into a whirling blade. Expect spinning saws, complicated machinery, sealed doorways, and strange bosses on the route. Every stage sets its own target: find the exit, last until the clock runs out, gather treasure chests, or switch on the objects you need. Finishing these tasks earns crystals, which you can spend in the in-game shop on helpful abilities.
