A speed boost lets the hero move through hazardous zones more quickly, while revival offers another chance after a error.

Controls are simple. Press and hold the left mouse button, or touch the screen, then drag the pointer or your finger toward where you want to go. The hero follows that direction. Let go to bring the hero to a halt. Study how the saws swing and move, then wait for a safe window before you push forward.
cyber-truck-drive-simulator: Cyber Truck Drive Simulator puts you behind the wheel of a recently released car that many people have been talking about. This single-player 3D racing game gives you a unique experience. Realistic physics, sound effects, and an advanced interface work together to make your time with it enjoyable. It also delivers a realistic driving simulation experience.

Your goal is to collect the flags placed across the map while keeping damage to the car as low as possible. You must finish before time runs out. Drive with W, A, S, D or the arrow keys, brake with the Space bar, and press C to switch between different camera angles.
cargo-truck-game: Behind the wheel of a sturdy yellow dump truck, you haul a heavy load of coal along rough off-road routes. The machine is built for tough jobs, so you need to handle it with care as well as speed. Your route crosses dirt trails, soggy mud, and steep mountain slopes, with dense woods on every side and sunrise colors in the sky.

Every delivery depends on smart gear changes, a steady touch on the throttle, and calm steering that keeps the coal secure over bumpy, uneven ground. Use W, A, S, and D or the arrow keys to drive and steer.
pool-shoot-tournament: Pool Shoot Tournament is a free arcade title that mixes careful planning with sharp aim. Your job is to clear colored balls by lining up three or more of the same shade. Every shot tests how steady your aim is, and quick, precise play helps you move up through the ranks. You can play it on a phone or a computer, so it fits either screen.

The goal is to build the highest score you can by firing bubbles at the field. The biggest rewards come from knocking out a large group in one shot, which means planning bounces off the walls as well as straight hits. Keep an eye on the wall of balls creeping down from above. The round ends as soon as one of them touches the bottom.
4-colors-multiplayer: Get ready for a brisk card contest in 4 Colors Multiplayer, where the action rarely slows down. Your task is to pair cards by color or number, and you can also play special action cards to throw off the competition. Challenge friends or computer opponents, and aim to empty your hand before anyone else does.

Keep track of how many cards you have left, because you must say so out loud when only one remains. Think through each turn carefully, since shrewd choices are what let you get ahead of your rivals and finish first.
brain-test-iq-challenge: Brain Test: IQ Challenge is a logic and puzzle game designed to train your mind, and it suits players of all ages. Its brain training challenges focus on pattern recognition, odd-one-out questions, and sequence puzzles. It is a single-player 2D game made for anyone who wants to learn while having fun.

You control it with the mouse on a computer: click and move to play. On mobile devices, simply tap the screen. The puzzles aim to strengthen logical thinking, so each one asks you to study what you see and work out the answer.
millionaire-life: Your life starts out modest, but a lucky break changes everything. After hitting the jackpot and winning the lottery, you're free to chase your biggest wishes and enjoy lavish spending with no second thoughts. This casual game is all about living large and pushing your wealth to outrageous extremes.

Buy flashy cars, luxury mansions, and golden accessories to show the world what you've earned. On desktop, click buttons, menus, and purchase options, then drag objects to unlock items and finish tasks. On mobile, tap items, buttons, and upgrade options, and swipe or drag to collect, move, and place things. Make bold choices, unlock new items, upgrade your lifestyle, and become a symbol of success.
go-kart-racing-game: Go Kart Racing Game puts you behind the wheel of a quick little kart in a fast-moving race series. Battles unfold on shifting courses and demanding terrain, where you dodge hazards, grab rewards, and try to outpace skilled rivals on the way to the championship. Stronger karts unlock as you progress, so you can build a garage of machines and sharpen your driving along the way. Colorful visuals and responsive handling keep the action at high speed.

Press W or the Up arrow to move forward, S or the Down arrow to move back, A or the Left arrow to move left, and D or the Right arrow to move right. Use the mouse to click any button. Smooth controls and action-packed gameplay are built in, so you can enjoy high-speed competition whenever you have a spare moment.
super-oliver-world: Super Oliver World is a platformer where you guide Oliver through dangerous realms full of traps and foes. Hitting blocks can reveal surprises, and you can collect coins along the way. Hidden power-ups are also waiting to be found, and they can help you outsmart your enemies.
The game uses retro pixel graphics and strategic gameplay that rewards careful planning. It is aimed at arcade fans who want thrilling action and unexpected challenges.
hungry-squirrel: You control a lively squirrel moving through green woodland, gathering nuts while steering clear of birds that swoop in to get in the way. The controls are simple to learn, so the game feels approachable from the very first moment.

As time passes, the pace gradually builds, so your reflexes need to keep up. Surviving longer and posting a bigger score are the main aims, giving every run a chance to beat your previous best and climb the rankings. Your mission is to feed that constant appetite for nuts while the difficulty ramps up.
obby-rainbow-parkour-two-player: Leap, dash, and climb past brightly colored parkour hazards in this rainbow-themed obby. You can tackle the courses alone or invite a friend to share the challenge and conquer each tough obstacle course as a team. Every stage asks you to dodge awkward traps, time your precise jumps, and make your way to the finish line.

Player one steers with W, A, S, and D, jumps with SPACE, sprints by holding SHIFT, and shoves with Q. Player two uses the arrow keys to move, L to jump, SHIFT to sprint, and the shove control. Work together with your partner to see whether you can clear every single level.
hit-tank-battle: Take charge of a powerful battle tank in this 3D shooter, which takes place across demanding arenas. Your goal is to take out every opponent on the field, so you will need to plan each move, slip away from incoming shells, and line up accurate shots. Every battle puts your aim, quick reactions, and tactical thinking to the test. The controls are easy to learn, the action moves at a brisk pace, and the tank clashes are intense, which makes it hard to stop after just one more battle.
Drive forward with W and backward with S, then steer left with A and right with D. Hold the Space bar or hold the left mouse button to keep firing without stopping.
chasinghunters: You take on the role of a bounty hunter in a dusty frontier setting, chasing down dangerous criminals across the Wild West. This arcade title keeps the action moving quickly, and your success depends on accurate aim. Every shot counts as you go after wanted outlaws and work to restore order to the frontier.

Along the way, you can boost your weapons, then look for chances to set off explosions that give you the upper hand. Enemies grow tougher as you progress, so you need to think ahead and stay one step in front of them. It is a game built around quick reflexes and clever tactics.
domino-battle: Domino Battle brings the classic tile game back to the screen. You can pick whichever version you prefer, Draw or Block, since both keep the same level of fun. Each player starts with 7 tiles, and the goal is to get rid of your tiles faster than your rival. The person holding the higher tile opens the first round.
A match is made up of several rounds rather than a single one. Points accumulate over
subway-surfers-in-berlin: Berlin 2021 is the 123rd release in the Subway Surfers World Tour lineup and the 110th entry in its World Tour branch. Filed under racing, this 3D adventure has you running as far as you can get. Along the way, you'll need to jump over barriers and dodge whatever lies ahead.

The controls rely on the keyboard. The arrow keys guide your movement, and the space bar activates your skateboard. Your aim is to keep going as far as possible, overcoming obstacles and dodging danger at every turn.
max-speed: Climb behind the wheel of glossy sports cars and speed through three-dimensional courses filled with jumps, stunt sections, and intense battles. Each location brings its own unique challenges. Pull off daring tricks mid-air, upgrade your vehicles, and customize them to suit your style. Short arcade-style races put your skills to the test.

Expect high-speed action and eye-catching visuals, all running right in your web browser. Steer with the arrow keys or WASD: Up or W performs front flips, Down or S performs back flips, and Left or A and Right or D turn the car. Shift or Space activates nitro, and barrel flips are listed alongside the turning keys. To begin, simply click or tap the screen.
cold-impact-rocket-missions: COLD IMPACT: Rocket Missions is a 3D arcade game built around quick repeat runs. You charge a rocket, launch it, and smash through a world you can break apart. Tanks, helicopters and bridges go first, followed by towering Titans and a boss in the abyssal sea. There are two levels. The first is a ground-to-air campaign that ends in a boss fight, and the second is amphibious, sending you diving underwater before you take to the sky again.

Between flights, collect coins and spend them on upgrades for your rocket's wings, reactor and turbo, along with your launcher and cargo, so each run goes farther. After a few flights, a chest opens with a big reward. It's a single-player game. Hold SPACE to charge the launch release and take off, steer with the arrow keys or WASD/ZQSD, and hold SPACE again to boost.
vangers-hd: Vangers HD takes you on a journey across an otherworldly landscape. You fight in vehicles through explosive combat, and between battles you plan how to strengthen your machine. The alien terrain is richly detailed, so every area you cross stands out.

Your missions send you across this world to earn rewards, which you can put toward your vehicle. Each upgrade expands what your ride can do, so the choices you make shape how you handle each fight. This reimagined version revisits a classic, letting longtime fans and newcomers explore its strange universe again.
ladybug-jigsaw-puzzle-collection: Young cartoon fans can enjoy this puzzle game, where they rebuild pictures of a favorite heroine. Lady Bug kept a photo album at home filled with snapshots of her adventures alongside Super-Cat. One day Hawkman broke into her house to hurt his foe and sliced every photo into pieces. Lady Bug is very upset and hopes players can put her memories back together.
The collection includes 12 jigsaw puzzles showing the famous pair, Bug and Super Cat. Players collect the puzzles one by one, and doing so unlocks the rest. The whole game is played with the mouse.
obby-dig-to-the-center-of-the-earth: Grab your drill and start digging straight down through the ground, breaking blocks as you sink deeper and deeper. Each layer of earth is tougher than the one before it and needs stronger upgrades before you can pass through. Collect currency along the way and spend it on better equipment, new tools, and drill upgrades so you can become a more skilled digger.

Hatch pets to earn bigger loot and dig faster, since they boost your rewards and speed up your progress. You can also compete with other players on the leaderboard to see who is the fastest and hardest digger. On PC, use WASD to move, the right mouse button to rotate the camera, and the left button to charge power and interact. On mobile, a joystick moves your character, a button makes you jump, and the sensor rotates the camera.
stickman-archero-fight: Stickman Archero Fight is a 2D fighting game in which every object around you can become a weapon. Its world feels unpredictable, so you never quite know what lies ahead. Instead of charging in blindly, you hold off enemies with careful tactics and clever combat moves. Along the way you can gather power-ups, and you make your way through environments that keep becoming more demanding.

Your goal is to grow into a skilled stickman warrior by coming out on top in the chaos. Every clash rewards planning, so the way you approach each fight shapes how it turns out. It is a 2D adventure built around strategy and making the most of whatever is within reach.
swipy-basketball: In Swipy Basketball, you score by swiping the ball toward the hoop. Accuracy and good timing count for a lot, and you need to read the arc of each throw. The hoops keep moving, so your reflexes get tested as much as your aim.

Every basket you sink adds to your high score, which gives you a reason to keep going. The mix of thrills and that just-one-more feeling keeps each round engaging from start to finish. Shifting targets keep things fresh whenever you think you have the timing figured out.
skyslime-adventures: A clever little slime hops across floating platforms in search of a hidden treasure. Your job is to steer the key toward the chest while putting gravity and the shape of the land to work for you. Along the way, you will get past traps, obstacles, and puzzles built into the surroundings. Each stage tests your reasoning and sense of timing through inventive mechanics.
The bright, colorful world rewards careful looking, so take a moment to study each challenge before you act. Solve every puzzle to help the slime claim its pr
bubble-word-jam: Bubble Word Jam has you pop word bubbles and sort them into categories while you unwind. Tap the bubbles, spot the theme they share, and place each word in its group until the board is clear. Joining two bubbles with related words, such as DOG and CAT, merges them into ANIMALS. You must reach the level goal before your moves run out, and boosters can break obstacles like locks, ice, and screws.
idle-noob-lumberjack: Step into a blocky world as a lumberjack with a lot of drive. Your job is to gather resources, grow your island, and open up new zones along the way. As your crew of workers expands, you handle more and more of the work. This is a laid-back, incremental game, so the more you collect, the stronger your setup becomes.

Plan your moves carefully, put your earnings back into the business, and see your operation grow over time. Each choice you make shapes how fast things progress. It all runs at an easy pace, letting you enjoy the steady climb from humble beginnings to a thriving island.
drone-zero-racing: Pilot a drone through a three-dimensional race across a rain-soaked, neon-lit city at night. You compete against seven rivals on ten floating courses packed with tunnels, jumps, and stormy weather. Along the way, roar over boost pads, fly through turbo rings, and tap the airbrakes when a corner gets tight.

Finish in the top three to open new courses and collect credits. Spend those credits in the hangar on any of eight drones or on upgrades for your ride. If you prefer racing against the clock, Time Trial mode lets you chase your own ghost. Steer and accelerate with the arrow keys or WASD, use Q and E for airbrakes, Space for turbo, V to change the camera, and Esc to pause. Touch buttons are available on mobile.
sniper-attack2: Sniper Attack2 is a modern sniper action game built around accurate shooting and smart tactical choices. You play as an elite marksman taking on high-risk missions in varied locations, including city streets, harbor areas, and desert battlefields. Each mission moves at a quick pace, so you need to take your time with every shot while eliminating enemies and completing your objectives.

Controls are handled entirely with the mouse. Hold down the left button to start aiming, then drag the mouse to move the camera and line up your target. When you are ready, release the left button to fire.
candy-match-saga-2: Candy Match Saga 2 is a match-3 puzzle game set in a bright world full of sweets. You swap colorful candies with their neighbors and line up matches to clear each board. Along the way you will face a variety of tricky obstacles and work through a growing set of levels that open up as you advance.

Explosive power-ups can shake up a tough board and help you chase high scores. Whether you are a longtime fan of candy-themed games or just want something cheerful to pass the time, this sweet puzzler offers plenty to keep you busy.
baby-brainrots-multiplayer-with-friends: Baby Brainrots is a free browser game where you hunt for cute Brenrots. You travel between different islands and play alongside other people online. Along the way you can make new friends, and the game is built for playing together with your buddies.

Your goal is to discover every island and find all of the Brenrots. On a computer, you move with WASD or the arrow keys. On a phone or tablet, tap the screen and a virtual joystick will appear so you can control your character.
mad-day-special: Earth is facing an alien invasion, and your beloved pet Octopus Fluffy needs rescuing before you can escape. Mad Day blends a racing game with alien shooting. Upgrade your car, guns, armor, clothing, and more to defeat the villains.

Behind the wheel, you face alien lasers and blasters, fire your truck's rocket launcher, climb hills, and smash through walls. Then you jump out and run on foot with a shotgun, killing and smashing aliens along the way. Press Space to jump, and use X
offroad-jeep-simulation: Offroad Jeep Simulation is a three-dimensional driving game built around rough terrain. You take the wheel of sturdy four-wheel-drive jeeps and head over rocky peaks, slippery mud tracks, steep slopes, and thick woodland. Each mission asks you to get through tough ground, dodge hazards, and arrive at your goal safely, and doing so earns rewards.
As you progress, you can unlock new vehicles and roam through attractive surroundings. The driving physics feel realistic, so each trip plays out differently. Controls are smoo
galactic-pixel-storm: Galactic Pixel Storm puts you in space battles set in a lively universe made of pixel art. You move through a series of arenas, tracking down pixel foes and wiping them out with explosive rockets. Every target you destroy adds to the chaos you leave behind across the screen.

Along the way, you can upgrade your spaceship and make use of power-ups to gain the upper hand. The game calls for strategy as well as action, so your choices shape how well you handle the cosmic storm. Its goal is to dominate that storm and cause as much pixel mayhem as possible.
popcorn-race-3d: Popcorn Race 3D puts you in control of a single corn kernel that must sprint against the clock. Your path cuts across a set of tracks, where you gather more kernels and turn them into popcorn explosions with the help of dynamic machines.
Success here depends on quick reactions and careful planning. The game offers a variety of levels, and each one asks you to adjust
alpha-guns: Alpha Guns puts you in the role of Max, who gets stronger by upgrading his arsenal. Your weapons are central to the action, and better gear helps you outsmart tough opponents. Each level calls for sharp aim and clever tactics, so every battle asks you to think before you shoot.

If a mission does not go as planned, you can replay earlier missions to refine your strategy. Going back gives you a chance to sharpen your skills and try new approaches. It is a mobile game built around precision, planning, and steady improvement.
pixel-gun-apocalypse-9: Pixel Gun Apocalypse 9 is a blocky shooter where you fight to survive in colorful, pixelated worlds. Battle your friends in multiplayer matches, or jump into offline zombie missions whenever you like. A large arsenal of powerful guns is available, and you'll face waves of zombies that keep coming. Your characters are goofy little blocks, and every match is quick and packed with gunfire.

Simple controls mean you only need a mouse click or a tap to play. The maps come in bright, varied colors, and the shooting rarely stops, so each round feels chaotic and fun from start to finish. Whether you want a short match or a longer run, the game is easy to pick up.
solitaire-klondike-treasure-island: Here is a pleasant way to spend your time that is both useful and enjoyable. Dive into a bright world of pirate adventure to ease tiredness and tension. You become the hero of your own story as you hunt for secrets hidden on faraway islands.

Your task is to build four stacks, one for each suit, each rising from Ace up to King. Seven columns sit on the table, and you move cards among them. Only a King can open an empty column. A card may rest on another if it is the opposite color and one rank lower. Chains of cards that alternate in color and descend in rank can be moved together, which leaves room for clever planning. You can flip through the draw pile as many times as you like, so every choice can be weighed carefully. The round ends once every card has been tidily sorted into its stack.
farming-simulation-game: Step into the boots of a present-day farmer in Farming Simulation Game. You can climb behind the wheel of heavy tractors, work the soil, sow seeds, and bring in your harvest, all while taking on farm missions. Running the property is up to you: keep your operation in order and upgrade your machinery as you go. The setting is a calm countryside, and the realistic farm work is designed to feel grounded.

Each job brings something new to handle, so your skills grow the longer you stick with it. Build up your land step by step into a thriving operation. Controls are smooth, and the 3D scenery makes the fields feel real. To steer and drive the tractor, use W, A, S, D or the arrow keys. It is a relaxed pick for players of any age.
stickman-simulator-final-battle: War is on the way in Stickman Simulator: Final Battle, a fighting game where you pick the troops you want to command and aim to win the battlefield. You can also step into the role of a true hero. The game features 3D stickman troops and levels, and its gameplay follows a tab-style format. Blood and killing are part of the action.

The menu music is War Menu 2 by Maestro Segments. Playing is simple, since the whole game works with just the mouse. It sits in the fighting and simulation categories, and its tags include knight, battle, stickman, and war.
temple-quest: After swiping a sacred relic, you find yourself sprinting for your life through a never-ending labyrinth of ancient temple remains. Gather gold idols, old coins and helpful power-ups as you dash along. Learn to handle the many hazards on your path, boost your power-ups over time, and complete objectives to raise your score multiplier. Each outfit you unlock brings its own special ability, giving you a chance to push further than before.
Keep moving as long as you can, finishing every objective along the way and dodging obstacles, with the aim of posting the highest score you can manage.
little-princess-dress-up: Bring a chibi doll to life in this dress-up game, shaping it with a wide range of customization options. Your wardrobe holds plenty of clothes, accessories, shoes, and dresses, and you can add cute pets to complement each look. Special princess dresses include gowns that give your doll a regal appearance.

Compete against other players in fashion battles where you show off your styling skill, and the top creator takes the win. Snap photos of your dressed-up dolls and store them in your gallery, then share them with friends or keep them as a personal portfolio. Soft, calming soundtracks play along, making the experience relaxing, while the sweet chibi art makes every outfit feel charming.
going-up: In this game, you guide a lone bird through a world built from pixel art. Every tap sends the bird flapping upward, so the controls stay simple throughout. Your job is to dodge obstacles in its path while collecting coins along the way. You can also unlock new skins to change how your bird looks.

Timing is essential, because each tap has to land at just the right moment. The retro look brings back memories of older arcade adventures, yet the challenge stays sharp from start to finish. Its simple controls mix with a strong pull to keep trying again, which makes it hard to put down. Whether the bird makes it home depends entirely on your skill.
zombie-catchers: Zombie Catchers drops you into a world overrun by the undead, where your job is to round up every zombie and protect the planet. Along the way you gather coins and finish missions, and those rewards let you unlock new upgrades. It is a single-player action adventure with shooter and zombie themes.

You can control the game with a keyboard and mouse or with on-screen touch buttons, so you can pick whichever setup suits you. Each mission pushes you a bit further into the invasion, and the upgrades you earn help you keep up with the chaos.
bus-parking-out: This puzzle title blends thinking and planning. You handle three different kinds of buses, and each one comes in one of eight bright shades, so every choice needs some forethought. The scene is drawn in three dimensions, which gives the lot a real sense of depth.

Buses are parked close together, and each vehicle has its own size and its own direction of travel. Your job is to open a route so the chosen bus can leave, while collecting the passengers that match its color. Aim to finish with the most efficient set of moves.
monster-school-challenges: Monster School Challenges is a playful pixel-art game built around Minecraft icons. Friendship and rivalry sit side by side as you guide these characters through offbeat trials that reward working together. The tasks change and grow more varied over time. Point-and-click controls keep things simple, so you can focus on the puzzles.

Along the way, the characters sharpen their abilities and work through silly disagreements between them. Teamwork often produces as many laughs as it does wins. Because the game is light and easy to follow, people of all ages can enjoy it. It suits anyone who likes humorous strategy in a charming pixel world.
shadobirds: Shadobirds puts you in control of a stubborn little bird flying through a world wrapped in shadows. Flight is handled with taps, so timing each tap carefully is the key to staying aloft. Across 20 demanding stages, you will need quick reactions and patience as you weave past hazards on the way to the top tier of players who have finished the journey.

The game is built to feel immersive, with dark surroundings that keep you focused on every move. Each level pushes harder than the last, so expect plenty of trial and error before you get through. If you enjoy games that reward persistence and sharp timing, this one offers a steady test of both.
cat-life-simulator-devil-cat: Step into the paws of a sneaky, mischievous cat in Cat Life Simulator: Devil Cat. This 3D simulation is played from a first-person view, so you watch the chaos unfold through the cat's eyes. The setting is Grandma's house, and your goal is to cause as much trouble as you can and drive her up the wall.

Wander through the rooms, since every one holds things worth messing with. Scratch walls, break items, and knock objects over to build your score, because the bigger the mess, the more points you collect. Keep moving to dodge Granny as she tries to stop your pranks. You can also leap onto tables and push things off shelves, leaving destruction in your wake.
ragdoll-robots-sandbox: Ragdoll Robots: Sandbox is a physics playground built around causing mayhem. You can experiment with floppy ragdoll patients, weapons, and machines, all reacting to wild physics. To add something to the scene, choose an item, then tap the screen or click the left mouse button.

Connect levers and wires to power up doors, conveyors, rocket silos, and fireworks. The patients are unusual animal hospital cases, and you can place as many of them as you like. Run chaotic shifts and see how each setup turns out. It is a silly, funny sandbox with plenty of room to experiment.
santa-wood-cutter: Pull on Santa's boots and put your quick reactions to the test in Santa Wood Cutter. Your job is to chop wood carefully while steering clear of awkward branches that get in the way.

As the pace picks up, you must keep your rhythm steady in this festive challenge that is hard to put down. The aim is to collect as much firewood as possible, and the whole game comes down to how well you swing the axe. Mastering that quick, skilled motion is the heart of it.
police-car-parking-2026: Police Car Parking 2026 puts you behind the wheel of a police cruiser, where careful parking is the whole challenge. You weave through busy city roads, narrow alleyways, and crowded lots, aiming to park with precision. Each level across the game is harder than the last, so your reflexes will be tested as you go. Watch out for obstacles, keep to the traffic rules, and handle these law enforcement vehicles with care.
The game features realistic controls and immersive Unity3D graphics, and it runs in your browser through WebGL. It is designed to be enjoyed by players of every age. Drive the car with the WASD keys.
merge-dragons: Merge Dragons lets you blend dragons together to create new species, which change and grow as they evolve. You keep finding new creatures by carefully combining the ones you already have, and each discovery adds another entry to your dragon guide. Races against the clock earn you rewards along the way. Controls are easy to pick up, and the whimsical setting makes every merge feel playful.

The game is a hypercasual title with a casual tag, so it suits quick sessions as well as longer play. Its charm comes from the steady stream of surprises as you experiment with different pairings. If you enjoy merging and collecting, this one offers a lighthearted way to spend your time.
sea-kings: This pirate naval battle game puts you in command of your own ship as you fight for control of the open sea. Your cannons blast hostile vessels, and stronger weapons can be unlocked as you progress. Your boat has to hold up through wave after wave of fierce fighting, so keeping it improved is essential.

Every clash is a ship-to-ship duel. Pick a target, lock in on it, and keep firing until the enemy ships go under. Real-time battles against rival pirates blend fast action with careful planning. Between fights, you can boost your firepower, armor, speed, and special weapons. Controls work with touch, mouse, or keyboard.
glow-hop: Keep a glowing ball bouncing across floating platforms in this never-ending, colorful run. Landing near the middle of a platform counts as a PERFECT jump, and chaining them together builds your combo. Along the way, gather gems, grab helpful power-ups, and explore bright, varied worlds.

Progress unlocks skins, trails, pets, and upgrades to customize your ball. Daily missions and challenges give you goals to chase, and you will face bosses too, all while going after your best score. Control it with a mouse, keyboard, or touch: move the mouse or drag left and right, use the arrow keys or A and D, or touch and drag on mobile. Aim for platform centers and avoid falling.
football-masters: Football Masters is a sports game built around quick, energetic soccer played from a flat, two-dimensional view. Its matches are short, and the cast is made up of goofy cartoon players who keep the mood light. You can take on a friend or a computer opponent, and each side can call on distinctive supershots to swing a match.

Controls are easy to pick up, so you don't need any real knowledge of the sport to jump in. Games come in small, snappy bursts, which keeps the duels lighthearted and easy to fit into a busy day. The game runs on both PC and mobile devices.
color-shot-throw-the-ball: Color Shot Throw the Ball lets you step into a wide open world where you can meet players from around the globe. It is a casual game you control with a single tap, and it is easy to get hooked on. To reach the top score, you need patience: hold off until the right color appears, then throw the ball. If waiting is
brazen-ball: Brazen Ball puts you in control of a robotic ball that rolls through a two-dimensional world packed with dangerous obstacles. You will face sawblades, lasers, meteor showers, trap gates, spikes, magnets, water, wind, and many more challenges along the route. Your goal is to reach the end marker as quickly as you can while picking up as many orbs as possible.

Controls are simple. Roll left with the Left Arrow key or A, and roll right with the Right Arrow key or D. To jump, press W or the Spacebar. This arcade platformer falls into the 2D, ball, and platform categories, so every roll and jump matters when you are dodging hazards.
snake-warz: Steer your serpent around the arena, eating to get longer and tougher. Other snakes are on the prowl, so dodge their strikes, slip past your opponents, and battle your way to the top spot as the biggest snake around.
Controls are simple: click or tap to play. Keep an eye on the field, because every move counts when rivals are closing in from all sides.
color-pixels-coloring-by-numbers: Color Pixels is a free online game that helps you relax through art. Starting from plain black-and-white pictures, you fill in each section by matching the numbers, and every area gradually takes on color. It works on both desktop computers and touch screens such as phones and tablets, so you can enjoy a calm session anywhere.
To begin, open the gallery, choose a category, and select the picture you like. Zoom in with the slider at the top, a pinch gesture, or your mouse wheel when you need to work on small
anime-couple-dress-up: Anime Couple Dress Up lets you flex your creative side by styling adorable anime pairs. The game offers more than 250 distinct pieces of clothing, so you can combine different looks until you find the right one. Whether your couple is heading out on a date or getting married, you decide how they appear. Everything is free to play, and there are no in-app purchases to worry about.
Build a look, take a snapshot of your favorite result, and enjoy making over your pair however you like.
racing-ball-3d: Racing Ball 3D takes you through three-dimensional landscapes, guiding your ball along tracks full of obstacles and tight turns. Every stretch calls for careful control and quick timing, so your precision and reflexes get a real workout.

The game also includes a two-player mode, letting you face a friend head to head. Speed alone won't get you far, so you'll need to plan ahead and choose your moves wisely. Fast responses and smart decisions are what help you come out on top.
backrooms-exit-protocol-0: Backrooms: Exit Protocol 0 is a horror survival adventure set on Level 0 of the backrooms. You need to find a keycard, solve puzzles, and avoid a monster while you search for a way out. Running is part of the challenge, so stay alert at all times.

On PC, move with W, A, S, D or the arrow keys, jump with Space, run with Shift, and crouch with C. Press E to interact, R to drop an item, and Tab to open the menu. Holding the right mouse button zooms the camera. On mobile, use the joystick to move, and use the on-screen buttons to jump, run, crouch, drop items, and interact. Rotate the camera from the right side of the screen, and open the menu with the button in the top-right corner.
catdoku: CatDoku is a cozy logic puzzle featuring cute, fluffy cats. Place them on the board so that three simple rules hold: exactly one cat per row and column, exactly one per colored zone, and no two cats touching, diagonals included. The rules stay easy, but the levels grow trickier the further you go.

Tap an empty cell to add a cat, and tap it again to remove it. Begin with the rows, columns, or colored zones that have the fewest empty cells left. After each placement, mentally cross out the neighboring cells along with that cat's row, column, and color. Stuck? The hint reveals a correct position. Over 100 levels are waiting to be cleared.
gym-boss: Gym Boss is a casual game that starts you off with basic gear, like push-ups and sit-ups. Tap the screen or click to finish sets and collect strength points. Heavier equipment unlocks as you level up, and tougher gear makes your strength grow faster. Other gym-goers roam the map, and passing them in level brings bonuses, with higher levels offering better rewards. Boosters and upgrades can speed up your progress, and you can unlock outfits for your character. Simple mechanics make it suitable for both mobile and PC.

Ring bosses wait for you in the ring, each one requiring a certain strength level and varying in difficulty. Defeat every boss to earn the title of Gym Boss. Don't stay on light weights, because steady growth is what leads to victory.
wonder-goal-fun-football-kick: Wonder Goal is a football game where you roll the ball toward the net. Dodging the defenders is the main challenge, and a well-placed shot can land a super goal. You only need one finger: swipe across the screen to steer the ball, keep clear of the opposing players, and line up your kick. Dribbling, dodging, and scoring all work together as you play.

Before you start, pick your country from a long list of soccer-star nations and choose the ball you like best. Claim your daily rewards, use power-ups to boost your skills, and collect 2X, 3X, 4X, and 5X rewards. Score and win big to fill your trophy library.
master-of-3-tiles: Master of 3 Tiles is a browser puzzler where your goal is to clear the board by grouping matching tiles in threes. As you move through the levels, the challenge steadily grows, which pushes your strategic thinking further each time you advance.

There is no setup to worry about, so you can start playing right away. The game runs on both desktop and mobile devices, making it easy to enjoy a quick round during a break or settle in for a longer session.
crazy-plane-shooter: Crazy Plane Shooter is an arcade-style game where you pilot a plane through the open sky. Success depends on fast reactions and careful positioning, since both keep you ahead of danger. Your aircraft can be improved over time, and it is flexible enough to suit different play styles. Watch out for incoming enemy fire, and when the moment is right, unleash strong blasts that wipe out hostile forces.
Battles here never really end, so you keep fighting in the air for as long as you can hold out. Your overall goal is to push back the enemies and leave the skies safe again.
dash-and-slash: Dash & Slash puts you in control of a quick stickman ninja who carries a sword. Pick a heading, then fire off a fast dash that cuts down foes before they get a chance to react. Every arena is a brief challenge that rewards careful thinking and quick reactions. Map out your route, dodge hazards, and chain together the right strikes to clear the field.

Controls are simple. On a computer, hold the left mouse button, aim toward where you want to go, and let go to send your hero into a sword dash. On a phone or tablet, swipe across the screen in the direction you want. Line up your hero straight at enemies and steer clear of dangerous obstacles. Expect fast sword attacks, short levels, and plenty of tests of agility and precision.
dino-squad-battle-mission: Dino Squad Battle Mission puts you in the shoes of a lone dinosaur struggling to stay alive. You have to pick your way across rough, dangerous ground while fighting through tense battles that reward careful planning. As you progress, your abilities grow stronger, so you can handle whatever comes next.

The creatures you face are clever, and beating them means thinking a step ahead. Each encounter teaches you something new, and you need to change your approach to get through. Expect a fast, high-energy escape story where every moment keeps the tension high and your dinosaur on the run.
jungle-game: Jungle Game is a retro title where staying alive depends on how quick your reflexes are. You hop over strange, unusual creatures while making your way through a vivid and dangerous jungle. The surroundings grow tougher as you progress, so you need to keep adjusting to new obstacles.

Your agility and sense of timing are pushed to their limits the whole way. The game is hard to put down, and each run invites you to chase a lasting sense of achievement. It is a retro pick for anyone who enjoys a demanding challenge.
tile-valley: Tile Valley is a relaxed matching puzzle built around the feel of Mahjong. Your aim is to gather three identical tiles at a time, clearing them from the board. Victory comes once the entire stack has been emptied, but the run ends if all seven empty slots on your board get filled. There is no clock and no limit on space, so you can take your time through hundreds of levels. Themes cover food, sweets, and shapes, which keeps the scenery fresh as you go.

Each level tests your thinking, and the game doubles as a way to keep your mind sharp while you unwind. When a puzzle gets stubborn, hints and power-ups are there to help you past it. To play, just tap or click a tile to collect it, and match three identical ones to clear them away.
cars-vs-zombies: Cars vs Zombies is an arcade survival game built around driving. You steer your car through arenas, wipe out waves of undead, and smash up the surroundings as you go. Between runs, head to the garage to spend the resources you collect. You can boost your vehicle's stats, bolt on extra armor, and fit boosters. The game includes several maps and different vehicle types to choose from.
Your main objective is to keep moving, gather points, and run down zombies on the road. Control your car with the arrow keys or with WASD.
siren-head-scp-6789-the-hunt-continues: A few months ago, you and your wife believed you had finally escaped Siren Head, but he kept tracking you down. To protect your family and friends, you leave the city and take the fight to him in the mountains. Over five days that feel endless and perilous, you guard your wife and daughters while hunting and trying to survive.

Left-click fires your weapon, and right-click raises your sights or blocks. Use WASD to move, hold Left Shift to sprint, and press Left Ctrl to crouch or X to go prone. Space jumps, F uses an item, R reloads, G throws grenades, and H holsters your weapon.
battle-shot-elite: Battle Shot Elite is a first person shooter where you can join team matches or take on opponents in solo fights. Coordinate tactics with your squad and customize your equipment to suit your playstyle. The ever-shifting battlefields keep each round fresh, and the controls respond smoothly.

Visuals look sharp and detailed throughout, so every match feels polished. Along the way you can gain exclusive rewards, and steady progress can lift you toward legendary standing. Fast-paced action runs through the whole game, making it a high-energy shooter.
shoe-race: Shoe Race sends you sprinting through a chaotic string of silly situations, where good timing and a sharp sense of footwear matter most. Your job is to pick the right shoes for each setup and get through the odd challenges before the clock runs out. Quick decisions keep you moving, and the game manages to teach a few things while still making you laugh.

Expect a mix of style and goofy humor as you race along. Thinking fast is the key, so staying sharp is part of the fun from start to finish. If you enjoy casual games with a playful twist, this one offers a lighthearted dash against the clock.
tower-crush: Tower Crush blends planning with spectacle. You construct towers that you can customize, then send them into battles against rivals. Attach strong weapons to your build and fire off power-ups that hit opponents hard. Meanwhile, you need to protect your own structure from incoming attacks.

As the match goes on, you can upgrade your arsenal and improve the weapons you already have. Planning each attack carefully matters just as much as sheer force. Watching towers collapse is part of the fun, and the whole challenge rests on clever engineering and smart tactics.
flying-grimace: Flying Grimace is a sniper-style shooter where careful aiming and planning matter most. Each round moves quickly and is full of bright colors, so you need to make every shot count against targets that are clever about dodging. Your ammunition is limited, which keeps the pressure up as you choose when to fire.

This colorful arcade adventure asks for as much patience as skill. Expect engaging challenges around every corner, and let your sharp shooting carry you through each one. The action rarely lets up, so stay focused from start to finish.
hex-a-mong: Set in space, this game places you aboard a spaceship where the crew has organized a tournament for some fun. Your task is to keep moving across hexagonal tiles on a three-storey platform that uses artificial gravity. Stop or slow down and you tumble off. Each hexagon you touch vanishes after roughly a second, so you need to keep your feet moving and last as long as you can in the arena.

You get two falls before the game is over, and the third one ends your run. You can compete alone or team up with a friend in two-player mode. Player 1 moves with the WASD keys and jumps with Q, while Player 2 uses the arrow keys and jumps with Space.
jungle-mart: Jungle Mart puts you in charge of a shop in the jungle, with help from cute monkeys, other animals, and assistants. You grow crops, process food, and hire staff to keep things moving. As your market expands, you can upgrade the systems that run it. You also need to keep your workers awake so the shop stays productive.
It is a casual idle farming and market management game with a light, easygoing pace. Your goal is to build a standout jungle market, one harvest, hire, and upgrade at a time.
horse-simulator-3d: Horse Simulator 3D lets you explore a beautiful open-world island on horseback. You can start a family, take on a range of quests, and join fast-paced races against other riders. Your horse can be styled to your liking and trained over time, and you also need to keep your herd safe from danger. Every corner of the island is open for you to roam, and the scenery is easy on the eyes as you ride from place to place.

The game focuses on the bond between you and your animals, with family life, training, and racing all tied together. Whether you prefer a calm ride across the land or a competitive dash to the finish line, there is plenty to keep you busy. It sits in the Adventure category and offers a relaxed yet varied way to spend time with your horses.
flufflings-pocket-pets: Look after a group of stray kittens as you build a warm house and yard for them. Buy toys and decorations to make your space more inviting to visiting felines. Leaving food out draws more cats in, and the more food and toys you provide, the bigger the crowd of furry visitors. Every cat that leaves happy leaves coins behind, so keep them content to earn more.
Put a collar on a cat if you want to adopt it, and it will stay with you permanently. Hold any cat to read about its traits, drop food or water into
gem-clicker: Gem Clicker offers a calm journey built around tapping gems. Every click you make on a gem brings in rewards, so each tap adds to what you collect. As you go, you can plan which upgrades to buy and decide how to shape your progress. Income can also be set to generate on its own, letting your collection grow while you take a break from tapping. The gemstone puzzles get tougher the further you advance, keeping each stage fresh.

This gem-cracking quest keeps changing as you play, so there is always something new to see and do, with endless fun built in. It suits casual players who enjoy a mix of planning and unwinding. If you like steady progress without rushing, this game blends thoughtful decisions with a soothing pace.
dream-room-arrangement-of-objects: Dream Room: Arrangement of Objects is a puzzle game about tidying up and placing things where they belong. Your job is to sort, clean and organize the items in a room so that every object finds its spot. Furniture can be moved next to other pieces, letting you shape the layout however you like and make the space feel cozy.

Controls are easy to pick up. On a computer, hold the left mouse button over an item and drag it to the place where it fits. On a smartphone, press your finger on the item and slide it to a suitable spot. The goal is to put each piece in the correct position inside the room. It is a calm, unhurried experience that suits players of every age and gender.
empire-tower-defense-zombie-fortress: Empire Tower Defense: Zombie Fortress asks you to hold your stronghold against waves of undead attackers. You position skilled archers where they will do the most good, keep a careful eye on your supplies, and plan clever moves to get ahead of the creatures trying to break through. It is a strategy game in the Puzzles category, and it is tagged for players who enjoy thinking ahead.
Every wave pushes harder than the last, so your choices matter from one moment to the next. The goal is simple: keep the fortress standing and stop the zombie horde from overwhelming your defenses.
slime-assembly-endless: Slime Assembly Endless places you in a fantasy world built around element-themed slimes, where you survive and battle through endless waves of monsters. The game is an elemental roguelike survival adventure divided into several themed chapters, so each stretch of the journey looks and feels different.

Expect a blend of survival, roguelike play, and fast-paced progression. Constant chaos keeps the pressure on, while upgrades help you grow stronger as the action goes on. To start, click and drag the Play control. The game sits in the Arcade category and is tagged for battle, endless, fantasy, strategy, and survival.
ellie-summer-spa-beauty-salon: Ellie Summer Spa Beauty Salon is a calm girls' game set by the seaside, where you help Ellie get ready for the summer season. Pick the spa routine level you'd like to try, then follow the instructions that appear on screen. Each beauty-care task has to be done in the right order, so take your time with every step.

You handle spa tools and beauty products with simple tapping, dragging, and swiping. Treatments include cleaning, applying products, rinsing, and styling, and each step must be done carefully before you move on. Finish all the required tasks in a level to open the next spa routine. It's a gentle, soothing experience meant for unwinding while Ellie's glow develops in a sunny room.
your-obby-size: Your Obby Size combines parkour with the ability to change your character's size. You climb, sprint, and leap toward higher platforms while staying clear of lava. Challenges range from easy to extreme, and your goal is to make it to the end. Gather enough trophies to open secret paths, unlock new locations, and earn unique character skins. Monsters stand guard over certain areas, and shortcuts can lead you to the top.

Press Q and E to resize your character, WASD to move, and the spacebar to jump. TAB pauses the game, and Shift frees your cursor. Scroll the mouse wheel to zoom the camera, and hold the right mouse button to rotate it while the cursor is visible. On phones, use the game's on-
guilty-sniper: Guilty Sniper is an arcade game that puts your accuracy and quick reactions to the test. You take on dangerous missions while working against both a clock and a limited supply of bullets. Each mission unfolds across pixel landscapes, and the challenges grow harder as you progress.

Your job is to make the most of what you have. Choose carefully when to shoot, because every wasted round or lost second brings you closer to failure. Keep your aim steady, fire with purpose, and stay alive through the pressure.
floppy-pipe: You control a flying pipe that drifts across the sky while dodging odd-looking chickens. The game takes a familiar style of play and gives it a fresh twist. Each tap keeps your pipe airborne, so the challenge comes from judging exactly when to tap.

Good timing lets you pull off smooth, precise moves as you work toward higher scores. The rhythm of the game and its charming pixel art make every run feel lively. Friendly competition gives you another reason to try for a better result.
rossroads: Crossroads is a single-player puzzle in which you fill every open gap with lines to finish a level. You shift the lines around until their combined value reaches zero, and careful aiming is what gets you there.

As you move through the stages, the puzzles become harder and more interesting, so each new level asks you to rethink your approach. It suits players who enjoy brain teasers and bridge-style challenges. You can control the lines with a finger on a touchscreen or with a mouse.
pondhero: In PondHero, a safe route appears across a pond and then vanishes. Your job is to guide a small frog along that same path using only what you remember. A single misstep means starting the round over. Each stage stretches the route further and makes it trickier, though the reward grows with it. Along the way, you build concentration as well as recall.

The game includes more than 40 hand-built levels, each harder than the last. Controls use a single touch, so the game is easy to learn. Bright pond scenery and a cute frog set the mood. To play, memorize the path, then click the spots in the correct order.
car-crash-sandbox: Car Crash Sandbox is a high-speed crash simulator where you send vehicles rolling down steep slopes and slam them into objects that can be broken apart. Each collision is built to feel heavy, with realistic physics and detailed damage that show cars bending, crumpling, and splitting into pieces. You can pick from several vehicles and watch how each one reacts to impacts.

You can play alone or join online multiplayer. Drive with WASD, use Space for the handbrake and Shift for nitro, and press Tab to pause. N switches to the next car, R repairs your vehicle, C changes the camera view, and V activates slow motion. On mobile devices, the on-screen controls handle everything. Your goal is simple: drive around and smash cars however you like.
cut-it-3d: In Cut It 3D, you slice through the obstacles lined up ahead of you. Every flip has to be timed well, because you want to split each object into two equal halves. Pencils, pipes, anvils, and many other items stand in your way, and your blade is sharp enough to cut through all of them.

The knife must stay airborne the whole time. If it lands on an obstacle with its handle, it can bounce back over, giving you another chance to make a cut. Click the left mouse button or tap the screen on a smartphone to flip the knife, and keep slicing until you reach the end.
slime-jelly-bouncer: Slime Jelly Bouncer puts you in charge of a cute green jelly blob that can only get around by hopping. Aim with your mouse or finger, press and hold to build up power, then let go to send your blob flying. Each level is cleared by touching down on the checkered platform. Along the way you will ricochet off obstacles and skate over icy platforms.

The game offers 50 handmade levels spread across five colourful worlds: Tropical Beach, Ocean Deep, Wild Jungle, Night City, and Outer Space. Landing a single perfect jump earns you three stars. Your challenge is to complete every world and earn the title of true Jelly Master. To play, just click or tap.
mice-hunt: Mice Hunt puts you in control of a nimble owl that must stay ahead of a dragon hot on its tail. The chase never really lets up, so every moment spent running keeps the pressure building behind you.

Your main goal is to catch mice, and each one you grab adds to your remaining lives. Keep collecting and you can work toward a high score. Along the way, you can also pick up potion power-ups, which give you an edge in the race to outpace the dragon.
tribal-zuma: Tribal Zuma takes you to a strange, ancient world of totems, where a curse seems to cling to the land. Your job is to launch marbles and match them up. Whenever three or more identical marbles line up, they vanish from the board.

The curse only lifts once every marble has been cleared, so keep aiming until the last one is gone. Controls are simple: click to play. The game sits in the puzzle category and carries the tags clicker, hypercasual, puzzle, and Zuma.
fruit-merger: Fruit Merger is a colorful game built around joining fruit together. Each time you pair two identical pieces, they blend into a surprising new kind of fruit, and that merging is what keeps you advancing. The puzzles call for planning, since you need to think a few steps ahead while the play area keeps growing larger over time.
The controls are simple to pick up, and the bright, eye-catching visuals make every session pleasant to watch. It is the sort of title that friends will likely enjoy sharing with one another.
build-a-rollercoaster-simulator: In Build a Rollercoaster: Simulator, you design your own coaster creations and then ride them. Track pieces can be purchased, and rare ones can be tracked down too. Your goal is to lay the longest possible routes, then board and travel along the tracks you have placed.

Every ride earns in-game currency, which you can put toward upgrading your tracks. Upgraded tracks help you generate more income as you keep building. Keep building and riding to watch your layouts grow. The title sits within the simulation, tycoon, and
pinball-football-kids: Pinball Football Kids is a game made especially for children. The board is packed with many pins, and a couple of players are there to help you shoot for the goal. The game has been eased so that kids won't find it hard to pick up. You only get a limited number of chances, and you need to score goals to win.

To do well, think carefully before every shot and aim so the ball finds the net. Keep an eye on the pins as you play, since they affect where the ball travels. Each goal brings you closer to victory, so make the most of the chances you have.
home-design-match-3: Home Design - Match 3 mixes puzzle play with room decorating. You swap neighboring items to line up three or more of the same kind, then use special boosters to help you clear tougher boards. Finishing level goals and taking on demanding challenges earns rewards that you can spend on furnishing and styling your space. It runs on whatever device you have.

To play, click with your mouse or tap the screen. Match three or more items, use boosters when you need a push, and work through each level's objectives. As you progress, your home takes shape piece by piece, showing off the look you have built.
the-panda-brother: Panda brothers star in this puzzle game, and they show real kung fu on screen. Your right hand and your left hand are the ones being challenged, so the game tests how well you coordinate both. It carries the hypercasual and puzzle tags, which makes it easy to pick up and quick to start.

Playing is simple: you just click to play. There is no long setup or heavy learning curve in the way. Whether you have a few minutes or want a longer session, the puzzle style keeps your attention on working things out as you go.
green-slaughter: In this shooter set in a wrecked, apocalyptic world, staying alive means fighting off huge groups of monstrous creatures. You play a fearless warrior determined to uncover a conspiracy hidden behind the chaos. Your arsenal can be upgraded as you go, which helps you face foes that grow steadily more powerful.

Getting comfortable with the intricate controls is part of the challenge, so take time to learn them well. Each victory brings you closer to conquering the creatures and saving humanity. Expect relentless, action-packed gameplay from start to finish.
case-opener-case-clicker-simulator: Case Opener puts you on a hunt for Counter-Strike 2 skins, with every click revealing a new one. You can keep the skins to build up your collection or sell them for profit. Improving your luck and your speed leads to larger rewards, so upgrading is part of the fun. The game is bright and colorful, and it also gives you daily bonuses to claim.

This single-player experience is designed to be kid-friendly and built around simple clicking. Whether you are chasing dazzling finds or watching your collection grow, there is plenty to keep you clicking.
from-nerd-to-school-popular: Step into this dress-up and styling game, where you decide how the story unfolds. Your job is to reshape a bookish, overlooked student into someone the whole school notices, moving her from the edge of the crowd to the spotlight.

Controls are simple. Grab a tool and drag it onto the character to finish each beauty treatment. The early levels include a guided tutorial, and as you advance you can roam freely at your own pace. Keep an eye out for glowing spots on her face, since they show where she needs a makeover. Along the way you unlock new cosmetics, hairstyles, and accessories to help her stand out.
one-shot-duel-snipe-hide: One Shot Duel: Snipe Hide blends fast shooting battles with sneaky hide-and-seek play. It suits anyone who likes action titles, and you can run it straight in your web browser with nothing to install. The game also includes a Subway Escape Mode for a different kind of challenge.

On a computer, move with A and D or with WASD, and fire with J or F. Shift crouches, Space jumps, and G drops a bomb. Press R to reload, E to aim, and C to open your bag, then use keys 1 to 4 to pick items. On a phone or tablet, tap the on-screen buttons to control everything.
baby-taylor-stomach-care: Taylor is a girl who loves desserts, and ice cream is her absolute favorite. Today, as soon as she finishes her meal, she hurries to the kitchen to make a tasty bowl of ice cream for herself. After she eats it, though, Taylor begins to feel a stomachache.

You take on the role of a doctor and work with a nurse to treat Taylor's tummy trouble. The game is played by clicking the mouse or tapping the screen, so you can start right away. It is filed under cooking, cleaning, dress up, doctor, food, and educational themes, and it is aimed at girls and babies.
sporty-chic-athleisure: Meet two close friends waiting for you in this dress-up game: Lily and Wolf Fang. Lily is all about water sports and still manages to look chic beside the pool, while Wolf Fang enjoys activities on dry land and likes blending athletic gear with the latest fashion trends. Your job is to act as a personal stylist for the girls, swapping out outfits, hairstyles, makeup and accessories as you go.

Sport and fashion work well together here. You can put together comfortable yet glamorous looks, try out different ideas and show everyone that being athletic can also be stylish. Controls are simple and familiar: click with your mouse or tap the screen to try each new look.
save-the-pets-draw-to-save: A sweet pup finds itself in trouble as a swarm of nasty bees closes in to sting it. Your job is to protect the dog by sketching a line that blocks the attackers. This puzzle mixes drawing with quick reactions, so you will need to think fast and get creative to keep the pooch out of harm's way.

The dog faces more dangers than the bees, including lava, water, spikes, and bombs, so you must plan carefully. Touch the screen and drag to draw your protective line. Keep the dog safe for at least 10 seconds, and remember that a shorter line earns you more stars.
paco-paco: Paco Paco puts you in charge of a ravenous little sphere that must wind its way through 3D mazes full of twists and turns. Your job is to gobble up every pellet along the path while keeping clear of the sharp-witted ghosts chasing it. Their movement patterns are hard to predict, so every corner calls for caution.

Quick reactions and well-timed moves are what keep you going. Clearing a maze opens up fresh stages, and each one ramps up the challenge a notch. Every step carries a sense of urgency, and the goal is to make it through the maze without taking a hit.
my-sweet-candy-outfits: Dress up the Rainbow High girls in candy-inspired outfits for their weekend party. You pick bright colors and patterns, and everything is done with simple point-and-click controls. There is a huge range of clothing choices to try, so you can keep testing new combinations until you land on a sweet look you love. The whole game takes place in a cheerful, colorful setting.

Fashion fans will enjoy mixing and matching pieces to build different styles from one candy-themed collection to the next. Every design you make is shown against a lively, playful background. This game sits in the Girls category and is tagged for Dress Up, so it is a natural pick for anyone who loves creating outfits.
exitblocks-color-match-puzzle: ExitBlocks: Color Match Puzzle is a bright, casual puzzle game set on a crowded board. Your task is to guide every shaped block out through the gate that shares its color, all while working around obstacles and watching the countdown. Levels are compact, the pieces move in a satisfying way, and helpful boosters are ready whenever a layout becomes tricky. Each stage is quick to play yet asks you to think carefully about every move.

On a computer, press the left mouse button on a block and drag it toward its target. On mobile, touch the block and drag it with one finger. Each block that reaches a gate of the same color vanishes from the board, so plan your route to keep pieces from trapping one another. Use boosters when a layout proves difficult. Clear every block before the timer reaches zero to win the level and unlock the next puzzle.
fish-rain: Fish Rain is a fishing game that blends lifelike detail with careful planning. You cast your line in a range of places around the world, and success depends on how well you think ahead. Watching the water closely pays off, since waiting quietly and studying your surroundings can reveal what is happening below the surface.

Choosing the right bait matters, and so does changing your approach for every fish you hope to land. Each catch brings a little excitement and a fresh test of your skill, so the game rewards anyone who enjoys learning the craft of angling step by step. It is a fishing experience built around patience and thinking.
ragdoll-crash-test-throw-and-break: Ragdoll Crash-Test: Throw and Break! blends relaxed puzzle play with physics-driven destruction. Your goal is to wreck a ragdoll stickman inside a simulator built for crashes. Hurl the figure around and watch each impact and tumble turn into a messy scene of breakage. The game follows classic ragdoll physics, so the bodies flop and react in that loose, unpredictable way.

Drag the stickman onto whichever objects you choose, then see how the chaos unfolds. Experimenting with different items is the key, since the aim is to cause as much damage as possible. The selection includes many kinds of objects, and each one has its own properties, so every hit lands with a different force. Work through all the tests to complete the set, and keep smashing and breaking along the way.
geometry-arrow: Guide a small arrow through a cave filled with unusual obstacles and sharp spikes. Your aim is to reach the portal at the far end while still alive. Every hazard you avoid keeps you in the run, so stay alert from the first moment.
The game has 6 levels, and each one is harder than the one before it. From the menu, you can pick any of the 13
helicopter-rescue-games-3d: Step into the cockpit of Helicopter Rescue Games 3D, a rescue simulator where you play as an experienced helicopter pilot. The game centers on one main rescue mode made up of ten demanding levels. Each level gives you a different job, such as pulling injured people to safety, carrying passengers, or responding to emergencies in mountain areas and busy cities.

You steer with an on-screen joystick that moves the craft forward, backward, left, and right, while a slider raises or lowers your altitude. A 1x/2x button changes your flying speed, and you will need to manage your fuel carefully by watching the fuel gauge. The controls feel lifelike, and the smooth 3D graphics bring each setting to life.
skill-driver-game: Skill Driver Game is a racing title that puts your skills, quick reactions, and planning to the test. Its controls feel smooth, and the gameplay draws you in with plenty of challenges to work through. It also brings in adventure and puzzle elements, so you get more than straight driving.

Movement works with either the WASD keys or the arrow keys. W or the Up arrow moves your car forward, S or Down sends it backward, A or Left moves it left, and D or Right moves it right. Use your mouse whenever you need to click a button on screen.
get-on-top-touch: Get On Top Touch is a fierce, competitive multiplayer fighting game. Two characters are linked together, and each player steers one hero in a battle to end up on top. Winning depends on moving your character wisely, since playing at random will almost certainly lose. It is arcade-style and classic in feel, and you can play it on a computer or a mobile device.

Player one jumps with W, moves left with A, and moves right with D. Player two jumps with the up arrow key and moves left with the left arrow key. Each hero is controlled separately, so both players can focus on their own character while the fight for the top continues.
ninja-vs-ragdolls-sharp-knife-throw: Step into a ninja knife-throwing game built around ragdoll physics. You hurl blades at ragdoll stickman foes spread across chaotic levels, solving puzzles and smashing everything around you on a variety of stages. Your precision decides the outcome, since a more accurate throw wins the level faster. To clear a stage, you must defeat every enemy.

Controls are simple. On a PC, aim with the cursor and left-click to send a knife in that direction. On a phone, tap the spot you want, and the blade flies toward your finger. Watch how the enemies move so you can pick the right moment to throw, and try different knife types. The game also offers 3D graphics, leaderboards to compete with other players, and free online play on any device.
robby-double-jump-for-brainrots: Robby: Double Jump for Brainrots is a jumping game where you try to leap higher, travel farther, and gather as many brainrots as you can. Improving your jumps and speed makes each leap stronger and your running quicker, which opens the way to new areas. Be careful, though: if you fall, you have to start over from the beginning.

To progress, catch brainrots and place them on your base, which boosts your speed and jump power so you can reach farther spots. Move with W, A, S, and D, and press Space to jump. Use Pcm to rotate the camera, E to pick up or put down a brainrot, and F to drop one.
runner: Runner is an arcade game built on quick reactions and careful footwork. You guide a hurdler through a series of challenging levels, timing each jump to clear the obstacles in the way. Staying on rhythm is the key to keeping your run going.

Keep a steady pace and do your best to avoid mishaps along the course. With practice, your movements become smoother and more precise, and you learn to refine every small timing decision. If you enjoy fast games that reward good timing, this one offers a lively run that tests whether you can keep the rhythm and finish the course.
fps-sniper-shooting-production-facility: Step into the boots of a skilled military operative in FPS Sniper Shooting: Production Facility, a first person shooter set across dangerous ground. You decide how each encounter unfolds: take patient, quiet shots from long range, or switch to up-close fighting when the situation calls for it. Either way, the goal is to take out every enemy you face.

Moving through the area carefully matters just as much as your aim. You can pick from a range of weapons, and each mission tests your timing and planning. Stay unnoticed, because the foes must never realize you are there. Finish the tough assignments by staying calm and thinking ahead.
hero-defense-king: Hero Defense King puts you in charge of a brave hero whose job is to hold off enemy attacks that keep coming in waves. You guard your tower and must rely on well-timed skills, careful planning, and useful upgrades to get through each harder fight. The aim is simple: keep your stronghold standing no matter what.

Lead your heroes into battle and shield your towers from every invader that tries to break through. Tougher enemies appear as the game goes on, so your plans need to keep up. You can shape your defense by choosing different tower upgrades and switching between heroes to suit the situation.
ben10-omnirush: Ben keeps running nonstop, so you must dodge obstacles and leap across platforms. Along the way, gather as many positions and coins as you can, since they unlock new features for the hero. Each level asks you to reach the goal safely and arrive as soon as possible, at just the right moment. The mission is to protect the world from aliens, monsters, and robots whose only aim is to destroy it.
The game draws on the Ben 10 series, an American animated TV show that aired on C
drag-me-ow: Take control of a nimble cat as it moves through hazardous landscapes built from pixels. Obstacles block the path, so you must dodge them and outwit the dangers ahead by relying on quick reflexes and well-chosen moves. Your mission is to drag yourself across the scene until you reach the comfy cushion that marks the goal.

Every challenge grows trickier as you press on, so the hurdles keep getting harder. Each new turn puts your cleverness and speed to the test. The whole experience is a charming cat adventure that rewards careful timing and sharp thinking.
squard-shooter: Squad Shooter puts you in charge of a team in a shooting adventure where planning, cooperation, and combat ability decide who comes out on top. You move into tense battlefields, guide your squad through risky missions, and take down enemies during intense gunfights. The game falls under the Hypercasual category.

Every mission brings fresh challenges and powerful opponents, along with new chances to prove your shooting expertise. Controls are simple, since you use the mouse to click any button in the game. That single control covers everything you need to interact with the game.
bomber-friends: Bomber Friends drops you into mazes full of explosives, blending puzzle solving, fast action, and planning. Set bombs to break through walls and clear your path, while staying one step ahead of your opponents. Every round tests both your reflexes and your strategy.

You can personalize your character and collect upgrades to grow stronger as you go. The goal is to come out on top. Be careful, though: a careless move can leave you caught in the blast of your own bombs.
the-kitchen-spot-the-differences: "The Kitchen - Spot the Differences" takes you into a lively kitchen where two scenes look nearly identical. Your task is to find the small changes hidden between the pictures. The shifts are subtle, so you will need sharp eyes to catch them all.

Time pressure runs throughout, and you only get a limited number of attempts. Every mistake brings a penalty, so you have to balance careful looking with quick decisions. The game is filed under Memory, and success depends on precision and speed alike.
cut-art-master: Cut Art Master is a bright adventure built around collecting fruit with a knife that flies through the air. As you gather fruit, you gradually level up. Each clean cut brings a real sense of reward, which pushes you to beat your previous score again and again. It sits in the puzzles category and carries the tags adventure, cut, fruits, and slicing.

Playing is simple, since you only need a mouse click or a tap to control the knife. The easy input keeps your attention on the slicing itself. Every run offers another chance to climb higher and improve your results.
worldcup2026: Your goal in this football title is to claim the World Cup by netting striking volleys and free kicks. The group stage reaches its final day, and you must win that match to move on to the knockout rounds. From there, four more victories stand between you and the trophy, and lifting it would bring pride to your nation.
You steer your player with the mouse or by touch, and shots are fired by clicking or lifting your finger. The game sits in the sports category and is tagged with football and soccer.
foot-chinko: Foot Chinko is a soccer game with bright, two-dimensional visuals. Across more than 90 levels, you face quirky opponents, including the Goalkeeper Duck of Evil. Win each match to move on, and collect trophies as you prove your skills.

It is a sports title with an adventure twist, pairing football action with a playful, fun-filled tone. Every new stage brings a fresh challenge to overcome. Fans of simple, colorful soccer games will find plenty here to keep them kicking.
catch-a-fish-obby: Catch a Fish Obby drops you into a bright obstacle course crowded with fish and quirky Brainrot Fish characters. Build a base that produces coins, then slip into rival setups to grab their best catches while guarding your own tank from bots and other players. You can go solo or share one device in 2 Player mode.

Every fish you own earns coins as you roam the map, and how much depends on how rare it is. Spend your coins on stronger or rarer characters, or save up for high-end draws at events and ticket machines aimed at Mythic and Omega fish. Player one moves with WASD, jumps with Space, buys or steals with E, hits with F or left mouse, and sprints with Left Shift
awareness-game-the-robot-bar: Step into a colorful robot nightclub in this memory game built around a short video. You get a brief look at the scene, then must answer detailed trivia questions about what you noticed. It is designed for players with sharp minds who want a serious test of how well they observe.
The challenge rewards quick, attentive players. Those who take in the most detail during the clip are the ones who come out on top.
feed-my-monster: In Feed My Monster, you take charge of a hungry creature and work to feed it and help it grow. Your task is to gather food while dodging obstacles, keeping your monster happy and energized along the way. Controls feel smooth, and the bright, colorful graphics give the whole game a cheerful look.
Classed as a puzzle title, it is a casual, hypercasual pick that players of every age can enjoy. Navigation is simple: use your mouse to click any button in the game.
obby-extreme-cart-ride: Expect constant forward motion, big jumps, and plenty of speed as you race across demanding tracks where careful timing and quick reactions matter. Each section asks you to pick up pace, get through dangerous stretches, and dodge traps while staying on the course. One mistake can cost you the win, which keeps every attempt tense. As you advance, the courses grow harder and the obstacles become harder to predict, with surprising turns, dramatic falls, and fun physics along the way.
