On a computer, use W, A, S, and D to move, Space to jump, and hold the right mouse button while moving the mouse to control the camera. On mobile, the left joystick moves your character, an on-screen button makes you jump, and the right side of the screen controls the camera. Every level offers new ways to reach the finish. The game is simple to pick up, but it takes practice to master.
mystery-of-the-old-house-hidden-objects: Mystery of the Old House: Hidden Objects is an adventure game in which every item you locate moves you a step closer to the answer. You wander through aged chambers filled with antiques and things that have long been forgotten. Puzzles and a point-and-click style of play add to the challenge, and the secrets tucked into each corner are waiting to be revealed.

In each room, your task is to spot the objects on the list, whose names appear along the bottom of the screen. If you get stuck, hints are there to help you along. Take your time and play slowly, since there is no need to rush through the search.
giant-snowball-rush: In this 3D adventure, you guide a snowball through a race toward the finish line. As you keep rolling, the snowball swells into a bigger and bigger ball, which makes it harder to steer. Along the way you must dodge a variety of obstacles while collecting as many gold coins and props as you can.
Controls are simple: tap and hold to move. Staying nimble matters, because the larger your snowball becomes, the trickier it is to control.
funny-throat-surgery: Funny Throat Surgery takes you into a playful, quirky version of dental care. Your job is to clean and scrub teeth and to track down pesky germs. Along the way, you can get creative and dress up the patient however you like, since the styling options seem almost limitless.
The game puts your dental know-how to the test while giving you plenty of room to design things your own way. Its charming style and lots of
street-ball-jam: Step onto the court as a basketball star in Street Ball Jam, where simple tap-and-hold controls are all it takes to get going. Time your shots to chase high scores, and unlock bonuses and crystals as you progress through the game.

The pace is quick, so every throw counts. Sharpen your skills, take charge of the court, and work your way toward MVP status. The game runs on any device, so this hard-to-put-down basketball challenge is ready whenever you want a match.
stickman-fighter-mega-brawl: Stick figure clashes never seem to stop in this action title. Quick thinking and fast responses count for a lot, since you need to stay in step with the flow of each fight. Enemies press in from two directions at once, so guarding both sides is essential. Learning the beat of the battle helps you hold your ground.

Along the way, you can gather power-ups and add upgrades, and using them carefully makes a real difference. Each skillful fight brings bigger rewards, so precise play pays off. Your goal is to keep conquering levels one after another.
my-phone-store: My Phone Store puts you in charge of building and selling gadgets. You make smartphones, laptops, and tablets, then sell them to shoppers who visit your shop. As your store grows, you can speed up production, collect more cash, and turn a modest storefront into a thriving electronics company. The game is light and relaxed, but it's easy to keep coming back to see how far you can go.

Your goals are to keep the money flowing, improve what your workshop can produce, and expand your business over time. Upgrades let you boost your store and add room for more work. On a computer, use the WASD keys or your mouse to move around and interact. On a phone, just tap the screen with your finger.
stickman-kart-hero: Stickman Kart Hero is a free physics game in which you fling your cart as far as you can while trying to keep your stickman alive. It's a bit like seeing how long you can last on a grocery run without falling apart, only with more fun and a lot more chaos.

You play with the mouse and the on-screen buttons. Each attempt is about launching the cart and seeing how far you can go before your little hero dies. The game leans into a funny, playful mood, with jumping, running, and fighting woven into the action.
robby-escape-the-rooms: Robby: Escape The Rooms takes you through 50 rooms, and each one hands you its own set of tasks. Expect puzzles, mini-obby runs, and hidden objects to track down. Every room brings a new adventure with special challenges. The clock keeps running and the puzzles grow harder as you progress, so you need to solve every one to get out a winner.

On a computer, move with the W, A, S, and D keys and jump with the Space Bar. Hold the right mouse button to adjust the camera view, and press Tab or Escape to pause. On a phone, use the game interface to control your character, move to any location, and change the camera view.
mineclicker: MineClicker drops you into a world built from blocks, where each tap you make fights off mobs and gathers materials. You can spend your earnings on upgrades and bring in helpers to take on tougher levels one after another. Boss fights run against a countdown, so you need to squeeze out as much gain as you can before you move forward to collect bigger rewards.
The game blends planning, idle progress, and quick clicking into one experience. Expect to balance your choices carefully while your helpers keep working in the background.
stickman-blast-puzzle: Stickman Blast Puzzle is a puzzle title where you launch palm blasts and gather them as you go. It's a clicker at heart, with a wild, energetic feel where every tap drives the action. Your job is to wipe out enemies while building a large collection of skins, hundreds in total.
Be warned that once you begin, you may find it very hard to stop. To get started, tap the red item on screen, then see how many skins you can add to your collection.
worm-puzzle-snake-apple: Worm Puzzle: Snake Apple blends the feel of classic snake with inventive puzzle tasks. You work through spatial problems, find your way out of traps, and steer snakes through clever levels. The snakes wiggle in silly ways and react to things playfully, which gives the game a strongly comical mood, while the puzzles still ask you to think carefully.

Casual players will likely enjoy the laid-back pace, and puzzle fans can dig into the deep level design. The whole experience flows in a calming way, and every stage brings a surprising twist. On PC, use the arrow keys or drag to move. On mobile, click the on-screen button to operate.
quizmania-trivia-game: Quizmania is a trivia puzzler that tests your knowledge across a series of stages. Each stage presents questions drawn from a wide mix of subjects, and every one comes with four possible answers, so you simply pick the one you believe is correct. Smart use of hints can point you in the right direction when a question stumps you.

As you advance, the questions grow harder, making each round more demanding than the last. A progress bar fills while you play, and it lets you unlock clues that you can save up and use on upcoming questions. Keep an eye on that bar and plan when to use your help.
the-biggest-number: The Biggest Number is a quick 3D runner that mixes arcade action with light math. Your number can rise fast, but one wrong move can bring your run to an abrupt end. Grab numbers that are equal to or below your own, and steer clear of the bigger red ones, spinning saws, gaps, and traps along the way.

Pick your gates wisely. Addition and multiplication boost your value, while subtraction and division pull it down. Shields and magnets help you stay alive and collect useful numbers, and coins earned during play let you raise your starting number and income. Along the track you will find colorful levels, achievements, leaderboards, and a finish where you crash through walls.
super-buddy-kick-2: Super Buddy Kick 2 is an arcade title built for letting off steam in a silly, offbeat way. You pick from a wide set of weapons and gadgets and aim them at Buddyman, the target of your attacks. Once you have knocked him out, he pops back up so you can go again. The whole idea is to have a single figure to vent your frustration on, with no real harm done. Playing is simple: use your mouse on a computer, or your finger on a phone or tablet.
steel-advance: You take control of an M4 Sherman tank during World War II. Your goal is to wipe out German Panzer barracks while holding off a heavy armored assault aimed at your own base. Shove sandbags into place to form cover that soaks up incoming shells, and use the surroundings to put together your own defenses.

Choose your route carefully, because becoming boxed in by sandbags leaves your tank unable to move. That counts as a failed mission, and the only way back in is to press F5 to reload the page and send your M4 out again. You lose if your tank is destroyed, your base is flattened, or you become trapped. Use W, A, S and D to move, and right click to fire.
heroes-inc: Heroes Inc! lets you build a team of technology-enhanced heroes and send them into tactical clashes in a futuristic world of stickmen. You direct your forces with clicks or taps, improve your heroes as you go, and find clever ways to overcome peculiar enemies.

Every battle rewards careful planning and creative thinking, because your choices shape how each engagement unfolds. Combat is the core of the experience, and your strategy determines the path you take. Whether you prefer a precise plan or an unusual approach, your decisions guide you toward victory.
puzzlebot: Puzzlebot gives you seven jigsaw puzzles to assemble, each built around a striking image that gradually comes into view. The game offers three difficulty tiers, so the challenge can range from relaxed to demanding depending on your choice. A timer keeps the pressure on, and you can use hints whenever you get stuck.

Whether you are new to jigsaws or have solved plenty before, this title should suit you. Speed and planning both matter here, so you will need to decide how to tackle each board while racing the clock. Working through all seven images is a good way to test your approach and see how your strategy shifts from one puzzle to the next.
online-car-destruction-simulator-3d: Take the wheel in this free 3D game built around realistic vehicle crashes. Smash through demolition chaos in immersive settings, driving a variety of cars with intricate damage effects. Jump into thrilling multiplayer action with other players, and play on either a phone or a computer.

Steer with W, A, S and D, use Spacebar for the handbrake and Shift for nitro. Press TAB or Escape to open the pause menu, C to change the camera and U for a free camera. R resets your car, K restores it, B slows down time, and N switches to a different car. On mobile, use the game interface instead. The goal is simply to drive and crash cars however you like.
mega-parkour-obby-escape-run: Mega Parkour: Obby Escape Run mixes parkour jumping with obby-style obstacle courses inside a bright, interactive world. Running and leaping across a range of maps and platforms, including the prison tower, you will be tested on your agility from start to finish. The controls are simple, so getting into the action takes little time, and learning to pull off your parkour moves is part of the appeal.
parmesan-partisan-deluxe: In Parmesan Partisan Deluxe, you take on the role of the only guardian standing against a constant wave of Mice People. Your job is to hold your ground using an unusual set of weapons. The challenge grows as you move through ten levels, so each stage asks more from you than the last.

Staying alive during this rodent uprising depends on fast reactions and on knowing when to switch between your weapons. Choose wisely, because the right swap at the right moment can make the difference. The game gives a cheesy twist to a tense defense.
drift-car-driving: Drift Car Driving puts you behind the wheel for fast highway runs where high speeds, lifelike car handling, and tough drifting tests all matter. The controls feel smooth, the 3D visuals look sharp, and there is plenty to keep you busy for a long session. It suits anyone who enjoys car, racing, drifting, or driving simulator games. You pilot powerful sports cars through crowded highways packed with other traffic.

Steering uses W or the Up Arrow to move forward, S or the Down Arrow to move back, and A or Left Arrow to move left, with D or Right Arrow to move right. Any button on screen can be clicked with the mouse.
little-cute-summer-fairies-puzzle: Little Cute Summer Fairies Puzzle is a jigsaw game with a dreamy, fairy-filled theme. Your job is to put together pictures of fairies, and the puzzles get harder as you go. Keep an eye on the timer, because you are working against the clock the whole time. The controls are easy to pick up, and the graphics are charming to look at.
Each piece you snap into its correct spot brings a bit of calm along with a small thrill. It is a good pick for anyone who enjoys gentle, colorful puzzles that still keep you on your toes.
mystery-squishy-dumpling-blind-box: Mystery Squishy Dumpling Blind Box is a charming collecting title built around surprise boxes, soft squishy toys and scarce dumplings. You pick one of four box types and open it to receive a random squishy dumpling. Every dumpling belongs to a rarity tier, so some are common, some are rare, some sit in an upper tier, and a few are highly valuable.

The more boxes you open, the better your chances of meeting new adorable characters and filling each empty slot in your collection. Compare your finds by rarity, keep hunting for the scarcer ones, and work toward a complete set. It's a simple, calm and satisfying experience for fans of blind box toys, squishy fidgets, surprise unboxing, ASMR toys and collectible characters.
chickz-stack: This arcade game sends flying chickens into the sky, and you build a tower of them by tapping the screen. A taller stack makes it easier to get past walls, traps, and enemies, so keep stacking as you move through colorful levels that grow more demanding. Collect coins to unlock new flying chickens, and explore fresh worlds along the way.

Controls use simple one-tap input and the pace is fast, so the game is easy to pick up but takes practice to master. Try to beat high scores and compete with others. Collect three perfects to activate a special skill that can help you through tough spots.
frontline-assault-battleground-fire-max-: Frontline Assault: Battleground Fire Max Shooting is a first person shooter built around tactical combat. You go it alone across demanding terrain, where the goal is to get the better of enemies through clever movement and accurate firing. Moving quietly, aiming carefully, and planning each step all matter as you push through dangerous surroundings.

Mastering surprise attacks is a central part of the experience, and it leads to powerful rewards you can unlock. Staying alive here comes down to sharp instincts and strategic skill, so think before you act and stay one step ahead of the opposition.
motocross-racing: Motocross Racing puts you on a dirt bike for a rough, off-road ride with unusual characters and bold stunts. The riders you meet are goofy and unpredictable, and the whole game has a playful, offbeat feel that sets it apart from more serious racers. Your goal is to speed across demanding tracks and reach the finish line first.

Along the way you can learn a range of eye-catching tricks, pulling off bold moves while the dirt flies around you. The courses are tough, so every run is a real test of your skills. Expect plenty of lively action and odd surprises that keep each race entertaining from start to finish.
toss-the-ring: Toss The Ring puts your aim to the test in this hypercasual ring-toss challenge. Simple throwing mechanics grow into a skill-based arcade adventure. Each level introduces new surprises, so the gameplay feels both relaxing and thrilling. The colorful look makes it a good fit for fans of casual and relaxation games.

To play, click and drag. Thanks to the simple one-tap mechanics, anyone can start right away. Its tags include fun, relaxation, and shooter, so it suits players looking for a light way to test their aim.
build-your-zombie-horde: Build Your Zombie Horde puts you in charge of an army of undead. Your job is to summon your horde, defeat enemies, collect resources along the way, and upgrade your forces until you conquer new lands. It is a simple strategy autobattler that keeps the focus on building up your army.

On a phone, tap any spot on the screen to summon a zombie, press and drag a finger to move the camera, and pinch with two fingers to zoom in or out of the battlefield. On a computer, click with any mouse button to summon a zombie, hold a mouse button and move the cursor to shift the camera, and press P to pause.
two-cups: Two Cups is a side-scrolling adventure set in a colorful world drawn in pixel art. You can run, jump, and slide your way through it. The story centers on a friendly rescue: you need to free Cupgirl from a sneaky cat. Along the way you cross a variety of terrains, collect her scattered pieces, and get past both traps and foes. The game has a warm, sincere tone, and each step you take carries weight as you work toward your goal.
battle-simulator-stickman-zombie: Battle Simulator Stickman Zombie puts you in command of a skilled stickman warrior who must hold off zombie hordes that keep coming. Master strategic maneuvers, since careful planning matters as much as the fight itself. You can wield an arsenal of weapons that become stronger through upgrades. The clashes take place in intense 3D battles.

Survival is the goal, and every choice you make helps you last longer. Think ahead, adjust your approach, and keep pushing through each clash. The whole fight is a struggle to save humanity from the undead.
war-robot-earth-survival: War Robot Earth Survival is a tactical online shooter built around walking battle robots. You pilot a massive mech that weighs many tons and carries some of the most powerful weapons around, crushing and destroying everything in your path. Matches pit you against players from around the world in intense PvP battles. Humanity has built huge war machines called mechwarriors, and here you get to step inside one.

Team up with friends, form a clan, and join clan battles for control of the planet. As you progress, you can unlock new weapons, robots, and areas, growing tougher with every fight. Support your teammates on the battlefield and work toward becoming a leading player among free robot games. The controls are simple: WASD to move, the mouse to shoot, and ESC to open the menu. More detailed instructions appear once you start the game.
idle-game-dev-simulator: Idle Game Dev Simulator starts you off with a cramped garage and a single old laptop, and your job is to grow that into a large, respected game studio. It is an idle tycoon game built around clicking, so every tap moves your projects forward, though some will end up as failures. You can combine genres, pick themes, and choose platforms to test out different recipes for a successful release. Along the way you hire staff, research newer technologies, and add rooms and features as your office gets bigger.

Production runs on its own once you set things up, letting you automate work and speed up output. To begin a new project, tap the middle of the room and the action menu will appear. The Research tab opens new content and raises your creative output, while the panel on the right holds upgrades that improve efficiency and production speed. Keep an eye on reviews and ratings, since they show how your studio is doing as you work toward becoming a respected name in game development.
fnf-red-light-green-light: FNF: Red Light, Green Light mixes the first round of Squid Game, the game known as Red Light, Green Light, with a lineup of today's most popular characters. Boyfriend and Garcello are among the familiar faces you will meet, along with many others. It is a single-player 3D shooting title that also includes action and simulator elements.

You can control the action with W, A, S and D, the arrow keys, the mouse, or a touchscreen, so pick whichever feels most comfortable. The game is tagged with blood, and it is available for Android devices.
poop-away: Poop Away is a single-player puzzle game built on physics. Your job is to launch a projectile toward the toilet and land accurate shots to clear each stage. Angle, timing, and momentum all matter as you work around obstacles, and the levels grow more challenging as you move through them. It suits players who enjoy casual, skill-based arcade games.

Controls are simple. On a computer, click and drag to aim, then release to launch. On a phone or tablet, tap and drag in the same way, and let go to send your shot. A single click or tap is all it takes to get started.
drive-crazy: Drive Crazy is a racing game set on wild, unpredictable courses. Each race asks you to make quick choices and keep your timing sharp. As you go, you can improve your car so it can handle a wide range of hazards. Drifting through corners is a big part of the fun, and winning takes careful planning. Every run gives you a chance to refine your approach and push harder.

The game delivers fast, heart-racing action from start to finish. It is a great pick for anyone who enjoys adventure driving with a bit of strategy mixed in. Get ready for a memorable ride full of tight turns, tricky obstacles, and plenty of chances to test your nerve.
the-mad-cow: Dasha is a cow who has suddenly lost her temper and decided to leave home. She charges into the city and begins wrecking whatever she finds. Your job is to smash everything in sight. Knock down buildings with your horns or weapons, rack up points as you go, and switch to a helicopter or a car when you want a different ride. Keep an eye out, because the police are going to come after you.

The keyboard controls are simple. Use A, W, S and D to move, the space bar to jump, and the A button to attack with your horns or fire your weapons. Hold Shift to accelerate and press T to pick up objects. On mobile, a joystick sits on screen alongside pop-up buttons for the same actions.
colorturntable: ColorTurntable is a puzzle game with vivid, fresh colors that make every screen pleasant to look at. Its controls are easy to pick up, and the gameplay stays lively from start to finish. Playing it is a good way to put your eyesight and hand speed to the test. You can also challenge friends and see who comes out on top.

Getting started takes just one click, so you can dive straight into the action. The operation is simple, and the fun arrives right away. Gather your friends and see who can keep up with you as you test your sight and speed side by side.
funny-shooter-destroy-all-enemies: Hold your ground against a wacky swarm of AI opponents who move in odd, silly ways. You'll roam a lively 3D arena and switch between a varied set of weapons as you go. Every wave throws up new oddities and hurdles, so expect to smile at the strangeness. Change your approach whenever needed and soak in the delightful mayhem around you.
gokart-rush: Racers hit the track in this kart game, where items are a big part of the fun. Grab the question boxes to collect weapons: rockets to fire ahead, oil to leave behind, bombs to lob, or thunder to strike the kart in front of you. Sliding through corners builds a turbo boost, and nitro gives you extra speed when you need it. Timing counts too, since a well-judged rocket start is possible when the lights turn green.

The course list includes 12 stages spread across 4 cups. You can chase your best lap in Time Trial, racing against a ghost of an earlier run, or switch to Eliminator. Earn coins as you go and spend them in the garage on faster karts. Steer with the arrow keys or A and D, press Space for nitro, hold Down to drift, and tap Up or E to use an item. P pauses the game, and gamepad and touch controls are supported.
hole-eats-all-eat-them-all: In this 3D casual arcade game, you steer a famished hole across bright, colorful stages and swallow everything within reach. Start with the smaller objects, then grow larger so you can take in the bigger ones that appear as you expand. Each stage asks you to collect the required objects before the timer runs out.

On desktop, move with W, A, S, D or the arrow keys. On mobile, drag the on-screen joystick in any direction. Challenging levels can be completed with the help of upgrades and boosters, which you unlock as you progress. Tagged as arcade, 3D, and io, it is a simple game for quick rounds of eating.
robby-the-speed-maze: Robby: The Speed Maze is an obby game built around mazes, where you dodge monsters while getting past traps and obstacles. Before you enter the winding courses, you can train on super-simulators in the lobby to build up your speed and stamina. Coins you collect let you buy upgrades, and the pets you purchase give you bonuses. A system of improvements and rebirths adds another layer to your progress.

On a computer, move with WASD, look around with the mouse, and press Space to jump. Tab or Escape pauses the game. On a phone, use the on-screen interface to play, move to any location you choose, and adjust the camera view.
noob-playground: Noob Playground is a playful sandbox where anything goes and creative mayhem is the main attraction. You can call in crash-test dummies and use a big collection of wrecking toys to see what happens. There are no missions or deadlines, so you can keep testing ideas for as long as you like. Each visit feels fresh, since the colorful world gives you room to try something new every time you play.
airplane-flight-manager-game: Take off from one airport and bring your plane down safely at another in this 3D flight simulation game. You sit in the pilot's seat, handle powerful aircraft, and fly up through the clouds to see the sky around you. Missions guide each trip toward its destination, and the open world leaves plenty of room to roam.

The controls are simple. Press W or the up arrow to move forward, S or the down arrow to move back, A or the left arrow to shift left, and D or the right arrow to shift right. Buttons are selected with the mouse. Combined with easy handling and a pleasant environment, each flight feels new.
my-army-base: Mix running a military base with building up troops and taking over land in this war-themed tycoon title. You begin by drilling your soldiers so their fighting skills grow stronger. Gear them with superior weapons and boost their stats as you go. Your camp can be expanded piece by piece, which lets you recruit a bigger force.

Head into tactical clashes against opposing units and seize hostile zones to widen your hold over the map. Keep an eye on your supplies so your campaigns stay funded. The goal is to win the conflict and defend America from threats. Movement is handled with the W, A, S, and D keys, and the mouse.
box-roller: Box Roller asks you to guide a wooden box as it rolls across uneven ground, aiming to drop it precisely into the target hole. Every stage calls for working out which way to head next and timing each move carefully, since a wrong step can send the box off its path. The rules are easy to pick up, but the puzzles grow tougher as you go, and the game becomes more and more hard to put down. Clearing a stage brings a real feeling of accomplishment.
Use the W, A, S and D keys or the arrow keys to move the box in each direction.
k-pop-demon-hunter-fashion: K-Pop Demon Hunter Fashion is a dress up game that mixes bright K-Pop style with a gothic, demon-hunting mood. You dress glamorous idols in daring K-Pop looks, then blend in dark, fantasy-themed pieces. Leather jackets, studded boots, neon hair, glowing makeup, and magical accessories all help you build striking, otherworldly outfits.

Go for a chic idol style or a fierce warrior look, and try out as many combinations as you like. The game is aimed at fans of K-Pop, fantasy fashion, and creative dress-up play. On desktop, left-click to pick outfits and accessories. On mobile, simply tap to make your selections.
car-parking-simulator-3: Car Parking Simulator 3 is a driving puzzle that is hard to stop playing. You can take on tough stages or focus on sharpening your parking skills, and several modes are available to begin with. Vehicles range from small compact cars to large heavy-duty trucks, so each stage brings a different handling challenge. Stages grow harder as you move forward, and every win feels earned.
Controls are simple. On a computer, use the WASD keys to drive. On a phone or tablet, tap the buttons shown on screen to steer and operate the vehicle.
warfare-1942-online-shooter: Warfare 1942 - Online Shooter throws you into the middle of World War II. Battles move quickly, and you need to mix careful planning with fast reactions to come out on top. You can outfit your soldier to suit your style, then push to capture important positions and win across several game modes. The odds are often stacked against you, so clever tactics matter as much as firepower. Over time you can earn a reputation as a true hero on fronts that keep changing around you.
highway-car-racer: Highway Car Racer puts you in the driver's seat for a rush of speed and quick decisions. The game tests how sharp your reflexes are, how fast you can go, and how well you handle a car. You take control of strong vehicles and weave through crowded highways packed with other traffic and obstacles. Filed under adventure, it blends casual play with drifting and racing.

The longer you keep driving, the higher your score climbs and the bigger your rewards become. Steer with W or the Up Arrow to move forward, S or the Down Arrow to move back, A or the Left Arrow to move left, and D or the Right Arrow to move right. Use your mouse to click any button.
football-wars: Picture a game of football where nobody blows the whistle and plenty of weapons are in play. You choose a hero, aim for the goal, and knock out any rival who blocks your way in fast online team matches. Coins and gems come in as you play, and they help you unlock new heroes and skins. You can also climb the ranked ladder and level up the season battlepass.

Movement uses WASD, and the mouse controls where you look. Left click kicks the ball, right click passes it, E tackles, and Shift sprints. From the lobby, buttons open the shop, the heroes screen, and the battlepass. On phones, a joystick and on-screen buttons take over these controls.
solitaire-emperor-secrets-of-fate: Step into a solitaire adventure built around Tarot cards. Every level presents its own mix of cards, and each one brings different mechanics into play, so no two stages play the same way.

To finish a stage, clear every card from the table. Cards leave the field in a set order: ace first, then king, queen, jack, ten, and so on. Any cards still left in the deck when you finish a level add more coins to your total. You earn coins by building continuous chains, and a gold card keeps a chain going without breaking it. When you run out of moves, you can draw a card from the deck or throw away a gold card.
stickman-attack: Waves of stickmen keep pouring in, each one trying to wear you down and waiting for you to slip up just once. You are the stick fighter chosen for this job, and you handle the crowd with your kung fu, swinging away without much thought.

Nobody explains why you were picked, and the attackers never say why they keep charging straight at you just to get hit in their most tender spots. Tap the white circle to defeat enemies, collect souls, and spend those souls on new weapons. The game works with a mouse click or with touch on a screen.
ninja-parkour-multiplayer: Take on constantly shifting obstacle courses as a agile ninja in this quick multiplayer parkour game. Your nimble movement and accurate jumps let you get ahead of rival players in a race that rewards both speed and technique. The landscape keeps changing, so you'll need sharp reflexes to keep up and come out on top.
Every run is a head-to-head test of who can move the fastest and think on their feet. Race other players through the course and see who can claim the title of top ninja.
trz-battleship: TRZ Battleship is a browser puzzle game built around naval warfare. You hide your ships, then hunt for the enemy ones one guess at a time. Each thoughtful shot brings you closer to victory, and the tension grows with every move. Success depends on sharp judgment and strategies that can adapt when the opponent's moves are hard to predict.

Fans of board games will find plenty to enjoy here, since the puzzle rewards careful thinking over luck. The goal is to sink the enemy ships before they sink yours. Hiding, seeking, and outmaneuvering your rival are the heart of every round.
squad-assembler-merge: Build a team of fighters from mixed parts and send them against rival squads. Merging two identical items upgrades them, raising their level and stats. Swap weapons and armor, and buy loot boxes stocked with gear, from bats and knives to grenade launchers, flamethrowers and plasma guns. Tap a box's picture and price tag to buy it, then click it in your inventory to open it.

Design your own fighter with the character editor by choosing arms, torso and head. Drag an item into the equipment slot and press Create to form a cyborg with its own skills. Hired heroes can join your ranks, while bosses, treasure chests and enemy outposts wait ahead. Win by beating the enemy squad, and press TO BATTLE to send your team out. The game blends merging, strategy, fighting and sandbox play.
tanks-1944: Tanks 1944 puts you in command of armored vehicles in realistic tank battles. Start by picking the tank you want to drive, then learn the basics of combat as you go. Over time you can shape your own approaches and tactics to suit how you like to fight. Expect physics that feel true to life, along with visuals that include shadows and grass that moves in a lifelike way. The battles
bridge-builder: You play as a design engineer who has to improvise and adjust to whatever task is in front of you. Choose from a range of materials to build structures that can hold up the weight of a vehicle. The physics feel convincing, and a real simulator lets you test each creation to see how it performs.

The levels are spread across four different locations, and the puzzles call for careful thinking and logic. When you need help, a built-in hint system is there to guide you and build your skills. On a computer, hold the left mouse button and drag to build a bridge, press Space to start the simulation, press Z to undo, and double-click a part to remove it. On mobile, use the touchscreen and the on-screen controls.
parking-solution: Parking Solution asks you to untangle tricky parking setups in this puzzle game. Each move takes careful planning and a clever approach, so you have to think several steps ahead. You steer your car through crowded traffic jams and work to clear the parking lot. As you advance, the levels grow steadily harder, so each new challenge brings something fresh to solve.

For players who enjoy a contest, there is a competitive speedrun mode. It pushes you to finish the puzzles quickly and see how fast you can go. Whether you want to sharpen your reasoning or beat your own best time, this car game gives you plenty to test.
your-obby-parkour: Your Obby Parkour is a 3D platformer built around running and jumping through a string of tough courses. Your aim is to reach the finish of each one while dodging hazards along the way. Expect scorching lava, slick ice slides, water traps, and strange portals, plus bouncy trampolines, spinning traps, and plenty of hidden routes. Regions range from simple starts to brutally hard sections, and you can team up with friends to tackle them together.

Keep an eye out for deadly skeletons, lava-filled volcanoes, icy paths, and horror mazes where getting lost is simple. Look for a tiny hidden dragon, gather trophies, and unlock secret shortcuts and bonus zones. Move with WASD and jump with the spacebar. Press TAB to pause, hold Shift for the cursor, and use the mouse wheel to zoom. On mobile, play using the game interface.
obby-1-speed-car-escape: In this obby-style driving game, your goal is to build up your car's speed through regular practice so you can pull ahead of every rival. Grab fuel cans along the way to keep your engine in good shape for long runs. The courses are packed with hazards that demand quick reactions and sharp driving.

When the police give chase, rely on raw speed and clever moves to slip away. Rare items can be collected along the route, and they unlock wings that help your ride stand out. On a PC, press WASD to drive, hold the right mouse button to turn the view, and use the mouse wheel to zoom. On a phone or tablet, a joystick handles movement, and you can swipe with a finger to rotate the camera.
magic-finger-3d: Magic Finger 3D is a hypercasual browser game where your fingers become a source of spellwork. Flick and fling objects through a shifting three-dimensional scene, reshaping the world around you to push back a group of cunning extraterrestrial intruders. The opening rounds are gentle, but the obstacles steadily grow harder, so you need to think about how to put every part of the environment to work for you.

Plan each strike with care, and strengthen your abilities as you progress so your magic grows along with the challenges. Its casual tag makes it a good fit for quick sessions, while the rising difficulty keeps each round engaging. By the later stages, you will need to decide whether your growing powers are enough to stop the alien threat.
tank-war-simulator-game: Step into a war zone in this tank shooting title, where you pilot heavy armored machines through dangerous fronts from the world war era. The game is built around fierce combat missions and explosive clashes that test your nerve. It suits anyone who enjoys military themes, tank battles, and planning a war strategy in a fairly realistic way.

Your job is straightforward. Line up each shot with care, take out enemy tanks, endure powerful attacks, and guide your forces toward victory. As you advance, every level brings fresh challenges, tougher opponents, and new war scenarios. All buttons are selected with the mouse.
sniper-master: Leap and drift through the air while you line up your shots. Fire at just the right moment to take down targets, aiming for clean, satisfying hits. Staying calm and leading your aim matter as much as speed, and the game spans several levels that steadily sharpen your precision.

Along the way, you earn rewards and improve your skills, growing into a skilled marksman in the sky. Controls are simple: a mouse click or a tap is all you need. Timing is at the heart of the experience, so each shot rewards careful thought over quick clicking.
royal-jewels-match: Royal Jewels Match is a matching puzzle where your aim is to link three or more jewels of the same type to finish each level and collect coins. As you go, you can unlock unique levels, join special events, and face surprising challenges. Every match you make helps you gather more coins along the way.

Spend your coins on unique decorations and show off your design skills. Each decoration you buy also rewards you with crowns, which open the way to the next stage of the adventure. Keep earning crowns as you advance and see how close you can get to mastering the game.
merge-adventure: Merge Adventure is a relaxed puzzle title about fixing up a bright neighborhood. Blend identical coffee, garden, and renovation pieces to uncover improved versions, then fill customer requests and collect rewards that help you revamp each district bit by bit. The friendly storyline, lively personalities, and pleasing merge sequences keep the long-term growth of the town engaging.

Mouse players click and drag one piece onto a matching one to combine them, while touch players tap and drag in the same way. Tap producer items to generate new pieces, and select a finished order to hand over the requested goods. No single mistake ends the game, since each renovation stage is cleared by completing orders, gathering the necessary materials, and finishing building upgrades. Keep improving structures and unlocking fresh merge chains to move the story forward.
run-gun-robots: Run Gun Robots takes you onto a high-tech war zone packed with dangerous terrain. Your job is to move through hazardous settings, take down machines that have gone out of control, and slip past lethal traps along the way.

Every robot you destroy pays out currency, which you can spend on boosts and gear that make you stronger. The difficulty ramps up as you go, and the soundtrack pulls you deeper into the action. Quick thinking and sharp timing are what keep you alive.
ace-brawl-battle-3d: Ace Brawl Battle 3D is a shooting game set in a 3D combat arena. You move through detailed battlegrounds, using controls that are easy to pick up, and fight with a range of advanced guns while trying to get the better of your opponents. The original text stresses that you should keep moving, make smart use of power-ups, and invest in strong upgrades if you want to come out on top.

Expect a fast, thrilling match from start to finish. Success depends on planning your moves as much as on aiming well, so think ahead, dodge incoming fire, and use every advantage the arena gives you. If you enjoy shooters where tactics and quick reflexes both matter, this one is built for you.
family-pet-dog-games: Virtual pet fans can take on the role of a puppy in this dog simulator. You live alongside a sweet, faithful pup and lend a paw to your make-believe family with everyday tasks both inside the house and around the neighborhood. Your main character is the family's dog, and the virtual mom often needs help tidying up a mess-filled home, getting through household jobs, and assisting the people next door.

Movement uses WASD on desktop, while holding Left Shift lets you sprint. Press F to act on things and I to read the instructions. Ctrl opens settings, and P or Tab pauses the game. On mobile, a joystick handles movement.
draw-or-delete-lovestory: Step into this puzzle adventure as a detective who uncovers a couple's secrets. You reshape scenes by sketching new details or wiping existing ones away, and it works on both a phone and a desktop computer. Expect a suspenseful story full of surprises, and you can join in online at no cost.
Start by studying the picture and reading the task on screen. Next, draw or erase the element that the task calls for to finish it. The method is simple and enjoyable from the first moment.
rabbit-samurai-2: Rabbit Samurai 2 is an adventure game where you control an agile rabbit warrior swinging through colorful stages. Your job is to time each move well so you can gather every carrot that is hard to reach. Getting around relies on rope-swinging, and you will need to avoid tricky traps along the way.
Each stage is built around precision and timing, and lining up your swings just right is the core challenge. Players who enjoy careful, timing-based play will find plenty to focus on here.
spider-evolution: Spider Evolution is an arcade-style game where you begin as a small spider and grow into a strong creature. Along the way, you need to outsmart your rivals and sharpen your abilities. It runs online in your web browser, so you can jump right in and take charge of the spider realm from your computer.
Movement is easy to pick up. Press the left and right arrow keys, or the A and D keys, to move sideways. If you prefer the mouse, steer with the right or left slider instead. Your skills improve as
family-simulator-beach-games: Step into a winter holiday with a virtual family in this vacation simulator. You travel alongside mom, dad, and other relatives to scenic getaways, where picnic outings and hill station trips become the memorable moments. Your days are filled with varied tasks and places to explore, and the family life feels realistic throughout. You can plan a winter vacation trip, join family activities during beach picnics and hill station adventures, and take the wheel of powerful 4x4 vehicles on snowy mountain roads and challenging tracks.
On desktop, move with WASD and hold Left Shift to sprint. Press Ctrl to open settings, P or Tab to pause, F to act, and I
4-colors: Facing as many as three computer players, you race to empty your hand before anyone else does. Plan each turn carefully, because a card can only be played when it shares a color or number with the one showing. Action cards bring surprising twists that can shake up the match and leave everyone a little confused.

Play by clicking or tapping the card you want to put down. If nothing in your hand fits, pull a card from the draw pile and try again. Remember to shout "Uno" when you are down to one card, or two extra cards will be added to your hand as a penalty. Every move matters, so think ahead and play with strategy.
god-of-light: God of Light is a puzzle game set in a magical world that you light up one beam at a time. Your job is to route rays of light past mirrors and around obstacles, using both creative ideas and careful planning. As your light paths reach them, dormant flowers wake up and bloom, and the whole screen turns into a glowing display. Each level throws a different challenge your way, so no two puzzles feel quite the same.
The game is filed under Arcade and is tagged as a skill game. It rewards patience and clever thinking more than quick reflexes, and every solved stage shows the light show growing a little brighter.
defender-tanks-merge: Defender: Tanks Merge is a strategy game where you build your force by combining distinct tanks, each with its own abilities. Enemies arrive in waves that keep growing harder to hold back, so you must adapt as you go. Auto-merge, bombs, and mines give you extra ways to sharpen your tactics. You can play on desktop or mobile at no cost,
stickman-fights: Stickman Fights throws tiny stick figures into a street brawl, with each one eager to be crowned the top brawler. You take control of a main character and guide him through battles against rival fighters. The stickmen want to settle who is strongest, and they plan to do it the only way they know: by fighting. Since stick figures seem made for scraps, the game leans fully into that idea. Your goal is to flatten an online opponent in combat.

Every win pays a cash prize, and the more money you wager, the bigger the reward. The dollars you collect can go toward new skins that decorate your fighter. Move with A and D, jump with W, kick with the left mouse button, and punch with the right one. The game is always free to play.
black-hole-fill-3d: Steer a strong black hole across the playfield and swallow everything in its path to clear each stage of Hole Collect Master 3D. Your aim is to fill the target zone before the clock hits zero. Levels are fun to tackle, the controls respond smoothly, and the bright visuals make every round pleasant to watch. The game is simple to pick up and tough to put down, and players of any age can enjoy it.

To move the hole, drag or swipe with your mouse. Anything the hole touches is pulled inside, so your job is to gather items as you go and keep an eye on the timer. Missing a single object can cost you, so try to collect everything before time runs out.
tidewell: Tidewell is a relaxed match-3 puzzler about repairing a harbor after a storm. Swap sea treasures to form matches, then shape flares, buoys, gulls and tide pearls from them, and combine these pieces to set off large chain reactions. Your task is to clear crates, sand, nets and message bottles across 100 hand-built stages.

Stars you collect along the way let you rebuild the pier, lighthouse, market, boatyard and café. Each level welcomes a Harbor Pal, either a crab, puffin, octopus or turtle, and every one has a special power that charges as you play. Swipe a tile, or tap one and then a neighbour, with a mouse or touch. Tap a power-up to fire it, or swap two together to combine them. For boosters, tap the button first, then the board. M mutes the sound, Esc opens pause or closes a panel, and Enter starts from the harbor.
wheelie-bike-for-2-players: Two people share one screen in this physics-based bike game for local play. Purple and Green stickmen face off to see who has the best balance. Each rider tries to hold a wheelie for as long as possible before the 60-second clock runs out. When time is up, whoever has built up the most wheelie time across the round takes
obby-all-games-dash-or-die: Dash or Die is an obby parkour game where you hop, sprint, and weave through several maps and mini-games. One course features bright rainbow sections, another has you outrunning lava that keeps climbing, a third is a huge field of obstacles, and a bike run tests your balance. Difficulty varies from stage to stage. A single misstep can send you back to the start.

Your aim is to cross the platforms, dodge traps, and avoid the gaps until you reach the end. Speed, skill, and well-timed jumps decide the outcome. On desktop, use W, A, S, and D to move or steer the bike, Space to jump, and the mouse to look around. On mobile, drag the virtual joystick to move, tap the jump button to leap, and swipe the screen to rotate the camera.
microplastics-feeding: In this two-dimensional arcade adventure, you guide a fish with a hearty appetite for tiny plastic bits drifting through the sea. Swim across the open ocean, munching on pollution as you go, while steering clear of obstacles in your path. Quick reflexes and good timing matter, since every move counts.
Your goal is to help create a cleaner underwater world where marine life can thrive. This playful quest is all about protecting the oceans, and each bite you take makes a small difference.
money-rush: Money Rush is a quick arcade game where small choices can grow your money fast. Your job is to pick gates that carry the biggest multipliers as you move through a world built around wealth. Each pick tests how fast you can decide, so you need to keep your wits about you.

The game is simple to learn and easy to follow, yet it keeps you focused on building up your fortune one gate at a time. Its straightforward style makes it a light, enjoyable run whenever you want a short bit of arcade fun.
spikes-and-feathers: Spikes & Feathers is an arcade title that sends you soaring through a sketched, hand-made landscape. You control a nimble bird and must steer it past sharp spikes by tapping in a steady, well-timed rhythm. Each obstacle you meet makes the next one harder, so the challenge grows as you progress.

Speed is not what this game asks for. Instead, success comes from learning how to control your flight while danger lurks all around. Expect a high-altitude journey where careful, precise timing matters far more than rushing through.
super-buddy-archer: Buddy is back, and this time his little friends are caught in ropes. Aim your bow, fire a limited number of arrows, and cut the ropes to free them without hurting them too much. Some levels require you to work out the right angle so your arrows reach the targets. Watch out for TNT, ricochet shots, boxes, sharks, and other obstacles.

Dynamite can be set off to blast the captives loose. Collect stars to unlock new levels, improve your score, and earn achievements as you go. Aim with the mouse, or touch the screen on mobile devices. The game is free to play on your phone, tablet, or desktop.
mexico-rex-2: You step into the claws of a real T-rex in this sequel, which sends you back to Mexico City to wreak havoc once more. Your rampage includes crushing cars, gathering chilli peppers, and eating as many humans as you can. Expect blood along the way.

The adventure carries you through different towns and settlements, where you destroy everything in sight and cause chaos at every stop. You can play with the keyboard or with the on-screen buttons, so you can pick whichever method feels more comfortable.
head-the-ball: Head the Ball is a quick soccer game built around heading the ball. You will work on your header technique as matches move at a rapid pace. Timing matters a lot, so you need to judge when to jump and connect, and every move should have a plan behind it.

Reading the other side is part of the fun. Watch how rivals position themselves so you can get ahead of their next play, and set up chances for your teammates to score. When the moment is right, a well-placed header can change the entire match. Defense matters just as much, since holding your ground keeps your side in control of the pitch and lets you finish each game with a win, one accurate shot at a time.
1-wings-keyboard-speed: Sprint along a massive highway made of giant keyboard keys, where every key you step on builds up your Speed. Press Space to leap, tap it again in midair to flap your wings, or hold it to glide as far as you can. Touch down on a trophy pad to earn trophies, and note that pads placed farther out over the water pay out much more.

Spend what you earn on new wings, auras, and trails, or go through a rebirth and begin again. You can also race against other players online. Steer with WASD, look around with the mouse, press E at shops, and press B to head back to base.
save-the-planet: Master the basics of sorting trash with Save The Planet. Your job is to drag each item and drop it into the right recycling bin, following the waste management methods used in Italy. Each stage brings harder challenges, so the game teaches while it entertains. The clock keeps running, so you need to work quickly to protect the environment.

This hypercasual title is designed for players who enjoy quick, simple rounds. It fits the casual category and offers a fun way to pick up useful habits about recycling. Every correct drop helps you move forward, and every mistake reminds you to think before you sort.
winter-clash-3d: On the eve of Christmas, wicked elves plan to take over Santa's secret base and bring the evil Baba Yaga, also called the Pagan Idol, into our world. You must stop them. Grab your gun and punish everyone who confronts you in Winter Clash 3D, a fresh team shooter. You play as a mighty Santa Claus, tasked with seizing the Pagan Idol from a deserted lighthouse island and burning it to ashes in your Christmas fire.
Move with W, A, S and D, and jump with the spacebar. Press C to crouch and the right mouse button to aim. Press TAB to open the score table and check how things stand.
where-are-the-puffies: Where Are the Puffies? is a seek-and-find game with 30 illustrated scenes, from leafy gardens to star-filled workshops. Small Puffies hide among books, plants and everyday objects. Tap one to reveal its color and watch your collection grow. There is no countdown, so you can zoom in and drag around each picture at your own pace, which makes it a good choice for a quick break.

Meet 10 characters and finish their three scenes to add each portrait to your album. The top-left counter shows how many Puffies you have found, and a wrong tap costs a heart. Stuck on one? The lightbulb button offers a hint. On a computer, click, drag and use the mouse wheel to zoom. Play with touch or mouse, in portrait or landscape, and switch between English and Russian from the top-right menu.
mountain-tank: Take control of massive tanks and roll across dangerous, rugged ground. Victory depends on sharp reflexes as well as strategic thinking, so you must react quickly while planning your moves. Battles are at the heart of the game, and unique upgrades let you improve your vehicle and change how it performs in combat. Each clash pulls you into the fighting, making the warfare feel close and absorbing.

Mountain Tank rewards players who can balance quick instincts with careful strategy. Its treacherous terrain and intense fights keep the challenge high. If you enjoy war-themed adventures where timing and tactics both matter, this one offers a demanding ride that gives back as much as it asks.
baby-chicco-adventures: Baby Chicco Adventures puts you in charge of a brave little penguin who must find his way through colorful pixel landscapes. Along the way you need to slip past enemies and gather treasures. The game borrows the feel of Mario-style platforming and has a nostalgic retro look, so each stage brings something new to figure out and some tough obstacles to clear.

Icy surroundings set the scene for this journey, which asks you to jump and sprint your way forward. Keep an eye out for secrets tucked away in the levels, since careful exploration can reveal them. Whether you enjoy mastering precise movement or searching every corner of a world, this platformer has plenty to discover.
sausage-man: Sausage Man is a 2D single-player action runner set on a never-ending path. You choose the sausage you want to be, from classic weisswurst and blutwurst to bacon, chocolate, or even a plumber or cowboy. As you race forward, you flex your hot-dog body to dodge being sliced, chopped, burned, or smashed.

Collect coins while you run, then spend them on buns of steel and other cool powerups. There is a large selection of sausages to pick from, along with plenty of hot dog skins to try. Keep moving and see how long your sausage can survive.
arrow-patrol: Arrow Patrol is a hypercasual game where an arrow travels up and down the screen without stopping. Your job is to keep it clear of saw blades. A single click flips the arrow's direction, so you decide when it climbs and when it drops. Touch a saw and the round ends.

The game is built around quick, one-tap reactions, and the controls are simple enough to pick up in seconds. Tags on the page include Best Games, Casual, Click, and arrow, which point to its easy-going, click-driven style. Keep tapping to steer the arrow through the hazards and see how long you can last.
crash-core: In Crash Core, you roll a powerful core that builds speed as it goes, plowing through crates, walls, containers, and heavy machinery. Smashing these objects is how you collect scrap. Spend the scrap on new upgrades to grow stronger as you push into harder zones, where each new area brings a fresh set of challenges.

Desktop players can steer with WASD or the arrow keys, or drag the mouse to guide the core. On mobile, drag to move and steer. Chain your destruction together for bigger combos, and upgrade your core so it can break through the sturdier obstacles waiting ahead.
novice-fisherman: Cast a line in Novice Fisherman, a sports game where your planning and skill decide how well you do. You steer through hazardous seas, pull in impressive catches, and stay a step ahead of sharks lurking beneath the surface. Each round brings new obstacles that keep the action engaging from start to finish.

As the challenges grow tougher, you sharpen your fishing abilities and upgrade your gear so you can keep pace with other players. The game sits in the Sports category and carries the Sports tag, making it a natural pick for anyone who enjoys competing on the water.
faily-skater: Faily Skater is a 3D endless runner set in a messy city streets. You ride a skateboard at high speed, weaving around obstacles and choosing between different routes as you go. Along the way you can pull off bold tricks and stunts. You also get to customize your skater, and the goal is to work your way up to becoming a pro.

The game rewards quick reactions and bold riding. Every run keeps pushing you forward through busy, unpredictable surroundings, so there is always something new to react to. If you enjoy skateboarding games where speed, balance and style matter, this one offers a fast-paced challenge with plenty of personality.
archer-ragdoll: Archer Ragdoll is a stickman game with floppy, ragdoll-style bodies. Every blow sends the figures tumbling, and arrows and armor follow believable physics. Each shot ricochets loudly and bounces off surfaces, so outcomes are hard to predict. Unique arrows each add their own gameplay features, and every body part takes a different amount of damage.

Upgrade your hero into a true master archer and take on a range of opponents and powerful bosses. The pleasant visuals show explosions, sparks and splashes. Compete in the general player ranking to show your skill
head-puzzle-shooter: Head Puzzle Shooter puts you in charge of an animated head that fires at bright bubbles marked with animals. Each shot needs careful aiming, and bouncing off the walls helps you reach spots you could not hit directly. Match and pop the bubbles as you go, and expect the puzzles to get harder the further you advance.
The game blends thoughtful planning with quick, playful action, so every move counts. Its colorful look keeps the screen lively from start to finish. You can enjoy it on any of your devices.
ant-moving-simulator: Ant Moving Simulator is an arcade puzzle game where you guide a small group of ants through colorful block-clearing challenges. The game includes 2,200 levels. Click or tap a numbered box at the front to slide it into an open slot, and your ants will automatically head out to gather reachable blocks of the same color. As they clear them, the pixel artwork breaks apart one piece at a time.

Space is limited, so you need to think a few moves ahead. Some boxes are linked and travel as a group, so you must have enough empty slots for the whole cluster. Clear every block to finish a level. If progress stalls, use the on-screen buttons to activate a power-up or pause the game. You can also unlock new character skins for your ants as you see how far your team can go.
paper-doll-dress-up: Paper Doll: Dress Up brings the classic feel of handmade paper dolls into a fashion game. You act as the stylist, dressing paper dolls from a wardrobe of more than 1,000 items. The collection includes current trends, eye-catching accessories, many hairstyles, and soothing makeup touches.

Your role goes beyond picking outfits. You build a hideaway for your doll, complete style challenges, and customize every part of her world. The game moves past the usual princess theme, blending fashion, creativity, and storytelling into a magical experience meant for doll lovers.
knit-loop-yarn-jam-puzzle: Knit Loop: Yarn Jam Puzzle invites you into a soft, woolly world of threads and needlework. Your job is to group bright skeins by colour, pull tangled loops apart, and free every piece on the board using satisfying 3D physics. Each stage is calm and easy to follow, with a handmade feel, charming knitted touches, smooth controls and straightforward rules.

Tap a yarn piece to send it where it belongs, and pay attention to its colour, order and direction. When a strand is stuck, move the pieces in its way first, and think a few steps ahead to open the right route. Levels grow richer with fresh combinations, extra wool and trickier knots. The game is free to play, it works well for sharpening focus, and it makes a pleasant pause for a short break.
fruits-shooter-pop-master: Fruits Shooter Pop Master is an arcade title that rewards fast hands and clever thinking. You step into a bright, lively setting where success depends on both reacting quickly and planning your moves ahead. Your job is to burst clusters of fruit while the clock keeps ticking, and the arrangements grow more intricate as you move along.

Special power-ups are on hand to help you chain together larger combos. Because the game leans so heavily on accuracy, it works well as a skill test for anyone who enjoys sharpening their aim and timing.
hedgehog-go-home: Hedgehog Go Home is a charming puzzle game where you help a hedgehog find a safe route back to its nest. You plan each path ahead of time, push the obstacles out of the way, and avoid traps to keep the route clear. Every level has its own layout, and the difficulty climbs as you go, rewarding sharp observation and logical thinking. The gameplay stays simple and relaxing, yet it is easy to keep coming back for one more level.

Everything is controlled with the mouse, so there is little to learn before you start. Study the board, choose your moves, and guide the hedgehog home one step at a time. The game is tagged as animal, block, click, and logic, and it sits in the puzzle category.
trend-family-merge-arena: Trend Family: Merge Arena is a puzzle game built around combining quirky characters such as Sprunkys, TV-Men, Brainrots and Labubu. Two matching heroes fuse into a stronger, odd new one with surprising powers, and you never know what will show up next. Build a family team, send it into arena battles, face bosses, and watch your family tree grow stranger.
Before each fight, place your units on the battl
color-water-sort-3d: Color Water Sort 3D is a relaxed yet clever 3D puzzle title built around untangling jumbled liquids. Your job is to pour the colored water between tubes so that every tube ends up holding just one shade. The levels begin gently and grow into tricky mind teasers, so you get a healthy mix of planning and calm. Its bright, three-dimensional scenes look realistic, and the water flows smoothly as it pours. Solving each puzzle brings a rewarding feeling that keeps you coming back.

To play on a computer, left-click a tube to select it, then click a second tube to pour. On a phone or tablet, tap a tube once to choose it, then tap the destination tube to complete the move. You win once all the liquid of each color has been gathered together and every tube is neatly sorted. Think a few steps ahead and work your way through the colorful mix.
gangsters: Gangsters is a shooting game with blocky, pixelated graphics in which you run a gang and defend your territory from rival crews. The retro look hides a tense, bloody fight. You can grab pistols or machine guns to take on your enemies, and the movement follows physics rules.

You control all three members of your gang at the same time. Player one presses W to move the squad forward and jump, and uses E to raise their arms for shooting or to punch with their fists. Player two uses I to jump and O to handle weapons. Two players can take part in the battle together. Your goal is to conquer the other gangs and show who the real mafia boss is.
stickman-killing-zombie-3d: Stickman Killing Zombie 3D sends you through chaotic streets rendered in three dimensions. You control a quick stickman, joined by his bird companion, and your job is to cut through relentless waves of zombies. Your weapon is a broad, sweeping crimson blade with plenty of power, so you will need to adapt your approach as the fight shifts and push onward through the undead apocalypse.

Along the way, you can collect gold and health to keep going. Each level comes with its own objectives to complete, so you always have a clear target as the battles grow tougher. It is a fighting game with a simple goal: slice your way through the horde and survive.
draw-one-part-brain-puzzle: Draw One Part: Brain Puzzle is a game that mixes logical thinking with sketching. Each stage presents a picture that is only partly finished, and your goal is to supply the missing piece so the whole image makes sense. It sits in the puzzle category and is built around brain teasers with a creative twist.

Playing requires only a mouse or a tap on the screen. Click or tap to draw the absent section and work out what completes the scene. Because the challenge asks you to imagine and reason at the same time, it suits players who like to test how they think while they doodle.
metal-animals: Command a squad of furry fighters who ride into battle on armored tanks in Metal Animals. Your task is to plan each move and swap troops in and out, so you can hold off a foe that looks cute but fights hard. The action moves fast and calls for careful tactics, and you must keep track of how much energy each of your adorable soldiers has left.

Expect a playful mix of sweetness and disorder as the game combines charm with chaos. Every decision counts, and the pace rarely eases up, so stay alert and keep your fluffy crew moving. It belongs to the Tanks category, offering a lively take on tank battles for fans of that style.
super-hitmasters: Step into the shoes of a spy in Super HitMasters, a casual, funny arcade game where your job is to catch or destroy every enemy in each room. The early stages are simple puzzles, and later levels get far more demanding, testing your aim and accuracy. Collect coins along the way to unlock plenty of weapons, outfits, and characters, and build up your arsenal.

Each level asks you to think before you shoot, because brute force won't always get you through. Keep track of how many bullets you have left, since restarting a stage means starting again from scratch. Fire huge boxes to crack enemies, or send them into a vacuum or crash them. You can solve the levels in whatever order you like, and there are several game modes to explore. Swipe across the screen to aim and fire, or play with a mouse.
wacky-strike: Pick a side in this cartoon strategy game, either the boys or the girls, and settle which team is really the stronger one. Build your towers, recruit your troops, and send them marching from your castle toward the enemy base, claiming ground along the way. Your goal is to bring down the opposing castle as quickly as you can.

Upgrades, air strikes, and several other deadly weapons can help you on the way. You can play with the mouse or the keyboard: keys 1 to 4 train units, keys 5 to 7 construct base pieces, and keys 8 to 0 trigger powerups. Use the left and right arrow keys to scroll across the map. This HTML5 title is tagged as a tower defense game with a strategy focus.
fin-freedom: You guide a small fish through risky underwater pipe systems. Along the way, you pull out key pins, outwit sea predators lurking nearby, and redirect streams of water so they avoid molten lava. Each stage presents puzzles driven by liquid movement, and they grow trickier as you progress.
Clear every level safely to win the fish its full freedom in the water. Controls are simple: a single mouse click or tap is all you need to play.
survive-the-glass-bridge: Survive The Glass Bridge brings the glass bridge challenge from the Squid Game series to your browser. Each step offers two panels, but only one of them is fake. You need to pick the safe one and leap onto it to move toward the finish. A wrong pick shatters the glass and sends you falling. You also have to reach the far side before the time runs out.

The difficulty options on the main menu can help you spot differences between the panels, giving you a useful edge. Move your character with W, A, S, D or the arrow keys, press Space to jump, and move the mouse to look around the surroundings.
satisfying-ball-clicker: In this clicker, you drop new balls onto the screen and collect coins every time one bounces. Spend those coins on upgrades that boost your income, and open different skins to change how your balls look. Evolving your balls unlocks fresh abilities, so there is always a new twist to try.

The game encourages you to test different setups and make the experience your own while you work to grow your earnings. Gems can be gathered along the way, adding another layer to your progress. Play has no set end, and the steady stream of rewards can keep you busy for hours.
battle-arena-race-to-win: Pick a side, Red or Blue, and drive into an arena where cars clash in close combat. Gather a range of vehicles and improve them over time. Each car asks you to weigh speed against toughness and acceleration, so choose the mix that suits your style. Fit your ride with strategic items, keep upgrading it, and climb the leaderboard to help your team win.

Use W or the up arrow to accelerate and S or the down arrow to reverse. A and D, or the left and right arrows, steer your car. Press R to restore your position, hold Space to handbrake into a drift, and press Left Shift for a nitro boost.
yummy-shelf: Yummy Shelf is a calming, three-dimensional puzzle that blends sorting with matching. Your job is to tidy up a collection of brightly colored foodstuffs spread across shelves. Find three identical products and tap them to take them off the display. You must clear every shelf before time runs out to win the level, so think ahead about which items to remove first.
When layouts get stubborn, you can lean
hill-climb-racings-2: Hill Climb Racing 2 returns with more of everything, and this new version is even more entertaining than the first. Millions of people from around the world have joined this car racing title, which relies on lifelike physics to make each drive feel grounded. It sits in the racing category and carries adventure and funny themes that appeal to younger players too.

Controls are kept simple, since a mouse click or a screen tap is all you need to get going. The action is packed and the physics are realistic, so every run feels like a true test of driving. Anyone who enjoys car racing will find plenty to enjoy here.
the-machinegg: In this calm idle clicker, eggs are your most prized treasure. Grow your farm, set up automation, and see whether you can earn enough to retire. Buy chickens, feed them, gather their eggs, and carry them to market. As your farm expands, unlock automation systems that streamline each step and boost your profits.

Pick the mode you prefer, either normal or speedrun, with speedrun helping you reach the top sooner. Two replayable handicap challenges shake things up considerably, and endless mode is there when you want even more birds. Use left click or touch to interact, spawn chickens, collect eggs, and purchase upgrades. Above all, treat the chickens well.
buba-jump: Buba Jump is an arcade game about leaping from one spot to the next. Staying alive depends on tapping at exactly the right moment, since even a small slip can send Buba into the deep drop below. As the game goes on, the tests get harder and fewer platforms remain to land on, so quick reactions matter more and more.

The visuals are appealing and the controls are kept simple, which makes the game easy to pick up. Players may find it hard to stop once they start, and each run can be played again. It challenges you to see whether your timing is sharp enough to steer Buba's fate.
space-destroyer: Space Destroyer is a top-down shoot 'em up built with HTML5. Alien ships have launched an attack, and your job is to protect the galaxy from being torn apart. The journey is split into three stages, and you must clear each one to move forward. Along the way, wipe out every enemy vessel you meet while chasing as high a score as you can manage.

Each stage also features three bosses that must be defeated. Everything runs on mouse clicks or taps, so the controls are easy to learn. Its tags point to alien, arcade, shooter, and space themes, and it sits under the adventure category.
urban-echo: Urban Echo is an action parkour title set in an urban setting. You guide a character through obstacles by running, jumping, sliding, and climbing walls to cross rooftops while avoiding traps. Keeping up a high pace matters, and precise timing lets you chain smooth combos to go further. The gameplay is simple yet hard to put down, and it puts your reflexes and skills to the test.
The controls are simple to pick up. W or Space gives a high jump, and pressing again in mid-air performs a double jump. S triggers a flip jump, A performs a wall jump, and D sends you into a dash.
stickman-broken-bones-io: Steer stickmen down chaotic, unpredictable drops, and try to rack up as much bone-breaking mayhem as you can. Make smart use of vehicles and upgrades to plow through obstacles, and customize your stickman's look along the way.

Precise timing and careful maneuvering lead to hilarious injuries and higher scores, and every big crash brings a real sense of satisfaction. The game has a quirky, hooked-you-fast feel, and it makes clear that destruction is the way to win.
super-rocket-buddy: Super Rocket Buddy puts you behind a cannon loaded with Buddies. Your job is to fire them toward the target and reach it. Along the way, you'll need to work out tricky puzzles and dodge obstacles. Each level may require a different number of Buddies, so you decide how many to use to finish it.
Expect the floppy movement of ragdoll physics, along with funny challenges that offer fun without end. Controls are simple: use a mouse on a desktop computer, or touch the screen on a mobile device.
grimace-penalty: Grimace Penalty is a soccer game that puts your accuracy and sense of timing to the test. Your goal is to get past the Grimace goalkeeper, who is hard to read, by choosing where each shot should go. Quick reactions help you keep your run of scoring going, but the game ends once you have missed three goals.

Every kick brings a bit of tension, and the reward is landing the decisive goal that wins the match. Keeping calm while the pressure builds is part of the challenge. It sits in the sports category, so fans of soccer and penalty-style games will feel at home.
robot-bar-find-the-differences: Step into a sci-fi world inside Robot Bar, a lively club where cheerful robots kick back and unwind. Your job is to sharpen your observation skills by spotting the differences hidden between two pictures. Keep an eye on the clock, because the round ends once time runs out.

You only have five chances, so careful, steady looking matters more than rushing. The cheerful, whimsical mood runs throughout, keeping each round light and engaging while still asking for sharp focus.
masked-forces: Masked Forces is a shooter for fans of games like CS:GO or CoD. Your strategy and survival skills are put to the test on a battlefield, where your mission is to eliminate every enemy and win the fight. You can play singleplayer or multiplayer missions, and an armory and weapons shop lets you choose your gear. The game also has good graphics.

The controls are easy to pick up. Use WASD to move, Space to jump, and C to crouch. Left mouse click fires, R reloads, and the mouse scroll wheel switches weapons. Press T to open chat and P to pause.
stickman-hooks: Stickman: Hooks is a 2D action game where you guide a stick figure through obstacle-filled courses. Clicking or tapping latches onto a hook, and you use that to launch yourself into long jumps and acrobatic flips. Your task is to dodge the hazards along the way while keeping your character moving forward.

The game relies on physics, so your swings matter. Each hook you grab builds speed, and you need to time when you let go so that your momentum carries you from one anchor to the next. Get the timing right and you can soar across to the finish line. It is controlled with a mouse click or tap.
bazooka-survivors: Bazooka Survivors is a bullet hell arcade shooter built around fierce battles against massive hordes of enemies. Your task is to keep fighting and surviving as the waves keep coming. Expect a busy screen full of incoming threats, where staying alert matters. Its action and adventure tags point to a fast, demanding pace.

Getting started is easy because the controls rely on a mouse click or a tap. Whether you use a mouse or a touchscreen, that one simple input starts the action. Once it begins, the goal stays the same: push through the swarms and last as long as you can.
