jigsaw-sort: Jigsaw Sort is a puzzle game built around swapping pieces until a hidden picture appears. Each level grows more complex than the last, so the challenge keeps building as you move forward. Fresh visuals show up along the way, and the game is enjoyable for players of every age.

To finish a level, you need to line up every piece so the full image is revealed. The task calls for careful thinking and sharp focus, making it a good test of both your intellect and your attention. Whether you want to exercise your mind or simply enjoy a new picture with each stage, this title has plenty to offer.
the-adventure-of-finn-and-bonnie: Robots have taken over planet X, and Finn and Bonnie have to push them back. Their mission is to gather a large supply of weapons so they can take out every robot on the planet. Along the way, the pair can mix weapons together and upgrade them, making each one stronger than before.

This shooting adventure works with a mouse or with touch, so you can play on a computer or on a touchscreen device. Whichever you prefer, the controls are all you need to get started. Keep an eye on the weapons you have and experiment with different mixes to see which ones work best against the robot threat.
the-malevolent-mansion-of-evil: Step into a gothic mansion where dark secrets wait to be uncovered. This game is played from a first-person view and blends action, horror, and adventure. Its gameplay is tense and creepy, keeping you on edge from one moment to the next.

The house is lovely to look at, yet its surroundings feel sinister, and that contrast gives the story extra weight. You wander through eerie hallways, uncovering the mysteries hidden inside this frightening estate.
obby-sail-for-egg: Set sail from the harbour toward ten islands, where the farther out you go, the rarer the eggs become. At each island nest, steal an egg, then outrun the hunter ship on your way home. Place the egg on your farm and it hatches into a pet that earns money.

Spend your earnings on faster boats and upgrades, and fill your Codex as you collect. You can also sail with other captains online. Walk with WASD and look with the mouse, then press E at the harbour to board your boat. Use W and S for throttle and A and D to steer. Press Tab to free the mouse, and on phones, use the joystick.
mini-dice-chess: Mini Dice Chess gives the classic board game a twist by mixing careful planning with a bit of luck. Before each move, you roll the dice, and the result decides which pieces you can move that turn. A strong plan can change in seconds, so you have to rethink your tactics every round. Matches move at a brisk pace, and you can play solo or against a friend.

Controls are simple: use a mouse click or a tap to make your moves. Whether you are new to chess or a longtime fan, the dice add unpredictability that keeps each turn interesting. Think ahead, adapt to what you roll, and outmaneuver your opponent.
chicken-merge: Chicken Merge blends merge gameplay with tower defense ideas. Your job is to field a large flock of chickens that guard your base against waves of incoming foes. To level up your birds, bring two identical chickens together and they combine into a tougher one. Then move that stronger chicken onto one of the defense lines.
Clearing each wave rewards you with coins, and those coins let you train more units. Launch the m
geometry-gunner: Geometry Gunner is an arcade game where quick reflexes and smart planning both matter. You weave past a constant wave of tireless shapes and aim your gun with care to bring each one down. Every move has to be made in an instant, so staying alert is just as important as hitting your targets.
The game is built around precision and survival. Outmaneuvering the geometric foes, choosing your shots deliberately, and making split-second calls all keep the action dynamic from start to finish.
monster-truck-simulator-game: Your journey starts in Demolish mode, where you smash through obstacles and destroy everything in your way across ten challenging levels. When you want a different kind of challenge, switch to Stunt mode to pull off wild jumps and drive on tracks that look nearly impossible, across ten more stunt levels. That makes twenty levels in total, split evenly between the two modes.

The monster vehicle handles in a realistic way, and a rewind feature lets you retry whenever you need to. You can switch between several camera views, and the game includes music and a horn to honk. On a computer, drive with WASD or the arrow keys. On mobile, use the on-screen buttons, where the race button accelerates and you brake to stop.
blindbat: BlindBat is a 2D arcade title that flips the usual bat story. Here your hero craves daylight, which goes against what nature would expect. You find your way across the open air by listening for echoes, a sonar-style method, while dodging and tricking the flocks of birds that stand in your path.

Your shots are limited, so you need to use them with care. Each shot that goes wide makes danger climb, while landing a hit gives back the supplies you need. Plan each move ahead of time so you can stay aloft and keep flying through a sky full of bird enemies.
mushroom-runners: Mushroom Runners is a never-ending running game where you keep moving forward and try to avoid whatever stands in your path. Along the way you can squash foes and pick up mushrooms that make your character grow much bigger. You also get to ride the Happy Flying Cloud, and the quick pace comes with a platforming twist.

On a phone or tablet, tap the screen to jump and swipe downward to stomp the ground. If you are playing on a computer, use the up arrow key to jump and the down arrow key to stomp. Stay sharp, because the run never really stops.
ragdoll-gun-shooter-cannon-spinner-playg: Ragdoll stickmen wait in this bright, casual 3D shooter, and your job is to clear every one of them from each level. You aim a spinning cannon and fire at the right moment to knock down the yellow mobs. The game takes its cues from Playground Man! Ragdoll Show! and Melon Playground, mixing ragdoll physics with silly, jelly-like stickmen. Your goal is to become the top marksman on the playground.

Controls are kept simple. On PC, press the left mouse button at the right moment to fire, and on mobile, tap the screen. Weapons range from a pistol up to powerful guns, and levels let you use items to take out enemies more effectively. For extra damage, try setting off exploding barrels or other objects in the scene.
car-eats-car-winter-adventure: Race against rivals on a busy highway and pass enemy cars as you go. Build your own vehicle in the incubator, then upgrade your cars and become a car tycoon. Your friends have been locked up, so your mission is to free the evil cars from prison. Good driving and turbo speed will help you in this driving simulator, which also includes police chases.

Play for monster cars and face off against the cops, then fight the boss to survive the races. Space drops bombs, X activates turbo, W is gas, and S is brake. A and D keep the car balanced, and the arrow keys can also handle gas, brake, and balancing.
parkourcraft: ParkourCraft drops you into a world made of blocks, where smooth, flowing movement is the key skill. Your job is to clear 3D platforming courses by jumping across gaps and crossing tricky ground. Watch your footing, avoid falling into pits, and move carefully to reach the treasures hidden along the way.

Every leap feels rewarding when you land it cleanly, and placing yourself well matters just as much as timing. The game gives a fresh spin on classic blocky adventures, so each course feels like its own small challenge to work through.
ropeman-3d: Ropeman 3D puts you in the role of a hero who depends on both smart planning and combat skill. You can draw on unusual powers that let you manipulate nature, move through gangster territory, and outwit your enemies. The controls are simple to pick up, and the battles carry high stakes, giving the game a lively, adrenaline-charged feel.

The world is visually striking, and you can work your way up the global leaderboard as you prove your skills against other players. Whether you are weighing your next move or reacting in the middle of a clash, the game keeps you engaged from start to finish.
ice-ball-run: In Ice Ball Run, you guide a frosty ball across intricate platforms packed with devious obstacles. Mastering the controls is essential, since each stage presents its own unique challenges that call for careful footwork and thoughtful timing. The game rewards precision and strategy, and it tests your dexterity as you work through each icy course.

Every level becomes a small test of skill, where each move you make can decide whether you succeed or fail. Progress depends on planning a few steps ahead rather than rushing. It is the kind of game that keeps you coming back as you refine your technique and aim to conquer each stage.
attack-hole: Your mission in this .io action game is to swallow every weapon in the world before the countdown reaches zero. You control a black hole, pulling in weapons as you go and racing the clock to gather as many as you can. The title is listed under PvE, which means player versus environment.

Once the collecting is done, you must take on a giant enemy and destroy it with all the weapons you have picked up. You take the role of the hero of the black hole, so the task is to build up your arsenal and then put it to use in the final fight.
snake-wiggle-master: Snake Wiggle Master! is a puzzle game about steering a snake through winding mazes. You guide it along narrow passages, and a single well-chosen move can open up the entire route ahead. Working out the right sequence is the core of the game, and the countdown keeps the pressure on as you go.

Thinking quickly while still being careful is the real test here. Some routes seem harmless at first, yet one misstep can seal off the maze. Tap to move, pick each step with care, and finish every stage before time runs out. The controls are simple and the tidy graphics keep your focus on the puzzle. Remember that order matters, beat the timer while protecting your hearts, and clear each maze to reach the next level.
car-eats-car-underwater-adventure: Car Eats Car: Underwater Adventure throws you into a fast highway race against rivals. Pass your opponents, and build your own vehicle in the incubator. Your friends have been locked up, so it's up to you to set the imprisoned evil cars free. Solid driving skill and a burst of turbo speed will help you along the way. This driving simulator also doubles as a police chase game.

Take on the role of a car tycoon, improve your machines, and play as monster cars against the cops. Space drops bombs, X triggers turbo, and W accelerates while S brakes. Keep the car steady with A and D, or use the arrow keys to gas, brake, and balance. Beat the boss to survive these races.
castel-war-3d: Castel War 3D puts you in charge of an army on a three-dimensional battlefield. You must defend your fortress from enemy attacks while gathering the resources you need to keep going. Every choice counts, so you will need to plan when and where to strike, and adjust your approach as the situation shifts.

You command a range of different units, and each one suits a different role in the fight. Victory depends on responding to the enemy in real time, since a tactic that works at one moment may need changing the next. Filed under strategy, the game rewards careful thinking and good timing for anyone who enjoys leading troops into battle.
frontline-conquest: Head into Port Valor, a first-person shooter built around combined arms. Your aim is to take control of the port by capturing flags with your squad. Pick a class, climb into tanks or other vehicles, and revive fallen teammates. Destructible cover can be blasted through during a fight.

Matches can be played online or against bots. Credits earned in battle unlock weapons and cosmetics, and some of these can also be unlocked by watching an optional video. WASD moves, the mouse aims, and left click fires, while right click aims down sights. R reloads, Shift sprints, Space jumps, and keys 1-6 select weapons and gadgets. G throws a grenade, E enters vehicles and interacts, and Escape pauses.
pop-it-3d-fidget: Everyone fidgets in their own way, whether it's tapping a foot or flexing a hand. That urge to keep moving is something most of us share. Inspired by plenty of imaginative makers, this collection gathers more than thirty of the finest fidget toys the creators could find. Many of them will leave you feeling satisfied.
This game offers objects of every sort aimed at easing anxiety. Above all, the models are made for stress management, so you can take a moment to unwind while you play.
ludo-world: Ludo World is a board game with no fixed ending, set against a range of colorful backdrops. Every roll of the dice brings a fresh challenge. Pick classic or quick mode, then climb the trophy road as you play. Each move is a chance to show who really rules the board.

Your goal is to roll the dice and guide your tokens from the starting point to the target square in the center, moving by the values you roll. If one of your tokens lands on an opponent's piece, that piece goes back to the start. You can also complete sub-quests to earn extra rewards.
dinosaur-city-hunting-destroy: Step into the body of a huge, realistic dinosaur and tear through a modern metropolis. Your goal is to flatten buildings and crush cars while tracking down specific targets to complete your missions. The 3D visuals look impressive, and the open-world setting gives you plenty of room to roam. As the apex hunter of the streets, you can wreak havoc everywhere while trying to outlast the city's forces and rule the roads.
This is a simulation game built around your choices in the city. To get started, click the mouse or tap the screen. After that,
poison-candy-obby-1-or-2-player: Poison Candy: Obby 1 Or 2-Player is an obby game built around a sneaky duel with a rival. You pick which candy is laced with poison, then use clever moves to get your opponent to eat it. The theme casts you as a detective in a bright, colorful world styled after popular obby games.

You can share one device with a friend or get matched against a random opponent. Bluffing is a big part of the fun, since skipping turns can confuse your rival and steer them toward the poisoned treat. On a computer, move with WASD and jump with Space. On mobile, use the joystick to move, the button in the lower right corner to jump, and swipe the screen to rotate the camera. Become the king of the party by outplaying your friend and surviving this sweet but dangerous obby adventure.
shape-transforming-shifting-run: Shape Transforming: Shifting Run is an arcade race where you switch between forms as you sprint across a range of landscapes. Your task is to change into the character that fits the current terrain so you can get past obstacles and keep moving. You might drive a car on land, fly an airplane through the air, or sail a ship across the sea. Each form has its own strengths and hurdles.

The game looks polished, with detailed environments and characters that make every run pleasant to watch. Funny animations and playful sound effects add a lighthearted feel throughout. The pace is quick, so you need sharp reflexes and fast decisions to stay ahead. Newcomers and experienced players alike can pick it up, since it is designed to be enjoyable for everyone.
stealth-robbery-of-a-house-together: You sneak through a house in this arcade game for mobile and desktop, either alone or with a friend sharing one device. Your aim is to take out as much furniture and valuables as you can without being caught by security. Guards patrol the rooms, so if one sees you, you need to run. You can also rely on your abilities to stay out of sight.

Carry the loot to the van to fill the progress bar and finish the level. More valuable items push the bar up faster. On PC, Player 1 moves with W, A, S and D, while Player 2 uses the arrow keys. On a phone, a single player moves by sliding a finger across the screen, and the left player slides a finger along the left side in two-player mode.
dash-masters: Dash Masters sends you climbing up a huge metal shaft, where you push against gravity with a series of timed hops and powerful dashes. Along the way you must take down robot enemies and pick up rewards. A deadly laser is always hot on your trail, so you need to keep moving to stay ahead of it.

Each jump higher brings you nearer to your goal, and the whole challenge depends on precise timing and steady nerve. It is a mobile game that rewards careful rhythm as much as quick reflexes, making every climb feel like a fresh test of your abilities.
mine-brothers-the-magic-temple: Mine Brothers The Magic Temple is a new adventure, escape, and puzzle game. You guide two characters, one fire and one water, through dangerous mazes on every level. Both must reach the same place, so each move needs care. Fans of FireBoy and Watergirl may feel right at home here.

Along the way you will face obstacles, puzzles, and dangerous enemies that you must solve or overcome before you can reach the higher levels. Finish each mission to unlock rewards and earn kizkoins. Move with WASD or the arrow keys, press the spacebar to switch characters, and use E for actions. On mobile devices, use the on-screen game buttons instead.
3d-laane-runner: 3D Laane Runner sends you sprinting through three-dimensional scenery, and you can change the camera angle to see what lies ahead. Your run depends on careful movement and good timing, so you'll need platforming techniques to leap and weave past the obstacles in your path. Gathering power-ups along the way can help you build a higher score.

Chasing a top score is the main aim, and the game adds a competitive streak that pushes you to keep improving. Its immersive setting keeps you absorbed as you play, and you can also take on friends to compare results. It's a good pick for anyone who enjoys running games with a bit of challenge.
garfield-rush: Garfield Rush is an endless running mobile game where you take control of Garfield, Odie, or Nemo. After a scheming cat named Harry tricks you, you set off in pursuit. While you run, you snatch floating gold coins and dodge vehicles and other obstacles. You can also leap onto the roofs of vehicles to spot shortcuts.

Along the way, you can pick up coins, score, elastic shoes, jetpacks, magnets, and booster packs. The faster you go, the more coins and points you can earn by switching direction quickly. Eighteen costumes can be unlocked through in-game purchases, and you can gather certain items to help you along. Your character can also chow down on lasagna, spaghetti, Neapolitan pizza, hot dogs, burritos, fried chicken, and more. To play, just use your mouse or click.
dinosaur-bone-game: In Dinosaur Bone Game, you play as an explorer digging for fossils hidden beneath the ground. Work slowly and carefully so you do not break the bones you uncover. Each one you collect moves you closer to completing a full skeleton, and every skeleton you assemble helps reveal the secrets of the prehistoric world.

The whole game is controlled with a mouse, because every button is selected by clicking. It falls into the puzzle category, so you will need to think about where to dig next and how each find fits into the bigger picture. Whether you are in it for a relaxed afternoon or a bit of skill-based fun, this dinosaur adventure lets you explore at your own pace.
super-chains: Super Chains is a math puzzle game where you link number blocks together. The chains can run upward, downward, or hold matching numbers, and each completed link reveals a magical creature. Your job is to plan your chains carefully, act quickly, and use Heroic Helpers at the right moments to get through tough levels and earn the title of champion.

The game looks calm and colorful, but the puzzles grow harder as you go, so you will need to think a few steps ahead. Choosing when to call on a helper can make the difference between clearing a board and getting stuck. If you enjoy number puzzles with a bit of fantasy flavor, this one offers a fresh way to practice your logic.
catch-the-roober: Slip on your badge and get ready to tidy up the town. This fast-moving action title casts you as a brave sheriff chasing a crew of thieves who wear red masks. Be careful, because these crooks carry oversized loot bottles and are eager to bolt. Sneak up on them, plan your moves, and corner each one so you can knock it out and keep the community safe.
The bright 3D visuals and gameplay that keeps pulling you back make every chase feel worthwhile. Controls are simple: click with a mouse or tap the screen.
egg-raid-nest-heist: You play a small thief with an oversized backpack and a real weakness for eggs. Your job is to slip past geese, lizards and drakes, lift an egg from a nest, and haul it back to your place, where it hatches into a pet that brings in coins for you. Gather 18 pets across three worlds, and improve your gear and your base along the way. Rebirth grants bonuses that last for good.

Move with WASD or the arrow keys, or drag to get around. Hold Shift to sneak and press Space to dash. Stay out of the guards' vision cones, duck into bushes to stay hidden, then grab an egg from a nest and carry it home to hatch a pet.
spiral-blitz: This arcade skill game has you guide a bouncing ball through twisting, tumbling helix mazes. Quick reflexes and a good sense of space matter most. Spin the platforms around to open a safe route for the ball, and steer clear of the barriers in different colors.

Build up speed to smash through each level. Every stage calls for careful, precise movement, so take your time lining up each bounce. Meet the helix challenge by moving with accuracy from start to finish.
field-master: Field Master is a laid-back farming sim where you sit at the controls of strong farm vehicles. You start by ploughing wide fields with a tractor, then move on to planting seeds with precise seeders. Crops need looking after while they grow, and once they are ready, you climb into large combines to gather the yield. Every stage, from preparing the soil to the final harvest, is handled by you, which gives it a mix of easygoing fun and true-to-life detail that suits farming fans and casual gamers.

Controls: On desktop, use W, A, S, D or the arrow keys to drive in each direction. Press Q to swap between vehicles and E to load or unload. On mobile, use the on-screen arrow buttons to steer up, down, left, and right.
offroad-jeep-game-suv-driving: Take the wheel of tough SUVs in this off-road driving simulator, where demanding courses test your handling. The career mode includes seven levels, and each one combines checkpoint missions with racing challenges. Your route might lead through mountains, mud roads, hills, or city streets. Reach each checkpoint on time, and aim to win the races.
On a computer, drive with the WASD keys or the arrow keys. On a phone or tablet, use the on-screen butt
bouncy-dunk: Bouncy Dunk is an arcade challenge built around quick reactions and steady focus. Basketball shots come at you in rapid succession, and a single click is all it takes to guide your moves through them. As you practice, you can unlock 24 unique players and keep refining your skills.

Your main aim is to build long scoring streaks. Keep your timing sharp and your focus steady, and see how far a run can take you. The whole experience is designed to feel quick, playful, and absorbing from start to finish.
smart-looter: Smart Looter puts you in the role of a thief planning daring heists. Your main tool is stealth, so you must slip past watchful guards without getting caught. Each level is filled with treasure, and you'll need to move carefully while staying one step ahead of the guards. Clever thinking helps, but quick reflexes matter just as much when a situation turns risky.

Success here depends on patience. Rushing in usually leads to trouble, so take time to study each layout and plan your route before you act. Strategy is the key to growing into a skilled thief who can pull off a clean escape. The challenge is outsmarting the guards one careful move at a time, and the question of whether you can loot without being nabbed is up to you.
draw-bridge-puzzle-2: Draw Bridge Puzzle 2 is a Clicker-category puzzle game where you play as a bridge designer. Sketch your own path with your finger to help a motor or a stick figure get through trouble. The game offers two modes. In car mode, you draw a sturdy bridge so a motor can cross gaps, broken roads, and dangerous obstacles to reach the goal. In save mode, you draw a protective shield to keep the stick figure safe from harm.
The levels grow more complicated as you move forward, so you need to plan before you draw. Saving ink matters, and your bridge must stay stable. Tap and drag to play.
fortress-clash: Fortress Clash is a strategy tower defense game where you build a fort and an army on your cart. Pick blocks or units from the tray along the bottom, then tap the grid to place them. Blocks cost coins, so you'll need to decide what to spend. When your setup is ready, press the Battle button, and your archers and other units will automatically fire at the enemy fort.

You win by destroying the enemy king. You can knock him off his cart, bury him in rubble, or blast through his walls. Every victory pays out coins and lets you choose a bonus reward. Spend your coins on the Upgrade screen to level up your units and unlock cannons, crossbows, lasers, and grenades. Your progress is kept through a reload. Mouse and touch both work, and no keyboard is needed.
2048-merge-blocks: Tap a number tile and every linked tile with the same value lights up, whether it touches sideways, up and down, or diagonally. Tap again to fuse them into one larger tile where you pressed. You start with small 2s and 4s and work your way up toward 2048, 8192, and beyond. Each merge adds to your score, and chain reactions can happen automatically. Levels ask you to reach a target tile before your moves run out, while endless mode challenges you to get the highest score possible.

Four collections of ten handmade puzzles each, from Beginner to Master, sit alongside a new daily challenge. Quests earn coins, and global leaderboards show how you compare with players around the world. Undo, Hammer, and Shuffle power-ups help when you get stuck. There is no time pressure, so you can play at your own pace, and the game works offline.
supermarket-expert-idle: Supermarket Expert Idle puts you in charge of a busy grocery store that begins as a modest shop and gradually grows into a large retail empire. Your job is to make smart choices with your resources, improve your facilities over time, and make sure shoppers leave happy while your business expands. The controls are straightforward, so you can focus on running the store.

The management gameplay pulls you in, and it is easy to keep playing as you work toward becoming a top name in the industry. Watching your small operation develop into a major business is the main draw here.
epic-robot-combat-simulator: Slip into your combat suit, load up your arsenal, and go after every foe scattered across the stars. This mech pilot game puts your piloting talent to the test, so you can see how well you really handle a robot in battle.

On a computer, use WASD to move around, the number keys to swap weapons, and Shift to dash. Aim and fire with the mouse. On a phone or tablet, the left joystick moves your robot while the right joystick aims and shoots. Tap the buttons in the bottom right corner to change weapons or dash.
k-challenge-456: You find yourself trapped on an unfamiliar island when a mysterious invitation arrives, bringing a set of challenges with it: 123, Stop, Glass Bridge, Marbles, Tug of War, and Ppopgi. Your goal is to win the 456 million reward and break out of this secret area.
Playing is easy, since you only need to tap or slide. This hypercasual title is built in 3D with HTML5 and blends arena battles, obstacle avoidance, and memory tests into one experience.
backflip-master-parkour-stunts: Backflip Master 3D is a physics-based arcade game about pulling off flips from high places. You leap from rooftop ledges, tall cliffs, and city platforms, as well as gym mats and construction sites. Crouch to build jump power, then tuck into a ball to speed up your spin and let go at the perfect instant to land on both feet. Touch down in the center of the target for top points and three stars. Misjudge the rotation, though, and your character takes a funny ragdoll tumble.

Controls are simple. On desktop, left click to jump and hold to flip. On mobile, tap and hold the screen. A beginner tutorial guides you step by step and adds mid-air slow motion to help you nail your first flips. Coins earned from great stunts unlock new characters, outfits, accessories, and stunt skins. Your goal is to finish every level and earn the title of Backflip Master.
2d-platformer-coin: Step into a playful, dreamlike land in 2D Platformer Coin, where you take on the role of a bold explorer. Your character can hover through the air and dive downward, so you'll need to plan each move carefully to reach gold coins that are hard to catch. The obstacles are clever and the surroundings are tricky, so every jump counts.

Strategy is just as important here as your moves. Work out how to get past each barrier, and watch for hidden routes that open up as you explore. Your goal is to round up every treasure in the game and finish with the upper hand.
lipuzz-water-sort-puzzle: Lipuzz is a brain game where you sort liquids by pouring them between containers. Your goal is to move and group the colored liquids so each container ends up with a single color. The puzzles begin simply but get harder as you advance, so you need to think ahead before each pour. Be careful to avoid deadlocks, since a poor move can leave you with no way forward.

The game has bright, lively visuals that make each level pleasant to look at. Every stage presents a new arrangement of liquids to untangle, testing your planning and logic. If you enjoy careful, step-by-step thinking and colorful puzzles, this one has plenty to work through.
solitaire-tripeaks: Dive into the depths with this TriPeaks solitaire title, where the theme centers on the mysteries of the deep sea. It takes the traditional card game of solitaire and offers a range of puzzles that give your mind a good workout.

To play, clear the table one card at a time. Pick any card whose rank is one step above or one step below the card drawn from the deck. Each match removes that card from the layout, so you keep working toward emptying the board.
mini-car-simulator: Mini Car Simulator puts you behind the wheel across 40 levels packed with challenges and obstacles. You can drive through three settings: busy city streets, peaceful forests, and sunny beach roads. Every stage tests your driving as you handle sharp corners and tricky routes. The smooth controls and immersive gameplay make it a good fit for anyone who enjoys car simulation and adventure games.

On mobile, on-screen buttons move your car forward, backward, left, and right. A booster button gives you a burst of extra speed when you need it. Tap the camera button to switch between different viewing angles while you drive. If your car gets stuck or crashes, press the reborn button to get back on the road.
size-up-giant-fighter-game: Sprint through bright city streets while steering clear of traps. Collect allies that match your color to grow stronger along the way. Shifting obstacles will keep you on your toes, and merging with crowds boosts your power. Every level is a chance to expand your force and claim the battlefield.
Rival groups stand in your way, so you will need to outsmart them with clever moves. The game blends size and strategy, rewarding both bold growth and careful planning. Keep expanding, ke
escape-strange-girl-s-house-2: You play a private detective searching for a person who vanished a month ago. The trail leads to a remote house hiding a sinister secret, and a peculiar girl lives there whose behavior is more unsettling than anything you could picture. Wander through every room, pick up items, combine them, and use them in the right spots to move forward.

This first-person point-and-click adventure pairs moody music and logic puzzles with a murky story where every sound and object counts. Each clue brings you closer to the truth about the missing person and the chilling history of the house. Tap or click to examine locations, read notes closely for hints, and mix inventory items to create new tools. Your aim is to learn what happened and escape alive.
the-lost-joystick: Set out on a lively quest in The Lost Joystick to win back a controller that someone has taken from you. Bright pixel artwork pairs with demanding platforming, and you will need to work your way past tricky traps as you go.

Bizarre creatures stand in your path, so you will have to battle them along the way. Watch for hidden treasures tucked into the action, too. Each trial brings you a step nearer to recovering your missing joystick, and the whole adventure is packed with surprises and nostalgic charm that keeps the fun going.
bubbla-boing: Bubbla Boing brings back the feel of a classic breakout game. You steer a paddle along the bottom of the screen and bounce a ball upward to pop every bubble in sight. The paddle responds smoothly to your input, so small adjustments feel natural. Keep an eye on the ball, because if it drops past your paddle and leaves the screen, you lose the round.

The game offers multiple levels, and the difficulty rises steadily as you progress. Power-ups and bonuses add extra help along the way. Press the space bar to launch the ball, and use the left and right arrow keys to move your paddle. Clear every level to reach the highest score possible.
granny-horror-village: Granny Horror Village is a free, first-person horror game that runs in your web browser. You look carefully at everything around you and work through a long list of demanding puzzles to find your way out. It is a single-player title built with HTML5 and WebGL, filed under action and escape games.

The 3D graphics look sharp, and the gameplay feels intense from start to finish. Move with W, A, S and D, jump with the Space bar, and hold Shift to run. Use these controls to explore the spooky setting and tackle each challenge as it comes.
sticker-art-book-puzzle: A calm, colorful puzzle game that swaps pencils for stickers. You fill detailed drawings with bright stickers, choosing from a wide palette and pairing each color with matching stickers. It is a fresh take on adult coloring, and the relaxed pace lets you unwind while your artwork slowly takes shape.

Beyond coloring, it doubles as a brain teaser. Follow the numbers and shapes to place each sticker in its matching spot and uncover a hidden image. Levels grow more intricate and detailed as you progress through the color-by-number stages, and the game aims to sharpen your thinking along the way. When a puzzle gets tough, hints and power-ups are there to help.
bad-cat-simulator-pet-game: Step into the paws of a mischievous cat who wanders through a comfortable house, stirring up trouble by playing tricks on the people living there. You jump, tiptoe, and claw your way through a series of playful tasks, gaining levels that open up new feline skills. Use the many objects and rooms around you to cause all sorts of havoc and grow into the most notorious prankster around.
mansion-design-match-3: Work through blast-style match-3 stages to restore a grand house and its grounds. Each room can be transformed with a wide range of classic furniture and fancy decor, and you can also redo your own bathroom and the garden. Follow the storyline to uncover secrets hidden throughout the mansion. The levels are fun yet tough, and they feature special boosters and explosive combinations to help you along.

A young lady casts spells as you swap and line up tiles, so every move brings a little magic into play. Matching three or more of the same item creates stronger boosters. Meet each level's objectives, collect Scrolls, and finish Tasks to move forward. Use your boosters at the right moment, and keep the interior of your home well managed as you go.
the-eggsecutioner: The Eggsecutioner is a game about smashing eggs, where good timing and a steady aim help you break as many as you can. The action moves quickly, so you need to stay sharp from start to finish. The controls are easy to pick up, and the scoring is packed with action, so every smash feels rewarding.

Along the way, the game tests both your speed and your accuracy. Eggs fly everywhere, making the whole thing a messy, cheerful mix of chaos. If you enjoy games that reward quick reactions and careful aim, this one gives you a lively challenge to work through.
zap: ZAP is a puzzle card game you can enjoy online. Your aim is to empty your hand before anyone else does. Each turn, you play a card that shares a color or a number with the card on the table. If nothing in your hand fits, you keep drawing from the pile until a match turns up. Watch out for the moment you're down to a single card: you need to press the "1" button right then, or two penalty cards will land in your hand.

The game is built around quick, competitive rounds that work well with multiplayer, and it's a good fit for anyone who likes card games. Think ahead about which colors and numbers you'll need next, and use that planning to block opponents and race them to the finish.
gt-truck-racer: GT Truck Racer lets you take the wheel of powerful trucks and drive across different cities in a range of weather conditions. You steer along demanding roads, dodge obstacles, and aim to reach your destination safely. The surroundings feel lifelike, and the controls stay smooth, so your attention holds from start to finish. Completing missions gives you a chance to put your driving skills to the test.

Everything runs through simple on-screen controls. Tap the left or right button to steer, and switch between camera views at any time for a clearer picture of the road. When you need extra speed, press the booster button for an instant boost. The gameplay responds quickly to your input, and the dynamic action keeps each drive feeling fresh.
bubble-war: Bubble War is an arcade bubble shooter where you control the launcher. You can play alone in single-player mode or face players from around the world in real-time battles. The game is also listed as a two-player title. Solo mode offers hundreds of levels, each built to test your accuracy and planning. Match three or more bubbles of the same color to clear them from the board, and you will earn powerful boosters that help you along the way.
Aiming is straightforward. Press and hold, drag to line up your angle, then let go to fire. Every sh
survive-zombie-arena: Survive Zombie Arena blends wave-based survival with tower defense and quick shooting. You step into a bright, Roblox-style arena where large crowds of zombies rush toward you. Your job is to guard your base and get through every dangerous wave that comes your way. Players who enjoy Roblox-style battles should feel at home with the colorful setting and straightforward action controls.

Getting around is simple. On PC, use W, A, S, and D to move, Space to jump, and Shift to run, while F fires your weapon. Aim as you go and keep adjusting your defenses as the enemies press in. On mobile, tap the on-screen buttons to operate the game.
ringo-starfish: Dive beneath the waves with Ringo Starfish on a quest to uncover treasures hidden across a mystical island. You will need to master the way the platforms behave while steering clear of dangerous traps along the route.

Checkpoints placed with care along the way let you mark your progress, and Ringo's powerful firepower and unusual abilities help him take on enemies. Gather the shimmering crystals you come across as you go. This retro arcade adventure is a platformer at its core.
nuts-bolts-sort: Nuts Bolts Sort mixes mental exercise with a calming break. Your job is to group nuts so that each bolt holds only one color. The rules are easy to pick up, yet each new stage asks more of your memory as you work out which pieces match. Tap any bolt to move a nut onto another one, but only when the colors line up and the target bolt has room for it. If you get boxed in, you can restart the level whenever you like. Free props are on hand to help you get past tough levels.
Pleasing visuals, gentle sound effects, and ASMR-style touches create a soothing atmosphere that can hold your attention for hours. It suits anyone wanting to wind down after a busy or stressful day.
car-escape: In this traffic escape game, you steer a car out of a jammed street. Every move matters, since a single misstep can mean either freedom or gridlock. Arrows on screen show which way each vehicle can travel, so you check whether its path is open before you act. Quick reflexes and a clever mind help you learn to weave through busy roads.

To move a vehicle, tap it lightly and it will travel in the direction the arrow points. Your goal is to guide every car away from the crowded area. Plan the order in which cars leave, because moving them in the wrong sequence can cause crashes with others on the route. Careful sequencing keeps traffic flowing smoothly from start to fin
super-pork: Super Pork is a playful shooter where you pilot a brave flying pig who must push back an alien invasion. The game has a charming pixel-art retro look, and it asks you to weave around incoming threats while aiming your shots carefully through a series of tough stages. Grab power-ups along the way to gain an edge and catch the alien enemies off guard.

Expect a light, quirky mood throughout, with a clear focus on careful dodging and smart shooting. Every level brings new challenges, so planning your moves matters as much as quick reactions. It's a fun pick for anyone who enjoys a whimsical, strategy-minded take on the shoot-'em-up genre.
my-pet-care-salon-obby-dress-up-3d: Step into a charming setting where you run your own animal care business. This relaxed 3D simulation has you bathe your pets, look after their needs, and decorate them while you train them to feel happier and healthier. Finish straightforward jobs, expand your salon, and open up new features as you progress.

Every pet relies on your attention, and the game moves at a gentle pace with a warm, cozy feel and plenty of sweet moments with adorable companions. It suits anyone who loves animals and calm casual games. On a phone, a joystick moves your character, a swipe on the right side of the screen moves the camera, and a jump button makes you hop. On a computer, the WASD keys move you, holding the mouse turns the camera, and the spacebar jumps.
basket-champs: Basket Champs is a basketball game where being tall doesn't give you an edge. What counts is your skill and your plan for each match. You pick a team, score more points than your opponents, and work your way up through the championship rounds. It runs on any device and costs nothing to play, so it's a good fit for anyone who loves hoops and wants to keep playing for a long time.

Every game asks you to think about your moves as well as your aim. Whether you're new to basketball games or already a seasoned player, the simulation gives you plenty to enjoy. Are you ready to take over the court?
panda-adventure: Panda Adventure is a platformer where you take on the role of a daring and inquisitive panda. Your path leads through colorful, demanding worlds, each one designed with care. Along the way you will explore, take part in fast-paced action, and tackle a variety of fun challenges that keep you engaged from the first moment to the last.

Controls are simple. Press W or the Up arrow to move forward, S or the Down arrow to move backward, A or the Left arrow to move left, and D or the Right arrow to move right. Any button on screen can be selected with your mouse.
super-stickman-hook: In Super Stickman Hook, you guide a stickman by tapping to fire a hook, which helps him make high jumps and clear every obstacle in his way. The game belongs to the hypercasual category and carries the jump and stickman tags, so its simple one-tap design is easy to pick up.

Your goal is to perform a string of acrobatic tricks in a row without missing a beat. You can play with a mouse or by touch, depending on your device. Try to keep the chain going as long as you can and see how smoothly you can move your stickman through each challenge.
choo-choo-charles-revenge: Choo Choo Charles Revenge combines horror, shooting, and survival in one game. A demonic train is loose and will eliminate anyone in its path. Your goal is to complete each level and destroy the train. You must search each map for keys and follow the steps to move forward. Shoot all your enemies, and keep moving and running around the map so they cannot catch you.
Controls are simple. Use the arrow keys or the WASD keys to move, and press Spacebar to jump. Hold CTRL to crouch and Shift to run. Right-click to shoot, and move the mouse to turn the camera.
tanks-2d-battle-with-ratte: Tanks 2D Battle with Ratte throws you into armored combat across shifting landscapes. You guide your tank through each terrain, planning every move so you can catch enemy tanks off guard. Careful positioning and well-timed maneuvers help you stay one step ahead.

You can also optimize your tank's upgrades to improve how it performs in battle. The opponents are controlled by a challenging AI, so each encounter gives you a chance to refine your tactics. If you enjoy shooting games, this one rewards smart thinking as much as quick reactions, and the battle keeps you engaged from start to finish.
jump-will-jump: In Jump Will Jump, your hero jumps, dashes, and wields various weapons to crush everything in the way, all with a single control. It is a clicker with adventure and jumping elements, and its simple design makes it easy to start and hard to put down.

Your goal is to reach the highest score you can. Along the way, you can collect costumes to dress up your hero. To advance, use the right mouse button or tap the screen if you are playing on a touch device.
crowd-rush: Start with a small group of runners and guide them along a bright track floating in the sky, gathering more as you go. Each gate offers a maths choice: add, multiply, subtract or divide, so pick the one that leaves you with the largest group. Dodge hazards such as whirling blades, swinging bars, shoving walls and holes in the path, and bump into rival groups to win head-to-head clashes by outnumbering them.

When you cross the line, you can stack your runners into a tall tower and climb the x1 to x10 steps for a multiplier bonus, or you can face a huge boss. Coins you collect let you improve your group and boost your income, and you can unlock eight playful outfits. Steer with a drag to the left or right, or press A and D or the arrow keys.
car-eats-car-volcanic-adventure: Racing along a busy highway, you go head to head with rivals and pass them one by one. Build your own vehicle in the incubator. Your buddies have been locked up, so it falls to you to free the evil cars from jail. Solid driving skill and a turbo boost will help you keep up in this wild driving simulator, which also doubles as a police chase game.

Step into the role of a car tycoon and upgrade your machines. You can also take control of monster cars and face off against the police. Survive by defeating the boss in these races. Space drops bombs, X fires the turbo, W accelerates, S brakes, and A and D keep the car balanced. The arrow
obby-snow-shoveling: In this snowy multiplayer clicker, you swing a shovel through drifts, and every scoop makes you stronger. Treasure is frozen in the snow, and you can dig it out and sell it at the shop for cash. That money goes toward sturdier shovels and auras. Nine snowy biomes lie ahead, with tougher snow and rarer finds the deeper you go. Rebirth when you want bigger rewards.

Controls are simple. Use WASD to move and the mouse to look around, then click while standing in the snow to shovel. Hold E to grab a treasure. Deeper biomes require more Strength, so keep shoveling. On phones, a joystick and on-screen buttons take over. You can also shovel alongside other players online.
motorcycle-racer-road-mayhem: Ride through busy city streets and open highways in this racing game, where your job is to dodge other vehicles without crashing. Each motorcycle you unlock is quicker and more powerful than the last, and every model handles differently, so you will need to get a feel for each one. You can also upgrade your bike's stats to
color-snake-3d-online: Color Snake 3D Online lets you take the shape of adorable animals as you wind through a bright, colorful landscape. Success depends on matching the colors around you, so keep your eyes on the path ahead. The pace is quick and arcade-style, and it puts your reflexes to the test, since the obstacles you face keep switching colors.

Sharp thinking and careful timing matter a great deal in this absorbing journey. Survival is never guaranteed, so every turn counts. It's a snake game built around fast decisions and steady focus, and it's up to you to see how far you can get.
subway-surfer-seoul: Dive down into the subway and start a new adventure in Subway Surfers: Seoul, an endless runner. Dodge obstacles, trains, and more while collecting coins. Stay clear of the grumpy inspector, because he is always close behind and will catch you if you slow down.

This arcade game uses 3D graphics and runs in the browser with HTML5. It is tagged as hypercasual, action, and adventure. Your task is simple: run as far as you possibly can and see how much distance you cover before the chase ends.
color-snake-run: Color Snake Run is a 3D arcade game in which a colorful snake glides through shifting tracks. Speed, concentration, and a sharp eye for color all play a part in staying alive. Expect obstacles, glowing routes, and sudden twists along the way. It is a fast runner with a casual feel and a puzzle side to it.
Your task is simple yet demanding: lead the snake through every obstacle by matching the correct color. Controls are easy to learn, since a mouse click or a tap is all it takes to play.
marble-color-sort: Marble Color Sort is a puzzle game built around sorting colored marbles. It is a three-dimensional brain teaser where the marbles move according to physics, and the challenge is to get each one from the upper trays into the boxes below that share its shade.

Tap on a tray to let a marble fall, then watch it roll and bounce in a lifelike way. Dropped marbles land on a circular conveyor belt that keeps moving, so timing and planning matter. Each bottom box has three slots for one color, and filling those three slots packs the marb
battleops: Battleops is a first person shooter set in a military world overrun by zombies, and it can be played offline. Its storyline unfolds gradually, drawing you through a plot that keeps you curious about what comes next. Along the way you'll face bosses that test your skills, along with a wide range of enemy types. You can set the difficulty to suit you, and each mission calls for careful planning and smart tactics.

As you advance, you'll discover new weapons across levels that shift and change as you go. The graphics are detailed and add a lot to the experience, making the outbreak feel vivid from start to finish.
perfect-snipe-online: In this shooter, you customize your own sniper and take aim at enemies that stand far away and never stop moving. You calculate the path your bullet will travel so you can hit your mark exactly. Some levels add obstacles and moving objects that get in the way of your aim, but each attempt is a chance to improve. Keep trying until you complete every level.

Build up the highest score you can and collect different weapons to finish your missions. The graphics are funny and the gameplay is entertaining. It works on mobile phones, tablets, and desktop computers. The controls are simple: on a computer, move the mouse to aim and release the click to fire; on a touchscreen, touch to aim and lift your finger to shoot.
the-black-and-white: In this platformer, you guide a pair of mismatched protagonists, each with their own special skills. Together they face a series of brain-teasing challenges that twist the mind. The path leads through a world full of portals, where you piece together clues and uncover the hidden secrets behind it all.

Progress depends on careful planning and teamwork, so you will need to think strategically about how the pair works together. Visuals are striking throughout, giving the adventure plenty to take in. Your aim is to guide these two odd companions back home.
keep-her-alive: Instead of battling foes head-on, this puzzle title has you redirect them so they end up hitting each other. You spin the whole scene around, adjusting angles until the enemies' own gunfire clears the way. The margin for error is tiny: a single slightly-off degree means the girl is lost, and the game gives you no retries. Take your time, study the layout, and line up each shot with care.

Controls are simple. Rotate objects with A and D or with the Left and Right Arrow keys. Fire by clicking the Left Mouse Button or pressing the Space Bar. Every move counts, so plan before you pull the trigger.
roller-ski-queen: Roller Ski Queen puts you on an icy course where you need both skill and poise to get through each run. Your moves include flips, spins, and quick dodges to keep you moving. Along the way you can pick up upgrades and coins. As the challenges grow harder, you can also unlock stylish outfits that add a touch of glamour to your speedy ride.

Every round asks you to balance fast movement with fashion-forward flair. The aim is to earn the crown by surviving the frosty tracks at high speed, with the increasing difficulty testing your timing at every turn.
robby-1-to-jump-power-per-second: Each second that passes in this obstacle course adds 1 jump power to your character. Your goal is to score as many points as you can and claim first place on the leaderboard. Along the way, you can also unlock pets.

The game offers two maps, Day and Night, each with its own towers and finishing platforms. On a computer, use W, A, S and D to move, the mouse to look around, and the Space bar to jump. Press Tab or Escape to turn the cursor on or off. On a phone, use the game interface to play, and move anywhere on the screen to change the camera view.
anna-s-story-dress-up-diy: Paper doll fans will feel at home in Anna's Story: Dress Up DIY, where you style Anna for all sorts of events. You might outfit her for a costume party, a romantic date, or a festive celebration such as Halloween or Christmas. The wardrobe holds plenty of clothing and accessories suited to each occasion, so a spooky Halloween costume and a sparkly Christmas outfit are both within reach.

The game has a soft, charming look and fairy tale themes that make dressing Anna feel like working on a little princess. Every look you put together adds to her story. Let your imagination lead the way and design unique outfits for her. When you finish one you love, you can save it and pass it along to friends so they can enjoy it too.
throw-sword: Throw Sword puts you in charge of a stickman who hurls swords at rivals. Your job is to aim each shot, throw with the right amount of force, and strike at the right moment so that foes fall before they can take you down. The gameplay is kept simple, but the pace is quick, and the combat comes with eye-catching effects that make every hit stand out.

Turn your stickman with the A and D keys or the Left and Right arrow keys. Press Z to collect a sword and to throw it. Sharpen your reflexes, chase high scores, and see how far you can go on the way to becoming a sword-throwing master.
hexa-sort-master: Hexa Sort Master invites you to sort, stack, and merge colorful hexagon tiles in a calm setting. Tiles that share a color merge on their own as you go. The game is easy to pick up and gives your brain a gentle workout. Each challenging level keeps your mind engaged without any rush.

To play, tap a stack of hexagon tiles to lift it, then choose the best spot to set it down. Think ahead so you don't block your own moves. When you get stuck, boosters can shuffle the board or clear tiles, and power-ups can help you solve trickier puzzles. Rela
soccer-dash: Soccer Dash is a football title where you guide a ball past obstacles and defenders, then kick it into the net. You aim by dragging your finger or mouse to pick the kick's direction, and letting go sends the ball flying. While you hold the drag, the action slows down so you can line up your shot with care.

Your objective is to get around every trap on the field and finish with a goal. Controls are simple: swipe to set up the ball, adjust the angle of your kick, and release to launch it. Each attempt asks you to read the layout and plan a route that avoids the hazards.
stock-car-hero: Stock Car Hero is a 3D arcade racer that takes you across North America in the Stock Car Series. Weave between other vehicles on the road, use a boost to shoot through banked corners, and pick up coins along the way. Those coins let you improve your car before the next race.
Controls are simple. On a phone or tablet, touch the screen to steer. On a computer, use the cursor keys or the WASD keys to drive. The game runs on both mobile and desktop.
smash-master: Smash Master is a 3D puzzle game built around physics. You operate a cannon and fire cannonballs at towers of stacked items, including crates, barrels, jars, fruit, and other objects that tumble to the ground. Look for the spots where a hit will do the most good, then let the chain reactions work for you.

Each stage brings a new structure and its own challenge, and you only get a limited number of shots, so planning ahead matters. Aim the cannon, then tap or release to launch the ball. Once you meet the objective before your shots run out, you can clear the level and move on to the next challenging build.
obby-1-roll-ice-cream: Roll a growing ball of ice cream across the sweet fields, where every fresh tile you touch wraps onto your giant roll. Then head north onto the Sweet Road, where each biome has a buyer who sets off after you. The deeper they chase you before catching up, the more cash they will pay for your roll.

When a buyer catches you, press E to sell, or watch a short video to pass on the offer and keep running for a better price. Move with WASD and look around with the mouse. Press E at shops to browse better scoops, flavors, and pets. Rebirth whenever you want a fresh start, and play online alongside other people.
cave-miner: Cave Miner sends you on an underground dig where steady tapping uncovers buried treasure. Persistence pays off here, so the more you keep at it, the more you tend to gain. Spend what you collect on better tools that let you dig through deeper layers, each one holding rare and valuable ores.

Every cave you explore feels different, so there is always something new to find as your mining skills grow. Each step deeper adds to your wealth, turning a long session of tapping into a steady climb.
minibattles-2-3-4-5-6-player-games: MiniBattles brings together many minigames you can play with friends, with up to six people competing at the same time. Every battle is an all-against-all contest that ends with just one winner. A counter tracks how many battles each player has won, so you can organize a tournament and see who comes out ahead.

The lineup includes Soccer, Cars, War Tanks, Sumo, Archers, Vikings, Spaceships, and more. Each game uses a single button per player. Player 1 presses C, Player 2 presses N, Player 3 presses P, Player 4 presses Q, Player 5 uses the Left key, and Player 6 uses the Right key.
courageous-sniper: Courageous Sniper is a game centered on precision, where every shot puts your strategic thinking to the test. Each mission asks you to take down threats with a sniper rifle, and you need to be careful about who is nearby. Civilian safety matters just as much as hitting your target, so every decision counts. Missions bring plenty of tension, and you must keep your focus while the pressure builds.
Across its captivating scenarios, you can hone your aim and build the calm need
funny-finds-hidden-object-game: Funny Finds is a traditional hidden object title with a lighthearted tone. You explore the scene by moving around the screen, and the task panel shows which items you need to locate. Keep an eye on those highlighted targets, then search each level until you spot them all and click on each one.

The game works with a mouse or on mobile, so you can play on a desktop or a phone. It sits in the Hidden Object category and carries the Funny tag, which reflects the playful feel of its scenes. Each stage asks you to hunt for specific things, making it a straightforward challenge for anyone who enjoys careful searching.
supermarket-simulator-dream-store: Start with a small shop and gradually turn it into a busy store. You arrange the layout and add decorations meant to draw shoppers in, then hire staff and train them so they can do their jobs well. Keep an eye on incoming stock requests, and set up price reductions to keep customers coming back.
As the days pass, your market grows, and you can expand it while keeping the books in the black. It is a management challenge where every decision shapes how your store develops.
going-rolling-ball: Going Rolling Ball is an arcade game where you guide a ball along tricky routes packed with obstacles. Your job is to keep it balanced as you travel through narrow tracks, take sharp turns, and avoid barriers that move. Each stage is harder than the last, so you will need quick reflexes and careful control.

Pick up points as you go, and try not to roll off the track. Your aim is to reach the highest score you can. The controls feel smooth and responsive, which makes this a fun pick for players of all ages. Use your mouse to click any button on screen.
snack-stack: Start with a small corner stand and turn it into a lively cartoon eatery over time. Guests place orders at their tables, and you hurry to the matching counter to prepare each meal before carrying it over. Your menu opens up as you go, with everything from hot dogs to pizza waiting to be unlocked. Pick up cash from the register and any tips left behind, and wipe down messy tables so the next group can settle in. Raising prices, bringing on waiters and cashiers, and improving your own movement, cooking and tray capacity, along with your team's abilities, all help things run smoothly.

Once the room fills up, you can add a fresh dining section. Bouncy animations, satisfying stacks of money and a calm pace keep every improvement feeling worthwhile. Move with the arrow keys or WASD, or press and drag anywhere on the screen to steer with a virtual joystick. To spend your earnings, stand on a floor zone to buy tables, dishes, staff and upgrades. Work through the objectives and grow your place into the busiest snack bar in town.
egg-clicker: In Egg Clicker, you build an egg empire from the ground up. Tapping gathers eggs, and you can spend what you collect on upgrades that help your collection expand. Along the way, you'll uncover new mechanics to explore.

Gameplay is simple to learn, but there is plenty of strategy to think about as you grow. Progress continues while you are away, so your egg stash keeps climbing even when you stop tapping. Your goal is to become a true egg mogul, and it's fun to see how big your collection can get.
pretty-tidy-asmr-organizing: Pretty Tidy is a puzzle game where you clean, arrange, and sort cluttered spaces until they look neat again. This cozy mini-game works as a quiet escape from daily pressure, helping you unwind, settle your thoughts, and find a sense of calm. It suits people who enjoy organizing as well as anyone who simply wants a gentle break.

Your tasks cover several kinds of puzzles, from sorting and tidying to arranging playful toys and charming little objects. Soft ASMR sounds and mellow background music accompany each session, and every small step can feel rewarding. The game also draws on art therapy ideas to encourage creativity and mindfulness, and it is said to support brain health and help boost focus.
hive-rush-bee-swarm: Guide a queen bee and her swarm through a three-dimensional meadow. Your bees gather pollen on their own, so your task is to bring it to a hive, where it turns into honey. Use that honey to buy more bees, then found six colonies across the field. Sting away the wasps and a hungry bear that get in your way.
Steer with W, A, S, and D or the arrow keys, or hold the mouse button to fly. On a touch screen, drag your finger anywhere to move. This single-player arcade game has a cute look and 3D visuals.
mad-day-2-special: Ride, shoot, leap and smash your way toward victory in this runner, which is hard to put down. You team up with Bob, a former Marine, to fight back against the evil aliens who have invaded the planet.

Things get even worse when the invaders kidnap his cherished pet octopus, so Bob sets out to make sure they never forget the encounter. Press space to jump, then press it again in mid-air to double jump. To fire up the rockets, press X together with the up arrow.
makeup-artist-fashion-salon: Step into the shoes of a makeup artist and create looks that match your own taste. You pick the styles you like from a large range of cosmetics, including foundation, eye makeup and lipstick. You can then complete the look with a hairstyle, a necklace and earrings. The game also includes many themed designs, such as cloud, butterfly, rainbow, Christmas and Halloween, so you can draw ideas from whatever is trending.
Play with your mouse or by tapping the screen. It is an HTML5 game in the Girls category, with a focus on coloring, decorating and fashion.
12-minibattles-two-players: Test your quick reactions and planning skills across 12 MiniBattles, a collection of short rounds where every match feels different from the last. The retro look is built on pixel art, which gives the whole package a classic arcade charm.

The lineup moves from sporty contests to silly one-on-one duels, and a playful spinner decides which mini-game comes up next. Each one is simple to pick up, so you can jump in quickly. It is made for two people who want plenty of variety and head-to-head competition.
break-a-tower-obby: Break a Tower: Obby is a demolition simulator that takes inspiration from the best obby modes and mixes fast-paced play with blocky sandbox style. You smash a tower one floor at a time until nothing is left, and you can raise your punch power, stamina, and demolition speed as you go. Helper pets can boost your destruction and bring their own bonuses, and a rebirth system lets you earn more trophies. The towers range from glass structures to reinforced concrete giants, and a global leaderboard tracks who can demolish the most.

Gameplay is a clicker at heart: you tap to break through floors and climb higher to improve your stats. Training works in a mini-idle style, where doing push-ups builds your strength, and stronger characters deal more damage, while floors gain HP as you advance. Coins earned from breaking floors go toward pets, and duplicate pets can be combined. On computers, use WASD to move and Space to jump. On mobile, use the joystick to move, the button in the lower right corner to jump, and swipe the screen to rotate the camera.
stickman-3d-legacy-of-war: Command a band of stickman soldiers on a dynamic battlefield where every choice matters. Your campaigns put you in charge of the fight, and the controls are intuitive enough to pick up quickly. Three-dimensional graphics make each battle feel immersive as you move through it.

Strategy is at the heart of the experience. You will need to plan carefully, manage your resources wisely, and adapt as the maps change. Powerful enemies will test whether your approach can outwit them. Varied units and clever upgrades let you shape your army over time, and they are how you secure your legacy in war.
ramp-racing: Ramp Racing puts you behind the wheel for fast, high-energy races where you can tune powerful cars to match your own look. Each track throws up new surprises as you work through its changing levels, and daily rewards give your progress an extra push. Test your driving against players from around the world, learn to take tight corners cleanly, and time your jumps well to climb toward the top of the speed rankings.
knifer: Knifer is an arcade title that puts your accuracy and sense of timing to the test. Each time you release a knife, your goal is to clear a route through the floating faces in your path. Take your time with every shot, because a single miss might end your run.

Landing hits in a row raises your points, so chaining successful throws is the key to a strong score. Your results can climb the leaderboard, giving you a way to compare your performance with others. Keep your focus steady and your aim sharp to see how far you can get.
mad-truck-challenge-special: Roar into fierce truck battles against some of the meanest monster trucks you have ever seen. Your journey begins at the Mad Truck Challenge starting line, where a relentless racing simulator keeps your pulse high from the first second. Pick a truck armed with rockets and take on the toughest off-road drivers on the planet.

Crush and blast your rivals on the way to the finish while pulling off extreme stunts that send your opponents out of the race. Use the left and right arrow keys to keep your balance, press the Space bar for nitro, and press X to fire your rockets. Win enough races and you will earn the coveted MTC trophy.
supercars-zombie-driving-2: In Supercars Zombie Driving 2, you take the wheel of high-performance sports cars and roam a city overrun by the undead. Your mission is to track down every zombie across the streets and run them down at high speed. Smashing them all is how you win.
This single-player 3D racing and driving game is controlled with W, A, S and D to steer, Space to brake, and C to switch camera views. Use these controls to chase the zombies through the streets.
gangster-vegas-driving-simulator-online: Gangster Vegas Driving Simulator Online drops you into a harsh mafia city where crime, shootouts, thieving and break-ins are part of everyday life. The gang district is full of violent underworld activity, and you take on the role of a rising mobster who wants to dominate the island city. Along the way you can drive a range of high-end cars and use plenty of powerful tools.

Press F to get into or out of a car, Tab to open the menu, and WASD to drive a vehicle or move your character. Hold Space to brake while you are in a car. The game offers more than 40 single-player missions with strong plots and memorable stories, plus a variety of unique models to drive. You can also fly a helicopter, where the Apache competitors hold control of the city. If you want to blow off some daily stress with simple action shooting and a rich story, there is plenty more fun waiting for you.
4x4-fury-offroad-jeep: Climb behind the wheel of a powerful 4x4 jeep and tackle rough ground. The routes take you over steep mountain roads, muddy tracks, rocky hills, and sandy deserts, plus other wild landscapes. Each setting handles differently, so you will need to drive carefully as you get past tough obstacles and work through a series of missions.

As you advance, you can unlock stronger off-road vehicles and choose from several jeep models, then customize them to your liking. The driving physics respond to the terrain, and the controls stay smooth and easy to learn. The scenes are shown in detailed 3D graphics. To drive, press W to accelerate, S to brake or reverse, A to steer left, and D to steer right.
flower-merge-triple-puzzle: Flower Merge - Triple Puzzle offers a calm but demanding puzzle experience. Your job is to line up three matching flowers so they vanish from the board, and each removal opens up more room. As you progress, you can unlock lovely new blossoms and work through colorful stages that grow steadily harder, rewarding careful thinking. It suits anyone who likes laid-back matching games with a flower theme.

Start by tapping flowers to gather them into the merge tray. When three identical ones sit together, they disappear and free up space. Clear every flower on a level to finish it. Think ahead, because a full tray ends the game. When a puzzle becomes especially tough, boosters are available to help you get past it.
dinosaur-rampage: Once the rampage wraps up, your dinosaur faces rivals roaming the same arena, and the game ranks everyone by how much destruction they caused. Many different dinosaur types can be unlocked along the way, and the in-game shop offers stylish skins to customize your creature. Your goal is to show who reigns over the chaos.

The pace is quick and the wrecking feels rewarding, making it a relaxing way to let off some steam. Stomping, smashing, and climbing the rankings are all you need to focus on. Controls are simple: a mouse click or a tap is all it takes to get going.
baolings-mystery-dumpling-unbox: Baolings is a bright, three-dimensional unboxing game. You strip away a package's outer wrap, lift the lid of a bamboo steamer, and rip open a sealed bag to meet a soft dumpling character. Once it appears, you can press and squeeze it. Rare figures are out there to find, and each one you collect can be placed in a themed room.

Squishy Pop, Squishy Drop and Dumpling Hunt add more ways to earn coins and gather companions. Soft ASMR audio and toy-style visuals set the mood, and daily gifts bring fresh surprises. Use a mouse or touch screen, following the on-screen guide for each step. Dumpling Hunt also works with the keyboard. Optional Watch buttons give rewarded bonuses, and your progress saves automatically.
world-archery-league: Step into the role of a celebrated bowman in World Archery League, a sport simulation centered on archery. The game brings the atmosphere of an Olympic-style range into your browser, where every shot counts and the pressure of a real contest is always present.

The physics are realistic, so each shot reacts in a believable way. Playing is simple: click with your mouse, or tap on a touchscreen. It is a hypercasual pick for fans of archery, sports, and strategy games who want a focused challenge.
stickman-prison-warriors: A stickman is framed for a crime he did not commit and locked up in prison. Even with his situation looking hopeless, he refuses to give up and makes plans to rescue himself. Through countless days and many years, he keeps pushing forward, held up by the hope that one day he will be free and able to breathe the air of freedom at last.

This 2D single-player title is listed under puzzles, with arcade and adventure elements mixed in. To make progress, cut the block, let it drop to the floor, and then step onto it to climb out of the woods. It suits players who enjoy stickman games and stories about escaping from prison.
ninja-in-cape: Take on the role of a ninja in this arcade game spanning 20 levels. Along the way you will battle tough enemies using an assortment of weapons. Agility and strategy both matter, so quick footwork and careful planning work hand in hand.

Your mysterious cape and sly tactics help you overcome the unique challenges that appear throughout the game. Every perilous encounter brings its own thrill and keeps you on edge from start to finish. Stay sharp, because each battle asks something different of you.
toon-blast-puzzle: Toon Blast Puzzle is a match-3 game that mixes bright colors with planning and a good amount of challenge. Your job is to pop colorful cubes and work through clever puzzles, taking your time to think each move through. The journey is meant to feel calm and easygoing, while still giving you a steady stream of levels to explore. Every stage brings its own mental workout, and the gameplay stays satisfying from start to finish.

Controls are kept simple, so you can jump right in and focus on the puzzles. Play with a touch screen or a mouse, whichever suits your device. Between the cheerful visuals and the steady pace, it's easy to keep coming back for one more round.
crazy-motorcycle: Crazy Motorcycle is a racing game in which you ride motorbikes through the sky. It runs on many kinds of devices and needs no extra setup, so you can jump straight into a race. Its bright, lively graphics pair with energetic gameplay that suits both new players and seasoned racers, offering an engaging experience for everyone.
On a computer, steer with WASD or the arrow keys and press Space to jump.
break-stick-completely: Break Stick Completely is a silly world built around a stick figure who is always ready for trouble. Your job is to set the stage for chaos by picking a ride, anything from a motorcycle to a supermarket cart. Next, place funny hazards in its path, such as huge ramps, traps and much more. When everything is set, hit Start and watch the wild tricks the stick figure p
robot-band: In this music game, you guide a small troop of musical robots as they build a techno beat. The scene is set in the vibrant Trastevere area of Rome. Sliders let you adjust the sound, and touching different parts of the robots changes what they play, so you can shape soundscapes that are entirely your own.
The experience is meant to be relaxing, letting you drift through a musical session at your own pace. Dynamic visuals keep the scene lively as you go, and the creative possibilities seem endless.
stickman-armed-assassin-3d: Stickman Armed Assassin 3D is an action shooter where you play a stickman caught in a big gunfight. You take on many kinds of stickman enemies across 3D stages, and the game is full of blood and violence. Pick from a large selection of weapons, and when a foe goes down, the body flops around in ragdoll-style death animations.

Your missions include killing stickman enemies, finding bombs, rescuing civilians, and fighting zombies. Walk with W, A, S, and D, look around with the mouse, and fire with the left button or aim with the right. Use the mouse wheel to switch weapons, G for grenades, R to reload, Left Shift to run, Left Ctrl to crouch, X to go prone, and V for melee attacks.
super-slashman: Super Slashman drops you into a futuristic city overrun by rogue robots. You fight back with a cyber sword in strategic duels spread across five levels. Along the way, you can collect green energy balls that power you up and help you outsmart your enemies.
Every run is a race against the clock, and your goal is to boost your score and sharpen your skills as you go. It suits anyone who enjoys arcade games with a sci-fi setting and a steady challenge.
master-checkers: Master Checkers is a two-player board game based on the Italian version of checkers. Pieces move only across the dark squares, so every step follows a diagonal line. A regular piece can advance only toward the opposing side, and it removes an enemy piece by leaping over it onto the empty square directly beyond, along the same diagonal.
