Each leap captures just one piece, but you can chain several leaps together within a single turn. Capturing is compulsory whenever it is available.

When a piece reaches the row furthest from the player who controls it, it becomes a king and can move forward or backward. You can challenge the computer, a local opponent, or players from around the world.
obbytycoon-money-tycoon: You play as your own character in this tycoon game, where the goal is to grow your favorite business and become the top figure in your city. Many building types and vehicles are available, you can upgrade the city, and you can buy existing businesses. Construct city structures and the home you have always pictured, dress your avatar in different outfits and skins, open companies that bring in millions, and purchase the car you want.

Move with W, A, S, D or the arrow keys, jump with the spacebar, and hold Shift to speed up. Hold the left mouse button to turn the camera. On mobile, use the on-screen buttons to get around, while the left and right sides of the screen control movement and camera rotation.
extreme-monster-truck: Extreme Monster Truck is an offroad racing game where you climb behind the wheel of huge, powerful trucks. You will tackle rough ground, race along tricky courses, and show what your driving can do. The routes cross steep hills, muddy paths, desert tracks, and hazardous obstacles, and you can pull off eye-catching stunts along the way. Each level pushes your accuracy, pace, and handling.
Steering is simple. Press W or the Up arrow to drive forward, S or the Down arrow to reverse, and A or D (or the Left and Right arrows) to turn. Buttons on screen can be clicked with the mouse.
army-force-war: Army Force War drops you into fast-paced shooter combat where picking the right class and getting comfortable with the controls can decide who comes out on top. You move across a range of different battle zones, take on missions that keep the pressure high, and choose from a large selection of weapons. The whole experience feels loud and busy, with plenty of war-zone energy running through each match.

The game offers several modes to try, so you can switch up how you play from one session to the next. Whether you prefer quick skirmishes or longer objectives, there is a style of battle to suit you. It is a good pick for anyone who enjoys team-minded strategy mixed with straightforward, action-packed shooting.
snowball-platformer: SnowBall: Platformer is a physics-driven platform game with a winter holiday theme. You guide SnowBall, a cheerful ball of snow, as it rolls, bounces and keeps rolling through 25 carefully built stages. Each stage ends with a special gift at the finish line, and every one is needed for New Year's Eve to happen. The early stages are gentle, but the difficulty steadily climbs, so you will need good timing and a feel for momentum and realistic physics. Gather every gift before midnight arrives, or the holiday disappears for good.
Controls are simple. On a computer, use the arrow keys or the W, A and D keys to move, and press E to leave a level. On a phone, tap the on-screen buttons.
snake-warz-eat-and-survive: Snake Warz: Eat & Survive is a 2D puzzle game for one player, built around snakes. Your snake follows your mouse as it slithers across a colorful arena. Collect the glowing food to grow longer and raise your score.

Rival snakes share the field, and one wrong move can end your run, so careful steering matters. Quick reflexes, clever planning, and smooth movement help you avoid deadly collisions. Outsmart the other snakes, grow long, and survive, because the bigger your snake gets, the tougher the challenge becomes.
stick-vs-zombies-epic-battle: Stickman fighters take on endless waves of zombies in this action game. The levels change as you go, mixing tactical combat with demanding platform jumps. You can pick up and swap between several weapons to get the better of the undead. Quick reflexes and clever moves help you push through the grim, end-of-the-world scenes. Anyone willing to take the risk has a shot at winning.
weapon-upgrade: Weapon Upgrade is a running shooter where you build your own guns as you go. You fire at foes and barriers along the way, which unlocks stronger weapons and gives you a chance to sharpen your aim against targets. Weapons grow from basic pistols into serious firepower as you collect and join parts together.

To move, steer with your mouse on a computer or slide your finger across a phone screen. Upgrades work by purchasing parts and attaching them to your current weapon. Keep experimenting with combinations and you will become skilled at putting arsenals together.
halloween-monsters-merge: Drop monsters onto the playfield and steer each one so it lands against a matching monster. When two identical monsters touch, they merge into a larger one. Keep the stack below the top lane, because if anything crosses it, your session ends. You earn coins for every merge.

Spend those coins in the store to unlock new monsters. Bigger merges are worth more points, so each new monster gives you a chance to beat your record. Your goal is to unlock every monster and climb to first place on the leaderboard. Use the left and right arrows to move the next monster, and press the down arrow or space bar to reset it. It's a spooky Halloween test of skill and precision.
icy-purple-head-2: Icy Purple Head 2 puts you in charge of a purple character trying to find a route through a cold, frozen landscape. Your hero can turn into ice and glide across each course, so you need to time your moves carefully to avoid deadly obstacles. The game spans 30 levels, each one a fresh set of icy challenges to work through.

Controls are simple, since all you need are strategic clicks to guide your character from start to finish. Success depends on careful planning and good timing rather than fast fingers. If you enjoy chilly clicking games, this frosty adventure has plenty to keep you busy.
squid-dalgona-candy: Squid Dalgona Candy is a puzzle game where you use a needle to free a shape from a candy mold. The candy is hard but brittle, so you have to ease the mold away with care. If the candy shatters, the game ends.

To lift the candy out in one piece, press the button at regular intervals. Clicking too often pushes the Crack Meter into the red zone, and the candy will break. You also lose if you haven't removed the candy before the time limit runs out. The game is controlled with mouse clicks or touch.
tall-io: Tall.io is a browser game built with HTML5 that blends growth strategy with battle-arena action. You guide a stickman across a busy arena, gathering bricks and rainbow orbs to grow taller, which increases both your size and your strength. Because the game is multiplayer, you face other players on several islands and fight to claim the top spot. Bright visuals and uninterrupted online play keep the competition lively.

Moving your stickman is handled with the arrow keys or WASD. Cubes, coins, and bricks are scattered around the arena, and collecting them raises your height. Press the spacebar to attack or smash rivals, and think carefully about when to use the swords and armor you pick up along the way.
robot-astro-party: Robot Astro Party is a fast-paced multiplayer running game full of silly and unpredictable situations. Every match feels like a fresh adventure, so you'll need to rethink your approach depending on which racing or running map you land on. It's a lighthearted pick for anyone who enjoys robots and funny, offbeat moments.
Playing is easy: just use a mouse click or a tap to get going.
wonder-vending-machine: Wonder Vending Machine is an easy simulation game that is fun to play. You choose one of three machines, which sell toys, sweet treats, or food. Each item has a price shown on the display, and you have a set of coins to insert. If you enter the right sum, the machine releases the item. If you get it wrong, an error message appears.
Your goal is to collect every item from the machines. Once you have them all, you can look through them again whenever you like. The whole game is played with your mouse.
epic-defense-clash: Step into the boots of a brave fighter in this battle game, which blends tactical thinking with fast-paced fighting. You carry a range of weapons and use them to hold back fearsome beasts across a richly drawn battlefield. Good timing and spotting where enemies are vulnerable both matter here.

As the game goes on, you can improve your gear to keep up with attack after attack of foes that keep coming without a break. It's a demanding challenge built around courage and skill, so you'll need to stay sharp throughout.
breakout-neon-drift: Breakout: Neon Drift is a retro-style arcade brick breaker with glowing neon graphics and CRT screen effects. Your job is to clear your way through 10 unique levels, grabbing power-ups such as lasers, multiball, and shields along the way. Every run gives you a chance to push for a new high score.

Controls are simple. Move your mouse to slide the paddle left or right, then click or tap to launch the ball or fire lasers. The game offers smooth controls, rewards chained hits with combo scoring, and features a synthwave soundtrack.
vexon: Vexon is a first person shooter built around fast gunfights and careful aiming. Its visuals are colorful, and the sound design wraps you in the action. You pick your own weapons, then either jump into team matches or play alone. As you go, you climb the ranks by completing challenges that come with rewards. The game is packed with action and asks you to use both good tactics and sharp shooting.

Every match rewards quick thinking as much as steady aim. Whether you prefer teamwork or working through the battles by yourself, the game gives you room to decide how you approach each fight. It is a good pick for anyone who enjoys shooters that test both planning and reflexes.
find-the-needle: Searching for one minuscule needle inside an enormous mound of hay is the task you're handed here. You dig through the straw one layer at a time, which gradually shrinks the heap and brings you nearer to the target. Along the way you gain access to fresh methods for gathering hay, stronger tools, and upgrades that speed up and streamline the clearing.

Resources you collect can be spent in shops on further upgrades and progression. On PC, WASD moves you, the left mouse button interacts, Space jumps, and Tab opens the upgrade menu. On a phone, you use the on-screen controls, with the joystick handling movement. Though the goal sounds simple, it proves trickier than expected.
chicken-merge-2: Chicken Merge 2 blends merging with tower defense. Your flock of chickens guards the path between your base and waves of enemies that never seem to end. You train chickens, upgrade them, and combine matching ones into stronger defenders, then arrange them across the battlefield. As your flock grows, you open access to better weapons and upgrades. The question is whether your finest chicken squad can keep the enemies back.

Start a mission and clear each wave to earn coins, which you spend on training more units. Put your most elite units in defensive spots, since those are the ones that strike the enemies. Power-ups are useful, but they recharge after use, so save them for the right moment. On desktop, click the interface to train units, and drag matching units onto each other to merge them or onto other slots to reposition them. On mobile, tap the screen to train units and use the same drag-and-drop method to merge and move them.
sift-renegade-brawl: Sift Renegade Brawl is a free fighting game featuring stickman samurai. Set in a land where clans often settle their differences through revenge and combat, it follows Ryu, a warrior who had been living quietly with his partner, a samurai master too. When a sudden turn of events shatters that calm, Ryu takes on a perilous quest to avenge her death, facing many hazards along the way.

Armed with his katana, you slice through foes and chain together combos to defeat them in style. Across the different levels you can gather trophies, and you can replay any stage as often as you like to raise your score. Follow the story as you guide Ryu through every mission. Control him with the mouse and arrow keys, or use the on-screen buttons.
urban-sniper-multiplayer: Urban Sniper Multiplayer throws you into tense long-range duels across a busy city setting. You move through its streets and rooftops, keeping out of sight while watching for opponents. Each rooftop and narrow passage could hide a threat, so staying alert matters just as much as aiming well.

Your success depends on careful planning and patience. Wait for the right opening, take your shot with a steady aim, and then outwit rivals who are hunting for their own chance. The game is a constant contest of nerve and tactics, where only the sharpest player comes out on top.
steals-eggs-from-animals: In this 3D adventure, you sneak into the territory of different animals and swipe their eggs. Your job is to race back to the safe zone while the animals chase you. Your speed improves as you level up, and the farther you travel, the cooler the animals you meet. Collect rare creatures to fill your pen, and earn money from them. Aim to make it all the way to the end.
fruit-smash-master: Fruit Smash Master lets you train as a skilled fruit slicer. You make clean cuts by swiping precisely across a variety of fruits, and each kind brings its own challenges to work around. As you advance, the levels grow harder, so you will need to sharpen your technique along the way.

Success depends on balancing speed with control, so you must cut quickly without losing precision. The game tracks results on a leaderboard, and your goal is to climb to the top through smart, rapid slicing.
halloween-horror-massacre: Halloween Horror Massacre puts you in the role of a chopper who works alongside well-known horror characters from film and fiction. Your task is to cut down a tree as quickly as possible while steering clear of branches that keep falling toward you. It takes the familiar idea of a lumberjack felling a tree and gives it a spooky makeover.

The action moves at a brisk pace, so sharp timing and fast reactions are essential to avoid the falling limbs. The lineup of famous scary faces adds to the fun for anyone who loves Halloween. If you enjoy testing your
basket-ball-for-two-player: This is a head-to-head basketball match made for two people sharing one device. Both players leap, collide, and race to score in a stripped-down arena where the clock keeps pressing. Each sphere runs on a single button, so a tap is all it takes to make it jump. The blue ball sits on the left side and the purple one on the right.

Your goal is to judge the moment to leave the ground so your ball drops into the central hoop before your opponent's does. Player 1 jumps by pressing W or tapping the screen, while Player 2 uses the UP arrow key or also taps the screen. Whoever times their leap better comes out ahead.
fire-boy-run-adventure: Fire Boy Run Adventure is a side-scrolling action game that combines adventure and running. You take control of Fire Boy, a bold little hero who dashes forward through risky levels filled with traps and obstacles. Jumping over hazards and staying alive are central to the challenge, so every move counts.

The whole game runs on one simple input. Use a mouse click or a tap to make Fire Boy act, and keep an eye on the path ahead so you can react in time. Each level tests your timing as you push on through the obstacles.
evolution-of-hamster-clicker: In this clicker game, you guide a hamster through a series of changes, one tap at a time. Each tap moves you closer to a huge goal of five quintillion points. Along the way, you can explore an almost endless range of evolution paths and build up wealth, so there is always a new direction to try.

The game focuses on that steady rhythm of tapping and watching your little pet transform. Every new stage opens up more possibilities, and the challenge is seeing how far you can push your hamster. It is a simple, focused experience that rewards patience and persistence.
draw-to-smash-zombie: Draw To Smash Zombie is a puzzle game built around drawing logic. Instead of using fixed tools, you sketch your own answers to fight off groups of goofy zombies. You can draw simple shapes, straight lines, ramps, or whatever else comes to mind. Once your drawing is in place, you send a bomb rolling to blast the undead crowd.

The game is easy to pick up and hard to put down, with a playful tone throughout. Controls are handled with a mouse click or a tap on a touchscreen. Whether you enjoy clever problem solving or just like watching things explode, this one offers a light, cheerful challenge.
save-the-dummy: Put your creativity and drawing skills to the test in this hypercasual title, where every line you sketch helps rescue a little dummy, a stickman. Solving the puzzles calls for focus and smart thinking, and only the fastest, quickest, and most intelligent players will come out on top. The game blends escape and platform challenges with many fully
obby-battle-arena: Obby: Battle Arena is a third-person shooter with attractive visuals. Its battles take place in a dedicated arena, and you can pick from a range of guns to take part. Before you start, you choose the game mode and the map you want to play on. Your character is also customizable, with many skins and extra accessories to choose from.

On PC, WASD moves your character, and keys 1 through 4 switch between weapons. Shift gives you a fast run, but your weapon stays hidden while you use it. R reloads, and F hides your weapon to increase your movement speed. The left mouse button shoots, and the right mouse button aims. Press Esc to open the game menu, or press Tab to view the leaderboard.
carrush: Car Rush is a fast endless racer where a single error brings your run to an end. You drive down a busy highway filled with traffic that moves unpredictably, so quick reactions are essential to keep your car on the road. Coins you collect let you unlock supercars for your garage, and each one has its own handling and speed.

Daily challenges give you extra goals to chase, and global leaderboards show how your scores stack up against players around the world. The controls are simple. Touch and hold the left side of the screen to steer left, or the right side to steer right. Let go and your car returns to the center. The design is intuitive and built for fast, reflex-driven play.
swim-or-die: Swim or Die puts you in charge of keeping a pet above water. The faster you tap, the longer your little companion stays afloat, so quick fingers matter here. As you play, you gather Time Points, and those points let you unlock skins to dress your pet in.

The whole game revolves around rescue. Every moment puts fresh pressure on your reflexes, and a single slow tap can leave your pet struggling. The action stays intense from start to finish, testing your timing and keeping you focused. Every second counts when you are trying to save your pet from drowning.
scary-baby-in-yellow: Scary Baby in Yellow is a 3D horror game built around tension and suspense. It mixes mystery, fear, searching and a series of levels. Your job is to track down the frightened yellow baby and guide him wherever the on-screen instructions point. Each level comes with a timer, so you need to finish before it runs out. If the clock beats you, your progress is wiped and you must start that level over.
Move with the keyboard arrow keys and turn your view by moving the mouse. Press F to pick up objects. Work through every level to reach the end of the game.
harvest-rush: Steer a combine harvester across 3D fields of wheat, corn, sunflowers, pumpkins and other crops in this calm farming arcade title. When your hopper fills up, head to the selling zone at the barn and trade the harvest for coins. Those coins can boost speed, capacity and harvest width, or unlock new machines. Eight distinct harvesters are available, each with its own custom skin.

Build a wind farm and a grain processing plant to earn passive income as you expand. Daily quests and achievements add extra goals, and you can grow a small plot into a sprawling operation. Clear every field to finish a level. Use WASD or the arrow keys to drive, or on mobile, use the on-screen buttons to steer, accelerate and reverse.
football-kick-3d: Football Kick 3D puts you in a fast three-dimensional soccer match where simply dribbling won't cut it. Instead, you barrel through opposing players to win the ball and head for goal. Charge ahead, knock rivals aside with forceful tackles, steal possession, and push across the field until you reach the net.

Controls are kept simple: a mouse click or a tap is all it takes to play. The game is categorized as casual sports and tagged for 3D, casual, football, and soccer fans. The pace stays quick from the first kick onward.
monopoly-online: Monopoly Online takes the board game you probably already know and love and gives it an online twist. It belongs to one of the most iconic board game series ever created, and this version lets you revisit that famous business game right in your browser.

To play, you only need a left click. Whether you are returning to an old favourite or meeting Monopoly for the first time, this online edition offers a familiar way to spend time with the classic business game.
bodybuilder-karate-fighting: Bodybuilder Karate Fighting places you in three-dimensional brawls against muscle-packed warriors, where sheer strength has to be balanced with clever planning. Sidestep and dodge incoming hits, throw punches, and launch special moves to get around your rivals. Thinking a step ahead is just as important as hitting hard.
Fights take place in arenas that reward careful technique as much as heavy
assault-zone: Assault Zone is a 3D first-person shooter where you take control of a character. Your challenge is to move into territory the enemy has seized and eliminate its guards one at a time. Speed matters, because any guard still standing will start firing back at you.

On a computer, the arrow keys or W, A, S and D move your character, while the mouse turns, aims and shoots. On a phone or tablet, an on-screen joystick handles movement and a fire button lets you shoot. To turn and aim, tap and drag on the right side of the screen.
coloring-by-numbers-pixel-room: Coloring by Numbers: Pixel Room turns filling in a picture into a calm, almost meditative activity. You play as a designer who builds and decorates houses. Each area of the image carries a number, and touching the screen fills it with the matching color, so you spend your time weighing how shades work together rather than following a dull routine.

A built-in music player plays calm tunes while you work, adding to the relaxed mood. You can create rooms from scratch and bring your dream rooms to life in this pixel game. The interface is simple to use, and the illustrations show parts of the rooms you design. Controls work with touch or the left mouse button, and the goal is to make unique rooms by experimenting with color schemes.
schoolboy-runaway-room-escape: In this 3D first-person adventure, you play a schoolboy who would much rather get out of the house than sit through lessons. Your strict parents will not let you go outside, so you need to find a way out of the room instead. Mom and Dad keep piling on chores, such as tidying up toys or mopping the floor, but your patience is wearing thin. It is time to search the house for hidden objects and make your stealthy escape.

On PC, use WASD to walk, move the mouse to rotate the camera, and press the left mouse button to interact with things. On a phone, drag the joystick on the left half of the screen to walk, swipe the right half to turn the camera, and tap objects to interact with them.
geom-etrys: Geom-etrys is a puzzle game where you need to think fast and plan ahead. Your job is to build combinations out of geometric shapes. As you move on, each stage becomes more complicated than the one before it, so the challenge grows steadily.

The aim is to keep the game alive by making smart moves and setting off chain reactions. Every choice you make helps you practice solving problems in a colourful setting that many players find hard to put down. It suits anyone who enjoys puzzles with a bit of strategy.
primal-druid-kingdom-of-animals: Primal Druid - Kingdom of Animals puts you in the role of a druid whose job is to capture, train, and lead a force of creatures. Your army can range from aggressive battle cats and mixed-breed monsters to mythical dragons from legend. Build up your group, take on engaging missions, and get through a perilous open landscape full of obstacles.

Taming is central to the game. You fight wild animals and beasts until they become faithful followers, and you can call on strong helpers such as an alpha wolf or gather a large crowd of tiny creatures. Collect scarce materials and craft artifacts to boost your creatures' skills. Forage for supplies, deal with sea-dwelling monsters, and search the rough wilderness for concealed secrets. On PC, move your character with the W, A, S, and D keys; on mobile, tap and drag across the screen.
dream-football-game: Dream Football Strike puts you on the field as a striker in a soccer game made for football lovers everywhere. Your job is to line up your shots, score goals, and guide your team to victory. Whether you prefer penalty kicks, free kicks, or fast-paced matches, the action keeps going. Realistic ball physics, responsive controls, and immersive stadium settings help you feel like a real striker in championship matches.

Show off your skills, slip past defenders, and grow into a standout player on the pitch. Use WASD or the arrow keys to move, press K to sprint, tap N for a short pass, press M for a long pass, and hit Space to shoot.
2048-x2-merge-blocks: In 2048 X2 Merge Blocks, numbered blocks drop down the screen, and your job is to line them up so matching ones combine into bigger numbers. The grid keeps closing in as it collapses, so you need to plan each move carefully to stay ahead of it. The game blends strategy with puzzle solving, and every choice affects how the board looks a few moves later.

The game has no set end, so you can keep going for as long as you like. Your goal is to reach higher merges while keeping the board as clear as possible. Clearing space is the key to doing well, since a crowded grid makes it much harder to stay in control.
drive-car: Drive Car is a skill game in which you steer a car along tricky roads. Your aim is to gather stars and bring the vehicle across the finish line without crashing. Watch for obstacles and pick your direction carefully so the car does not tip over. Every level has its own kind of terrain, which means you need fast reactions and steady handling to keep going.

You move the car with the W, A, S and D keys, or with the arrow keys if you prefer. The game mixes entertainment with challenge, so it suits anyone who enjoys testing their driving instincts on uneven ground.
my-kitties-catworld: Step into a dreamy world full of cats, where you build a lively home filled with one-of-a-kind kittens. Every kitten is different from the rest. Mix and test shades to uncover surprising tones, such as neon green and pink, and see what new colors appear.

Grow your collection of cats and complete amusing tasks as you go, watching your household expand bit by bit. Everything in this personalized purring paradise is yours to shape, so you can enjoy its charm at your own pace.
rocket-clash-3d: You command a resistance unit of special forces soldiers. Their mission is to stop enemy intelligence agents who are trying to take control of a missile base. You'll use a tactical, shortened version of the well-known AK rifle, and you can also uncover a secret weapon hidden deep within the level.
Watch your step around pools of acid made from toxic rocket fuel, and explore a network of underground tunnels. Move with W, A, S and D, press C to crouch, and tap SPACE to jump.
swarm-picnic: Swarm Picnic is a calm puzzle game centered on colors and sequencing. From a line of boxes, you pick the one at the front and drop it into a free work slot. The ants inside that box gather every matching cube they can reach in the scene and haul them back to their nest. Your job is to think ahead, leaving room for the colors that will surface next and avoiding a jam where every slot is stuck.

The game includes 30 garden stages, harder challenges, and a shuffled stage order once the main campaign is finished. Controls work with either a mouse or a touchscreen, and tapping any queue's front box is all it takes to act. When a line is buried under a box you need, boosters can reshuffle the queues, reach a deeper box, or add one more slot to work with. Clear the entire picture to complete a level.
obby-and-dead-river: Set out on a three-dimensional journey down a dangerous river known as the River of Death. Your character is a brave fighter who must take on savage monsters, sea raiders, and dragons along the way.

Crossing huge castles is part of the route, and hidden treasure waits for those who look closely. Collected loot lets you strengthen your weapons and gear. Overcome each obstacle along the way, and eventually you will meet a final boss. The game rewards courage and skill, so every step tests both.
epic-battle-simulator-2: Plan your tactics in this strategy game by choosing your soldiers and placing them wisely across the battlefield to overcome any rival. You can work through a series of campaign levels or design your own battles in the custom mode. Your army can also be upgraded to three levels, gaining powerful gear and stronger stats.

Battles unfold with lifelike physics and ragdoll reactions, while refined graphics and sharper AI opponents make large-scale clashes feel more convincing. The placement system has been improved for more precise tactics, and your troops behave more intelligently as they fight. On a computer, use the arrow keys or W, A, S, and D to move the camera. On a touchscreen, touch the lower-left area of the display and drag your finger to pan the view.
battboy-adventure: Battboy Adventure is a platform game where quick reactions and careful planning both matter. You move through a colorful world, overcoming odd-looking enemies that stand in your way. The journey is split into eight levels, and each one grows more demanding than the last.

Steer clear of the spikes scattered along the way. Your main goal is to gather stars, since collecting them is how you secure victory. The cartoon art style is bright and full of character, and finishing every stage gives a real sense of accomplishment.
pop-it-infinity: Pop It Infinity is a calm and unusual clicker built for long, restful play. Its board holds pop gadgets in many different shapes, and your goal is to press each one so it bursts, until every pop is gone. Working fast is part of the challenge, so try to smash them all quickly. The whole experience is meant to ease tension as you go.
The game is made for people of all ages and can keep you busy
adventure-rush: Adventure Rush is a browser platformer where you race along routes filled with traps. Your job is to time your jumps well and dodge hazards that show up very fast. Each failed try teaches you something, so your reflexes get sharper as you move forward. Levels get tougher with every step, and you advance by getting past harder and harder obstacles.

You can control the game with your keyboard or with on-screen touch buttons, so it works whether you are at a desktop or on a touchscreen. The game fits the hypercasual style, with quick rounds that are easy to pick up. Its tags also point to running, jumping, ball and geometry themes.
merge-combo: Merge Combo is a brain-teasing game where you join matching blocks to rack up points and chain combos. You can play it free in your browser, and it balances calm moments with a bit of pressure. Each cube you stack pushes you toward a higher score, so every move matters.

The core idea is easy to pick up: drag identical blocks together and watch them fuse into a higher number. Its straightforward match-two style will appeal to people who enjoy logic challenges, and it runs on phones, tablets, and computers alike. The big question the game poses is how large a number you can reach.
bee-careful: Bee Careful puts you in control of a focused little bee as it flies through detailed, winding surroundings. This arcade adventure asks you to avoid hungry predators, gather pollen along the way, and steer past obstacles by thinking a few moves ahead. The levels move quickly, so you will need sharp reflexes to keep up.
Power-ups are there to help you raise your score and climb higher on each run. Every flight is a new chance to improve your technique and see how far your bee can go.
cow-rescue: A sweet cow finds herself stuck behind a heap of wooden planks, and it's up to you to free her. Tap screws that share a color to take them out, then carefully lift away the boards in the way. Think ahead about each move so you don't leave yourself with no options, and open a clear route for the animal to slip through.

Expect colorful screws and challenging board layouts that test your planning. Helpful tools are available when you need a boost, and a funny bird companion keeps things lively. It's a calm and enjoyable brain teaser that players of any age can pick up. Finish each level to bring the cow to safety.
fall-guyz: This lighthearted arcade course sends your character running and jumping through a series of obstacles, racing rivals who all want to cross the finish line first. Expect dangerous objects and tricky platforms blocking the way. Clear each level, collect as many points as you can, and earn trophies along the way.

You can unlock up to seven characters, and every attempt gives you a chance to beat your previous score. Learn the maps, anticipate hazards, and plan your movements carefully. Steer with the arrow keys or mouse, or touch the screen on a phone. The game works on mobile, tablet, and desktop, making it a casual, fun pick on any device.
blocky-zombie-shooting: Step into a blocky, voxel-built battlefield where zombie waves pour into every lane. You can pick up oddball firearms, throw together quick barricades, and weave through tight corners while the horde chases you. Upgrade your ammo, unlock new skins, and go after headshot combos in either arcade or survival mode.

Runs are short and fast, and the crunchy sound effects and satisfying ragdoll physics make every round tempting to replay. Walk and drive with W, A, S and D, look around and aim with the mouse, and shoot with the same mouse. Aim carefully and reload faster to last longer.
jungle-mart-idle-game: Jungle Mart is a laid-back, idle-style game about running a farm and a market in the jungle. Your workers keep production moving so everything runs smoothly. You can bring in helpers, improve how efficiently your operation works, and grow your jungle market one step at a time. It is simple to pick up, yet it still leaves room for planning. Progress keeps coming steadily, and managing your business feels rewarding.
On a phone, use the on-screen joystick to move your character and interact with things around the market. On a computer, press the W, A, S and D keys to walk around the jungle mart.
boss-level-pumpkin-madness: Step into a vintage games console and team up with Billy Boy in Boss Level - Pumpkin Madness. Your job is to take on creepy opponents while steering clear of dangerous hazards. Along the way, gather rockets with care, because you will need them when you face the Halloween boss at the end.

The action moves quickly, and every level brings strategic challenges that demand smart choices. This haunted arcade-style journey keeps your reflexes sharp from start to finish. Watch every move and see how your reactions hold up against the spooky threats.
kick-a-lucky-block-tsunami-waves: In this skill game, your job is to boot a lucky block as far as you can. Each kick gives you a shot at rolling a one-of-a-kind brainrot, so every try is a bit of a gamble. When the block finally stops, you change into a brainrot yourself and have to outrun a huge tsunami that your own kick set off. Kicking farther brings better rewards, but the wave also becomes more dangerous.
Between kicks, gather the brainrots you win and set them
bubble-boom: Bubble Boom is a timeless take on the bubble shooter genre, where your aim gets tested. You line up each shot, fire, and watch bubbles burst across a series of bright levels. Each stage offers its own kind of challenge, yet the pace stays calm and easygoing.

The goal is simple: fire at clusters and pop any group of three or more bubbles that share a color. Keep in mind that the whole level slowly sinks lower over time, so you need to act quickly. If the bubbles creep down to the bottom line, the round is over and you lose.
euro-2020-2021: This sports game brings a free kick twist to the Euro 2020 tournament, presented as the 2021 edition. You choose from 10 of the best teams and aim to lead yours to championship glory. The free kick format sits at the heart of the action, so every shot matters.

Control is handled with a mouse or touch, and the same input covers both kicking and defending. Tagged as football, soccer, and HTML5, it suits anyone who enjoys browser-based sports games. Whether you play on a desktop or a touchscreen, you use the same controls to attack and defend.
minetap-merge-clicker: MineTap Merge Clicker blends mining with merging. You combine blocks to create stronger tools, push back monsters that come your way, and grow a village from scratch. Every tap counts, so quick clicking paired with smart upgrades is key to getting ahead in this idle adventure.
Your progress depends on both speed and planning, which keeps each session interesting. There is plenty to explore and plenty of room to get creative with how you build and play, one click at a time.
ladder-to-brainhot-climb-obby: Climb through a series of obby courses to reach the top, where tiny, charming Brainhots are waiting to be snatched. The courses are set in different locations, and each one has its own boss to get past. The collection is huge, and every single Brainhot can be stolen.

Build and upgrade your own base, where you can sell the Brainhots you take. Logging in every day brings generous gifts, and those bonuses help you upgrade your base faster and boost your speed for bolder raids. Quick thinking and cunning go hand in hand, and a deeper economy and progression system waits beyond the obby itself. On computers, WASD moves your character and Space makes you jump. On mobile, a joystick moves your character, a button in the lower right corner makes you jump, and swiping the screen rotates the camera.
snow-slider-3d: Snow Slider 3D puts you on a sled racing down a snowy mountain. Your job is to weave between trees, rocks, snowmen and other hazards while collecting gifts that unlock new sleds. The farther you travel, the faster you go, so staying alert matters more with every second.

No two runs feel the same, because the endless runner style terrain keeps changing as you go. The smooth 3D graphics make each slide easy to follow and enjoy. Controls are simple: use the Left Arrow and Right Arrow keys to steer your sled down the mountain.
hotgear: Hotgear puts you on busy city streets built for fast driving, where high-speed getaways and tense pursuits take center stage. You can customize your dream car, then tackle missions full of explosive action. The open city is yours to explore whenever you feel like it.

With a wide selection of cars to choose from, every chase keeps the pace high. Whether you are escaping or chasing, the game gives you plenty of ways to test your driving. Your goal is to grow into a top racer by taking on each challenge the streets offer.
alien-catcher: Alien Catcher returns in an HTML5 edition. Once again, the world faces an invasion from outer space, and professional teams must step in at once to stop it. You and a friend each belong to one of these teams, and together you direct two intervention agents whose job is to round up the aliens.

Player one moves with W, A, S and D, fires with F, and hides by pressing S. Player two steers with the arrow keys, hides with the down arrow, fires the laser gun with J, launches the catcher capsule with K, and throws a trap with L. This two-player shooting and puzzle adventure is set in space, so work with your partner to capture every alien.
park-tycoon: Build a theme park from scratch in a 3D world. You begin with one ticket booth and gradually expand it into a busy park. Gather the cash visitors leave behind by walking over it, and step onto a construction tile to open a ride or upgrade it up to level 5. Hire cashiers, operators, vendors, cleaners and technicians, and the park can eventually run on its own.
Pirate Bay, with its swinging ship, log flume and pirate coaster, is wai
santa-vs-zomby: On the night before Christmas, a crowd of zombies breaks into Santa's base and walks off with the presents meant for children. The elves are stunned, so the job falls to you. Your task is to aim Santa and launch him at the zombies, using physics to make them fall or crash until none remain.

Every level must be cleared before you move on, and doing so brings the stolen gifts back and saves Christmas. The rules are simple, and the physics keep each launch fun to watch. Play with a mouse click or a tap.
space-tower-defense: Space Tower Defense asks you to guard your high-tech base against waves of attackers that never let up. Your job is to decide where each tower goes, and you will need to plan those spots carefully. The battles unfold on shifting three-dimensional fields, and you can rely on cutting-edge technology to push back the invaders.

As the fighting intensifies, you must respond fast and keep improving your weapons so you can come out on top. If your defenses collapse, though, the run ends and you have to begin again from the start.
bob-save-stuart: Bob has to hurry because his friends are in serious trouble. A purple cloud and a purple liquid are poisoning them and turning them into purple monsters. Stuart needs Bob's protection from that smoke. Lift the cage and dash away before the fumes arrive, gathering bananas along the way to rescue the group.
Watch for the purple monsters, which want to eat Bob, so he must run from them. Move using WASD or the arrow keys, or use touch controls on mobile. Double jumping is enabled throughout the game.
survive-lava-for-brainrots: Race ahead and gather Brainrots while staying one step ahead of the lava that keeps climbing behind you. Every Brainrot you pick up helps you get farther, and boosting their power brings in more cash over time. Spend your earnings on upgrades for your base so it can hold a bigger crowd of characters.
Keep moving, grab what you can, and don't let the molten wave catch up. The longer you dodge it, the more you can build, so plan each run and see how far your base can grow.
tank-1944: Tanks 1944 puts you in charge of armored vehicles in a setting built around lifelike tank combat. You pick a tank, then learn how to handle it in battle. Over time you can shape your own approach, mixing strategy and tactics to suit your style. The game uses realistic physics, detailed graphics with shadowed objects, and physics-driven grass. Battles are extended, giving you time to plan each move.

Your objective is to defeat everyone on the battlefield. Start by choosing a tank and launching the game. Then work out the angle and force of each shot, and pull the trigger to fire. Keep going until your opponent has been defeated.
minicat-fisher: Take on the role of a cat who goes after fish using harpoons. You can try out a variety of harpoons and items while you fish. Along the way you will meet all kinds of fish, from adorable ones to strange-looking ones. The game is controlled with a mouse click or by tapping a touch screen.
mr-dude-king-of-the-hill: Mister Dude, a well-known crook, ends up at the summit of a mountain where the locals are waiting to turn him in to the cops. Your job is to keep him out of their hands, take down every foe, and claim the peak. The game is built around interactive ragdoll characters, so you knock opponents over, grab them, and fling them using physics-driven, silly ragdoll reactions. Plenty of objects can be picked up and hurled at enemies, and the mix of options and tactics keeps each fight lively. Expect a range of enemies, levels, and modes.

On a computer, move with WASD, jump with Space, and pick up items with F. Press G to eat food and E to grab a ledge. Use the left mouse button to hit or throw, hold the right button to aim, and press 1, 2, or 3 to switch between items.
grand-prix-hero: Race through the Grand Prix Series, which takes you across several continents. Weave past other vehicles on the road, push your speed for a boost when the pace gets high, and grab coins along the way. Spend what you collect on car upgrades to prepare for the following race.

Controls are simple. On a phone or tablet, touch the screen to steer. On a computer, use the cursor keys or WASD to move your car. The game challenges you to prove you deserve the Grand Prix Hero title.
neon-velocity: Neon Velocity is a quick, demanding platformer built around precision. You play as a high-speed operative in a glowing cyberpunk universe, where running, wall-jumping, and dashing are your main tools. The journey covers 50 hand-built stages, and each one tends to push harder than the last.

Your task is to keep your momentum going. Dash straight through enemy drones to destroy them, cross platforms that crumble beneath you, and slip past deadly laser grids. Move with A and D or the Left and Right Arrow keys, jump with W or Up Arrow, and double-tap A, D, or the matching arrow keys to dash. Controls are tight, respawns are instant, and the neon look ties it all together, making this a strong test of your reflexes.
black-hole-attack: Black Hole Attack puts you in charge of a black hole within a lively arcade world. You need to plan your moves fast, because you must quickly gather weapons before facing tough boss battles. Those fights reward speed and sharp thinking, so stay alert the whole time.
The game is built around testing your reflexes, and it also gives you a leaderboard to climb. The whole experience is fast-paced. It sits in the Fun category and carries the same tag.
geometry-black-ball: Geometry: Black Ball is an arcade game inspired by Geometry Dash, where you guide a ball past obstacles by switching its gravity. The ten levels vary in difficulty, and each one tests your reflexes and how precisely you move. As you progress, the obstacles grow tougher, so the challenge keeps rising.
Choose any of the ten levels from the menu, where each button shows that level's difficulty
robot-strike-fps-shooter: Robot Strike: FPS Shooter puts you in a 3D first-person view on a battlefield filled with hostile robots. Your job is to aim your weapons and take down the dangerous mechanical enemies you meet. Every fight tests your shooting ability, and you must survive tough encounters to keep going. Challenging battles and missions await, all delivered through an immersive first-person experience.
Movement uses the W, A, S, and D keys, while the mouse controls your aim. Click the left mouse button to shoot, press the spacebar to jump, and tap R to reload.
ragdoll-show-throw-break-and-destroy: Ragdoll Show: Throw, Break and Destroy! is a relaxed puzzle game that mixes logic challenges with lifelike physics. It works like a doll simulator where chaos is the main attraction. Your job is to grab the ragdoll and drag it toward different objects, then see what happens when it collides with them.

Play around with a range of items and try different angles to cause the most damage possible. Every throw can bring a new surprise, so experimenting is part of the fun. If you enjoy messy, physics-driven mayhem, this one lets you toss, smash and wreck the ragdoll to your heart's content.
diamond-painting-by-number: Diamond Painting by Number is a coloring game where you draw, fill in colors, and build diamond artwork by following the numbers. The game includes a wide range of attractive diamond designs, all presented as coloring books you can work through.
On a computer, you play with a left click of your mouse. On a phone or tablet, you touch the game elements on the touch screen. The controls are simple and designed for everyone.
frogtastic-marble-adventure: Frogtastic Marble Adventure is a free puzzle game you can play right in your browser. It challenges your strategy and how quickly you think. Your goal is to stop a line of colored marbles before they travel along their route, and you do this by lining up matches and clearing them away.

To play, shoot colorful spheres into the track and form groups of at least three spheres that share a color, and those groups will burst. Act fast, because the spheres keep moving along a path that grows more winding as you go. You must never let them reach the final destination. The game works on any device, so you can enjoy it wherever you like.
mini-pool-3d: Sink every ball on the table in this bright, colorful 3D billiards game. You can pick from three ways to play: a relaxed Classic mode with free play, a set of 20 Arcade levels, or Time Attack, where you race the clock to clear the table. The game is simple to pick up, but getting really good at it takes practice.

Play is controlled with a mouse click or a tap, so there is only one input to learn. Switch between the modes whenever you want a different kind of round, and keep practicing until the shots start to feel natural.
basket-battle: Basket Battle puts a fresh spin on the classic game of basketball and lets you compete head to head. Your aim is to plan your moves, get past your rival, and turn each shot into points while stopping them from scoring. Every block and basket adds to the pressure, so the match keeps you on your toes and rewards careful thinking as much as quick reactions.

Because the stakes stay high from start to finish, the game feels intense without losing its tactical side. Each play gives you a chance to outwit your opponent, and the back-and-forth between attack and defense keeps the energy up. If you enjoy a competitive contest where strategy matters, this one has plenty to offer.
obby-craft-build-a-plane: Step into the role of an aircraft designer in this free browser game. You assemble your plane from parts in a handy constructor, and every block affects how it flies. Approach the aircraft, pick a part from the inventory at the bottom, and click to install it beside the plane. Dozens of parts are available, and the store sells more when you run short. You can save up to four builds for your projects.

Before takeoff, level up the slingshot to launch your plane faster and higher. Once airborne, steer it and grab the coins scattered across the map, since they serve as the in-game currency for upgrades. Spin the roulette for bonuses, and browse the parts store for items and skins, including 2 free skins. Complete the level, test your creation in this flight simulator, tackle the Obbi obstacle course, and see whether your plane truly stands out.
bunny-stack-jump: Bunny Stack Jump is an arcade game in which you guide a lively bunny to stack blocks higher and higher. Time each jump with care to earn style points, and avoid dangers such as the ghost ship.

There is no set limit on how far you can climb, since the game pursues endless heights across its dynamic modes. Power-ups of many kinds can help you along the way, so every run can feel a little different.
alien-bubbles: Alien Bubbles puts you in a playful adventure where a brave dinosaur steps up to push back an alien attack. Armed with a reliable launcher and bright arrows, you fire at colorful bubble invaders and pop them to protect our planet. This title sits in the monster category.

Each shot matters, so pick your moments carefully and aim with purpose. Power-ups can turn the tide when used at the right time, so save them for the toughest threats from outer space. Keep firing until Earth is safe again.
knives: Knives is an arcade game that rewards quick reactions and careful aim. Your job is to throw blades at a target that keeps spinning, all while steering clear of knives already stuck in it. As the game goes on, the challenge ramps up, so timing your throws becomes just as important as where you aim. Every toss asks for focus and a steady hand.

Take your time to learn the rhythm of the spinning target, since a well-timed throw can make the difference between a clean hit and a miss. Aim with care, keep your concentration sharp, and see how high you can climb on the leaderboard.
lovely-doll-creator: Lovely Doll Creator is a fashion avatar maker and self emoji tool that lets you design your own avatar face. You can pick from a wide range of skin tones, eye colors, hairstyles, and hair colors, along with other options, to shape the look you want.

The game works with a mouse or by tapping the screen, so you can play on a computer or a touch device. It sits in the Girls category and is tagged for creation, decorating, design, and dress up. Try different combinations until the result feels right to you.
kingdom-tower-defense: Step into the role of a magical monarch who must hold off waves of attackers approaching the castle. Your skills are the key to keeping foes away from the walls, and every battle pits your heroes and spells against monsters and invaders bent on seizing the land. Gather money as you go, then spend it on stronger weapons and fresh power-ups before the final boss makes its way to your stronghold. A wide range of special abilities helps you push back the crowds of enemies in this fantasy tower defense adventure.

Aiming is simple. On a computer, point with the mouse and click to fire, while on a phone or tablet, touch the screen to aim and shoot. Improve your weaponry and the properties of your defenses so your tower can endure the terrible creatures for longer.
bmg-crashday-2025: BMG! CrashDay 2025 is a racing game that blends arcade fun with a fair amount of realism. You pick from a range of distinctively designed cars and take them onto demanding tracks where the physics feel true to life. Along the way you will need to handle sharp bends, steep hills, and surprise hazards that appear without warning.
The result is a thrilling, absorbing drive that keeps you focused from start to finish. If you enjoy racing that rewards careful handling as much as speed, this one is worth a look.
cat-lovescapes: Cat Lovescapes puts you in charge of a lovesick black cat who is determined to reach the bell-wearing cat he adores. Along the way you solve whimsical puzzles that twist through everyday household settings. You play matchmaker, steering the little feline past charming domestic obstacles while outwitting other curious cats who want to get in the way.

This point-and-click adventure is relaxed and free of pressure, so you can take your time with each scene. The game's core message is that love always finds a way, and your job is to help it along one clever move at a time.
gang-blast: Gang Blast is a shooter where you take cover and guide a group of people out of danger. A horde of out-of-control dinosaurs stands between them and freedom, so you must protect the evacuation and clear a path through. Cash lets you unlock powerful weapons and perks to help you survive. Planning matters too, since you can map out escape routes and outwit the guards.
Every decision counts, because one mistake could jeopardize the entire rescue. The game is controlled with a mouse click or a tap. Your task is to escort everyone safely to the end.
stickman-archer-kick: Pick up a bow and arrows in this shooting game and aim at stickmen who need saving. Their floppy, ragdoll-style bodies react to every hit, and the game physics make each shot feel lively. Your job is to fire arrows and deliver kicks to the stick figures, keeping them alive as you go.

Work through the levels and clear them all to rescue every stickman. Along the way, collect stars to unlock a new character. Everything is controlled with the mouse or touch, so you can start aiming right away.
diy-phone-case-maker: DIY Phone Case Maker is a decoration game about customizing your phone case to show your own taste. It suits seasoned artists as well as anyone who simply wants a relaxed, creative way to pass the time. You start with a plain case and turn it into something one of a kind.

Painting lets you pick from bright colors, from soft pastels to glowing neons. Acrylic art invites you to swirl, mix, and pour paint into eye-catching abstract patterns. You can also add whimsical or edgy stickers, including quotes and quirky characters. Pop it and fidget toys can be worked into your design, and keychains that dangle and dance come in a variety of styles to finish the look.
football-crash: Football Crash puts you on the field, where you must slip past aggressive opponents. Controls are simple: a single swipe of one finger steers your player, so the moves feel natural from the first try. Your job is to guide your runner into the end zone for elusive touchdowns, all while the defenders become more persistent as you go.

The game looks sharp, with captivating graphics and seamless animations that keep the action flowing. The challenge is a fast gridiron test played entirely on your screen, and it delivers a lively football experience. Fans of quick, reflex-based sports games will find plenty to enjoy here.
mineworld-horror-the-mansion: Half a day ago, two police officers and a medic went to a mansion on the edge of town after receiving a call about something strange happening there. Nobody has heard from them since. You are sent to look into the house and wait for backup to arrive, but things quickly spiral out of control. The game mixes a Minecraft-style world with first and third person views, combining a horror shooter with an escape challenge.

You get six weapons to use, two melee and four ranged, and you will face more than ten kinds of zombies. Left mouse fires, right mouse raises your sights, and C switches the camera mode. W, A, S and D move your character, Shift sprints, Ctrl crouches, and X drops you into a prone position. Space makes you jump, F uses items, and R reloads. The visuals are rendered in 3D.
school-of-basketball: Step onto the court in School of Basketball, an arcade game where you aim to sink baskets across several game modes. The setting is a basketball academy that welcomes fans eager to sharpen their aim. Finding the right spot to target is the core challenge, and there may be secret strategies to discover. Your supply of balls is limited, so every miss costs one, although a streak of clean shots can sometimes earn you an extra.

Throwing is simple: touch anywhere on the screen and drag. Arcade mode gives you 10 balls and gets harder each time you score. Time attack offers unlimited balls, but the clock is ticking, so pile up as many baskets as you can before time runs out. Distance mode lets each successful shot push your range farther, while every miss shortens it, and reaching zero ends the game.
santa-gift-matching: Santa Gift Matching is a cheerful holiday puzzler where you line up presents for Santa, and the arrangements get trickier as you move forward. You work your way through festive stages, and you can play with a mouse or on a touchscreen. Chase a high score, and finish each round quickly to earn extra bonus points.
Every successful match carries the warm, hooked feeling of the Christmas season. It is an easy game to pick up for a few minutes of seasonal fun.
cake-maker-girls-cooking-games: Cake Maker is a girls' baking game where you mix, bake, and decorate your own treats. Choose a flavor, then gather flour, milk, eggs, butter, chocolate, and fruit. Pour the batter into a bowl, slide it into the oven, and take it out once it has puffed up into a light foam. Afterward, you can create cupcakes, birthday cakes, and other designs, finishing them with sprinkles and icing.
The aim is to become a top cake maker and run your own bakery, serving a steady flow of customers every month. Along the way, you can present your creations to friends. The
city-bike-stunt-2: City Bike Stunt 2 brings back the series with a fresh chapter. The large Free Riding map has received a new layout for doing tricks. Inside the Garage you can improve your motorcycles and give them new looks. To pay for these changes, you gather diamonds scattered around the Free Riding map. New bikes are unlocked by beating the timed levels in the Racing section.

You can enjoy the game alone or with a friend in 1 Player or 2 Player mode. Player 1 steers with the arrow keys, uses Nitro with N, and switches the camera with C. Player 2 drives with W, A, S, and D, activates Nitro with T, and changes the camera with Q.
snow-mo-cannon-shooting-game: Guard your frosty friends on a snowy battlefield by operating a cannon that fires at waves of advancing snowball foes. You aim and shoot by tapping and dragging. Smart upgrades to your cannon, along with quick reactions, will help you get through a nonstop stream of enemies and tough boss encounters.
Your task is to take control of the snowy field before the snow bears can claim the win. Plan your upgrades carefully, keep your reflexes sharp, and hold the line for as long as you can.
ninjas-blade: Step into a grim ninja world where danger waits in every shadow. You play Ryu, the last warrior of his clan, and your path leads through waves of foes toward Tengu, the main villain. Expect dynamic battles, spectacular combos, deadly traps, and tough boss fights. The game asks for quick speed, careful precision, and the power of the Dragon in a demanding challenge.
On a computer, press A to move left, D to move right, W to jump, G to swing your sword, and H to throw shuriken. Esc pauses the action. On a phone or tablet, use the on-screen controls instead.
ice-man-3d: Ice Man 3D is an action fighting game where you take on thugs armed with chilly powers. Your job is to freeze enemies and then shatter them. Success depends on learning to dodge incoming attacks and landing your moves at the right moment. As you go, you can upgrade your abilities and change your approach, since the foes you meet keep getting tougher. Each stage brings you closer to restoring peace to the city.

The game pairs intense combat with striking visuals. Across its levels, the challenge steadily climbs, rewarding careful play and flexible tactics. Good timing makes the biggest difference. Expect plenty of icy clashes as you work your way through the city.
stick-army: Stick Army puts you in charge of a group of stick-figure troops in an arcade-style adventure. You lead them through dangerous terrain, where you can throw up defensive structures while the action is already underway. Enemies try to catch you off guard, so you need to slip around them and stay one step ahead.

The controls are simple to pick up, but the challenges keep getting harder as you go. Each choice you make can change how things turn out, so you must think fast and plan your moves with care. Your goal is to guide your army all the way to a win.
robby-build-bridge-to-brainrots: Robby is a 3D obby with management elements. You gather wood to build a bridge that carries you toward brainrots on other islands. Each bridge lets you go farther, and every new island you reach gives you more brainrots to collect. Along the way, you can improve how you gather and store wood so you can keep moving forward.

Your main job is to catch brainrots and place them on your base. Move with WASD and jump with Space. Hold the right mouse button to rotate the camera. Press E to place a brainrot on the base or take one back, and press F to throw one away.
black-friday-store-manager: Run your own fashion shop in Black Friday Store Manager and design the store you have always wanted. Purchase fresh outfits, stock them on the shelves, and draw in shoppers who want the newest looks. Each sale brings in coins, which you can spend on growing the shop, training your employees, and opening up new sections.

Walk your character through the store to refill bare shelves and serve customers quickly so they leave satisfied. You will also need to decide whether to sell budget, fast-moving clothing or pricier designer pieces that earn more per item. Control everything with a mouse click or a tap.
coffee-color-blocks: Slide colorful pieces across the board by tapping and dragging them toward the gates that share their shade. A piece only fills when it reaches the matching gate, and then the cups inside its outline begin to fill. Your goal is to fill every part of the figure while keeping paths open for the other pieces.

The look is warm and cozy, with a coffee theme and smooth motion that makes each move feel satisfying. Planning ahead matters, since a careless move can trap another block or leave you in a dead end. As you progress, new shapes, color mixes, and special mechanics appear, and the challenge gradually grows. It is a clever, relaxing puzzle that quickly pulls you back for another round.
makeup-stories-asmr-beauty: Makeup Stories: ASMR Beauty is a calm game where you help clients transform with a fresh new look. Each makeover moves through a series of steps, from caring for the skin and picking up beauty tools to adding makeup and choosing a finish. ASMR moments add to the peaceful feel, so every session is pleasant to watch and play.
Work through the levels and collect stars along the way. You can spend those stars on furniture and dec
anti-spider-run: Anti Spider Run is an action runner where you try to survive among spiders. Your character keeps moving quickly, and you can grow and change as you go through the run. Along the way you take on spider battles and work to capture territory on the map. Success depends on reacting fast and choosing your moves carefully, so it suits players who enjoy a casual running challenge.
The game is built around quick reactions and smart movement, so every choice you make matters. Controls are simple: tap and drag to play. Its tags point to running, strategy, and fun gameplay.
just-golf: Just Golf challenges you to send a ball through 210 minimalist golf puzzles, where accuracy and good technique matter most. An aim assist helps you line up your shots, but you still need to steer past the obstacles in each course. Every level has stars to collect, so you can keep pushing toward full mastery.

The game keeps its design simple, yet the puzzles are tricky enough to hold your attention. Its clean setup and steady difficulty make for a relaxed but engaging round of golf that rewards careful planning.
drive-and-crash-sandbox: Launch vehicles down steep slopes and send them into breakable obstacles in this high-speed car crash simulator. Every impact follows lifelike crash physics, so bodies bend, parts snap off, and cars fall to pieces under a detailed damage system. Pick from a range of vehicles and see how each one holds up under heavy collisions.

Join online multiplayer matches or enjoy the detailed 3D graphics and smooth driving controls on your own. Drive with WASD, brake with Space, boost with Shift, switch cars with N, change the view with C, and repair with R. Use V for slow motion and Tab to pause, or tap the on-screen controls on mobile. There are no set goals here, so just drive around and smash cars however you like.
black-hole-eat-the-universe: You control a hungry black hole that starts by swallowing single atoms and works its way up to planets, stars, and entire galaxies. A tap or click on the hole pulls matter into its grip. As your void grows, you can spend what you collect on upgrades that strengthen the pull and set up automatic feeding, so the hole keeps eating even when you step away.

Other features add variety along the way. A spinning wheel hands out boosts, and you can dress up your hole with different skins and hats. When you are ready, you can collapse the universe to earn Dark Matter, a lasting bonus that helps every new run progress more quickly. It is an idle clicker in a space theme, built around steady growth and repeated restarts.
musketeers-gunpowder-vs-steel: Musketeers: Gunpowder vs Steel is a free strategy game set in the 1600s. You lead a mixed group of soldiers, giving orders and making key decisions as fierce battles unfold. It runs on iOS, Android, and desktop computers, and it suits anyone who enjoys tactics drawn from history.

Your commander moves with the left mouse button or a joystick. Q and E turn the squad left and right, W sends it forward, and X moves it backward. A has the squad follow you, S halts its movement, and D marks a target for the squad. Press F to fire your pistol, V to mount a horse, and Space to switch the camera view.
dress-up-babi-doll: Dress Up Babi Doll is an engrossing dress-up game about styling a cute doll. Many players recall the small dolls their parents once bought them to decorate, though those dolls often came with pricey, hard-to-find outfits. This online version lets you try on a wide range of pretty clothes for the doll as often as you like, with no limits on experimenting.

Beyond outfits, you can change the doll's skin color, facial expression, and hairstyle. A careful selection of charming dresses has already been chosen for you to mix and match. Once the clothing looks just right, you can pick out hats and purses to complete her look. Use your mouse or tap the screen to play.
guns-vs-magic: You play as Silvius, a brave young student of magic who must save the world from the dark forces unleashed by his former mentor, Lucius. Lucius was once a wise and kind wizard, but a cursed crystal twisted him into an evil sorcerer bent on dominating the world. Your task is to confront Lucius and his army of enchanted creatures, relying on your wits, your power, and your courage.

The game uses the arrow keys, WASD, and the mouse for its controls. It is filed under adventure and carries tags for action, magic, RPG, and shooting, so you can expect a blend of those styles as you move through the story.
siren-head-nightmare-scary-survival: You find yourself trapped inside a spooky estate, hunted through its halls by the strange Siren Head creature. The game asks you to move quietly and stay out of sight in a tense, hushed atmosphere. Over several nights, you gather useful supplies that can help you get through each one.

You have no weapons, so your best options are to listen closely for warning sounds, step carefully, and avoid being spotted. As you explore, you can piece together the secrets hidden within the building while trying to slip away from a monster that never stops searching for you.
granny-s-mansion: Granny's Mansion is a first-person horror quest with a chilling atmosphere, designed for one player in 3D. You control a man who finds himself inside an unknown structure, and you want to get out as soon as possible. To do that, you have to search for clues and get past the required objects.

Everything is dark, and the only light is in the little building, where a sinister grandmother moves around the room. Move with WASD, interact with E, use your light with F, change the camera with G, restart with R, and lock the cursor with L.
train-drift: Train Drift puts a fun spin on drifting. You take the wheel of huge locomotives and guide them across scenic terrain, sliding through sharp turns while weaving around rival trains during fast-paced races. Handling is precise, so each run depends on careful steering and quick reactions. Every race tests your focus and timing, making it a racing adventure that feels quite unlike the usual car game.

Expect intense moments as you push your train to the limit and try to pull off bold slides without losing control. The track layouts are visually striking, and the mix of speed and precision keeps every attempt feeling fresh. If you enjoy racing that rewards sharp reflexes, this one has plenty to offer.
sweet-merge-cafe: In this laid-back puzzle game, you help Mia bring a little seaside café back to life. Combine matching ingredients by dragging two identical pieces onto each other, and they grow into a richer, tastier treat. Tap the generators to produce fresh items, though each tap uses up energy, so plan your moves. When a customer's order is ready, press Serve to collect your coins.

Those coins go toward repairing furniture and decorations inside the café, which slowly unlocks new spots to fix up. Your journey starts in a dusty old shop and ends at a lighthouse, with five locations along the way. The game is a rel
murder-mafia: Murder Mafia drops you into a web of trickery where each choice carries risk. You control everything with a single button, yet you still need careful planning and a convincing disguise to slip past the mafia and take out the Don. Scenarios keep changing as you go, so you can never quite know what waits around the next corner. Part suspense, part puzzle, it is the sort of game that pulls you in and holds your attention from start to finish.
police-car-parking-game: Step into the role of a police officer in this parking challenge, where you handle patrol cars through three-dimensional surroundings. Your aim is to sharpen your parking ability while enjoying responsive controls, lifelike missions, and entertaining tasks. Each car must be guided into its spot without hitting obstacles. Whether you are new to driving games or already a seasoned player, this adventure title has something to offer.

Controls are easy to pick up. Press W or the Up Arrow to move forward, S or the Down Arrow to move back, and A or the Left Arrow or D or the Right Arrow to move left or right. Any on-screen button can be clicked with your mouse. The game is filed under adventure and carries tags for police, cars, driving, and parking, with a 2025 release label.
hoop-stars: Hoop Stars is a basketball sports game where dunking is a big part of the fun. It takes a fresh approach with reverse basketball dribbling, a style that feels quite different from the usual way of handling the ball. If you enjoy sports titles, this one offers a new kind of dribbling to get used to.

The game invites you to take on players from around the world and gather every trophy on offer. It belongs to the .io family, so it sits alongside other browser titles in the Sport and Sports categories. Whether you are chasing trophies or just enjoying the dunks, there is plenty to keep you busy.
merge-home-ball-2048: Merge Home Ball 3D is a 3D puzzle game that blends classic 2048-style ball merging with cozy home renovation. Fire colorful numbered balls into the board and join identical ones, so two 2s become a 4 and two 4s become an 8, working up to large totals. Physics shapes how the balls move, so aim with care, plan each shot, and set off chain reactions and big combos.

Every merge earns stars that you spend on furniture, wallpapers, and home upgrades. Start with worn, dusty rooms and transform them step by step, unlocking new areas as you progress. Colorful 3D graphics and smooth animations keep the mood calm, and the gameplay stays relaxed even when a level gets tricky. It is easy to pick up but takes practice to master.
santa-snow-runner: Santa Snow Runner puts you in charge of Santa as he makes his way across icy, snow-covered terrain. Your job is to steer him along dangerous routes while dodging everything in his path. Along the way, grab the presents you pass to earn special bonuses. The controls are easy to pick up, and the levels get harder as you move forward, so the challenge keeps building.

It's a holiday-themed action runner that works on whatever device you happen to use, which makes it a cheerful choice for a quick round. Each run tests how far Santa can get before he runs into trouble. The goal is simple: keep him moving, stay clear of obstacles, and spread a little festive joy along the way.
ninja-samurai-runner-online: Ninja Samurai Runner Online throws you into a fast-paced rush where speed and clever moves matter most. You weave past enemies and leap over barriers as you run. Grab coins and ninjas along the way to gain boosts, then push through each stage using quick reflexes and smart planning. Keep your eyes open, and you'll be well placed to reach the finish line first.
lumbering-at-sea: Lumbering At Sea takes you on a sea voyage that feels nothing like the Grand Line. Your job is to gather materials so you can construct your very own ship. Once it's ready, you head out to race against other players, and winning brings plenty of generous rewards. The game is played in 3D, with arcade-style action and a focus on building and attacking. Controls are simple: click or tap with your mouse to play.

Its hypercasual design makes it easy to pick up and enjoy in short sessions. Each round rewards steady collecting and careful building, so your ship grows stronger over time. If you like quick, straightforward games where progress comes from gathering and crafting, this one is worth a look.
ultimate-robo-duel-3d: You step into a robot battle arena and face off against advanced machines in this 3D fighting title. The arena is built to feel real, with lifelike sounds, visual effects, and an immersive atmosphere that pulls you into every clash. You can take on the computer or invite a friend for a head-to-head match in two-player mode.

Player 1 moves with W, A, S, and D, throws punches with F and G, lands a special hit with H, fires a bullet with T, kicks with C and V, and uses B for grabbing moves. Player 2 moves with the arrow keys, punches with U and I, lands a special hit with O, fires a bullet with M, kicks with J and K, and uses L for grabbing moves.
flipper-dunk-3d: Flipper Dunk 3D is a sports game built around landing the perfect dunk, where timing and accuracy decide everything. You only need one tap to control your player, which keeps things easy to pick up. Each stage brings tougher hoops and obstacles to get past, and the levels grow harder as you move along.

Patience pays off here, since every clean dunk feels rewarding and your skills improve the longer you keep at it. The game rewards careful play rather than rushing, so take your time and aim for precision each attempt.
qblock-puzzle: QBlock Puzzle is a block game aimed at people who enjoy puzzles, jigsaws, and classic wooden blocks. You drag pieces onto the board and aim to complete full horizontal or vertical lines. Clearing a line scores points and opens up room to keep going. Try to keep the board tidy and push past your best score.

The game offers four free themes to choose from: Wood, Cartoon, Day, and Night. There is no time limit and no pressure, and you can rotate blocks to help them fit. Short sessions of about ten minutes a day are suggested as a way to keep your mind sharp, and many players find it a calming way to ease stress and focus. The game ends once a block no longer fits anywhere on the board.
crash-glass-boom: Crash Glass Boom is a ball game with a lively, colorful feel. Your task is to position balls thoughtfully and pair them by color, which makes them disappear in eye-catching ways.
