As you advance, the levels become more demanding, so paying close attention and planning your moves are essential.

The gameplay is easy to grasp from the start, yet the challenges are hard to put down. Your observation skills and sense of strategy carry you through each stage. You can also share your victories with friends.
urban-derby-stunt-and-drift: Urban Derby Stunt And Drift puts you behind the wheel of a stunt car in a game that blends relaxed fun with tougher challenges. Pull off tricks and gather coins, which earn you money for unlocking new vehicles. The driving aims for a true-to-life feel, so each model handles differently, and you'll need to learn its behavior to keep it under control.

Explore the open map at your own pace and take in its scenery whenever you like. Steer with the arrow keys, hit Space to brake, and press F to activate nitro. Tap C to switch camera views, and use Esc or Tab to pause the action at any moment.
lazy-orcs: In this clicker, you oversee a group of orcs and must get them working so they bring in cash. The king wants a castle built, but he can't pay for one without that money. The catch is that he is far too idle to order anyone around, so it falls to you to put the orcs to work.

This is a single-player game in 3D, and it is played entirely with the mouse. Your goal is to bring the lazy king's stalling to an end by getting the orcs to labor. Every action is handled by mouse input.
zombies-4-weapon-merge: Zombies have overrun the area, and it is up to you to push back. In Zombies 4 Weapon Merge, you blend strategy with shooting, so each choice you make can change how the fight goes. Combine weapons by matching them together to build stronger guns, then take aim and fire at waves of zombies that keep coming without end.

Everything is controlled with a mouse click or tap. Think carefully about which weapons to merge, since the guns you craft will shape how you handle the undead. The title sits in the arcade category and mixes fighting, shooting, strategy, and a bit of brain work.
arrowshift-classic: ArrowShift:Classic is an arcade puzzle game where your aim is to release every arrow so the stage is cleared. You begin on tiny cubes and gradually move up to enormous ones. Along the way you can unlock alternate looks for your cubes and compete for a spot on the leaderboard.

On a computer, a left click sends an arrow out, while holding the left button and dragging turns the cube around. The mouse wheel lets you zoom closer or farther away, and the Esc key pauses the game. On a phone or tablet, tap to send an arrow, drag with a finger to rotate the cube, and pinch to zoom in or out.
love-story-find-the-piece: Love Story: Find the Piece is a puzzle game about a couple and the funny situations they get into. Players try to work out what she is thinking about and what he might be hiding, following a story full of amusing moments. The game asks you to use logic and creative thinking to crack its challenges, and it also includes hidden object scenes for anyone who enjoys searching pictures.

To play, read the text shown in each picture, then drag the magnifying glass or scanner across the illustration. When you spot the correct item, click it to solve the task. Work through the tasks to finish every level and see how the couple's story unfolds.
mad-mad-unicorn: Mad Mad Unicorn casts you as a unicorn zooming through the air in a fast, thrilling flight game. A single touch steers your mount across the sky, letting you weave past incoming missiles while knocking birds out of the air to score points. Grab magic carrot power-ups along the way, and enjoy the silly visual effects that fill the screen as the chaos builds.

Each run is an endless dash where the odds keep climbing, so there is no final stage to beat. You can also unlock extra artwork to look through. It suits anyone who enjoys quick, reflex-driven action with a playful twist.
toca-life-adventure: Toca Life Adventure lets you act out any story you like. Familiar settings from the Toca Life series, including City, Vacation, Office, and Hospital, are gathered in one place, along with more. The game uses a 2D cartoon look and can be played solo or with a friend in two-player mode.

Your main goal is to collect balls, since each one raises your score and helps you unlock new characters. The game is endless, so you can keep playing for as long as you want. You control everything with your mouse or by touch.
ant-colony: Ant Colony is a 2D strategy game where you run your own ant empire. You manage the colony, gather resources, and lead your ants into battle against other insects. Idle elements keep progress moving along even when you are not actively playing.

Strategy runs deep here, so each choice you make can shape how your colony grows. Keep expanding your ranks and building a force strong enough to take on the insect world. Whether your ants can rise to the top is up to you to discover.
obby-parkour-with-ragdoll: Obby: Parkour with Ragdoll combines obstacle courses with player-versus-player knockout fights. Across three maps, you climb through courses, gather crystals and coins, and collect rewards that help you get better. Map One, Lava, is a gentle course for beginners, but a single wrong step sends you into the molten rock. Map Two is much harder, with spinning obstacles, vanishing platforms, and sliding blocks, and only the strongest players reach its finish. Map Three, Ice World, features slippery ground and risky jumps.

Shove rivals and knock them off the map with ragdoll physics. Each player you send over the edge earns you rewards, and the tumbles often create silly falls. Left-click punches, W, A, S, and D move your character, Space jumps, and C crouches. On mobile devices, on-screen controls appear automatically.
fnf-trick-or-die: Step inside the house of Lemon Demon in this adventure game that blends action with stealth. Your goal is to rescue Girlfriend from Friday Night Funkin' (FNF) before the clock runs out, so you will need to move quickly and think carefully as you go.
Use W, A, S and D to get around. Press F to pick up or use an item, G to drop an item you are holding, and T to come out of hiding. Hide, grab what you need, and make your way toward the rescue.
john-is-a-lifeguard: Once again, our planet is in trouble, and you must gather a large number of rings to save the land. Expect to spend much of your time leaping through the adventure, and be ready to clear out anyone who stands between you and your goal.

This platform game is built around running and jumping. You control the action with mouse clicks, the A, W, and D keys, and Shift. Each stage keeps you moving, so you will need to jump often and keep your eyes on the rings you still have to collect.
jump-and-fly: Jump and Fly takes you into a playful forest where you control either a energetic squirrel or a happy bee as it soars through the air. Press and hold to leap, gather coins to unlock power-ups, and make your way across colorful scenery. The game rewards careful timing, and there are secret routes to find along the way, so the fun keeps going.

Every run asks you to read the terrain and react quickly, while the bright, cheerful visuals keep the mood light. Whether you choose the squirrel or the bee, you can explore new paths and sharpen your timing as you go.
flip-gun-3d-ragdoll-shooter: Flip Gun 3D Ragdoll Shooter is a browser shooter where floppy, tumbling ragdoll figures take the hits. Each tap fires your weapon, and the gun flips over in the air as you line up shots at the targets. Hits send bodies sprawling in funny ways, and you can unlock new guns to change how each shot flips and fires.
Your goal is to clear every level by knocking down all the targets before you run out of shots. Smash
stacky-dash-nail: Stacky Dash Nail is a game where you pile nails into tall towers. Your mouse handles every move, so the controls are simple to pick up. The goal is to build the highest and most striking stack you can, and taller builds bring bigger rewards.

Think through each move before you make it, since every choice affects how far you can climb. The challenges never run out, and they grow more complex the longer you play. Each new height asks you to plan a little further ahead, which keeps the building going.
2048-cube-runner-3d-merge: Picture a fast three-dimensional runner built around the number-merging logic of 2048. You race down an obstacle course while steering a line of numbered cubes that grows as you move. Collect cubes with matching values to combine them into higher numbers, and pass through helpful gates along the way. Keep clear of saws, spikes, and moving obstacles that can stop your run.

Your aim is to reach the finish with as many high-value cubes as you can, building up your 2048 collection as you go. On desktop, click to start, then hold the left mouse button and drag left or right to steer. On mobile, tap to start, then swipe or drag left and right to steer.
space-shooter-boss: Take the controls of a capable spaceship in this fast-paced arcade shooter. Enemies and meteor showers arrive in waves, so you will need to dodge attacks and pick up power-ups as you go. Your mission is to bring down the formidable final boss and save the galaxy from its threat.
Steering is simple: slide the mouse
cooking-match: Cooking Match is a colorful game about turning ingredients into tasty dishes. Careful planning and quick thinking are the keys to success. Your main task is to solve match-3 puzzles. Building larger clusters earns bonus points, so aim for big groups when you can. The clock keeps ticking, so you must think fast as you move through a bright world filled with unique cooking challenges.
Each challenge brings its own kitchen problem to work through, and the mix of puzzle solving and time pressure keeps the action moving. It is designed for endless family fun, so everyone can join in.
zombie-colosseum: Zombie Colosseum drops you into an arena that never lets up, where staying alive depends on careful planning and smart fighting. Supplies are limited, so you must decide how to use every resource you have. As you advance, the difficulty climbs, and you need to adjust your approach to keep pace.

Your arsenal of powerful weapons is your main tool against waves of zombies that keep coming. Each battle calls for tactical decisions, while the striking visuals and shifting challenges keep the action engaging. The game tests how long you can hold out against the end of the world.
neon-jumper: Neon Jumper puts you in control of a small green square as it moves through glowing circuits and electrified pathways. The whole world has a futuristic neon glow that keeps the energy up and your reflexes sharp. Controls are simple: one tap makes your square jump, and a second tap in mid-air performs a double jump. The game never ends, so your aim is to stay alive as long as you can and set a new world record. Every run is powered by intense speed metal tracks. Collect coins and power-ups along the way to boost your performance. To play, click the mouse or tap the screen.
rise-up-hero: Rise Up Hero is an arcade game built around climbing. Your reflexes get a workout as you make your way upward through a tall, vertical course. Dangerous obstacles stand in your path, and you must find a way past them while using your agility to keep moving. Gravity works against you at every turn, so each move has to be judged carefully.

Every level brings its own set of challenges, and the visuals are striking enough to keep you engaged as you go. Success depends on planning ahead and timing your actions well, so think before you act. Your aim is to keep climbing until you have grown into a true hero.
4-colors-pgs: 4 Colors PGS is a card game that is easy to pick up but offers plenty of room for planning. You compete against as many as three computer-controlled rivals, and your goal is to get rid of every card in your hand before they do. The controls feel natural, so you can concentrate on reading the table rather than wrestling with the interface.

Every decision asks you to weigh your options and pick the right moment to act. Success depends on both tactics and timing, which keeps each match interesting from start to finish. If you enjoy card games that are simple to learn but reward careful thought, this one offers a solid challenge.
tiger-tank: Tiger Tank drops you into the fierce conflict of World War II. You steer your armored vehicle through tricky battlefields, using cover wisely to get the upper hand on enemies. Handling your tank well is key, and you can boost it through an advanced tech system that offers more than 30 upgrade choices for winning every clash.

The facts here are limited to what the original states, so no extra levels or features are added. Expect a tense, tactical experience where positioning and smart upgrades decide the outcome of each fight.
speeding-ball: Speeding Ball is a 3D arcade golf game with a casual, hypercasual feel. Each hole allows just one shot, so the whole round depends on how you send the ball off. Landing it in the cup is far from simple, and you need to judge your aim and force carefully to sink it on the very first try.

Controls are kept simple: a mouse click or a tap is all you need, on either a computer or a phone. Because you only get one stroke per hole, it pays to think through every shot before you commit. The mix of fast arcade action and golf-style precision is the core of the game.
nail-salon-manicure-fashion-girl: In this nail salon game, you step into the role of a manicure artist and design your own nails. Start by choosing the skin tone of the hands you want to work on, then pick the nail shape you would like to apply. Paint each of the five fingers in a different color, and add some glow for a bright finish. As you play, you can also learn all about nail art and how different looks come together.

Your collection of polish colors is wide, so mixing shades is part of the fun. Slip several rings onto your fingers to make them shine, and decorate your nails with sparkling gems. Polish and decorate until your hands look just right, then show off your nail paint art. Each design is unique and beautiful, making this a fresh way to express your personal style.
minimarket-67-7-store-tycoon: Run a small corner shop and watch it grow into a busy, money-making business. You handle the day-to-day work: filling the shelves, bringing on staff, and buying better equipment so the store can keep up. Quick service keeps shoppers happy, and as you speed things up, you can automate routine tasks and widen your floor space bit by bit. Each improvement lets you welcome more customers, collect more cash, and open up new chances to expand.

The game is built around simple management with no complicated rules, so it suits a relaxed session. New opportunities appear as you progress. To move around, use the joystick at the bottom of the screen on a phone, or press the WASD or arrow keys on a computer.
street-race-master: Street Race Master lets you take the wheel in a street racing game with more than ten distinct cars, three separate tracks, and several levels that grow harder as you go. Pick the car you like best, speed through a range of settings, get comfortable with each course, and push on into tougher races. The bright, colorful graphics and straightforward handling make it simple to start and enjoyable to keep playing.
To drive, use your mouse or touch screen. Slide left or right to steer and keep your car on the road the whole way.
ninja-obby-parkours: Ninja Obby Parkours is a 3D running game where speed is everything. Your job is to keep going and stay on your feet for as long as possible, because a fall costs you a life. You begin with three lives, and once they are all gone the run ends.

Solo players can practice their timing alone, or grab a friend for two-player mode, where both runners race to see who can get farther. Move with the WASD keys and tap the space bar twice to double jump. In two-player mode, the second player uses the arrow keys to move and the L key to jump, pressing L twice for a double jump.
bun-boss: Run a growing bakery with just one finger on a touch screen. Gather wheat, carry a tall stack of goods on your head, and bake buns, croissants and cakes. Restock the shelves and serve a line of hungry customers. Spend your coins on glowing floor pads to unlock machines and helpers, a terrace with tables, tips and coffee, and an orchard for pies. Donuts and sandwiches come later.

Expand into separate branches at the beach, in the city and in the mountains. Each one follows its own rules and grants lasting bonuses. Your bakery keeps earning while you are away. Move by dragging anywhere on screen, or use WASD, the arrow keys or a mouse on a desktop. Everything else happens automatically as you walk around. A yellow arrow shows your next step. Watch for Rush Hour, when prices go up, and VIP guests who arrive with big orders.
outfit-love-queen: Outfit Love Queen is a 3D run game built for fans of sassy, stylish fashion. As your character moves along the track, you grab beauty items on the way, and each one makes them look a little more polished. The shopping theme is part of the experience too.

Controls are simple: you slide to move your character. Sliding is the only control needed. The game sits in the Girls category and carries the tags 3D, run, and Shopping, which give a quick sense of what to expect
bois-d-arc-bow-shooting: In Bois d'Arc, you fire arrows from the top of a castle tower during medieval battles. Landing hits takes skill, since you must aim ahead of moving foes, and well-timed shots pack extra force. Enemies keep arriving in successive waves, so you have to hold them off to protect your kingdom.
Between fights, you plan your approach and spend upgrades to strengthen your defenses. This tough medieval defense adventure asks you to think ahead, adapt, and defend, so every decision counts.
fruit-box-sort: Fruit Box Sort is a calm puzzle game about sorting fruit into the right containers. You choose a box that is open, and tapping it sends its fruit onto a conveyor belt. Each piece must be matched with the containers waiting below. Plan your moves ahead, and try not to fill up the belt.

The game includes 210 levels that bring in mystery boxes, fruit barrels, ice, and linked boxes. When a level gets tricky, you can use helpful boosters for a bit of extra support. Play with a mouse by left-clicking, or tap the screen on a mobile device. Your progress is saved in your browser.
diamond-sort-picture-puzzle: Sort colorful gems in this calm puzzler by matching each diamond to its own color. As you clear the board, a hidden piece of artwork comes into view. The rules are simple to pick up, but the game is tricky to step away from once you begin.

To move gems, tap a group that sits in the wrong spot, then tap either an open area of the matching color on the board or an available buffer slot. Gems already in the right place stay locked. To finish a level, sort every active gem into its correct color and empty the buffer, and the artwork is revealed. Touch controls work on mobile, and a mouse works on desktop.
stickman-army-the-resistance: In this two-dimensional desert conflict, you hold your ground with a band of stick figures against waves of incoming enemies. You split your attention between offense and defense, and you can upgrade your gear as the battle goes on. Each new wave arrives before the last one is cleared, so you have to keep pushing back the threat before it overwhelms you.

Accuracy matters a great deal here. Target your shots swiftly, and secure rewards that help your side survive the onslaught. Your army is kept minimal and stripped down, yet your job is to lead it toward victory even when the odds are stacked heavily against you.
military-strike: Military Strike puts you in a true-to-life, first-person view of modern warfare. Expect heated gunfights where a single slip can cost you dearly, and where quick thinking, steady aim, and a calm head matter most. You need to keep an eye on what's around you, pick positions that give you the upper hand, and reach decisions within seconds. Each bullet you land may tip the whole battle, yet one reckless step can send you straight to defeat.
On desktop, the WASD keys work alongside M2 for aiming and M1 for shooting. TAB opens the scoreboard, and Q and E handle leaning. Mobile players get on-screen buttons and automatic shooting.
pilot-life-flight-game-3d: Pilot Life - Flight Game 3D puts you in the cockpit as a beginner pilot who has to fly through rough skies and deal with equipment breakdowns. This 3D flight simulator focuses on getting your takeoffs and landings right. You can try to achieve the softest touchdown, work through puzzles inside the aircraft, and handle the everyday demands of flying a plane. Each trip is designed to feel like a thrilling journey.

It's a flight title that rewards careful handling and quick thinking when things go wrong. Whether you are learning the basics or testing your skills against tricky conditions, the game keeps the controls and the sense of being in the air front and center.
memorybot: Memorybot is a card game built around recall and speed. Animated cards are face down on the board, and you flip them two at a time to find matching pairs before the clock runs out. Controls are simple, so the challenge comes from remembering where each card sits and planning your next moves to push your score higher.

The game looks polished, with lively card animations and a soundtrack that sets a calm but focused mood for each round. It suits anyone who enjoys a brain-training style puzzle, and newcomers can pick it up without any trouble.
block-bloom-124106: Block Bloom mixes bright colors with puzzle strategy, rewarding good timing and careful planning. Blocks of different hues travel along a moving belt across the top of the screen, while a grid of shooters waits underneath. Each shooter carries one color and only a set number of shots. Tapping a shooter moves it into one of your limited firing slots, where it automatically hits every block of its color that passes by. Shooters blocked by others can't be tapped until the way is clear.

Picking the wrong shooter is costly, since it occupies a slot while having nothing to fire at. If every slot fills with idle shooters, the board locks up and the run ends. Once a shooter runs out of ammo, it vanishes and opens its slot again. Clear every block on the belt to finish the level.
i-want-to-be-king: "I Want to Be King" drops you into a playful, whimsical setting where planning and sharp thinking matter most. You can take the path of a sneaky assassin, deceiving others with cunning, or you can play a watchful king who spots danger and outsmarts it. The cartoon art is cheerful and charming, and everything runs on simple tap controls.

Nothing stays predictable for long. Each choice you make leads to results that can surprise you, and those unexpected outcomes keep the game lively. It falls under the hypercasual category and carries the casual tag.
bottle-flip-game: Bottle Flip 3D is an arcade title that tests how well you can time your moves. The aim is to toss a plastic bottle so it lands on different items without tipping over. What looks simple turns out to be harder than it seems, because you must tap the screen at exactly the right instant to get the bottle to leap, flip, and bounce across a run of rooms packed with obstacles. Shelves, tables, chairs, sofas, and subwoofers all serve as landing spots, so you'll use whatever is nearby. Keep in mind that some objects are trickier to land on than others.
Controls are simple: use your mouse to click any button in the game.
blocks-puzzle: Blocks Puzzle asks you to place its one-of-a-kind pieces with care so that full lines disappear and your score climbs. Each cleared line opens up room for more demanding layouts, so the puzzles grow trickier as you go. You move pieces by dragging them, and the controls feel intuitive from the start.
The game is a good way to sharpen your sense of space, since you must jud
body-drop: This three-dimensional game asks you to find out how much force a dummy's body can withstand. You drop it from a variety of structures, and the physics behave in a lifelike way as it tumbles and gets damaged. Your aim is to inflict as much harm on the dummy as possible.
Launch balls at the dummy with a left click of the mouse. Hold the right mouse button to rotate the camera around the scene, and use the mouse wheel to zoom in or out.
maze-evolution: Maze Evolution is a single-player puzzle game built around mazes. The early stages are simple, but the challenge grows as you move forward. The game includes 28 levels and runs on any device.

Controls are easy to learn. On a computer, you use your mouse, while on mobile devices you can use a touch pen or your finger. To start a level, touch the black star first. Once you have touched the player, you can guide it through the maze.
obby-1-power: Step into a world centered on working out and building a physique. You begin with nothing and gain strength by clicking to carry out workouts, slowly growing your muscles. Every click earns experience and resources, which you can spend to raise your stats and take part in contests. Plan your moves carefully as you aim to be the top muscle builder in the game.
Controls are easy to learn on both desktop and phone. On a computer, press the left mouse button to work out and upgrade your character, and hover over menu entries to pick them. On mobile,
goods-sort-match-puzzle: Goods Sort Match Puzzle is a bright game about tidying up store shelves. You move drinks, snacks, toys and other products between shelves, aiming to line up three identical items so they disappear. Each successful group makes room and uncovers new products. Watch the open slots and plan a few steps ahead, because the clock keeps ticking until you clear the board.

The shelf setups vary, and helpful boosters can rescue you from tight spots. On a computer, press and hold an item, then let go over an empty slot on another shelf. On a touch screen, touch and slide items to empty slots in the same way. On-screen buttons handle boosters and pausing. Your progress stays saved in the browser you are using.
paper-panzer: Paper Panzer puts you in command of a German tank, where precision matters most. Turret movement is handled through intuitive controls that are easy to pick up. A key part of the challenge is weighing which rare tanks to buy, so you plan ahead before you ever reach the battlefield.

Set during World War II, the game recreates tank warfare with authentic weaponry. Your vehicle carries serious firepower, and winning takes tactical skill as well as raw force. Every battle gives you a fresh chance to show how well you can lead.
the-dwarf-planet: In The Dwarf Planet, you explore an unfamiliar world and try to uncover the secrets hidden within it. You take on the role of Mark, moving through striking scenery while working through puzzles and gradually putting together the stories the place holds.

The controls are smooth and easy to get comfortable with, so your attention stays on the journey. You can also adjust the resolution to your liking. Each new step brings something unexpected to light, making every session feel like a personal adventure across this mysterious planet.
big-boom-building-smash: Players who enjoyed Captain TNT or Noob Demolisher will find plenty of chaos in this demolition title. Your job is to bring down structures with dynamite, bombs, and rockets, smashing through whatever stands in your way until only debris is left. Hundreds of missions are waiting, each with its own challenges, and a single well-placed charge can set off huge explosions. The 3D graphics look realistic, and the effects add plenty of motion.

You can play online on a phone or a computer, either alone or with friends. On desktop, hold the left mouse button and drag to rotate around the object, then position your explosives where they will do the most damage. On mobile, swipe across the screen to choose spots, rotate the structure, and drop bombs wherever you like. Leaderboards let you compete with other players, and upgrading your weapons increases the destruction and makes your attacks more efficient.
duel-of-builders: Duel of Builders is a 2D pixel action platformer built around head-to-head fights. You can take on a friend in a duel or challenge the computer if you would rather play alone.

Player 1 moves with W, A, S and D, switches weapons with R, and attacks with the Space bar. Player 2 uses the arrow keys to move, O to swap weapons, and P to strike. Each player has a separate set of keys, so two people can share one keyboard.
fragment: In FRAGMENT, you are a human test subject who has been turned into a weapon and disguised as a robot. Your test is to shoot your way through it and destroy the heart behind your creation. The game has about 40 levels, and you are encouraged to finish them as fast as you can. It is a single-player 2D arcade game built around destruction.

Move with A and D, slide with S, and jump with Space. Aim with the mouse and shoot with a right-click. If you get stuck, press R to reset. Press ESC or P to pause. The menu also lists Skip Intro, Exit, Time, and Screen options.
monster-wheels-apocalypse: Take the wheel of a towering monster car and clear the road of every rival vehicle, plane, and enemy soldier in your path. The roads have been overrun by a fleet of hostile monster machines, so the journey is anything but easy. Your job is to wipe out each enemy on the highway and push your score higher with every run.

The gold you accumulate can be spent on upgrades. Make your vehicle and weapons more powerful, and raise your speed and shield. Aim with the mouse and fire where you point, or on mobile devices, touch the screen to aim and shoot. Each attempt gives you a fresh chance to beat your last score.
sand-sorting-challenge: Sand Sorting Challenge invites you to pour colorful grains into bottles and group each shade together. It is simple to pick up and gives a fresh spin on the familiar color-matching puzzle style. The calm pace keeps things relaxed, but the levels still call for careful thinking and planning. Your aim is to leave every bottle filled with a single matching color.

To move sand, tap one bottle and its contents will flow into another. Grains can only join others of the same shade, and each bottle must finish holding just one color. As you complete levels, you earn rewards and open new bottle sets, each with its own shape and look.
stickman-gun-battle-simulator: In this game you lead an army of stickmen, and smart planning decides who wins. You choose from a variety of unit types, manage your resources carefully, and take on monstrous opponents across tactical battles played in 3D. Keep your forces well balanced as the fight unfolds.

As you progress, you can unlock more powerful fighters to add to your ranks. Every battle rewards careful thinking. Learning how to master the battlefield will help you secure victory and outwit every challenging foe you meet.
sausage-flip-free: Sausage Flip Free puts you in control of a sausage with a lot of bounce and a bold streak. Your job is to get through wild levels packed with hazards that demand good timing and careful aim. The game mixes silly humor with genuine skill tests, so every jump needs thought. Launch your sausage off the vine, then keep it moving toward the next pot, shelf, and other obstacles along the way. Each tricky spot rewards precise technique, and reaching the finish line wins the level.

Playing is simple: click the mouse or tap the screen. A single tap sends your sausage into a flip, so the real challenge lies in choosing the moment to act. It is tagged as an arcade adventure with a cute, funny feel and plenty of jumping.
block-vs-block-ii: Block vs Block II is a puzzle game where you test your skills against a clever computer opponent or a friend. Your job is to move colorful blocks around so they fill complete lines, which earns you points. The rules are simple enough to pick up quickly, yet getting really good at it takes practice.
The game looks bright and runs at a brisk pace, so every round keeps you on your toes. Keep an eye on your score as you go.
daruma-matching: Daruma Matching combines a traditional theme with puzzle play. Your job is to link together brightly colored Daruma dolls, and the goal is to build up a high score. The challenge rises steadily as you progress, yet the basic rules are easy to pick up. Because the moves are simple, the real skill lies in planning ahead, since each choice you make can shape how the rest of the round unfolds.

If you enjoy games that reward careful thinking, this one gives you plenty to work through. Watch your options, weigh each move, and work your way toward a win. The gameplay is not complicated, but the strategy it asks for keeps things engaging from start to finish.
border-battleground: Border Battleground puts you in the boots of a capable soldier caught up in a fight along a frontier. You rely on sneaking and smart planning as you move through a snowy, moody war zone, and each choice you make shapes how your mission turns out. Pick up weapons along the way, stay out of sight of enemies, and work through tough objectives aimed at holding back growing disorder. The whole adventure is seen through your own eyes in first person, which keeps the tension high from start to finish.
burger-game-burger-shop: You play as an ambitious burger owner who dreams of building a thriving business. The story starts with a modest shop where you cook and serve guests, aiming to make each visitor comfortable. The trade moves quickly and competition is fierce, so you will need smart choices and a well-organized workflow to keep up. As you advance, new challenges put your management skills to the test.

Open branches in new locations, each with its own customers and demands, and keep expanding without limit. Improve your kitchen equipment, uncover hidden recipes, bring on more workers, and raise their abilities. Decorate the restaurant with appeal
robots-world-battle: Robots World Battle lets you assemble your own robots before entering a tournament. Once your machine is ready, you take on one opponent after another with the aim of destroying every enemy you face. Only one fighter can remain standing at the end, so each battle counts.

The game is filed under puzzles and tagged with fight and robot, which fits its mix of building and combat. You start by clicking to play, and the whole experience is driven by clicks. It suits anyone who enjoys robot battles with a bit of construction along the way.
granny-chapter-3-high-school: Set in an abandoned school, this third-person horror game has you running from Granny and the ghostly specters of Slendrina. Your goal is to last as long as you can by gathering items that help you hide and get away. Search for the keys to the empty classrooms and pick up ammo along the way.

Find the revolver, which comes loaded, and collect every classroom key while the two chasers close in. Inside one room, a lone desk reads Granny and holds the key to a locked door. Move with WASD, shoot with a right click, press F to interact, and open the Esc menu.
downhill-car-ride-crash-test: Downhill Car Ride Crash Test throws you into a wild slope where you launch crash test dummies down the hill on scooters and bikes. Your goal is to create huge wrecks. Time your moves well to build up speed and cause as much destruction as you can. You are paid for both the damage you cause and the distance you cover.

Between runs, you can keep improving your vehicles and their stats. Each upgrade helps you hit harder and travel farther, so every new crash can look even more messy than the last. It is a loop of bold launches, noisy collisions, and big blasts that keeps you coming back for another go.
merge-battler: Merge Battler is a puzzle game with a strategy twist that plays out in real time. You combine units to build up sizable forces made of both warriors and mages. As you move forward, the enemies you meet grow tougher, so you need to keep your troop mix in good shape.

Your goal is to keep merging until you can defeat the final boss waiting at the end. Plan carefully, because the fight keeps ramping up the whole way. Get your tactics ready, since the showdown only grows more intense as you go.
your-majesty-build-and-conquer: Your Majesty - Build & Conquer is a strategy game set in a land of kingdoms. You play as a ruler whose goal is to bring back a former empire. You start by rebuilding a wrecked town and growing it into a busy capital. From there, you push outward and take over new territory.

Your work involves a few main tasks. You repair the ruins, construct new buildings, and gather crops and other materials that you can sell for profit. You also recruit fighters to defend your realm and to attack neighboring lands. Managing all of these parts well is how you grow your kingdom step by step.
cute-little-dragon-creator: Cute Little Dragon Creator invites you to let your imagination run wild as you build the dragon of your dreams. The customization options are practically limitless, so you can shape every detail to match your own taste. Simple click-and-drag controls make it easy to adjust things like color and accessories, and the result is a companion that no one else has.
Have fun experimenting with different looks and enjoy the pleasure of coming up with something new. When your whimsical creation is ready, you can show it off to your friends.
zombie-survival-2: Zombie Survival 2 is an Arcade shooter with a survival focus, set in a perilous wasteland crowded with the undead. You pick up different guns and other weapons to fight back, and you need to keep moving carefully while laying traps to hold off huge hordes. Your journey takes you through deserted cities, shadowy back streets, and eerie woods, and every stage brings something new to face.

Watch out for towering zombie bosses that test how well you can stay alive when the pressure is on. Along the way, gather plenty of helpful items that can repair your damaged gear. Controls are simple: click with your mouse or tap the screen to play.
desolate-isle-survival: You are stranded on a mysterious island in this open-world survival adventure, and your goal is to endure and find a way out. Along the way, you gather resources, craft tools, and build a base to work from. Each new area you reach has its own unique materials and challenges, so there is always something unfamiliar to deal with.

Finishing quests opens up new territories and reveals more of the island's secrets. On a keyboard, move with WASD or the arrow keys. On mobile, use the joystick to move and turn. Most interactions happen automatically once you get close enough, but some objects need you to press the button that appears above them. This game suits anyone who enjoys survival, exploration, or crafting.
noob-s-chicken-farm-tycoon: Noob's Chicken Farm Tycoon takes you on a playful farm journey full of odd charm. You raise unusual chickens, improve your farm through upgrades, and build your operation in wacky settings. Foxes are always lurking, so keeping your flock safe is part of the job. Along the way you can come across strange finds such as dinosaur eggs and the Skibidi Toilet.
Strategy matters here, and selling eggs can be very rewarding. The overall goal is world domination. The game sits in the Action category.
grand-city-stunts: Grand City Stunts is a long driving adventure set across a big city. It mixes stunt sections with races, and you can take them on alone or with a friend in two-player mode. Computer-controlled racers join every race alongside you and your partner. Finish first to earn a reward.

Player 1 steers with W, A, S and D, fires nitro with F, looks back with T, respawns with R and pulls the handbrake with the spacebar. Player 2 uses the arrow keys to drive, K for nitro, O to respawn, L to look back and the right shift key for the handbrake.
thief-puzzle-online: Step into the shoes of a stickman thief in Thief Puzzle Online, a browser game that mixes puzzles with fast, action-filled play. Your goal is to help the little thief recover valuable items as you work through levels that test your problem-solving. The game sits in the casual category, where easy access and fun are the main draw.

On a computer, you move the thief's hand with your mouse. On a touchscreen, touch the display and drag your hand to where it needs to go. The game carries funny, hypercasual, and clicker-style tags, so expect light humor and quick, simple interactions.
big-shark: You play as a hungry shark exploring the deep in Big Shark. Simple taps steer your movement, so the controls feel natural from the start. The ocean around you is bright and full of life, and it invites you to swim through its waters.

Growing bigger means swallowing the smaller fish you come across. Larger creatures pose a danger, so you must dodge them while you struggle to survive and explore what lies beneath. Your goal is to rise to the top of the food chain and become the leading predator of the sea.
flower-magnet: Flower Magnet is a calm puzzle game where you steer a charmed magnet through soft, dreamy gardens. Your goal is to pull in blossoms of many colors while dodging obstacles and winding paths that make things harder. Careful planning and good timing help you collect every bloom and finish each stage gracefully.

The game pairs a gentle soundtrack and elegant graphics with puzzles that grow steadily more clever. It suits people who want a peaceful experience that still asks for thought. As you advance, you open new garden settings, alternative magnet designs, and special flower effects. You control everything with the mouse, swiping and sliding your magnet across each garden.
carletto-halloween-dreams: Carletto wanders into a Halloween dream filled with floating islands, haunted forests and glowing castles. His telescope uncovers paths hidden in mist, and he can guide starlight through mirrors. Pumpkin creatures chase him, so you must keep moving and collect 90 stars along the way.

Spread across 30 story stages and six bonus dreams, the journey pits you against an old witch, a storm raven and a moonbound wolf, before you face the giant Pumpkin Phantom in three battles. Defeat the nightmares to help Carletto wake to a new day. On desktop, use the arrow keys or A and D to move,
bowling-stars: Bowling Stars brings the familiar lanes-and-pins experience to your browser with a straightforward, enjoyable feel. You follow standard bowling rules as you roll, and you aim by swiping across the screen, which sets both the path your ball takes and how much it curves. Every strike and every match you win earns trophies, and those trophies open up stronger balls that help you take on tougher rivals.

Cash is the in-game currency, and you spend it on boosts that raise your ball's weight, speed, hook, and hook control. The game also offers several skin options so you can change how your bowling balls look. There are no daily rewards, but special events are part of the game. Music adds to the atmosphere, though you can play perfectly well without it.
car-eats-car-sea-adventure: Take on rival drivers in a fast-paced highway race, passing opponents as you go. Build your own vehicle inside the incubator. Your buddies have been locked up, so your mission is to free the villainous cars from custody. Solid driving skills and a turbo boost will help you through this wild driving simulator, which also doubles as a police chase game. Grow into a car tycoon by upgrading your machines, and race monster cars against the cops. To survive, you'll need to defeat the boss in these over-the-top races.
Space drops bombs, X activates turbo, W accelerates and S brakes, while A and D keep the car balanced. The arrow keys also handle gas, brake and balancing.
drift-race-in-the-open-world: Drift Race in the Open World lets you take the wheel and practice sliding your car through corners. You can roam wide city environments, pushing through the streets at speed while keeping your steering sharp and accurate. Along the way, you can tune and personalize your vehicle to suit your driving style.

The game also brings intense crash scenarios into the mix, and hidden secrets are waiting for curious players to find. Each race is held against the clock. It's a sports title built around drifting, speed, and careful control.
bridge-race: Bridge Race is an arcade game that mixes collecting with racing. Your job is to gather blocks in your own color and use them to lay stairs up to the next floor. Speed matters, but so does blocking rivals from taking over your steps. You only win once you reach the final level. Controls are simple: slide your finger to move.

Think you have what it takes? Each round asks you to race rivals while keeping your path intact, so every block counts. It is a 3D casual puzzle-style game with a friendly, kid-friendly look, and it suits anyone who enjoys quick, competitive collecting.
good-knight-story: Our reluctant hero wakes up in a dungeon with a pounding headache and no memory of how he got there. Your job is to uncover what happened the night before by solving puzzles, battling monsters, and putting up with some truly awful jokes. The tale is layered and entertaining, and it unfolds piece by piece as you go.

Gameplay centers on finding combinations of identical elements and connecting them. Each level asks you to complete a task shown in the upper right corner, and there are over 100 levels to clear. Your character grows through a flexible upgrade system, and you can collect daily gifts to aid your quest. Special boosts unlock along the way, weapons can be upgraded, boss fights await, and a custom themed soundtrack plays throughout. You will also meet over 1000 handsome tavern owners.
archer-2023: Archer 2023 drops you into a futuristic setting where your bow skills are tested by accuracy, speed, and challenges that keep changing. You aim, pull back the string, and release at exactly the right moment to strike your targets. Every shot is a race against the clock, so you need to act quickly.

As you move forward, the levels grow more intricate, giving you room to show off what you can do with a bow. Each stage asks you to sharpen your timing and control. It is an archery game built around careful aiming, so if you enjoy precise shooting, there is plenty here to keep you engaged.
car-eats-car-arctic-adventure: Battle rivals on a busy highway in this fast-paced racing game. You can overtake your opponents and build your own car inside the incubator. Your friends have been locked up, so your job is to free the evil cars. Strong driving skills and a turbo boost will help you in this driving simulator, which also works as a police chase game.

Become a car tycoon, improve your vehicles, and send monster cars against the cops. Press Space to drop bombs and X for turbo. Use W to accelerate and S to brake, and A and D to keep your balance. You can also use the arrow keys for gas, brake, and balancing. Defeat the boss to survive these tough races.
death-run: Death Run throws you into brightly colored obstacle courses where every step is in your hands. Your clicks set the pace, so timing matters as you dash past dangerous traps and duck under blades that swing across the track. The goal is to leave your rivals behind and cross the finish line first.

Winning takes quick reactions, but it also takes patience, since knowing when to pause is just as important as knowing when to push forward. Each victory feels sweeter because of the effort behind it, and every misstep becomes a challenge to overcome.
tic-tac-toe-mania: Tic Tac Toe Mania gives the familiar grid game a modern makeover. Each match is a battle of wits in which you try to stay one step ahead of your rival. You can pick a three-by-three board or a larger five-by-five grid, depending on how involved you want the contest to be. Your goal is to line up your symbols while blocking the ones your opponent is building.

Play against a friend or challenge the AI opponent, and the strategic fun can continue for as long as you like. The game sits in the Puzzles category and carries the Board tag. Whether you are new to grid games or a long-time fan, there is plenty to think about here.
stickman-fighting: Stickman Fighting puts you in brawls staged in a 2.5D style, where chaining attacks and reading your opponent at the right moment make all the difference. You pick a stickman to represent you, then face a range of different foes as you work your way up through lively arenas. The game offers several difficulty settings and multiple modes, so you can adjust the challenge to suit you.

Your aim is to grow into the top stickman fighter by showing off your combat skills. Each victory moves you further along, and every new opponent tests a different approach. Whether you are sharpening your timing or experimenting with combinations, there is plenty to work on in this action title tagged for fighting fans.
betweenmarine: Betweenmarine is a single-player arcade game with a 3D look. Your goal is to steer a submarine through a course full of obstacles, and the longer you last, the more points you earn. Each run gives you a chance to beat your own high score.
To move the submarine on a touchscreen, slide your finger to guide it. On a keyboard, use the W, A, S and D keys or the arrow keys.
crazy-cart: A small blue figure pushes a cart loaded with bright, colorful shapes. Your job is to gather objects, pile them up, and carry them along while keeping the whole load steady. Watch closely, because dropping anything can ruin your progress. Each stage gets harder as you move ahead, and the physics-based gameplay keeps you on your toes.

The colorful 3D graphics and simple controls make it easy to start. Click with a mouse or tap the screen to play. Every level brings a new challenge, and you need to test your skills to overcome them. Your goal is
super-onion-boy: Super Onion Boy is a platformer with a nostalgic vibe. You hop across each stage, scoop up coins, and take on dangerous foes on your way to rescuing someone you hold dear.

The adventure is split into 15 varied levels, and the controls feel intuitive, so you can start playing right away. Its retro charm gives the game a classic look and feel. Aiming for a high score gives you a re
tanks-blitz: Tanks Blitz puts you in the driver's seat for armored combat that mixes realistic simulation with fast, fun arcade action. You aim to take control of the battlefield by choosing smart tank upgrades along the way. The game looks bright and colorful, which keeps every clash easy on the eye.

You can steer and fire with either touch controls or the keyboard, so pick whichever feels more natural. Your goal is to defeat opponents from around the world in intense warfare. Aim to grow into a skilled commander who knows when to push forward and when to hold back.
wood-color-block: Wood Color Block is a free puzzle game that mixes calm play with mental workouts. You work through a field of colorful wooden blocks, sliding each one toward the crusher that shares its shade. Every smash feels more rewarding as the pile shrinks, and the fun grows with each hit.

Each level brings a fresh set of challenges, and the difficulty climbs steadily. The layouts are tricky, so every slide, shift, or alignment deserves a moment of thought. You also have a clock to beat: clear your route and break every block before time runs out. As you advance, you unlock new tools and power-ups that help with the hardest stages.
pixel-art-color-by-numbers: This HTML5 single-player game asks you to color a pixel picture by matching each square to its correct number. No drawing talent is needed, so anyone can jump in and start building a colorful piece of pixel art.

The game includes plenty of free pixel pictures that suit both adults and kids. To paint, left-click once to fill a single pixel. If you hold the mouse button down for two seconds and then drag, you can color several pixels in one smooth stroke.
rewarp: Rewarp is a 2D arcade game where you move by teleporting from place to place. Your teleport ability helps you get around danger, avoid traps, and jump over obstacles almost instantly. You explore a world with plenty of challenges and secret routes to find. Quick reactions, careful aim, and smart thinking will help you get through this fast game.

You can play with a mouse and keyboard on desktop, or use touch controls on a mobile device. It is a single-player game, and it is listed under the Hypercasual, Arcade, Dash, Jumping, Logic, and Ladybug tags.
zombie-can-t-jump: Survival in this junkyard means battling nonstop hordes of zombies, with nothing to rely on but your own cleverness and your willingness to work with others. Construct tough barriers, dig through heaps of scrap to find weapons, and join forces with friends to withstand the walking dead.
The action keeps coming, offering endless fun and
mystical-blade-3d: Mystical Blade 3D is a simulation game inspired by B-Blades, where you design your own blade creatures. You mix different elements, blades, and rings in whatever combinations you like, then experiment until you land on a design you want. Crafting lets you try unusual pairings and see what each one produces.

Once your creations are ready, you can compete against players from around the world. Battles call for planning and tactics, and a strong performance can help you climb the rankings. The game is free and runs on both phones and computers, so you can play on whichever device suits you.
zombotron-re-boot: Zombotron Re-Boot sends you into outer space as a bold space hunter. Your job is to travel through worlds overrun by alien zombies and search for precious treasure. You will need smart tactics and a small supply of resources to stay alive. Shoot down the undead while steering clear of dangerous traps. Each stage puts your nerve to the test, and sticking with it is worth the effort.
The game is an action title and fits neatly into that category. Expect a mix of combat, careful planning, and quick reactions as you push deeper into each alien world.
smash-and-speed: Smash & Speed is a 3D driving game built around crashing and experimenting. Three different environments give you room to race, jump, and smash cars. Before heading out, you can give your vehicle a new look with paint, decals, and body kits, then adjust the wheels and suspension for bouncy or blistering runs.
Every map includes presses, ramps, and traps to wreck things with. Crashes look realistic, with parts flying and wheels spinning in slow motion. Mo
airplane-pilot-simulator: Airplane Pilot Simulator puts you in the seat of an aspiring pilot who takes charge of several kinds of aircraft across a set of missions. Your aim is to keep each plane under tight control so you can land it safely and complete successful rescues. Precision matters here, since every input you make shapes how the flight turns out.

Everything takes place in a wide open sky, which gives you room to sharpen your skills over the course of the adventure. Flying in this game is about steady, careful handling, and each mission is a chance to build that control further. The open sky setting makes the whole experience feel like a true adventure in the air.
extreme-ball-balancer-3d: Your reflexes and precision are put to the test in this balancing game. You guide a ball across wooden bridges and slim rails while shifting traps move around you and deep blue water surrounds the course. The physics feel lifelike and the 3D visuals are sharp, so one misstep can send you tumbling into the depths. Your aim is to stay steady, get past every hazard, and reach the finish line.

Controls are simple. Press W, A, S, or D to move the ball, and move the mouse left or right to swing the camera around the course. Stay calm through each obstacle and see whether your hand is steady enough to finish the route.
ghost-walker: Ghost Walker is a 2.5D arcade platformer built around a sword and moves that bend the usual rules of physics. Your journey takes you through a series of underground crime waves, where you fight your way forward with blade in hand.

Time slows down while you line up a shot, giving you room to plan each move. You can leap in the air as many times as you like, which helps you slip past incoming bullets and foes. Careful stealth and clever planning are key to overcoming the tough, nonstop challenges.
penalty-shooters-3: Penalty Shooters 3 puts you in a soccer shootout where every kick matters. You take turns trying to beat the keeper with your shots and stepping into the goal to block your rival's attempts. Along the way, you can use power-ups strategically, so think carefully about when to play them for an edge over your opponent.

Each match is a one-on-one battle where perfect timing makes the difference, and your precision and agility are tested against the clock. Win each duel, then keep going until you have earned the title of champion in this soccer showdown.
run-guys-knockout-royale: Run Guys: Knockout Royale is a multiplayer running game with a royale twist, and it leans into the funny side of racing with plenty of jumping. In seesaw mode, you hurry across one seesaw after another while keeping your balance, aiming to reach the finish line first. Racers must also dash through spinning wooden columns, dodge trap floors, and avoid other trap obstacles. After each level, the slowest players are knocked out of the race.

The second mode is mountain climbing, where the goal is to reach the summit before anyone else and jump onto the crown. Everything is controlled with a mouse click or a tap, so you can start playing right away.
swimming-pool-romance: Lucas is searching for a girl at the swimming pool, and it doesn't take him long to spot Natasha. She is so charming that he can't hold back. Your job is to help him win her over with his mojo so the two of them can share a romantic evening together. This is an adventure game filed under Girls and Love.

The game adapts to every device, so it works on both desktop and mobile. On a computer, you click with the mouse to interact, while on a phone or tablet you tap the touch screen. Whichever device you use, the goal stays the same: help Lucas attract Natasha.
kendel-7-days-7-styles: Kendel 7 Days 7 Styles is a dress-up game for girls that follows her through one full day, from sunrise to sunset. Each round reveals the current day and the occasion, whether that's a day at the beach, a weekend brunch, a workout at the gym, or a trip to the mall. Tap to choose a fresh outfit for Kendel, then style her so it suits the setting.

Keep going through the seven looks, picking clothes that fit each place and showing off your own taste. Once all seven outfits are finished, the game is complete. It's a fashion-focused game all about dressing up and having fun with every look.
slow-mo-blade-rush: A blade hangs in midair above a crowd of wobbly, jelly-like red goofballs with googly eyes. Tap or click to fling your weapon, line up your aim, and enjoy each hit in slow motion as the bunch tumbles and red cubes scatter. Throwing through a 3x gate splits one blade into a whole flying flurry, which helps when the crowd gets too big.

Topple the enemy towers to keep the chaos rolling. Then a giant blue boss appears, and you can reach for fiery weapons, frosty hits, or crackling lightning to make every throw more outrageous. A missed shot is no problem, since the next throw might turn out even funnier.
t-rex-n-y-online: T-Rex N.Y is a packed action game centered on demolition. You take control of a huge, ferocious robot T-Rex and stomp through the streets of New York. Your goal is to destroy everything standing in your way as you go on a rampage across the whole city.

The game is a harsh contest of destruction, so your focus stays on wrecking as much as you can. Move with the arrow keys and use Z or X to attack. Fans of shooting games who enjoy loud, chaotic destruction will find plenty to like here.
online-cats-multiplayer-park: Step into a lively arena packed with other real players, all moving in real time. You play as a playful but determined kitty who can sprint, leap, make guesses, and race against the crowd. The game offers seven modes to choose from. Take Grab A Shabby Ball, for example, where you face your opponents in a scramble to touch the ball and earn points.
Getting started is simple. A mouse click or a tap is all you need. Pick a mode, jump in, and see how your cat holds up against the competition.
zombie-survival-last-stand: In this first-person shooter, you fight to stay alive in a city overrun by the undead. Armed with modern firearms, you face packs of aggressive zombies that chase you through tight streets and deserted districts. You'll need careful aim, smart ammo use, and quick reactions, because the horde gives you no time to catch your breath. Each level tests your reflexes and accuracy, and the threats grow more dangerous the longer you last.

Keep moving, aim for headshots, and take down as many enemies as you can to raise your kill count. The controls are simple: WASD moves your character, left click shoots, right click scopes, R reloads, and middle mouse switches weapons. Press Z to lock the cursor and ESC to unlock it. Close-quarters encounters keep the action intense from start to finish.
mixed-world-weekend: Mixed World Weekend drops you into a colorful world where you team up with quirky cube companions to outwit round foes. Your tools include sliding across the ground, building platforms, and using a playful tongue to manipulate your surroundings. The puzzles grow tougher as you progress, so you'll need to plan your moves carefully.

The game blends strategic thinking with whimsical fun that people of all ages can enjoy. It is listed under the clicker category. Whether you like careful problem solving or just want to goof around with your cube crew, there's plenty to keep you busy.
stickman-shooter-2: Stickman Shooter 2 puts you in charge of a base under attack. Alien creatures and soldiers are closing in, and every one of them wants to bring your fortress down. The world has changed for the worse, with the green grass withered away and the ground covered in fire.

Your task is to destroy every enemy on the field. Collect coins as you go and use them to upgrade your arsenal, then hold your defenses through each wave until the last one. You can play with a mouse or by touch.
stickman-team-force: A brand-new adventure begins in this Kiz10 special, where a team called Stickman Team Force is recruited for a major job. Their mission is to restore order to a world that is under pressure from a high-tech organization. That group wants to seize the streets everywhere, so the stickmen must help put an end to the threat. Succeed, and you could rise up to become a leader.

The controls are easy to pick up. Press Z or click to shoot, press C to change heroes, and press Space to use Special. Filed under fighting games and tagged with Stickman, it suits anyone who enjoys stick figure action.
twerk-eat-and-run: Set out on a sunny beach course where tasty treats lie along the way and a rival waits near the finish line. Guide your runner past burgers, donuts, broccoli, and other obstacles. What you eat reshapes her body, so the path you choose affects how each run plays out.

Hold the left mouse button or keep a finger on the screen to run, then drag left or right to steer. Collect burgers and donuts, dodge obstacles, and avoid broccoli and salads, since they shrink your runner. At the finish, watch the indicator and tap at just the right moment to hit your rival harder. Earn coins to upgrade your runner and unlock
hockey-hero: In Hockey Hero, you step up for one-on-one shootouts against a goalie who is hard to beat. Every shot you launch needs both speed and precision if you want it to find the net. You get 10 attempts to collect as many points as you can.

Your points feed into a leaderboard, so you can aim for a spot at the top and see how your scores compare. Along the way, you can enjoy the rush of landing the goal that decides the game and feel like a champion on the ice.
spookily-stylish-duo: Arelia and Tiara are two friends getting ready for autumn, and they want to be fully equipped with great style. You can help them pick fashionable fall outfits and add accessories that bring out each girl's personality. The fun doesn't stop at the wardrobe, though. You can switch on the lights around the house, dress up the entrance, and transform the yard into a cozy, storybook-like spot. Let your creativity loose and build a wildly spooky yet stylish pair.
Controls are easy: use the mouse to click, or tap the screen on a touch device, to bring each look to life.
heart-calcopus: Step beneath the waves in Heart Calcopus, a game set in an underwater realm where a clever octopus puts your math skills to the test. Equations bubble up before you, and you must solve them swiftly to earn the octopus's approval.

Everything runs against the clock, so quick thinking is key. Charming underwater visuals keep the mood light while you focus on the numbers, and the challenge makes practicing math feel both engaging and rewarding. Beat your own previous scores to see how far you have come in this brainy adventure.
head-ball-hyper-casual-game: Head Ball Hyper Casual Game is a quick sports title built around head-to-head action. You guide your character by controlling its head, hitting balls as they come your way. The pace stays fast, so you have to stay sharp and respond right away.

The controls are simple to learn, but winning takes some thought. Decide when and where to strike so you can gain ground and climb the ranks. Every match offers a fresh spin on classic ball games, with an innovative twist that keeps the fun going from start to finish.
flick-shot-soccer: Flick Shot Soccer is a soccer shooting title where accuracy decides every goal. To take a shot, you pull the ball back by dragging to set your aim and placement, then let go to kick it toward the net. The controls are simple enough for newcomers to jump right in, but scoring again and again takes careful angles and good timing. Mouse clicks or taps are all you need to play.

Each kick rewards thoughtful positioning, so it pays to study where the net is open before you release. The game mixes a relaxed, easy-to-learn feel with enough skill to keep you coming back for more.
dead-seek: Dead Seek is an explosive arcade shooter where every shot is part of the fight to survive. You face endless waves of zombies and can choose from a broad range of weapons. Upgrading them increases their firepower, which helps you handle tougher encounters. As you explore dangerous zones crawling with infected, you can discover new tactics.

The game has bright, eye-catching graphics and fast-paced play with nonstop action. Shooting is automatic, so you can concentrate on moving and staying alive. On a desktop computer, use the WASD keys to move. On mobile, use the on-screen controls to get around.
fruit-slasher: Fruit Slasher is an action game where you play as a ninja cutting through fruit. You swipe with your finger to slice juicy fruits, so quick reactions and accurate movements are what count. Bombs and other explosive hazards appear along the way, and you need to steer clear of them. Chaining several cuts together into combos pushes your score higher.

The game is set in a colorful, fast 3D arcade environment. Along with slicing, you get to make tasty juices from the fruit you collect. Each round moves quickly, so you need to stay sharp to reach your best results.
cheese-collector-rat-runner: Cheese Collector - Rat Runner is an arcade adventure where you guide your furry rats along a rope while dodging dangerous obstacles. The action is fast, and one-tap controls keep every move simple, so the fun rarely slows down. Your rats are out to snatch cheese and earn bonus points as they go.

Perfect timing and quick reflexes are what keep your rats alive in this game. Its quick pace makes it easy to keep returning for another try. Can you grab the cheese? Well, that depends on how well you time each jump.
super-bowling-mania: Bowl on realistic lanes where the physics feel true to life. Drag to line up your throw, then swipe forward to send the ball rolling. Adding spin and curve lets you bend your shot toward the pins, aiming for strikes and spares. Controls stay smooth from start to finish.
There is no story here. The aim is simply to score more points and beat your rivals, who can be tough to face. A competitive mode lets you climb the ranking, and
road-designer: Road Designer lets you lay out tangled, detailed streets and then watch how vehicles get through the city you have built. You take on the role of a city planner, shaping roads and working out how traffic should flow. Once your network is in place, cars move through it in a steady swirl, so you can see how your design holds up in action.

The game is hands-on and interactive, blending creative building with strategic road planning. Each layout is a chance to experiment with efficient traffic patterns and see the results unfold on screen.
baby-taylor-babysitter-daycare-2: Baby Taylor Babysitter Daycare 2 is an HTML5 game that runs in web browsers such as Safari and Chrome. It also works on smartphones and tablets, including iPhone, iPad, Samsung, Android, and Windows Phone devices. Taylor's aunt has an urgent work meeting today, so Taylor and her mom are stepping in to look after the aunt's baby boy, who is not yet one year old.

Caring for an infant takes real effort, and you are there to help. Feed the baby and keep him happy by playing with him. When his diaper gets dirty, change it right away, or he will cry from the discomfort. The game lets you practice the skills of a good babysitter. Two players have rated the mobile version, and 95.68% of them like it. Controls work with the mouse or with simple clicks.
ninja-bamboo-assassin: In this arcade action title, you step into the role of a capable ninja sent on a covert job through dangerous bamboo woodland. As the Bamboo Assassin, you work through demanding stages crowded with foes, barriers, and snares. Your tools are stealth, nimble movement, and accuracy, which you use to get around enemies and take out targets without being noticed.

Quick fights, strategic planning, and fast reactions all matter here, and the game asks you to keep your timing sharp throughout. Its clean visual style and engaging gameplay make it a good match for anyone who enjoys ninja-themed games.
off-road-motocross: Off-road motocross puts you on rough, risky tracks where speed is everything. You clear obstacles, upgrade your vehicles, and work toward becoming the top rider on the road. You control a powerful motorcycle, perform stunts, and sharpen your racing skills along the way. Throughout the ride, you can feel both the speed and the sense of freedom.

Staying balanced is the key to every run. Press W and S, or the up and down arrows, to keep your motorcycle steady and under control. Use A and D, or the left and right arrows, to speed up and get past the various obstacles ahead.
stickman-mega-boss-battles: Step into the shoes of a fighter in Stickman Mega Boss Battles! Enemies keep coming in a constant stream, so you need to stay sharp as you clash with them. Swords are at your disposal, and you can collect stronger armor to stay protected as the fights grow harder.

Your main goal is to defeat huge bosses that stand in your way. Each victory lets you climb through a series of modes, and every win moves you a step closer to the top spot on the leaderboard, where you can try to prove you are the strongest stickman around.
destructive-car-crash-simulator: Every car here can be broken, dented, or destroyed, and the damage and deformation are shown in detail. Hitting a police car sets off a chase, since the officer will start hunting you down. Crash testing lets you sit back and watch each vehicle fall apart, with destruction that follows a lifelike simulation. You can choose from several maps and a range of cars.

Plenty of crash props are available, including cannons, catapults, hummers, and presses, for launching your car into chaos. Steer with W, A, S, and D, tap Spacebar for the handbrake, or hold Shift for nitro. Press C to change the camera, R to reset your car, K to restore it, and N to switch cars. Open the pause menu with TAB or Escape. On mobile devices, the game interface handles all the controls.
gothic-new-era: A gothic girl is heading to the brand-new Nevermore Academy, expecting it to feel like a bad dream full of disorder and puzzling riddles. Still, she is sure she will enjoy her time there. Before setting off, she wants a fresh set of clothes that still feels true to her style, so her wardrobe is limited to murky, shadowy colors, goth-style gowns, and school uniforms. Your job is to shape her into a one-of-a-kind dark princess and help her make new friends along the way.
Playing is simple: on a computer you click with the mouse, and on a touchscreen device you just tap the screen.
russian-car-drift-3d: Russian Car Drift 3D puts you behind the wheel for a drifting challenge seen from an isometric angle. You take corners on slippery tracks, and the controls work through simple taps that are easy to learn. Along the way you can grab valuable items and unlock a variety of different cars. Obstacles stand in your path, and getting past them takes careful timing and good technique.
The game is light and casual, so anyone can jump in. Your progress carries forward and never resets. You can build up your drifting skills whenever you like and at whatever speed feels comfortable.
chicken-dash: Chicken Dash is a quick platformer where a small chicken sprints and hops toward the finish line. Every level is packed with tricky hazards, so you must time each leap carefully to get past them. Grabbing the glittering coins scattered along the route pushes your score higher.

On a computer, press the Up Arrow to jump and the Right Arrow to move forward, or click and drag to move the chicken. On phones and tablets, tap the right side of the screen to move and tap and swipe up to jump. This HTML game is built for players of every age.
badland: Badland drops you into an eerie world drawn entirely in dark silhouettes. You guide a nimble creature through atmospheric challenges, where every flap has to be well timed. The screen never stops moving, so quick reflexes matter just as much as careful control.

Treacherous terrain waits at every turn, and transformative objects can change what your creature is able to do. Success depends on a blend of survival and strategy, so you need to plan ahead while still reacting in the moment. The result is a haunting landscape that lingers in your mind long after you put it down.
car-parking-master-3d: Car Parking Master 3D gives you a chance to sharpen your driving. You take the wheel of lifelike vehicles and aim for parking spaces placed in awkward spots on each stage. Signs point the way, and you must steer clear of obstacles while finishing every task carefully. The visuals are detailed three-dimensional scenes, and each stage brings its own challenge.

The controls feel smooth and are easy to pick up. Press W or the Up Arrow to accelerate, and S or the Down Arrow to brake or go in reverse. Use A or the Left Arrow to steer left, and D or the Right Arrow to steer right. Several cars and settings are available, so you can switch things up as you go.
chroma-trek: Chroma Trek is a glowing neon platformer with bright, colorful scenes. Each stage has its own layout and a fresh set of challenges, so you need to stay alert from start to finish. A color-switching ability lets you slip through different kinds of obstacles, adding strategy to every run through the shifting surroundings. Along the way, encouraging messages pop up to keep you moving toward the Finish Crystal.

Controls are simple. Press A or the left arrow to move left, and D or the right arrow to move right. Use W or the spacebar to jump. Your goal is to avoid traps, pits, and other hazards, then find and touch the Finish Crystal to clear the level. It is an arcade run that tests your timing and skill, and it also works on mobile devices.
angry-gran: Angry Gran is a silly action game in which an irritated grandmother takes on troublesome neighbours. She grabs a set of oddball weapons and turns everyday streets into a stage for comedic mayhem. From the first moment you pick it up, it pulls you back for another round.

The whole adventure is built around humour, with a steady stream of laughs and fast-paced action. The game has already drawn in millions of people who enjoy its wacky take on neighbourhood feuds. Whether you want a quick giggle or a longer session of chaos, it delivers both in equal measure.
hunting-master: In this strategic wolf hunt, strength decides every match. You choose which prey to pursue and compare your attack power with theirs before you commit. When your force is greater, the enemy falls and instantly joins your team. Each victory adds another wolf to your side.

Tap a target to check its attack power, then tap again to confirm and begin the battle. Tapping the upgrade option raises your team's combined attack. Swipe sideways to move between hunting areas and find new targets. The game is simple to learn but takes planning to win. Build a strong pack and take on tougher prey one step at a time.
smod-sandbox-in-backrooms: SMod: Sandbox in Backrooms is a mod-style title that combines sandbox building with the eerie setting of the Backrooms. It runs as a real-time simulation where enemies keep appearing and you work through levels to finish. A portal gun lets you summon foes whenever you like, and you can also take on quests and search for weapons.

Your goal is to destroy as many monsters as possible, saving your points so you can climb the leaderboard. On a computer, the left mouse button shoots, Tab opens the monster spawn panel, WASD moves your character, and mouse movement steers the camera. Spacebar handles both flying and jumping. On a phone, a left joystick moves your character, the right side of the screen controls the camera, and the jump button on that side handles flight and jumps. A box icon opens the spawn panel, and a gun icon fires.
professional-archerist: Professional Archerist is a quick skill game built around accuracy and motion. Your character is always on the move, so you need to run, slide, leap, and turn while lining up each shot. Targets show up at varied heights, from different angles, and at changing speeds, so you have to adjust as you go. Good timing, sharp concentration, and fluid movement count for more than sheer strength.

Land several hits in a row, keep a regular rhythm, and stay in control when the pressure builds. The arenas test how well you can move and how accurate you stay. Clean runs call for awareness, steady consistency, and a calm head at all times. Click to interact with the game.
master-checkers-multiplayer: Master Checkers Multiplayer is a take on the classic board game that puts plenty of thought into every turn. Its visuals are bright and colorful, and each move asks you to look ahead before you commit.
