You can face players from around the world, sharpen your strategy against the computer opponent, or sit down for a head-to-head game with a friend on the same device.

The game keeps the familiar checkers rules but adds a modern feel to the board and the play. Whether you want a quick round or a longer battle of tactics, it gives you a way to enjoy the timeless game in a fresh digital form.
100-doors-escape-from-prison: Step into the role of Beren, a prisoner who has lost all memory of his past. Your job is to examine unusual cells, work through tangled puzzles, and slowly uncover pieces of your own history. Each chamber presents its own set of clues that must be untangled before you can move on.

Success depends on sharp observation, because every room hides a route to freedom that is not obvious at first glance. Look closely at your surroundings, notice the details others would overlook, and use what you find to plot a way out. Your journey through the prison blends exploration and careful deduction as you search for the exit.
christmas-girls-dress-up: Christmas Girls Dress Up invites you to get into the holiday spirit by styling four friends for a festive Christmas celebration. Each girl has her own seasonal theme: one is a gingerbread-inspired sweetie, another has Nutcracker-style elegance, a third is a Santa-loving charmer, and the last goes for playful Grinch-inspired glam. You can combine tops, dresses, hairstyles, shoes, and accessories in many ways to build cozy, cheerful outfits. Let your imagination lead each design and enjoy the sparkly, stylish mood of the season.
On a computer, use your mouse to play. On a phone or tablet, tap the screen. Browse through the category items and choose the pieces you like best.
mazean-com: Mazean drops you into a cybernetic battlefield as a robotic fighter in fast, real-time first-person shooter combat. You can plan your approach using a range of laser weapons, while enemies keep coming at you without letting up. Teaming up with your squad is part of the fun, and moving through shifting arenas helps you slip past opponents and gain the upper hand. It is a multiplayer game packed with adrenaline from start to finish.
stickman-rescue-draw-2-save: Think of your mind as the stickman's only protection in this relaxed puzzle game. Stickman Rescue - Draw 2 Save is a very easy-going puzzler where you sketch lines with a finger to pull the little figure out of harm's way. Each level puts him in a jam, whether rocks are tumbling down, arrows are zipping through the air, or he's about to fall into a deep hole.

Your job is to decide what to sketch. You might draw a protective shield, lay down a bridge, or build some clever contraption that keeps him safe and finishes the rescue mission. Controls are simple: click with a mouse or tap the screen to play.
tractor-trial: Take the wheel of a tractor in this off-road racing game. Your goal is to get across the course by passing every obstacle and trap in your path, all while keeping your machine balanced. It is listed as an HTML5 racing title with obstacle challenges, and it is built to be played on mobile too.

On a computer, drive with the arrow keys or with W, A, S and D. If you are on a phone or tablet, tap the on-screen buttons to drive. Either way, you steer the tractor directly as you cross the rough ground ahead, so keep an eye on your balance at every bump.
robot-attacks: Protect your city in this arcade game, where robot invaders arrive in waves that grow harder as you go. You fight back by clicking or tapping quickly to take down the mechanical monsters before they reach you. Careful planning matters too, since you can strengthen your base and collect power-ups that help you survive the attacks.

Your reflexes are tested from start to finish. Every second counts, so you need to stay sharp and react fast as the pressure builds. Robot Attacks is a fast-paced title that rewards quick thinking and steady focus, and it suits players who enjoy a demanding challenge.
gladiators-merge-and-fight: Build up your fighter by combining materials into stronger gear, which improves your hero's weapons and equipment. Each match is a one-on-one duel in a harsh arena, and you can change your approach as the fight goes on. Look for your rival's weak points and press them to win. Every choice you make steers your champion's path toward glory.
The game sits in the Action category and is tagged Fighting. Its tone is rough and gripping, so expect a tense fight from start to finish.
challenge-the-zombies: Challenge the Zombies is a fast-paced shooter where you face off against dangerous undead foes. You play as a brave survivor who uses a range of weapons to help save the world from a zombie apocalypse. As you move through each stage, the zombies grow stronger, so you need to plan your moves and rely on quick, sharp shooting to stay alive.

Expect demanding missions and nonstop action from start to finish. The game will appeal to fans of zombie survival, shooting action, and offline zombie attack titles. Use your mouse to click any button.
the-escape-series: The Escape Series is an adventure title tagged with escape, brain, and puzzle games, and it puts your reasoning and analytical skills to the test. You search detailed environments for clues and objects that can help you get out. Each space has its own distinct puzzles and riddles to work through.

Everything is controlled with the mouse, which you use to select and interact with objects. You solve codes and apply logic and problem-solving to find a way out of each room. The game works on both mobile and desktop, so you can play on whichever device you have.
modern-strike-shooting-game: Modern Strike Shooting throws you into fierce fighting, where accuracy, quick reflexes, and smart tactics decide the outcome. You step onto the battlefield, take careful aim, and play through a first-person shooter (FPS) experience made for people who enjoy action and combat titles. Each shootout tests your skills, and every encounter gives you a chance to sharpen your aim. Fans of gun games, military combat, FPS shooters, and tactical action adventures should find plenty to enjoy here.

Movement uses W, A, S, and D, or the arrow keys. W or Up moves you forward, S or Down moves you back, A or Left shifts you left, and D or Right shifts you right. To click any button in the game, use your mouse.
pirates-tiles-challenge: You play as a bold pirate captain in this tile-matching puzzle. Each board is a grid of pirate icons, including flags, treasure chests, swords, anchors, pistols, compasses and more. Your job is to spot identical pairs and link them with a path of no more than three straight lines, as long as nothing blocks the way. Clear every tile to finish a board and earn up to three stars.

The game offers hundreds of levels that grow harder over time, all set in a colorful pirate world with a treasure-hunting feel. On desktop, click one tile, then its match, and a valid route connects automatically. The lightbulb icon gives you a hint, and the pause button stops play when you need a break. On mobile, you tap the tiles instead. Power-ups add extra variety, and the mix of simple rules and tricky boards suits players of all ages.
paper-doll-diary-chibi-dolls: Paper Doll Diary - Chibi Dolls is a free game for Android. Players design their own personalized dolls, then use them to take photos or make videos. Each doll can be dressed up in whatever style the player chooses.

The game also lets you build the setting around your dolls. You can pick from a selection of backgrounds, then add props and stickers to enhance the scene. These extras help each picture or video look more complete, and they give you plenty of room to get creative.
alchemist-lab-jewel-crush: Step into an alchemy workshop in this match-three puzzle game. Your job is to line up three jewel elements so they vanish from the board. Lining up four or five chips creates bonus pieces, and each bonus must be matched with a gem before it activates. You can also join two bonuses together to forge a philosopher's stone.
The lab holds more than 100 challenging levels, so there is plenty to keep you busy. Control is simple: swipe across the board to match the colorful gems.
robbie-draw-your-sword: Robbie: Draw your Sword is an online adventure that runs right in your browser. You collect swords, finish challenges, and gain levels to change how your character looks and performs. Along the way, you can unlock new outfits, pets, and abilities. The game works on both mobile devices and desktop computers, and it is free to play.

On a computer, use W, A, S, and D to move and left-click to swing and draw your sword. Press the spacebar to jump, and hold the right mouse button while moving the mouse to rotate the camera. On a smartphone, drag the joystick on the left side of the screen to move, slide a finger across the right side to turn the camera, and tap the screen to swing and draw your sword.
noob-vs-zombie: You wind through twisting, labyrinth-style terrain in this action title, where careful fighting and clever puzzle-solving both play a part. Stronger gear comes from upgrades, and deadly traps must be dodged along the way. Collecting coins helps you expose a betrayer hiding among the population.

Journey across a range of distinct biomes, uncover secrets that stay locked until you find them, and talk with villagers to learn more about the mystery. Expect a steady stream of tough obstacles and surprises as you press onward.
d-copter-reloaded: Take the controls of a strong helicopter and fly high above the city as you join fierce gangster battles. The game mixes airborne dogfights with precise long-range sniping, so you'll need to weigh each move carefully while dodging incoming threats. Between missions, you can improve your weapons and your chopper to get ready for harder assignments. This immersive 3D shooter gets tougher as you progress.

Each mission asks you to think on your feet and use clever flying to stay alive. Keep your wits about you, pick your moments to attack from a distance, and push through the rising challenge one stage at a time.
realistic-car-destruction-sandbox: Realistic Car Destruction Sandbox turns every drive into a crash test. You can explore steep downhill courses, dirt roads, cliffside routes, and winter terrain, or send your vehicle into giant presses, swinging hammers, and grinding machines. Car bodies crumple and parts break away during jumps, impacts, and crushing sequences. Fences and trees can be smashed through too.

Repair your car with R whenever you want another attempt. Choose any available vehicle and location, set your own goals, and explore at your own pace or join multiplayer sessions. On desktop, drive with WAS
snake-2048-io: Snake 2048.io combines a snake game with number puzzles. You steer your snake around a bright three-dimensional arena, chomping cubes that carry numbers and merging matching ones to help it grow. Each move asks for a bit of planning and a bit of math, so think ahead before you turn.

Rival snakes share the arena, so you will need to stay alert and outwit them. Patience and a sneaky approach can carry you to the top. Your target is the 2048 cube, so keep merging and see how far your snake can climb.
grow-empire: In Grow Empire, you can choose to hold your fortress or go on the attack. Improve your walls, towers and fighters with careful choices as you go. Your city faces elephants, siege guns and waves of hostile troops, while arrows and flames fill the sky above. You clash with Egyptian, Italian, Gallic, Iberian and Carthaginian warriors as your empire spreads across Europe and Africa.

Release your troops and they will fight on their own. Use various abilities and keep upgrading your warriors to turn the tide. Conquer enemy cities to collect chests full of gems, gold, potions and maps, and defend your colonies to refill your bank with gold. It is a strategy game that blends tower defense and army management. Aim to be the leader that R
fail-run-online: Fail Run Online is a funny, tough trek where each careful step tests your balance and patience. You need precise footwork to move along tricky paths while avoiding comedic stumbles along the way. Bright, colorful visuals add to the game's pull, making it hard to put down once you start.
Your aim is to walk the whole way without a single wobble. Each move asks for focus and patience, so take your time with every step. It sits in the Arcade category and carries the Arcade tag.
loaf-clicker: Loaf Clicker is a puzzle-style game in which you build up a stash of bread by clicking. Each tap adds more loaves to your inventory. As your pile grows, you can spend what you have on automatic generators that make loaves for you, plus upgrades that help you plan your growth. The game also tracks achievements you can earn along the way, and it carries a strategy tag, so careful choices matter. Your aim is to become a bread mogul and rise to the top of the dough-based economy.

Think of it as a race to build the biggest bakery empire through steady clicking and smart spending. Keep an eye on which generators and upgrades give you the best return, and watch your achievement list fill up as your loaf count climbs.
super-motocross: Saddle up on a dirt bike in Super Motocross, a sports game that sends you over demanding courses packed with ramps, jumps, and obstacles. Your goal is to keep your balance, build speed, and reach the finish line without taking a spill. The pace is quick, making it an arcade-style ride that suits players of all ages.

Controls are simple: a mouse click or a tap is all you need. Built with HTML5, the game runs right in your web browser. If you enjoy motocross or two-wheeled racing, this title delivers plenty of fast, bumpy action.
pixel-flow: Pixel Flow is a quick puzzle game about reacting fast and getting your actions in the right order. Each cannon fires only at pixel blocks that match its color, and every hit breaks a block, so the board empties one piece at a time. To win, you manage the flow of shots, keep the conveyor from overloading, and build combos. It is easy to pick up, yet lining up the right sequence keeps you coming back.

Tap a cannon to send it onto the conveyor. Once it completes a full cycle, it moves into a spare slot. Slots are limited, so watch the order closely. Shoot in the right sequence and the whole board will clear.
red-stickman-vs-monster-school: In this 2D fighter, you control a red stickman who takes on fearsome monsters in a pared-down version of the Minecraft world. Quick reflexes matter just as much as skillful combat and clever jumping across platforms. You will need to push through waves of tireless creatures and bring down oversized bosses along the way.

Every foe you defeat helps you move forward, and you can strengthen your abilities as you go. The pace is quick, so you have to stay alert and react fast. Whether you are landing blows or navigating tricky ledges, each battle asks you to sharpen your skills.
words-and-bubbles: Words and Bubbles is a calm word game built around association. Your goal is to spot words that share a meaning and group them together. When you tap a set of bubbles that fits, they fuse into a larger bubble labeled with the category they form. Those new categories can then serve as ingredients for later combinations, so each finished group may open up fresh possibilities.

The game holds thousands of stages, and the links grow subtler as you move forward, so obvious pairings give way to hidden ones. Achievements and helpful boosters are on hand for tricky moments. Go at whatever speed suits you, and you may find your attention getting sharper along the way. Before moves run out, make sure to clear every combination that remains open.
screw-out-jam-puzzle: Screw Out: Jam Puzzle centers on nuts and bolts puzzles that test your problem-solving. Each stage presents a tangled jam maze to work through, and there are 1000 levels in total, so there is plenty to keep you busy. You can play on either a smartphone or a computer, and the game is offered free online.

As you advance, you earn rewards and can use boosters to help with tricky spots. Keeping a winning streak going is part of the fun. Controls are simple: on a desktop you use the mouse, and on a mobile device you tap the screen with your finger.
boxing-stars: In Boxing Stars, you begin in an underground boxing scene and work your way up toward the championship, aiming to become a boxing star. Rewards along the way help you sharpen your skills, which opens the door to stronger tournaments. The game sits in the sports category and carries the boxing, fighting, and management tags.

Each match is won by knocking your opponent out. You can throw a variety of attacks, block incoming blows, and move around the ring, so you can plan your own approach and shape your own story. Keep training your abilities so you are ready for the tougher competitions ahead.
natural-disaster-survival-obby: Moving through dangerous terrain in this adventure title, you rely on fast responses to stay alive as disasters keep striking. Rising water, molten rock, and twisting storms all test how long you can last, while demanding obstacle routes keep you moving forward.

You can join forces with players from around the world, collect stylish outfits for your character, and bring home charming companion animals. Each run blends survival with course progress, and the main goal is to see how long you can hold out against the chaos.
super-onion-boy-2: Super Onion Boy 2 is a platformer that sends you on a journey through colorful stages with a classic, nostalgic feel. Your mission is to save a companion who has been captured by a mighty monster. Along the way you can gain special powers, search out hidden treasure, and get past foes by thinking ahead rather than just charging in.

Expect tough bosses waiting at the end of various stages, and keep an eye out for concealed routes that lead to extra areas. Each part of the game is built to keep you moving and curious about what lies just beyond the next screen.
dop2-draw-love: In this puzzle title, you guide a goofy pair of lovers out of awkward jams. Each stage shows a scene, and your job is to sketch the piece that is absent so the situation can be resolved. Along the way, you also uncover little secrets hidden in the artwork. The aim is to help the guy get out of trouble while making sure his partner stays by his side. Mobile players can enjoy it too.
Start by studying the picture carefully, then draw the missing element on screen. Once you finish the detail correctly, the couple's reaction plays out, showing how they respond to what
color-coin-merge: Color Coin Merge is a puzzle game built around sorting coins. You can try out several ways to arrange them, and as you play, you start to notice patterns that repeat across the board. When obstacles get in the way, you can call on special power-ups to push through, and each level grows trickier than the one before.

Your task is to place colored coins into slots and merge them until the board is cleared. Power-ups such as the Hammer, Free Move, Shuffle, and Time Slot help you along, and unique coins appear that change how each round unfolds. Later levels speed up and race you against the clock, so quick thinking matters. Fans of match-3 and logic puzzles will find plenty to work through here.
baby-bear: Baby Bear lets you experience both the happy and the tricky sides of raising a child, this time with a family of bears. You help Mummy Bear and Daddy Bear get ready for their little one's arrival, then look after the baby once it is here. The characters are full of charm, you can customize things in creative ways, and each scenario brings its own situations to work through.

The game is played entirely with clicks, so it is easy to pick up and start. As you move through the story, you follow the highs and lows of bear parenthood, with plenty to keep you busy along the way.
truck-transport-simulator: Truck Transport Simulator puts you behind the wheel of a truck in a driving game designed with boys in mind. Your job is to finish transport missions across a variety of landscapes. You'll haul cargo such as boxes and barrels, then park the truck in the designated locations.

Uneven, rocky roads make the job harder, so you'll need to watch the terrain closely. Driving slowly helps make sure your cargo doesn't fall off, because a lost load means you fail the mission. Controls are simple: just mouse click or tap to play.
santa-city-run: Santa has a stack of presents to get to the right homes, and you control his dash through a busy city. Sprint down the streets while dodging every obstacle in your path, and try to rack up as many points as you can before you run out of room to move.

You steer with the arrow keys on a keyboard, or by tapping the screen if you are playing on a touch device. The game is fast and chaotic, so quick reactions matter as much as careful timing. It is a festive, holiday-themed runner that is easy to pick up and hard to put down.
penalty-kick: Penalty Kick puts you on the spot in tense football showdowns. Each shot calls for careful aim and well-timed kicks. The goalkeeper and defenders are always trying to stop you, so you need to keep them guessing and find the gap that gets the ball past them.

Every goal you score earns points, and those points help you unlock new balls. There is no time limit, so you can take your time with every kick and plan each shot without a clock hurrying you along. Practice at your own pace and sharpen your skills until you feel confident on the penalty spot.
one-bit: One Bit puts you in control of a pixel character who must make its way along a series of tracks. This single-player 2D platform adventure asks you to push through each obstacle, and you can set a checkpoint along the way so you do not have to start over from the beginning. Clearing every obstacle is how you win.
Movement uses W, A, S and D or the arrow keys, while C sets your checkpoint. Players on mobile devices can rely on the touch controls displayed on the screen to get around.
drawrider: Drawrider combines sketching with racing. Before each run, you draw the wheels your rider will use, and then the race begins. Each new challenge needs a fresh pair, because every one asks for a different wheel shape, so you will need to vary your designs as you move forward.

Speed counts, so race fast to get through all the levels successfully. The wheels you draw are what decide each race, so think about the shape before you start drawing. Drawing the right wheels is how you win.
neon-shot: Neon Shot puts you in a neon-lit universe where you use a catapult to hurl vividly colored projectiles. Your goal is to hit precise spots and shatter the targets. Each level tests your strategy, because you have to adjust the trajectory of your shots. Stages begin with easy targets and grow into tough challenges, all in a bright arcade style.
Along the way, you can collect coins. Keep your aim true and you can reach victory with plenty of glowing style.
offroad-jeep-hills-driving: Take a bumpy trip over rugged hills while thick fog rolls across the scenery. You sit behind the wheel of a powerful jeep and steer it over tough ground, threading your way past rows of palm trees. The physics feel lifelike, and the surroundings are built to pull you in, so the terrain feels real. Nature throws plenty of obstacles your way, and getting past them is what this genuine offroad drive is all about.
Use WASD to drive the jeep.
fastlane-road-to-revenge: Fastlane: Road to Revenge is an online racing game with a strong combat side. You choose your fastest vehicle and the most powerful weapon to go with it. Your goal is to clear the barriers blocking the street while you battle a fierce, cruel wanted man. Speed matters, but so does staying alive as you race along the road.

The game is played with the mouse. It belongs to the Action category and is tagged Arcade, Racing, and Shooting, which reflects how it mixes driving with gunfire. If you enjoy fast pursuits with plenty of firepower, this title covers both sides of that appeal.
obby-keyboard-run-1-speed: Hop and sprint across giant keyboard keys in this 3D parkour challenge. Your pace climbs with every stride, so the longer you keep moving, the faster you get. Courses full of hurdles test your timing, and each win you gather can be spent on upgrades for your character. Two separate worlds are waiting, and you can wander through either one whenever you like. Your progress is saved, so you can pick up where you left off.

Controls are simple. Press W, A, S, and D to move and the Space bar to leap. Hold the right mouse button to turn your view. On a phone, a joystick handles movement, dragging rotates the camera, and tapping Jump makes you hop. Reach the trophy at the end of a course to finish it.
blocky-combat-swat-original-2026: Step into the blocky, pixel-filled fighting of Blocky Combat Swat Original 2026, a newer take on the voxel shooter you may already know. Tactical battles take place in environments that can be broken apart as you fight through them. You can storm enemy strongholds in single-player missions, or compete in quick multiplayer arenas where the goal is to top the leaderboard.

This year's version brings sharper gameplay, a broad range of blocky guns to pick from, and bright, low-poly visuals. Use Tab to open the in-game menu, WASD to walk, and the mouse to aim and shoot. Scroll the wheel to swap between weapons. Gather
eatable-birds: Eatable Birds puts you in the air, gliding over colorful scenery where staying alive depends on agility and fast reactions. Your flight path brings you close to dangerous creatures such as furious eagles and bees, so you must steer clear of them. The controls are straightforward and easy to pick up, which keeps the focus on movement and timing.
Each stage takes you on a journey past many different kinds of birds, giving the game a varied feel from one level to the next. It is a lighthearted pick that people of every age can enjoy.
